metadata.source: B.D. Basu, Allahabad 1923-1925 (Sacred Books of the Hindus, 27)

children.translated_text: Now, therefore, the inquiry into <s>dharma</s> (duty/righteousness). / Jaim 1.1.1 /
<s>Dharma</s> is the object (<s>artha</s>) characterized by Vedic injunction (<s>codanā</s>). / Jaim 1.1.2 /
Its [i.e. dharma's] investigation of causes [is the subject of this treatise]. / Jaim 1.1.3 /

children.text: satsaṃprayoge puruṣasyendriyāṇāṃ buddhijanma tatpratyakṣam animittaṃ vidyamānopalambhanatvāt / Jaim_1,1.4 /
children.translated_text: When there is contact of a person's sense-organs with an existing [object], the arising of cognition is <s>pratyakṣa</s> (perception); it is not a means [for knowing dharma], because it apprehends [only] what is present. / Jaim 1.1.4 /

children.text: autpattikas tu śabdasyārthena saṃbandhas tasya jñānam upadeśo 'vyatirekaś cārthe 'nupalabdhe tatpramāṇaṃ bādarāyaṇasyānapekṣatvāt / Jaim_1,1.5 /
children.translated_text: The relation of a word with its meaning is innate (<s>autpattika</s>); the knowledge of that [relation] is instruction (<s>upadeśa</s>); and there is non-deviation regarding an object that is not [otherwise] apprehended — that [Vedic word] is a <s>pramāṇa</s> (means of valid knowledge); [this is] the view of <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s>, because of [its] independence [from any human author]. / Jaim 1.1.5 /
Some [say the word denotes] action (<s>karma</s>), because it is seen [to do so]. / Jaim 1.1.6 /
Because there is no [fixed] locus [for a universal]. / Jaim 1.1.7 /
Because of the word 'karoti' (he does/makes). / Jaim 1.1.8 /
And because of simultaneity in different beings. / Jaim 1.1.9 /
And [because of the relation] between the original (<s>prakṛti</s>) and the modified (<s>vikṛti</s>) [forms]. / Jaim 1.1.10 /
And there is increase [of denotation] for this [word] through the multiplicity of agents. / Jaim 1.1.11 /
But the observation [of denotation] there is the same [for both views]. / Jaim 1.1.12 /
The non-observation of what exists [is due to] the non-arrival [in the range] of the sense-objects. / Jaim 1.1.13 /
[The non-observation is] subsequent to usage. / Jaim 1.1.14 /
Simultaneity, like [that of] the sun. / Jaim 1.1.15 /
A difference of phoneme is not a modification [of the word]. / Jaim 1.1.16 /
[Objection:] The increase of sound [constitutes modification] — no, [the increase is merely] supplementary. / Jaim 1.1.17 /

children.text: nityas tu syād darśanasya parārthatvāt / Jaim_1,1.18 /
children.translated_text: But [the word] would be eternal, because the observation [of it] serves another's purpose. / Jaim 1.1.18 /
Because of simultaneity everywhere. / Jaim 1.1.19 /
Because of the absence of [a fixed] number. / Jaim 1.1.20 /
Because of [its] independence [from any producer]. / Jaim 1.1.21 /
And because there is no appearance [of newness] in the conjunction [of word and meaning]. / Jaim 1.1.22 /
And because of the observation of indicatory marks (<s>liṅga</s>). / Jaim 1.1.23 /

children.text: uttpattau vāvacanāḥ syur arthasyātan nimittatvāt / Jaim_1,1.24 /
children.translated_text: Or, at [the time of] origination, [the names] would be [merely] utterances, because the object is not their cause. / Jaim 1.1.24 /
The traditional teaching of those that have become that [i.e. conventional words] is for the purpose of action, because the object is their cause. / Jaim 1.1.25 /
Because of the restriction in the world, there would be proximity of usage. / Jaim 1.1.26 /
Some [say] that even the <s>Vedas</s> are [merely] a proximity [of usage], [being] authored by persons. / Jaim 1.1.27 /
And because of the observation of non-eternality. / Jaim 1.1.28 /
But it has been stated that the word is prior [to meaning]. / Jaim 1.1.29 /
The name [of a Vedic text derives] from the act of teaching (<s>pravacana</s>). / Jaim 1.1.30 /
But the other [argument is based on] mere similarity of [Vedic] utterance [to worldly speech]. / Jaim 1.1.31 /

children.text: kṛte vā viniyogaḥ syāt karmaṇaḥ saṃbandhāt / Jaim_1,1.32 /
children.translated_text: Or the application [of an injunction] would be to an action already performed, because of its connection with the ritual. / Jaim 1.1.32 /

children.text: āmnāyasya kriyārthatvād ānarthakyam atadarthānāṃ tasmād anityam ucyate / Jaim_1,2.1 /
children.translated_text: Since the sacred tradition (<s>āmnāya</s>) has action as its purpose, what is not for that purpose is purposeless; therefore [such passages] are called 'non-eternal' [i.e. dependent/secondary]. / Jaim 1.2.1 /
And because there is no conflict with what is seen in the <s>śāstra</s>. / Jaim 1.2.2 /
And because [such passages] do not produce [an independent] result. / Jaim 1.2.3 /
Because of the purposelessness of the other [i.e. taking them as independent]. / Jaim 1.2.4 /
And because of the prohibition [against giving a share] to one who has no share. / Jaim 1.2.5 /
Because of the connection with what is non-eternal [i.e. context-dependent]. / Jaim 1.2.6 /

children.text: vidhinā tv ekavākyatvāt stutyarthena vidhīnāṃ syuḥ / Jaim_1,2.7 /
children.translated_text: But because of being one sentence with the injunction (<s>vidhi</s>), they would serve the purpose of praise (<s>stuti</s>) for the injunctions. / Jaim 1.2.7 /
And the traditional [interpretation] is the same. / Jaim 1.2.8 /

children.text: āptā cānupapattiḥ prayoge hi virodhaḥ syāc chabdārthas tv aprayogabhūtas tasmād upapadyeta / Jaim_1,2.9 /
children.translated_text: The established [interpretation] is fitting, because in actual performance there would be a conflict; but the meaning of the word, being beyond [actual] performance, would be tenable. / Jaim 1.2.9 /
But [it is] a <s>guṇavāda</s> (subsidiary/commendatory statement). / Jaim 1.2.10 /
Because of [its] form, in most cases. / Jaim 1.2.11 /
Because of the preponderance of being remote [from the injunction]. / Jaim 1.2.12 /
And because of the fault of the agent — the example of the son. / Jaim 1.2.13 /
A desire that is [independent of] time [would make it an injunction]. / Jaim 1.2.14 /
[It is merely] praise of knowledge. / Jaim 1.2.15 /
The 'all-ness' [belongs to] the context of eligibility. / Jaim 1.2.16 /

children.text: phalasya karmaniṣpattes teṣāṃ lokavatparimāṇataḥ phalaviśeṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_1,2.17 /
children.translated_text: Since the result is accomplished by the ritual action, their [i.e. the <s>arthavāda</s> passages'] specification of result would be [determined] from their measure, as in the world. / Jaim 1.2.17 /
For the last two, as stated. / Jaim 1.2.18 /

children.text: vidhir vā syād apūrvatvād vādamātrama hy anarthakam / Jaim_1,2.19 /
children.translated_text: Or it would be an injunction (<s>vidhi</s>), because of its unprecedented nature; for mere argument is purposeless. / Jaim 1.2.19 /
If [one says] 'as in the world' — / Jaim 1.2.20 /
No, because of [its] priority [over worldly usage]. / Jaim 1.2.21 /
But it has been stated [that it is] a sentence-complement (<s>vākyaśeṣa</s>). / Jaim 1.2.22 /

children.text: vidhiś cānarthakaḥ kvacit tasmāt stutiḥ pratīyeta tatsāmānyād itareṣu tathātvam / Jaim_1,2.23 /
children.translated_text: And the injunction is sometimes purposeless; therefore praise (<s>stuti</s>) should be understood; and because of the similarity [of form], it is the same in the other cases. / Jaim 1.2.23 /

children.text: prakaraṇe sambhavannapakarṣo na kalpyeta vidhyānarthakyaṃ hi taṃ prati / Jaim_1,2.24 /
children.translated_text: When it is possible [to interpret it] within the [injunctive] context, a forced [secondary] interpretation should not be postulated, for the injunction would become purposeless with respect to it. / Jaim 1.2.24 /
And in [the case of] an injunction, there would be a splitting of the sentence. / Jaim 1.2.25 /
Or it would be a reason (<s>hetu</s>), because of meaningfulness and propriety. / Jaim 1.2.26 /
But the [established interpretation] stands, because of the priority of the word, and because there is no injunctive force for it. / Jaim 1.2.27 /
If [one objects that] praise without a purpose is improper — / Jaim 1.2.28 /

children.text: arthas tu vidhiśeṣatvād yathā loke / Jaim_1,2.29 /
children.translated_text: The purpose [of praise] is that it is subsidiary to the injunction, as in the world. / Jaim 1.2.29 /

children.text: yadi ca hetur avatiṣṭheta nirdeśāt sāmānyād iti ced avasthā vidhīnāṃ syāt / Jaim_1,2.30 /
children.translated_text: If the reason stands firm, [one might argue] from specification or from generality — if so, there would be a fixed position for the injunctions. / Jaim 1.2.30 /
Because of the <s>śāstra</s> serving that purpose. / Jaim 1.2.31 /
Because of the restriction of [syntactic] sentence [unity]. / Jaim 1.2.32 /
Because of the <s>śāstra</s> [that deals with] understanding. / Jaim 1.2.33 /
Because of the statement regarding what is non-existent. / Jaim 1.2.34 /
Because of the attachment of purpose to what is insentient. / Jaim 1.2.35 /
Because of contradiction in meaning. / Jaim 1.2.36 /
Because of the statement [being] like [that regarding] <s>svādhyāya</s> (Vedic recitation). / Jaim 1.2.37 /
Because of being unknowable [through other means]. / Jaim 1.2.38 /
Because of the connection with what is non-eternal, the meaning of <s>mantras</s> is purposeless. / Jaim 1.2.39 /
But the sentence-meaning is undifferentiated. / Jaim 1.2.40 /
The [Vedic] text recurs for the purpose of a subsidiary [element]. / Jaim 1.2.41 /
[It is] an enumeration (<s>parisaṅkhyā</s>). / Jaim 1.2.42 /
Or [it is] an <s>arthavāda</s> (commendatory passage). / Jaim 1.2.43 /
The later [interpretation, being] non-contradictory, [is preferable]. / Jaim 1.2.44 /

In the <s>saṃpraiṣa</s> (directive formula), the censure of a [badly performed] action is not a reproach [of the performer], because it serves the purpose of consecration (<s>saṃskāra</s>). / Jaim 1.2.45 /
In the case of a designation, [it is] an <s>arthavāda</s>. / Jaim 1.2.46 /
There should be no prohibition based on a subsidiary [element]. / Jaim 1.2.47 /
The statement of [mere] knowledge, because of non-connection [with action]. / Jaim 1.2.48 /
The supreme knowledge of what exists [is independent of ritual]. / Jaim 1.2.49 /
And the connection with what is non-eternal has been stated. / Jaim 1.2.50 /
And the teaching through indicatory marks (<s>liṅga</s>) is meaningful in relation to that [ritual action]. / Jaim 1.2.51 /
[Such modification is] adaptation (<s>ūha</s>). / Jaim 1.2.52 /
And [there are] injunctive words [within mantras as well]. / Jaim 1.2.53 /

children.text: dharmasya śabdamūlatvād aśabdam anapekṣaṃ syāt / Jaim_1,3.1 /
children.translated_text: Since <s>dharma</s> has its root in the word [i.e. Vedic text], what is not based on the word would be disregarded. / Jaim 1.3.1 /

children.text: api vā kartṛsāmānyāt pramāṇam anumānaṃ syāt / Jaim_1,3.2 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of commonality of the agent [i.e. learned persons], inference (<s>anumāna</s>) may be a <s>pramāṇa</s>. / Jaim 1.3.2 /

children.text: virodhe tv anapekṣyaṃ syād asati hy anumānam / Jaim_1,3.3 /
children.translated_text: But in case of conflict, [inference] should be disregarded, for inference [operates only] in the absence [of scriptural evidence]. / Jaim 1.3.3 /
And because of the observation of a reason. / Jaim 1.3.4 /
If [one says it is valid] because there is no disturbance [to the conduct] of the learned, [and therefore it is] non-contradictory — / Jaim 1.3.5 /
No, because <s>śāstra</s> is the [sole] measure. / Jaim 1.3.6 /

children.text: api vā kāraṇagrahaṇe prayuktāni pratīyeran / Jaim_1,3.7 /
children.translated_text: Or, [the practices of the learned] would be understood as employed for the grasping of a cause. / Jaim 1.3.7 /

children.text: teṣv adarśanād virodhasya samā vipratipattiḥ syāt / Jaim_1,3.8 /
children.translated_text: Since conflict is not observed in those [practices], the divergence [of opinion] would be equal [i.e. inconclusive]. / Jaim 1.3.8 /
Or [those practices] are grounded in <s>śāstra</s>, because [the śāstra] is their cause. / Jaim 1.3.9 /
But what is enjoined should be accepted, because of non-conflict with the <s>pramāṇa</s>. / Jaim 1.3.10 /
If [one says it is a] <s>śāstra</s> of [mere] practice — / Jaim 1.3.11 /
No, because there is no fixed restriction. / Jaim 1.3.12 /
And because it is not a sentence-complement. / Jaim 1.3.13 /

children.text: sarvatra ca prayogāt sannidhānaśāstrāc ca / Jaim_1,3.14 /
children.translated_text: And because of [its] universal practice, and because of the <s>śāstra</s> of proximity. / Jaim 1.3.14 /
Because of the establishment of inference, what is connected with that [inference] would be a <s>pramāṇa</s>. / Jaim 1.3.15 /

children.text: api vā sarva dharmaḥ syāt tannyāyatvād vidhānasya / Jaim_1,3.16 /
children.translated_text: Or everything would be <s>dharma</s>, because the injunction is of that nature. / Jaim 1.3.16 /
The application would be [determined] from observation. / Jaim 1.3.17 /
And because of the absence of an indicatory mark for the eternal [word]. / Jaim 1.3.18 /
For the name [derives] from connection with a place. / Jaim 1.3.19 /

children.text: na syād deśāntareṣv iti cet / Jaim_1,3.20 /
children.translated_text: If [one objects] that it would not [apply] in other places — / Jaim 1.3.20 /
There would be a name based on connection, like [one called] '<s>Māthura</s>' (from <s>Mathurā</s>). / Jaim 1.3.21 /
Or [the name] would be a property of the ritual action, like [the river] <s>Pravaṇa</s> (flowing). / Jaim 1.3.22 /
But it is equal [in force] to [being] a property of the agent. / Jaim 1.3.23 /

children.text: prayogotpatyaśāstratvāc chabdeṣu na vyavasthā syāt / Jaim_1,3.24 /
children.translated_text: Since origin from effort in [the production of] words has no <s>śāstra</s> [as authority], there would be no fixed determination regarding words. / Jaim 1.3.24 /
Because words are produced through effort, the fault belongs [to the speaker, not the word]. / Jaim 1.3.25 /
And it is improper for there to be multiple words [for one meaning]. / Jaim 1.3.26 /
The truth therein would be [determined] from the specific effort. / Jaim 1.3.27 /
And the incapacity of that [effort to alter the word] is because of conformity [of words to fixed forms]. / Jaim 1.3.28 /

children.text: eka deśatvāc ca vibhāktivyatyaye syāt / Jaim_1,3.29 /
children.translated_text: And because of being part [of the same word], there would be interchange of case-endings. / Jaim 1.3.29 /
Because there is no injunction of usage, the meaning is one, because of non-differentiation. / Jaim 1.3.30 /
Because of not being a word for substance. / Jaim 1.3.31 /
And because of the observation of another [denotation]. / Jaim 1.3.32 /
But [the word denotes] the universal form (<s>ākṛti</s>), because of [its] serving the purpose of action. / Jaim 1.3.33 /

children.text: na kriyā syād iti cedarthāntare vidhānaṃ na dravyam iti cet / Jaim_1,3.34 /
children.translated_text: If [one says] there would be no action — if [one says] the injunction is of a different thing — if [one says] it is not the substance — / Jaim 1.3.34 /
[There is] non-differentiation because the practice serves that purpose. / Jaim 1.3.35 /

children.text: uktaṃ samāmnāyaidam arthyaṃ tasmāt sarvaṃ tadarthaṃ syāt / Jaim_1,4.1 /
children.translated_text: It has been stated that this sacred tradition (<s>samāmnāya</s>) is purposeful; therefore everything [in it] would serve that purpose. / Jaim 1.4.1 /

children.text: api vā nāmadheyaṃ syād yadutpattāvapūrvam avidhāyakatvāt / Jaim_1,4.2 /
children.translated_text: Or the <s>nāmadheya</s> (name) would be that which is unprecedented at the time of its origination, because of its non-enjoining nature. / Jaim 1.4.2 /
That in which the teaching of a subsidiary [element] has its principal connection [with an injunction]. / Jaim 1.4.3 /
And another <s>śāstra</s> [passage] that is [merely] an expression of that [already enjoined thing]. / Jaim 1.4.4 /
And [a passage that is] a designation of that [thing]. / Jaim 1.4.5 /

children.text: nāmadheye guṇaśruteḥ syād vidhānam iti cet / Jaim_1,4.6 /
children.translated_text: If [one says] that in the name, because of the mention of a subsidiary quality, there would be an injunction — / Jaim 1.4.6 /
No, because of the equality of the two actions. / Jaim 1.4.7 /
When there is identity of word, [it is] like [that which] serves another's purpose. / Jaim 1.4.8 /

children.text: tadguṇās tu vidhāyer annavibhāgād vidhānārthe na ced anyena śiṣṭāḥ / Jaim_1,4.9 /
children.translated_text: But the subsidiaries of that [injunction] would be enjoined, because of the non-separation from the enjoined purpose — unless they are [already] taught by another [passage]. / Jaim 1.4.9 /

In [the case of] <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) and <s>ājya</s> (clarified butter), when there is no consecration, because of obtaining [their identity from] the word, the word [used for them] is other than that [i.e. they are not named by the ritual name]. / Jaim 1.4.10 /
In the <s>prokṣaṇī</s> (sprinkling) waters, because of connection with purpose. / Jaim 1.4.11 /
Similarly in the fire produced by churning (<s>nirmanthya</s>). / Jaim 1.4.12 /
If [one says there is] an option in the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [offering] — / Jaim 1.4.13 /

children.text: na vā prakaraṇāt pratyakṣavidhānāc ca na hi prakaraṇaṃ dravyasya / Jaim_1,4.14 /
children.translated_text: Or not, because of the [injunctive] context, and because of the explicit injunction — for the context does not [determine] the substance. / Jaim 1.4.14 /
And the mutual non-connection of purpose. / Jaim 1.4.15 /
Because the subsidiary elements serve another's purpose. / Jaim 1.4.16 /
Those preceded [by an earlier injunction] are not for the purpose of [a new] injunction; their efficacy [is established] from the sacred tradition. / Jaim 1.4.17 /

children.text: guṇasya tu vidhānārthe tadguṇāḥ prayoge syur anarthakā na hi taṃ pratyarthavattāsti / Jaim_1,4.18 /
children.translated_text: But the subsidiaries of a subsidiary that is for the purpose of an injunction would be purposeless in practice, for there is no purposefulness of that [subsidiary] with respect to it [i.e. the sub-subsidiary]. / Jaim 1.4.18 /
Its remainder is untenable. / Jaim 1.4.19 /
Because of non-differentiation, [the passages] that are for the purpose of injunction would be tenable as serving the purpose of praise. / Jaim 1.4.20 /
If [one says] there would be a cause — / Jaim 1.4.21 /

children.text: ānarthakyād akāraṇaṃ kartur hi kāraṇāni guṇārtho hi vidhīyate / Jaim_1,4.22 /
children.translated_text: Because of purposelessness, it is not a cause; for the causes belong to the agent, since what is enjoined serves the purpose of a subsidiary. / Jaim 1.4.22 /
The establishment of that. / Jaim 1.4.23 /
[It is determined by] genus (<s>jāti</s>). / Jaim 1.4.24 /
Because of similarity of form. / Jaim 1.4.25 /
[It is] praise. / Jaim 1.4.26 /
[It is determined by] the greater number (<s>bhūmā</s>). / Jaim 1.4.27 /
Because of the co-inherence of the indicatory mark. / Jaim 1.4.28 /
In doubtful cases, from the sentence-complement. / Jaim 1.4.29 /
Or from the meaning, because of being a partial postulation. / Jaim 1.4.30 /

children.text: bhāvārthāḥ karmaśabdās tebhyaḥ kriyā pratīyetaiṣa hy artho vidhīyate / Jaim_2,1.1 /
children.translated_text: Words for action (<s>karmaśabda</s>) denote coming-into-being (<s>bhāva</s>); from them an action (<s>kriyā</s>) is to be understood — for it is this [i.e. the action] that is enjoined. / Jaim 2.1.1 /
If [one says] the meaning of all [words] is coming-into-being — / Jaim 2.1.2 /

children.text: yeṣām utpattau sve prayoge rūpopalabdhis tāni nāmāni tasmāt tebhyaḥ parākāṅkṣā bhūtatvāt sve prayogai / Jaim_2,1.3 /
children.translated_text: Those whose form is perceived at the time of origination in their own [independent] use — those are nouns (<s>nāmāni</s>); therefore from them there is an expectation of something else, because in their own use they are [already] established (<s>bhūta</s>). / Jaim 2.1.3 /

children.text: yeṣāṃ tūtpattāv arthe sve prayogo na vidyate tāny ākhyātāni tasmāt tebhyaḥ pratīyetāśritatvāt prayogasya / Jaim_2,1.4 /
children.translated_text: But those for which there is no independent use at the time of origination with respect to the object — those are verbs (<s>ākhyātāni</s>); therefore from them [the action] is to be understood, because the usage depends on [them]. / Jaim 2.1.4 /
The injunction (<s>codanā</s>) is a fresh beginning [i.e. initiates action]. / Jaim 2.1.5 /
Those [ritual elements] are of two kinds: subsidiary (<s>guṇa</s>) and principal (<s>pradhāna</s>). / Jaim 2.1.6 /

children.text: yair dravyaṃ na cikīrṣyate tāni pradhānabhūtāni dravyasya guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_2,1.7 /
children.translated_text: Those by which a substance is not intended to be produced — those are principal, because substance is subsidiary [to them]. / Jaim 2.1.7 /

children.text: yais tu dravyaṃ cikīrṣyate guṇas tatra pratīyeta tasya dravyapradhānatvāt / Jaim_2,1.8 /
children.translated_text: But those by which a substance is intended to be produced — the subsidiary is to be understood therein, because substance is the principal [element] of that [rite]. / Jaim 2.1.8 /

children.text: dharmamātre tu karma syād anirvṛtteḥ prayājavat / Jaim_2,1.9 /
children.translated_text: But in [the case of] <s>dharma</s> alone, it would be a [mere] action, because it is not [yet] accomplished — like the <s>prayāja</s> (preliminary oblation). / Jaim 2.1.9 /
Or, because of equal [Vedic] textual support, it would have common properties with the others. / Jaim 2.1.10 /
If [one argues] from the teaching regarding substance — / Jaim 2.1.11 /

children.text: na tadarthatvāl lokavat tasya ca śeṣabhūtatvāt / Jaim_2,1.12 /
children.translated_text: No, because [the substance] serves that [action's] purpose, as in the world; and because that [substance] is subsidiary. / Jaim 2.1.12 /

children.text: stutaśastrayos tu saṃskāro yājyāvad devatābhidhānatvāt / Jaim_2,1.13 /
children.translated_text: But in the case of the laudatory and imprecatory [hymns], the consecration (<s>saṃskāra</s>) is like [that of] the <s>yājyā</s> [hymn], because of the mention of the deity. / Jaim 2.1.13 /

children.text: arthena tv apakṛṣyeta devatānām acodanārthasya guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_2,1.14 /
children.translated_text: But [the deity] would be subordinated by the [ritual] purpose, because the deity, not being the object of the injunction, is subsidiary. / Jaim 2.1.14 /
Or it would serve the purpose of a subsidiary, like [the case of] the <s>vaśā</s> (barren cow). / Jaim 2.1.15 /
No, because of [its] co-inherence with the <s>śruti</s> (scriptural text). / Jaim 2.1.16 /
And because of the difference of designation. / Jaim 2.1.17 /
And the subsidiary would be purposeless [if deity were merely subsidiary]. / Jaim 2.1.18 /
Similarly [in the case of] the <s>yājyā</s> and <s>puroruc</s> [hymns]. / Jaim 2.1.19 /
[The directive applies] to the barren cow, because of the co-inherence of purpose. / Jaim_2,1.20 /
Or, [the particle] 'yat ca' would have significance, because it has a purpose. / Jaim_2,1.21 /
But not in those that are taught [by scripture]. / Jaim_2,1.22 /
[For this] is observed [in practice]. / Jaim_2,1.23 /

children.text: api vā śrutisaṃyogāt prakaraṇe stautiśaṃsatī kriyotpāttiṃ vidadhyātām / Jaim_2,1.24 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the connection with scripture, in the context the <s>stauti</s> (laudatory hymn) and <s>śaṃsati</s> (recitation) would establish the origin of the ritual act. / Jaim_2,1.24 /
And because of the distinctness of the words. / Jaim_2,1.25 /
And that statement would be purposeless. / Jaim_2,1.26 /
And a different meaning is apprehended. / Jaim_2,1.27 /
And the designation [is] like that of a rite. / Jaim_2,1.28 /
And the accomplishment of the result [supports this]. / Jaim_2,1.29 /
The unity of purpose between the injunction and the <s>mantra</s> [is established] from the unity of expression. / Jaim_2,1.30 /

children.text: api vā prayogasāmarthyān mantro 'bhidhānavācī syāt / Jaim_2,1.31 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the capacity for application, the <s>mantra</s> would be expressive of designation. / Jaim_2,1.31 /
In those that prompt [ritual action], the designation '<s>mantra</s>' [applies]. / Jaim_2,1.32 /
In the remainder, the term '<s>brāhmaṇa</s>' [applies]. / Jaim_2,1.33 /
In those not taught [as <s>mantras</s>], the non-<s>mantra</s> status [applies]; for in those that are taught, the distinction [is maintained]. / Jaim_2,1.34 /
Among them, the classification as <s>ṛc</s> (verse) is determined by the arrangement of metrical feet (<s>pāda</s>) based on purpose. / Jaim_2,1.35 /
In songs, the designation '<s>sāman</s>' [applies]. / Jaim_2,1.36 /
In the remainder, the term '<s>yajus</s>' [applies]. / Jaim_2,1.37 /

children.text: nigado vā caturthaṃ syād dharmaviśeṣāt / Jaim_2,1.38 /
children.translated_text: Or <s>nigada</s> (spoken formula) would be a fourth [category], because of the specific nature [of its function]. / Jaim_2,1.38 /
And because of the designation [as such]. / Jaim_2,1.39 /
Or [they are] <s>yajus</s> (sacrificial formulas), because they have that form. / Jaim_2,1.40 /
The specific nature is [known] from the verbal statement. / Jaim_2,1.41 /
And from the purpose. / Jaim_2,1.42 /
The designation is for the purpose of [indicating] a subsidiary [quality]. / Jaim_2,1.43 /
If [it is argued that this applies] to all — / Jaim_2,1.44 /
No, because of the designation as <s>ṛc</s> (verse). / Jaim_2,1.45 /

children.text: arthaikatvād ekaṃ vākyaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ ced vibhāge syāt / Jaim_2,1.46 /
children.translated_text: Because of unity of purpose, [it constitutes] one sentence; if there is syntactic expectancy upon division, [it would remain one sentence]. / Jaim_2,1.46 /
When [the elements are] equal, there would be a division of sentences. / Jaim_2,1.47 /
The connection (<s>anuṣaṅga</s>) [serves as] the completion of the sentence for all, because of equal applicability. / Jaim_2,1.48 /
[But] because of intervention, [it] should not be connected. / Jaim_2,1.49 /
When there is a different word, there is a difference of rites, because of the established connection. / Jaim_2,2.1 /

children.text: ekasyaivaṃ punaḥ śrutir aviśeṣād anarthakaṃ hi syāt / Jaim_2,2.2 /
children.translated_text: For one and the same [rite], such a repetition of the scripture, being without distinction, would indeed be purposeless. / Jaim_2,2.2 /
But the context [determines the connection] with the full-moon [offering], because the form is not [separately] stated. / Jaim_2,2.3 /

children.text: viśeṣadarśanāc ca sarveṣāṃ sameṣu hy apravṛttiḥ syāt / Jaim_2,2.4 /
children.translated_text: And because of the observation of a specific [characteristic]; for among equals, there would be non-application [of all]. / Jaim_2,2.4 /
But [it is] a subsidiary [element], because of the connection with scripture. / Jaim_2,2.5 /

children.text: codanā vā guṇānāṃ yugapacchāstrāc codite hi tadarthatvāt tasyatasyopadiśyeta / Jaim_2,2.6 /
children.translated_text: Or the injunction of the subsidiaries [would be] simultaneous, because of the scripture; for since they serve [the purpose of] the enjoined [rite], each would be taught in relation to each. / Jaim_2,2.6 /
And the designation is likewise. / Jaim_2,2.7 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory mark. / Jaim_2,2.8 /
The <s>upāṃśuyāja</s> (low-voiced offering) would be like the full-moon [offering]. / Jaim_2,2.9 /
Or [it is a separate] injunction, because it is not derived [from the archetype]. / Jaim_2,2.10 /
Because of the attachment of a subsidiary [quality]. / Jaim_2,2.11 /
And because of the statement in the <s>prāya</s> (expiatory rite). / Jaim_2,2.12 /
The <s>āghāra</s>-type <s>agnihotra</s> [is a separate rite], because it has no [typical] form. / Jaim_2,2.13 /
Because of the attachment of a [distinctive] name. / Jaim_2,2.14 /
And because it is not derived [from the archetype]. / Jaim_2,2.15 /

children.text: codanā vā śabdārthasya prayogabhūtatvāt tatsannidher guṇārthena punaḥ śrutiḥ / Jaim_2,2.16 /
children.translated_text: Or [it is an] injunction, because the meaning of the word has the nature of application; the repetition of scripture in its proximity is for the purpose of the subsidiary. / Jaim_2,2.16 /

children.text: dravyasaṃyogāc codanā paśusomayoḥ prakaraṇe hy anarthako dravyasaṃyogo na hi tasya guṇārthena / Jaim_2,2.17 /
children.translated_text: The injunction [applies] because of the connection with a substance in the case of the animal and <s>Soma</s> sacrifices; for in the context, the connection with a substance would be purposeless if not for its subsidiary purpose. / Jaim_2,2.17 /
And the preparatory rites (<s>saṃskāra</s>) are not [separately] enjoined. / Jaim_2,2.18 /

children.text: tadbhedāt karmaṇo 'bhyāso dravyapṛthaktvād anarthakaṃ hi syād bhedo dravyaguṇībhāvāt / Jaim_2,2.19 /
children.translated_text: Because of the difference of that [substance], there is a repetition of the rite; because of the separateness of substances, [the rite] would indeed be purposeless without distinction; the distinction [arises] from the substance becoming a qualifier. / Jaim_2,2.19 /

children.text: saṃskāras tu na bhidyeta parārthatvād dravyasya guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_2,2.20 /
children.translated_text: But the preparatory rite is not differentiated, because the substance serves another's purpose, being a subsidiary. / Jaim_2,2.20 /
Because of the placement of separateness, there would be a difference of rites based on number. / Jaim_2,2.21 /
And the name [is established] because of the connection with the origin [of the rite]. / Jaim_2,2.22 /
And the subsidiaries, when connected with a new [element], because of the equality of the two sentences. / Jaim_2,2.23 /

children.text: aguṇe tu karmaśabde guṇas tatra pratīyeta / Jaim_2,2.24 /
children.translated_text: But when the word for a rite has no subsidiary [attached], the subsidiary would be understood there [from context]. / Jaim_2,2.24 /

children.text: phalaśrutes tu karma syāt phalasya karmayogitvāt / Jaim_2,2.25 /
children.translated_text: But because of the scriptural mention of the result, it would be a [separate] rite, because the result is connected with a rite. / Jaim_2,2.25 /

children.text: atulyatvāt tu vākyayor guṇe tasya pratīyeta / Jaim_2,2.26 /
children.translated_text: But because of the inequality of the two sentences, its subsidiary [status] would be understood. / Jaim_2,2.26 /
Among equals, it would be connected with a rite. / Jaim_2,2.27 /
In the <s>Saubhara</s> [hymn], because of the mention of a person, the <s>nidhana</s> (concluding formula) is connected with a desired [result]. / Jaim_2,2.28 /

children.text: sarvasya voktakāmatvāt tasmin kāmaśrutiḥ syān nidhanārthā punaḥ śrutiḥ / Jaim_2,2.29 /
children.translated_text: Or, because the desire is mentioned for all, the mention of desire in that case would be for the purpose of the <s>nidhana</s>; the repetition [of scripture] is for the <s>nidhana</s>. / Jaim_2,2.29 /

children.text: guṇas tu kratusaṃyogāt karmāntaraṃ prayojayet saṃyogasyāśeṣabhūtvāt / Jaim_2,3.1 /
children.translated_text: But the subsidiary, because of the connection with the sacrifice, would require a separate rite, because the connection is not exhausted [by the first rite]. / Jaim_2,3.1 /

children.text: ekasya tu liṅgabhedāt prayojanārtham ucyetaikatvaṃ guṇavākyatvāt / Jaim_2,3.2 /
children.translated_text: But for one [rite], because of the distinction of the indicatory mark, the oneness would be stated for the sake of purpose, because it is a subsidiary statement. / Jaim_2,3.2 /
In the <s>aveṣṭi</s> (auxiliary offering), because of the connection with the sacrifice, the principal sacrifice is stated. / Jaim_2,3.3 /
In the <s>ādhāna</s> (fire-establishment), because it serves as subsidiary to all [rites]. / Jaim_2,3.4 /
In the <s>ayanas</s> (half-year periods), [there is] a separate injunction, because of the attachment of a [distinctive] name. / Jaim_2,3.5 /
And because there is no subsidiary [quality], [it is] an injunction of a [separate] rite. / Jaim_2,3.6 /
And the sentence is complete in [stating] the result. / Jaim_2,3.7 /
Or [it is] a modification (<s>vikāra</s>), because of the context. / Jaim_2,3.8 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory mark. / Jaim_2,3.9 /
The attachment of the name is due to the subsidiary [quality]. / Jaim_2,3.10 /
The completion is undistinguished. / Jaim_2,3.11 /
And the preparatory rite, when not in the context [of a specific rite], because it is not a word for a rite. / Jaim_2,3.12 /

children.text: yāvad uktaṃ vā karmaṇaḥ śrutimūlatvāt / Jaim_2,3.13 /
children.translated_text: Or to the extent stated, because the rite is rooted in scripture. / Jaim_2,3.13 /

children.text: yajatis tu dravyaphalabhoktṛsaṃyogād eteṣāṃ karmasambandhāt / Jaim_2,3.14 /
children.translated_text: But [the word] <s>yajati</s> ('he sacrifices') is [applied] because of the connection with the substance, the result, and the enjoyer — because of the connection of these with the rite. / Jaim_2,3.14 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory mark. / Jaim_2,3.15 /
Because of the observation of the prevailing [usage] regarding the subject. / Jaim_2,3.16 /
And because the <s>arthavāda</s> (laudatory passage) supports [this interpretation]. / Jaim_2,3.17 /

children.text: saṃyuktas tv arthaśabdena tadarthaḥ śrutisaṃyogāt / Jaim_2,3.18 /
children.translated_text: But [the rite] connected with the word 'purpose' serves that purpose, because of the connection with scripture. / Jaim_2,3.18 /
But in the <s>Pātnīvata</s> [offerings], because of priority, there is limitation. / Jaim_2,3.19 /
In the <s>kavala</s> (morsel offering), because it is not a [separate] substance, it would be subsidiary to the rite. / Jaim_2,3.20 /

children.text: agnis tu liṅgadarśanāt kratuśabdaḥ pratīyeta / Jaim_2,3.21 /
children.translated_text: But <s>Agni</s> (fire), because of the observation of an indicatory mark, would be understood as a word for the sacrifice (<s>kratu</s>). / Jaim_2,3.21 /

children.text: dravyaṃ vā syāc codanāyās tadarthatvāt / Jaim_2,3.22 /
children.translated_text: Or it would be a substance, because the injunction serves that purpose. / Jaim_2,3.22 /

children.text: tatsaṃyogāt kratus tadākhyaḥ syāt tena dharmavidhānāni / Jaim_2,3.23 /
children.translated_text: Because of connection with that, the sacrifice would be named after that; through that, the prescriptions of <s>dharma</s> [are established]. / Jaim_2,3.23 /
In another context, the purpose is different. / Jaim_2,3.24 /
And the result [is obtained] in the absence of a [specific] rite. / Jaim_2,3.25 /

children.text: saṃnidhau tv avibhāgāt phalārthena punaḥ śrutiḥ / Jaim_2,3.26 /
children.translated_text: But in proximity, because of non-distinction, the repetition of scripture is for the purpose of the result. / Jaim_2,3.26 /
Because of being the cause of the <s>Āgneya</s>-hymn, [it] would be understood through repetition. / Jaim_2,3.27 /

children.text: avibhāgāt tu karmaṇāṃ dvirukter na vidhīyate / Jaim_2,3.28 /
children.translated_text: But because of the non-distinction of rites, [a separate rite] is not enjoined by the double utterance. / Jaim_2,3.28 /
Or the repetition of scripture is for a different purpose. / Jaim_2,3.29 /
The lifelong repetition is a property of the rite, because of the context. / Jaim_2,4.1 /
Or [it is a property] of the performer, because of the connection with scripture. / Jaim_2,4.2 /

children.text: liṅgadarśanāc ca karmadharme hi prakrameṇa niyamyeta tatrānarthakam anyat syāt / Jaim_2,4.3 /
children.translated_text: And because of the observation of an indicatory mark; for if it is a property of the rite, [it] would be restricted by sequence; and in that case, the other [interpretation] would be purposeless. / Jaim_2,4.3 /

children.text: vyapavargaṃ ca darśayati kālaś cet karmabhedaḥ syāt / Jaim_2,4.4 /
children.translated_text: And [the text] shows a completion; if time [is the basis], there would be a difference of rites. / Jaim_2,4.4 /
But because of non-permanence, it should not be so. / Jaim_2,4.5 /
And there is also a contradiction, as before. / Jaim_2,4.6 /

children.text: kartus tu dharmaniyamāt kālaśāstraṃ nimittaṃ syāt / Jaim_2,4.7 /
children.translated_text: But because of the restriction of the duty on the performer, the time-prescription would be a [mere] occasion. / Jaim_2,4.7 /

Because of the observation of name, form, specific property, repetition, censure, capacity, completion, verbal statement, expiation, and different purpose, there would be a difference of rites in other [Vedic] recensions. / Jaim_2,4.8 /
Or [the rite is] one, because there is no distinction in the connection, form, injunction, and name. / Jaim_2,4.9 /
The difference would not arise from the name, because it is a designation of what is not enjoined. / Jaim_2,4.10 /
And all [recensions] would pertain to one rite. / Jaim_2,4.11 /
And the designation is artificially constructed. / Jaim_2,4.12 /
Even in [the case of] oneness, the other [arguments hold]. / Jaim_2,4.13 /
In the <s>Vidyā</s> (meditative upāsanā), [it is governed by] the rules of <s>dharma</s>. / Jaim_2,4.14 /
The re-statement [is] like the <s>Āgneya</s> [offering]. / Jaim_2,4.15 /
Or [it is] not a re-statement, because there is no distinction in the connection with scripture. / Jaim_2,4.16 /
And because of the absence of [mutual] proximity of meaning. / Jaim_2,4.17 /
And one [version] is not prohibited. / Jaim_2,4.18 /
And the examination is like the completion. / Jaim_2,4.19 /
Even in [the case of] oneness, the other [arguments] — censure, capacity, and completion-statements — [hold]. / Jaim_2,4.20 /
The expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>) is [determined] by the occasion. / Jaim_2,4.21 /
Or by the injunctive force of the sequence. / Jaim_2,4.22 /
The completion is [understood] as before, and would be apprehended as in the known [cases]. / Jaim_2,4.23 /

children.text: liṅgamaviśiṣṭaṃ sarvaśeṣatvān na hi tatra karmacodanā tasmāt dvādaśāhasyāhāravyapadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_2,4.24 /
children.translated_text: The indicatory mark is undistinguished, being subsidiary to all; for there is no injunction of a rite therein — therefore [it] would be a designation of the twelve-day [rite] as a food-[related term]. / Jaim_2,4.24 /

children.text: dravye cācoditatvād vidhīnām avyavasthā syān nirdeśād vyatiṣṭheta tasmān nityānuvādaḥ syāt / Jaim_2,4.25 /
children.translated_text: And regarding the substance, because it is not [separately] enjoined, there would be instability of injunctions; [the rite] would be established from the designation — therefore [the substance] would be a constant reference (<s>anuvāda</s>). / Jaim_2,4.25 /
Because of the prohibition of what is enjoined, in [such] a case there would be a surplus. / Jaim_2,4.26 /
In the <s>Sārasvata</s> [rite], because of conflict, the one that goes [is preferred]. / Jaim_2,4.27 /
In the <s>upahavya</s> (invocatory offering), [there is] no counter-exception. / Jaim_2,4.28 /
Or the repetition of scripture is for the purpose of a subsidiary. / Jaim_2,4.29 /
And [the text] also shows a basis for conviction. / Jaim_2,4.30 /

children.text: api vā kramasaṃyogād vidhipṛthaktvam ekasyāṃ vyavatiṣṭheta / Jaim_2,4.31 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the connection with sequence, the injunction would remain distinct within one [recension]. / Jaim_2,4.31 /

children.text: virodhinā tv asaṃyogād aikakarmye tatsaṃyogād vidhīnāṃ sarvakarmapratyayaḥ syāt / Jaim_2,4.32 /
children.translated_text: But because of the non-connection with a contradictory [element], when there is one rite, because of the connection with that, there would be the basis for conviction of the injunctions for all rites. / Jaim_2,4.32 /
Now, therefore, the definition of the subsidiary (<s>śeṣa</s>). / Jaim_3,1.1 /
The subsidiary [is so called] because it serves another's purpose. / Jaim_3,1.2 /
<s>Bādari</s> [holds this applies to] substances, qualities, and preparatory rites. / Jaim_3,1.3 /
<s>Jaimini</s> [holds that] the rites too [are subsidiaries], because they serve the purpose of the result. / Jaim_3,1.4 /
And the result too [is a subsidiary], because it serves the purpose of the person. / Jaim_3,1.5 /
And the person too [is a subsidiary], because he serves the purpose of the rite. / Jaim_3,1.6 /
Their connection is through purpose. / Jaim_3,1.7 /

children.text: vihitas tu sarvadharmaḥ syāt saṃyogato 'viśeṣāt prakaraṇāviśeṣāc ca / Jaim_3,1.8 /
children.translated_text: But what is enjoined would be a universal property, because of connection [and] because of non-distinction, and because of non-distinction of context. / Jaim_3,1.8 /
In the absence of purpose, [the rite] would be without action. / Jaim_3,1.9 /

children.text: phalaṃ tu saha ceṣṭayā śabdārtho 'bhāvād viprayoge syāt / Jaim_3,1.10 /
children.translated_text: But the result, together with the effort, would [occur] in separation from the verbal meaning, because of [its] absence. / Jaim_3,1.10 /

children.text: dravyaṃ cotpattisaṃyogāt tad artham eva codyeta / Jaim_3,1.11 /
children.translated_text: And the substance, because of the connection with origin, would be enjoined for that purpose. / Jaim_3,1.11 /

children.text: arthaikatve dravyaguṇayor aikakarmyān niyamaḥ syāt / Jaim_3,1.12 /
children.translated_text: When the purpose is one, a restriction would apply because of the oneness of the rite for substance and quality. / Jaim_3,1.12 /
What befits oneness belongs to one [rite], because of the connection with scripture. / Jaim_3,1.13 /

children.text: sarveṣāṃ vā lakṣaṇatvād aviśiṣṭaṃ hi lakṣaṇam / Jaim_3,1.14 /
children.translated_text: Or [it belongs] to all, because [the definition is] a characteristic, and a characteristic is undistinguished. / Jaim_3,1.14 /
Being enjoined and subsidiary, [it] would be understood according to the scriptural statement. / Jaim_3,1.15 /
Or from the preparatory rite, there would be instability of subsidiaries. / Jaim_3,1.16 /

children.text: vyavasthāvārthasya śrutisaṃyogāt tasya śabda pramāṇatvāt / Jaim_3,1.17 /
children.translated_text: Or the establishment [comes] from the connection of the purpose with scripture, because of the authoritativeness of the word for that. / Jaim_3,1.17 /
Because of purposelessness, [the same applies] to the subsidiaries of that [rite]. / Jaim_3,1.18 /

children.text: kartṛguṇe tu karmāsamavāyād vākyabhedaḥ syāt / Jaim_3,1.19 /
children.translated_text: But when [it is] a quality of the performer, because of non-co-inherence with the rite, there would be a division of sentences. / Jaim_3,1.19 /

children.text: sākāṅkṣaṃ tv ekavākyaṃ syād asamāptaṃ hi pūrveṇa / Jaim_3,1.20 /
children.translated_text: But when there is syntactic expectancy, it would be one sentence, because [it is] incomplete without the preceding. / Jaim_3,1.20 /
But when in doubt, because of intervention, there would be a division of sentences. / Jaim_3,1.21 /

children.text: guṇānāṃ ca parārthattvād asambandhaḥ samatvāt syāt / Jaim_3,1.22 /
children.translated_text: And because of the subsidiarity of the qualities, the absence of connection would be [inferred] from equality. / Jaim_3,1.22 /
And because of the mutual absence of purposeful connection. / Jaim_3,1.23 /
Mere sequence [of statements] is not an injunction. / Jaim_3,1.24 /
And because of the completeness of the sentences. / Jaim_3,1.25 /

children.text: śeṣas tu guṇasaṃyuktaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ pratīyeta mithas teṣām asambandhāt / Jaim_3,1.26 /
children.translated_text: But the subsidiary connected with a quality would be understood as common, because of the mutual absence of connection among them. / Jaim_3,1.26 /

children.text: vyavasthā vārthasaṃyogāl liṅgasyārthena sambandhāllakṣaṇārthā guṇaśrutiḥ / Jaim_3,1.27 /
children.translated_text: Or the establishment [would be] from the connection with purpose, because of the connection of the indicatory mark with purpose; the scriptural mention of the quality is for the purpose of characterization. / Jaim_3,1.27 /

children.text: arthābhidhānasāmarthyān mantreṣu śeṣabhāvaḥ syāt tasmād utpattisambandho 'rthena nityasaṃyogāt / Jaim_3,2.1 /
children.translated_text: Because of the capacity of expressing purpose, there would be subsidiary status in the <s>mantras</s>; therefore the connection with the origin [is established] from the constant connection with purpose. / Jaim_3,2.1 /
Because of being a preparatory agent, [the connection] would be with what is not [separately] enjoined. / Jaim_3,2.2 /

children.text: vacanāt tv ayathārtham aindrī syāt / Jaim_3,2.3 /
children.translated_text: But because of the verbal statement, contrary to the [actual] purpose, [it] would be the <s>Aindrī</s> [formula]. / Jaim_3,2.3 /

children.text: guṇād vāpy abhidhānaṃ syāt sambandhasyāśāstrahetutvāt / Jaim_3,2.4 /
children.translated_text: Or the designation would also be from the subsidiary [quality], because the connection does not have [the status of] a scriptural ground. / Jaim_3,2.4 /
If [one argues] that the same [applies to] the <s>āhavana</s> (invocatory fire) — / Jaim_3,2.5 /
There is no time-prescription, because [the rite] is already enjoined. / Jaim_3,2.6 /
Because of the absence of a subsidiary [quality]. / Jaim_3,2.7 /
And because of the indicatory mark. / Jaim_3,2.8 /
There would be conflict with the injunction at the point of instruction. / Jaim_3,2.9 /
Similarly regarding the rising and the dismissal. / Jaim_3,2.10 /
And in the <s>Sūktavāka</s> (recitation of hymns), the time-rule is due to its being for the sake of another. / Jaim_3,2.11 /

children.text: upadeśo vā yājyāśabdo hi nākasmāt / Jaim_3,2.12 /
children.translated_text: Or it is an instruction, for the word <s>yājyā</s> (invocatory verse) is not without reason. / Jaim_3,2.12 /
It has the purpose of [specifying] the deity, because of its connection with that. / Jaim_3,2.13 /

children.text: pratipattir iti cet sviṣṭakṛdvadubhayasaṃskāraḥ syāt / Jaim_3,2.14 /
children.translated_text: If it be said that it is for identification, then like the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> (offering to Agni), there would be a preparation of both. / Jaim_3,2.14 /
Because of the instruction regarding the whole, the word 'all' applies to both. / Jaim_3,2.15 /
Or according to the purpose, because the preparation is subsidiary. / Jaim_3,2.16 /
If it be said, because of the scriptural statement— / Jaim_3,2.17 /
Because there is no division in the context, the word 'whole' refers to both. / Jaim_3,2.18 /
From the indication, sequence, and designation, the recitation is connected with the <s>kāmya</s> (desire-motivated) rites. / Jaim_3,2.19 /

children.text: adhikāre ca mantravidhir atadākhyeṣu śiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_3,2.20 /
children.translated_text: And in the <s>adhikāra</s> (subject-context), the <s>mantra</s>-rule applies to those not named after that, because they are taught. / Jaim_3,2.20 /
Or the one named after that, because of the context and reasoning. / Jaim_3,2.21 /

children.text: anarthakaś copadeśaḥ syād asambandhāt phalavatā na hy upasthānaṃ phalavat / Jaim_3,2.22 /
children.translated_text: And the instruction would be purposeless, because of the absence of connection with that which has a result; for the <s>upasthāna</s> (invocation) does not have a result [of its own]. / Jaim_3,2.22 /
And because all are taught. / Jaim_3,2.23 /
From the indicative sign and the designation, the <s>anuvāka</s> (recitation section) is for the purpose of <s>bhakṣa</s> (ritual eating). / Jaim_3,2.24 /
Its withdrawal is due to the form and instruction, because the purpose is enjoined. / Jaim_3,2.25 /

children.text: guṇābhidhānān mandrādir ekamantraḥ syāt tayor ekārthasaṃyogāt / Jaim_3,2.26 /
children.translated_text: Because of the mention of a quality, <s>mandra</s> (low tone) and the rest would constitute a single <s>mantra</s>, because of the connection of both with a single purpose. / Jaim_3,2.26 /
Because of the specification of a distinguishing mark, among those of similar procedure, those not addressed to <s>Indra</s> have the character of non-<s>mantras</s>. / Jaim_3,2.27 /

children.text: yathādevataṃ vā tatprakṛtitvaṃ hi darśayati / Jaim_3,2.28 /
children.translated_text: Or according to the deity, for it shows that it has its origin in that. / Jaim_3,2.28 /
In those that are again brought forward, the indication is for all, because of the twofold distinction. / Jaim_3,2.29 /
Or because of the impropriety, the former is not indicated. / Jaim_3,2.30 /
Or because of the taking, there would be a removal. / Jaim_3,2.31 /
But in the <s>Pātnīvata</s> (rite connected with the wife), it is as before. / Jaim_3,2.32 /
Or because of the taking, it would be removed. / Jaim_3,2.33 /
But one should indicate <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, because of the drinking. / Jaim_3,2.34 /
But because of the inequality, it should not be so. / Jaim_3,2.35 /
And the thirty, because of being for the sake of another. / Jaim_3,2.36 /
And the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> (sacrificial exclamation) is like the performer. / Jaim_3,2.37 /
But the prohibition regarding the metre is because of its universal applicability. / Jaim_3,2.38 /
But in the case of the <s>Aindrāgna</s> (rite to Indra and Agni), it would be so because of the force of the indicative sign. / Jaim_3,2.39 /
Or in one [offering], because of the different deity, it is like division. / Jaim_3,2.40 /
And the metre is like the deity. / Jaim_3,2.41 /
Or because of the absence in all, there is a single metre. / Jaim_3,2.42 /

children.text: sarveṣāṃ vaikamantryam aitiśāyanasya bhaktipānatvāt savanādhikāro hi / Jaim_3,2.43 /
children.translated_text: Or all would have a single <s>mantra</s>, because the <s>Aitiśāyana</s> has the character of a <s>bhakti</s> (distribution) drink, for the <s>savana</s> (pressing) is the governing context. / Jaim_3,2.43 /
From the <s>śruti</s> (direct scriptural statement), the authority would belong to the <s>jāti</s> (generic class). / Jaim_3,3.1 /
Or the <s>Veda</s>, from the observation of the norm. / Jaim_3,3.2 /
And because of the indicative sign. / Jaim_3,3.3 /

children.text: dharmopadeśāc ca na hi dravyeṇa sambandhaḥ / Jaim_3,3.4 /
children.translated_text: And because of the teaching of <s>dharma</s> (duty), for there is no connection with a [particular] substance. / Jaim_3,3.4 /
And it is called <s>Trayīvidyā</s> (knowledge of the three Vedas), for it pertains to that. / Jaim_3,3.5 /
If it be said that when the order of individuals is [considered], it should be according to the text— / Jaim_3,3.6 /
Not so, because it applies to all. / Jaim_3,3.7 /
Because of its connection with the <s>Veda</s>, it is not overridden by the context. / Jaim_3,3.8 /
When there is a conflict between the secondary and the primary, the connection with the <s>Veda</s> is through the primary, because [the secondary] has its purpose in that. / Jaim_3,3.9 /
Because of the preponderance, both scriptural statements [apply]. / Jaim_3,3.10 /
That which is unconnected [is determined] by the context, because it requires a mode of performance. / Jaim_3,3.11 /
And the sequence is because of the similarity of place. / Jaim_3,3.12 /
And the designation likewise, because of its having that purpose. / Jaim_3,3.13 /

When <s>śruti</s> (direct statement), <s>liṅga</s> (indicative sign), <s>vākya</s> (sentence), <s>prakaraṇa</s> (context), <s>sthāna</s> (position), and <s>samākhyā</s> (designation) combine, each subsequent one is weaker, because of increasing remoteness from the meaning. / Jaim_3,3.14 /
Or the <s>Ahīna</s> (multi-day sacrifice) is secondary because of the context. / Jaim_3,3.15 /

children.text: asaṃyogāt tu mukhyasya tasmād apakṛṣyeta / Jaim_3,3.16 /
children.translated_text: But because of the non-connection of the primary, it should be withdrawn from that. / Jaim_3,3.16 /
Or it is connected with duality and plurality, because of the injunction of that. / Jaim_3,3.17 /
If it be said, by one alternative, because of its serving a purpose— / Jaim_3,3.18 /
Not so, because of the connection with a single performance. / Jaim_3,3.19 /
And the <s>jāghanī</s> (concluding portion) is so because of being part of one. / Jaim_3,3.20 /
Or the injunction, because of its being unprecedented. / Jaim_3,3.21 /
If it be said, it is part of one— / Jaim_3,3.22 /
Not so, because the archetype is not established through non-scriptural means. / Jaim_3,3.23 /
The <s>santardana</s> (satisfaction rite) in the archetype would be like the purchase, because of the non-loss of purpose. / Jaim_3,3.24 /
Or there is elevation because of the taking of the specific. / Jaim_3,3.25 /
Or the specific is due to the performer, because it is caused by that. / Jaim_3,3.26 /
Or it belongs to the sacrifice, because of the reasoning from the <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage). / Jaim_3,3.27 /
And the <s>saṃsthās</s> (concluding rites) are like the performer, because there is no difference in the purpose of sustaining. / Jaim_3,3.28 /
Or in the <s>Ukthya</s> and other [sacrifices], because the purpose exists. / Jaim_3,3.29 /
If it be said that the praise is purposeless because of the absence of distinction— / Jaim_3,3.30 /
It would [still be purposeful], because of its non-permanence. / Jaim_3,3.31 /
That which is connected with number belongs to the sacrifice, because of the context. / Jaim_3,3.32 /

children.text: naimittikaṃ vā kartṛsaṃyogāl liṅgasya tannimittatvāt / Jaim_3,3.33 /
children.translated_text: Or it is occasional, because of the connection with the performer; for the indicative sign has its cause in that. / Jaim_3,3.33 /

children.text: pauṣṇaṃ paiṣaṇaṃ vikṛtau pratīyetācodanāt prakṛtau / Jaim_3,3.34 /
children.translated_text: The <s>Pauṣṇa</s> (offering to Pūṣan) and the <s>Paiṣaṇa</s> (grinding offering) would be recognized in the modified rite, but not in the archetype because of the absence of an injunction. / Jaim_3,3.34 /
That serves all purposes, because of the absence of distinction. / Jaim_3,3.35 /

children.text: carauvārthoktaṃ puroḍāśe 'rthavipratiṣedhāt paśau na syāt / Jaim_3,3.36 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Caru</s> (oblation), what is stated [applies] to the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake); because of the conflict of purpose, it should not apply to the <s>paśu</s> (animal sacrifice). / Jaim_3,3.36 /
If it be said, in the <s>Caru</s> also— / Jaim_3,3.37 /
Not so, because of it being a name for cooking. / Jaim_3,3.38 /
In a single one, because of the connection with one. / Jaim_3,3.39 /
And because there is no conflict of <s>dharma</s> (properties). / Jaim_3,3.40 /

children.text: api vā sadvitīye syād devatānimittatvāta / Jaim_3,3.41 /
children.translated_text: Or alternatively, it would be with a second, because the deity is the occasion. / Jaim_3,3.41 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_3,3.42 /

children.text: vacanāt sarvapeṣaṇaṃ taṃ prati śāstravatvād arthābhāvād vicarāv apeṣaṇaṃ bhavati / Jaim_3,3.43 /
children.translated_text: Because of the scriptural statement, there is grinding for all, since scripture applies to that; because of the absence of purpose, in the <s>vicāra</s> (deliberation), there is no grinding. / Jaim_3,3.43 /

children.text: ekasmin vārthadharmatvād aindrāgnav adubhayor na syād acoditatvāt / Jaim_3,3.44 /
children.translated_text: Or in a single one, because of the nature of the purpose; in the <s>Aindrāgna</s> (offering to Indra and Agni), it would not apply to both, because of the absence of injunction. / Jaim_3,3.44 /
The absence of a final dental is merely a cause [of difference, not a separate injunction]. / Jaim_3,3.45 /
The scriptural statement is paramount. / Jaim_3,3.46 /

children.text: nivītām iti manuṣyadharmaḥ śabdasya tatpradhānatvāt / Jaim_3,4.1 /
children.translated_text: The <s>nivīta</s> (wearing the sacred thread in a particular manner) is a rule for men, because the word has that as primary. / Jaim_3,4.1 /
Or it is an indication, because the meaning truly exists. / Jaim_3,4.2 /
It would be an injunction, because it comes before the praise. / Jaim_3,4.3 /
That would be, from its predominant usage, a rule of the rite. / Jaim_3,4.4 /
Because of being a supplement to the sentence. / Jaim_3,4.5 /

children.text: tatprakaraṇe yat tat saṃyuktam avipratiṣedhāt / Jaim_3,4.6 /
children.translated_text: That which is in that context is connected with it, because there is no conflict. / Jaim_3,4.6 /

children.text: tatpradhāne vā tulyavat prasaṃkhyānād itarasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_3,4.7 /
children.translated_text: Or in that which has that as primary, it is like equal enumeration, because the other has its purpose in that. / Jaim_3,4.7 /
Or it is an <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage), because of the context. / Jaim_3,4.8 /
And because it forms a single sentence with the injunction. / Jaim_3,4.9 /
And the distinction of direction is likewise, because the connection serves a purpose. / Jaim_3,4.10 /
And in the <s>Paruṣī</s> (rough pressing), the ghee that has been kindled, filled, and scorched is likewise. / Jaim_3,4.11 /

children.text: akarma kratusaṃyuktaṃ saṃyogān nityānuvādaḥ syāt / Jaim_3,4.12 /
children.translated_text: That which is not a [separate] rite but is connected with the sacrifice — because of the connection, it would be a mere restatement of what is permanent. / Jaim_3,4.12 /
Or it is an injunction, because of a different connection. / Jaim_3,4.13 /
Like in the <s>Ahīna</s> (multi-day sacrifice), [it pertains to] the person, because it has its purpose in that. / Jaim_3,4.14 /

children.text: prakaraṇaviśeṣād vā tadyuktasya saṃskāro dravyavat / Jaim_3,4.15 /
children.translated_text: Or because of the specific context, the preparation of that which is connected with it is like that of a substance. / Jaim_3,4.15 /
It should be withdrawn because of the designation. / Jaim_3,4.16 /
And in the <s>Śamyā</s> (wooden peg), because of complete distribution. / Jaim_3,4.17 /
Before the conclusion, [it is] like impurity of the garment. / Jaim_3,4.18 /
And because of the prohibition regarding food. / Jaim_3,4.19 /

children.text: aprakaraṇe tu tadvarmas tato viśeṣāt / Jaim_3,4.20 /
children.translated_text: But when there is no [specific] context, that particular one, because of the distinction from that. / Jaim_3,4.20 /
But because it is not a substance, it would be subsidiary. / Jaim_3,4.21 /
Because of connection with the <s>Veda</s>. / Jaim_3,4.22 /
And because of connection with the substance. / Jaim_3,4.23 /

children.text: syād vāsya saṃyogavat phalena sambandhas tasmāt karmaitiśāyanaḥ / Jaim_3,4.24 /
children.translated_text: Or its connection with the result may be like a conjunction; therefore, according to <s>Aitiśāyana</s>, it belongs to the rite. / Jaim_3,4.24 /
The remaining [rules apply] in the context, without distinction, to all rites. / Jaim_3,4.25 /
But the <s>homas</s> (oblations) are separate, because of the connection with food and the <s>Āhavanīya</s> (sacred fire). / Jaim_3,4.26 /
And the remainder is because of the designation. / Jaim_3,4.27 /

children.text: doṣāt tv iṣṭir laukike syāc chāstrād dhi vaidika na doṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_3,4.28 /
children.translated_text: But because of a fault, the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) would be worldly; for from scripture it is Vedic, and there would be no fault. / Jaim_3,4.28 /

children.text: arthavādo vānupapātat tasmād yajñe pratīyeta / Jaim_3,4.29 /
children.translated_text: Or it is an <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage) because of the impossibility [of literal meaning]; therefore it should be understood in relation to the sacrifice. / Jaim_3,4.29 /
And it is not enjoined, because of the difference of rites. / Jaim_3,4.30 /
From the indicative sign, it would pertain to the <s>ṛtvij</s> (priest). / Jaim_3,4.31 /
And the process of drinking is likewise. / Jaim_3,4.32 /

children.text: doṣāt tu vaidike syād arthād dhi laukike na doṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_3,4.33 /
children.translated_text: But because of a fault, it would be Vedic; for from reasoning it is worldly, and there would be no fault. / Jaim_3,4.33 /
That applies everywhere, because of the absence of distinction. / Jaim_3,4.34 /
Or it belongs to the owner, because it has its purpose in that. / Jaim_3,4.35 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_3,4.36 /
The complete offering of the <s>havis</s> (oblation material), because it has its purpose in that. / Jaim_3,4.37 /
But because of the absence of offering [to specific deities], it would be the remainder. / Jaim_3,4.38 /
Or it is a means, because it has its purpose in that. / Jaim_3,4.39 /

children.text: kṛtatvāt tu karmaṇaḥ sakṛt syād dravyasya guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_3,4.40 /
children.translated_text: But because the rite has been performed, it should be done once, because the substance is subordinate. / Jaim_3,4.40 /
And because of the observation regarding the remainder. / Jaim_3,4.41 /

children.text: aprayojakatvād ekasmāt kriyerañ cheṣasya guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_3,4.42 /
children.translated_text: Because it does not serve a purpose from a single one, the actions regarding the remainder should [still] be performed, because [the remainder] is subordinate. / Jaim_3,4.42 /
And because it has been prepared. / Jaim_3,4.43 /

children.text: sarvebhyo vā kāraṇāviśeṣāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_3,4.44 /
children.translated_text: Or from all, because there is no distinction in the cause; for the preparation has its purpose in that. / Jaim_3,4.44 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_3,4.45 /
If from one, then at will, because of the absence of distinction. / Jaim_3,4.46 /
Or from the primary one, because of its temporal priority. / Jaim_3,4.47 /
Because of the non-mention of <s>bhakṣa</s> (ritual eating), the word <s>dāna</s> (giving) refers to a purchase. / Jaim_3,4.48 /
And because of the connected praise. / Jaim_3,4.49 /
Or it is for the purpose of <s>bhakṣa</s> (ritual eating), because of the equality with respect to the substance. / Jaim_3,4.50 /
From the express statement, it is a praise of <s>dāna</s> (giving). / Jaim_3,4.51 /
And from the <s>ājya</s> (clarified butter), because of connection with all. / Jaim_3,5.1 /
And because of the cause. / Jaim_3,5.2 /
In a single one, because of the word 'samavatta' (coming together). / Jaim_3,5.3 /
And in the case of <s>ājya</s> (clarified butter), from observation, it is like the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> purpose. / Jaim_3,5.4 /

children.text: aśeṣatvāt tu naivaṃ syāt sarvādānād aśeṣatā / Jaim_3,5.5 /
children.translated_text: But it would not be so because of the non-subsidiary nature; the non-subsidiary nature is due to the offering of all. / Jaim_3,5.5 /
Because of commonality, it would not be in the <s>dhruvā</s> (permanent ladle). / Jaim_3,5.6 /

children.text: avattatvāc ca juhvāṃ tasya ca homasaṃyogāt / Jaim_3,5.7 /
children.translated_text: And because of being cut, [it would be] in the <s>juhū</s> (offering ladle), and because of its connection with the oblation. / Jaim_3,5.7 /
If it be said, like the <s>camasa</s> (cup)— / Jaim_3,5.8 /

children.text: na codanāvirodhād dhaviḥ prakalpanātvāc ca / Jaim_3,5.9 /
children.translated_text: Not so, because of the conflict with the injunction, and because it is a preparation of the <s>havis</s> (oblation). / Jaim_3,5.9 /
When the authority has arisen, the word 'all' [applies] when it exists. / Jaim_3,5.10 /
The superior one is because of the distinction of class. / Jaim_3,5.11 /
The last one, when the purpose is not [otherwise achieved]. / Jaim_3,5.12 /

children.text: sākamprasthāyye sviṣṭakṛd iḍaṃ ca tadvat / Jaim_3,5.13 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Sākamprasthāyya</s> (a particular Soma offering), the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> (offering to Agni) and the <s>iḍā</s> (refreshment oblation) are likewise. / Jaim_3,5.13 /
And in the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s> (sacrifice), with respect to the <s>grahas</s> (cups of Soma). / Jaim_3,5.14 /
And the statement regarding the remainder is likewise. / Jaim_3,5.15 /
When the substance is one but the rites differ, the actions should be performed for each rite. / Jaim_3,5.16 /

children.text: avibhāgāc ca śeṣasya sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭhatvāt / Jaim_3,5.17 /
children.translated_text: And because of the non-division of the remainder, it is without distinction with respect to all. / Jaim_3,5.17 /

children.text: aindravāyave tu vacanāt pratikarma bhakṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_3,5.18 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>Aindrāvāyava</s> (offering to Indra and Vāyu), because of the scriptural statement, the <s>bhakṣa</s> (ritual eating) should be for each rite. / Jaim_3,5.18 /
In the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifice], because of the absence of a statement, <s>bhakṣa</s> (ritual eating) does not exist. / Jaim_3,5.19 /
Or it may exist, because of observation of another purpose. / Jaim_3,5.20 /

children.text: vacanāni tv apūrvatvāt tasmād yathopadeśaṃ syuḥ / Jaim_3,5.21 /
children.translated_text: But the statements, because of their being unprecedented, should be according to the instruction. / Jaim_3,5.21 /
In the case of the <s>camasas</s> (cups), because of the designation, since the connection is caused by that. / Jaim_3,5.22 /
The <s>camasa</s> (cup) of the <s>Udgātṛ</s> (chanting priest) is one, because of the connection with the scriptural statement. / Jaim_3,5.23 /
Or all, because of the connection with all. / Jaim_3,5.24 /
Or of the <s>Stotrakārins</s> (chanters), because of the connection with them and the multiple scriptural statements. / Jaim_3,5.25 /

children.text: sarve tu vedasaṃyogāt kāraṇād ekadeśe syāt / Jaim_3,5.26 /
children.translated_text: But all, because of the connection with the <s>Veda</s>; from the cause, it would be in one part. / Jaim_3,5.26 /
For the <s>Grāvastut</s> (praiser of the pressing stones), <s>bhakṣa</s> (ritual eating) does not exist, because it is not mentioned. / Jaim_3,5.27 /
Or in the <s>Hāriyojana</s> (a particular offering), because of the connection with all. / Jaim_3,5.28 /
Or of those who have <s>camasas</s> (cups), because of proximity. / Jaim_3,5.29 /

children.text: sarveṣāṃ tu vidhitvāt tadarthā camasiśrutiḥ / Jaim_3,5.30 /
children.translated_text: But of all, because it is an injunction; the scriptural statement about the <s>camasa</s>-holders has that purpose. / Jaim_3,5.30 /
And one should ritually eat because of the <s>vaṣaṭkāra</s> (sacrificial exclamation). / Jaim_3,5.31 /
And because of the <s>homa</s> (oblation) and the <s>abhiṣava</s> (pressing of Soma). / Jaim_3,5.32 /
Because of the direct instruction regarding the <s>camasas</s> (cups), it is unspecified with respect to the remainder. / Jaim_3,5.33 /

children.text: syād vā kāraṇabhāvād anirdeśaś camasānāṃ kartus tadvacanatvāt / Jaim_3,5.34 /
children.translated_text: Or it may be so, because of the absence of a cause; the non-specification of the <s>camasas</s> (cups) is because of the performer, since the statement pertains to him. / Jaim_3,5.34 /
And because something different is seen in the case of the <s>camasa</s> (cup). / Jaim_3,5.35 /

children.text: ekapātre kramād adhvaryuḥ pūrvo bhakṣayet / Jaim_3,5.36 /
children.translated_text: When there is a single vessel, the <s>Adhvaryu</s> should partake first, in order. / Jaim_3,5.36 /
Or the <s>Hotṛ</s>, because of the wording of the <s>mantra</s>. / Jaim_3,5.37 /
And because of an explicit statement. / Jaim_3,5.38 /
And because of the sequence of causation. / Jaim_3,5.39 /
The partaking is permitted by an explicit statement. / Jaim_3,5.40 /
The one summoned thereby should be invited by the formula '<s>upahvayasva</s>' (invite) — because it has the character of a <s>liṅga</s> (indicatory sign). / Jaim_3,5.41 /
There, the response follows from the sense of the statement. / Jaim_3,5.42 /
Because those [elements] are found together in one place. / Jaim_3,5.43 /
The <s>bhakṣa</s> (portion for partaking) is removed by the removal of the <s>yājyā</s> (offering verse), like the <s>pravara</s> (selection). / Jaim_3,5.44 /
Or [it belongs] to the sacrificer, because the cause is traceable to him. / Jaim_3,5.45 /
Because the <s>pravara</s> has already been initiated, there is no withdrawal from it. / Jaim_3,5.46 /
The <s>phalacamasa</s> (fruit-cup) is an incidental modification of the <s>bhakṣa</s>, because of its connection with a <s>śruti</s> (Vedic text). / Jaim_3,5.47 /
Or it is a modification of the offering, because the <s>saṃskāra</s> (preparatory rite) serves that purpose. / Jaim_3,5.48 /
Because of the oblation. / Jaim_3,5.49 /
And because of simultaneity with the <s>camasas</s> (cups). / Jaim_3,5.50 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign (<s>liṅga</s>). / Jaim_3,5.51 /
In the case of the subsidiary elements, because of their commonality. / Jaim_3,5.52 /
Or [it belongs] to the <s>Brahman</s> (priest), because of the identity of the word. / Jaim_3,5.53 /
That [rite] serves all purposes, because there is no specific context. / Jaim_3,6.1 /
Or [it belongs] to the archetype (<s>prakṛti</s>), because it is stated twice. / Jaim_3,6.2 /
But excluding that, when [the application] is obtained from an explicit statement. / Jaim_3,6.3 /
If [one argues] because of observation — / Jaim_3,6.4 /
No, because the injunction has a single purpose. / Jaim_3,6.5 /
If [one argues] because of origination — / Jaim_3,6.6 /
No, because of equality. / Jaim_3,6.7 /
But because of the completeness of the injunctive meaning, owing to the conflict with the primary [meaning], the sense pertains to the archetype (<s>prakṛti</s>). / Jaim_3,6.8 /

children.text: prakaraṇaviśeṣāt tu vikṛtau virodhi syāt / Jaim_3,6.9 /
children.translated_text: But in a modification (<s>vikṛti</s>), because of a particular context, there would be a contradiction. / Jaim_3,6.9 /

children.text: naimittikaṃ tu prakṛtau tadvikāraḥ saṃyogaviśeṣāt / Jaim_3,6.10 /
children.translated_text: But the incidental element in the archetype is a modification of it, because of a particular connection. / Jaim_3,6.10 /
The <s>Agnyādhāna</s> (establishment of the sacred fires) serves the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering), because of the context. / Jaim_3,6.11 /
Or not, because those [offerings] serve that [fire-establishment] as their purpose. / Jaim_3,6.12 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_3,6.13 /
That [statement] serves the purpose of the archetype, just as other <s>anārabhyavādas</s> (statements not initiating a new topic) do. / Jaim_3,6.14 /
Or it serves all purposes, because the <s>Agnyādhāna</s> has its own proper time. / Jaim_3,6.15 /

children.text: tāsām agniḥ prakṛtitaḥ prayājavat syāt / Jaim_3,6.16 /
children.translated_text: The fire for those [offerings] would be derived from the archetype, like the <s>prayāja</s> (preliminary offering). / Jaim_3,6.16 /
Or not, because those [offerings] serve that [fire] as their purpose. / Jaim_3,6.17 /
The rule regarding the animal [sacrifice] is the same for all, because there is no distinction in context. / Jaim_3,6.18 /
And the first [animal belongs] to the [first rite], because of its position. / Jaim_3,6.19 /

children.text: śvas tv ekeṣāṃ tatra prākśrutir guṇārthā / Jaim_3,6.20 /
children.translated_text: But 'tomorrow' — for some of them, the prior mention of the <s>śruti</s> serves a subsidiary purpose. / Jaim_3,6.20 /
If [one argues] that thereby there is a prescription of time for the superior [rite] — / Jaim_3,6.21 /
No, because it is only a part [of the whole]. / Jaim_3,6.22 /
If [one argues] because of the purpose — / Jaim_3,6.23 /
No, because of the conflict with the <s>śruti</s> (Vedic text). / Jaim_3,6.24 /

children.text: sthānāt tu pūrvasya saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_3,6.25 /
children.translated_text: But the first [rite's] <s>saṃskāra</s> [comes first] because of its position, since the <s>saṃskāra</s> serves that purpose. / Jaim_3,6.25 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_3,6.26 /
There is no injunction [for it], because it serves a subsidiary purpose. / Jaim_3,6.27 /

children.text: dohayoḥ kālabhedād asaṃyuktaṃ śṛtaṃ syāt / Jaim_3,6.28 /
children.translated_text: Because of the temporal difference between the two milkings, the cooked [milk] would be unconnected. / Jaim_3,6.28 /
Or, because of the division of context, the time-prescription pertains to what is connected with that. / Jaim_3,6.29 /
Similarly, the mention of the <s>graha</s> (cup of Soma) in another pressing (<s>savana</s>). / Jaim_3,6.30 /
And the rope (<s>raśanā</s>), because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_3,6.31 /

children.text: ārāc chiṣṭam asaṃyuktam itaraiḥ sannidhānāt / Jaim_3,6.32 /
children.translated_text: What is taught from a distance is unconnected with the others, because of proximity [to something else]. / Jaim_3,6.32 /

children.text: saṃyuktaṃ vā tadarthatvāc cheṣasya tannimittatvāt / Jaim_3,6.33 /
children.translated_text: Or it is connected, because it serves that purpose, and the remainder is caused by that. / Jaim_3,6.33 /
It would be settled by the explicit statement. / Jaim_3,6.34 /
An element of the fire [ritual], when there is no [specific] context, is like that. / Jaim_3,6.35 /
The incidental element would be [treated differently] because of dissimilarity, for those that do not have the same procedure. / Jaim_3,6.36 /
And it is a substitute (<s>pratinidhi</s>). / Jaim_3,6.37 /
Like that, because the purpose is one and the same. / Jaim_3,6.38 /
And because it lacks the characteristics of a [new] injunction. / Jaim_3,6.39 /
The mention of the subsidiary serves the purpose of restriction (<s>niyama</s>). / Jaim_3,6.40 /
But the concluding rites (<s>saṃsthā</s>) have the same procedure, because there is no distinction in context. / Jaim_3,6.41 /
And the designation is likewise the same. / Jaim_3,6.42 /

children.text: vikāsas tu kāmasaṃyoge nityasya samatvāt / Jaim_3,6.43 /
children.translated_text: But the optional rite (<s>vikāsa</s>) applies when there is a conjunction with desire (<s>kāma</s>), because the obligatory [rite] is the same [regardless]. / Jaim_3,6.43 /

children.text: api vā dviruktatvāt prakṛter bhaviṣyantīti / Jaim_3,6.44 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the double statement, they would belong to the archetype. / Jaim_3,6.44 /
But because of an explicit statement, there is a cumulative performance (<s>samuccaya</s>). / Jaim_3,6.45 /
And because of the prohibition of the earlier indicatory signs. / Jaim_3,6.46 /
The designation pertains to one [rite], because of a particular subsidiary distinction. / Jaim_3,6.47 /
Because of a particular context, the unconnected [element belongs] to the principal [rite]. / Jaim_3,7.1 /
Or [it belongs] to all, because the subsidiary character is not exclusively connected to that [one rite]. / Jaim_3,7.2 /
If [one argues] because [it is taught] from a distance — / Jaim_3,7.3 /
No, for that statement serves that purpose. / Jaim_3,7.4 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_3,7.5 /
But because of the connection with the result, it is connected with the owner and belongs to the principal [rite]. / Jaim_3,7.6 /
And because of the connection with the intention to act (<s>cikīrṣā</s>). / Jaim_3,7.7 /
Likewise, by means of the statement. / Jaim_3,7.8 /

children.text: tadyukte tu phalaśrutis tasmāt sarvacikīrṣā syāt / Jaim_3,7.9 /
children.translated_text: But the mention of the result in what is connected with that — therefore the intention should extend to all. / Jaim_3,7.9 /
Because of the mention of the subsidiary, the statement serves all purposes. / Jaim_3,7.10 /
But the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (priestly fee) at the <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation) belongs to the principal [rite], because of an explicit statement. / Jaim_3,7.11 /
And because the cessation [of it] is observed. / Jaim_3,7.12 /
Likewise, the altar (<s>vedi</s>) in relation to the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>). / Jaim_3,7.13 /
Or it is merely a designation of place, because it forms a single statement with what is taught. / Jaim_3,7.14 /

children.text: sāmadhenīs tad anvāhur iti havir ddhānayor vacanāt sāmadhenīnām / Jaim_3,7.15 /
children.translated_text: The <s>Sāmadhenī</s> verses — they recite '<s>tad anvāhuḥ</s>' ('they said thereafter') — because of the explicit statement regarding the <s>Sāmadhenī</s> verses in the oblation and the fire-establishment. / Jaim_3,7.15 /

children.text: deśamātraṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ hy arthakarma somasya / Jaim_3,7.16 /
children.translated_text: Or it is merely a designation of place, for the rite of <s>Soma</s> is directly perceptible as its purpose. / Jaim_3,7.16 /
And the designation is likewise. / Jaim_3,7.17 /

children.text: śāstraphalaṃ prayoktari tallakṣaṇatvāt tasmāt svayaṃ prayoge syāt / Jaim_3,7.18 /
children.translated_text: The result of the injunction accrues to the performer, because it has the character of being connected with him; therefore it should apply to self-performance. / Jaim_3,7.18 /

children.text: utsarge tu pradhānatvāc cheṣakārī pradhānasya tasmād anyaḥ svayaṃ vā syāt / Jaim_3,7.19 /
children.translated_text: But in the general rule, because the principal [performer] has primacy, the one who performs the subsidiary acts belongs to the principal; therefore it should be either another person or oneself. / Jaim_3,7.19 /

children.text: anyo vā syāt parikrayāmnānād vipratiṣedhāt pratyag ātmani / Jaim_3,7.20 /
children.translated_text: Or it should be another, because of the mention of hiring (<s>parikraya</s>), owing to the conflict [that arises] when [the result is directed] inward, toward oneself. / Jaim_3,7.20 /
There, the number of performers would be determined by the purpose; there is no restriction, because of the absence of distinction. / Jaim_3,7.21 /

children.text: api vā śruti bhedāt pratināmadheyaṃ syuḥ / Jaim_3,7.22 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the division of <s>śruti</s>, there would be individual designations. / Jaim_3,7.22 /
If [one argues that] it is due to the division of rites for a single [person] — / Jaim_3,7.23 /
No, for [this applies] at the origination. / Jaim_3,7.24 /
And the <s>camasa</s>-<s>Adhvaryus</s> (cup-priests), because they are designated by those [cups]. / Jaim_3,7.25 /
But at the origination, because of the multiple <s>śruti</s> passages. / Jaim_3,7.26 /
The number ten, because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_3,7.27 /
And the slaughterer (<s>śamitṛ</s>), because of the difference in the word. / Jaim_3,7.28 /
Or, because of the context, owing to the lack of connection at origination. / Jaim_3,7.29 /
And the <s>Upaga</s> priests, because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_3,7.30 /
But the seller is another person, because the rite is not enjoined [for him]. / Jaim_3,7.31 /
Because the rite requires it, all of them have the status of <s>ṛtvij</s> (priests), without distinction. / Jaim_3,7.32 /
Or not, because of an enumeration (<s>parisaṃkhyāna</s>). / Jaim_3,7.33 /
If [one argues] by means of an alternative (<s>pakṣa</s>) — / Jaim_3,7.34 /
No, all do not have the qualification. / Jaim_3,7.35 /
But the restriction is [established] through the <s>dakṣiṇās</s> (fees), because of their connection with <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim_3,7.36 /

children.text: uktvā ca yajamānatvaṃ teṣāṃ dīkṣābidhānāt / Jaim_3,7.37 /
children.translated_text: And having stated [their] status as sacrificer (<s>yajamāna</s>), because of the prescription of <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation) for them. / Jaim_3,7.37 /
The seventeen [priests] belong to the sacrificer (<s>svāmin</s>), because of the commonality of the rite. / Jaim_3,7.38 /

children.text: te sarvārthāḥ prayuktatvād agnayaś ca svakālatvāt / Jaim_3,7.39 /
children.translated_text: They serve all purposes, because they are employed [in the rite]; and the fires [are established] at their proper time. / Jaim_3,7.39 /

children.text: tatsayogāt karmaṇo vyavasthā syāt saṃyogāsyārthavatvāt / Jaim_3,7.40 /
