children.translated_text: Because of the connection with that, the arrangement of the rite would be [determined thereby], since the connection is meaningful. / Jaim_3,7.40 /
The specification of that is by means of the instruction and designation. / Jaim_3,7.41 /
And the observation of the indicatory sign is likewise. / Jaim_3,7.42 /
The recitation following the <s>praiṣa</s> (directive) belongs to the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> (priest), because of the instruction. / Jaim_3,7.43 /
Or the qualification pertains to the <s>puronuvākyā</s> (invitatory verse), because of the proximity of the <s>praiṣa</s>. / Jaim_3,7.44 /
And in the morning litany (<s>prātaranuvāka</s>), because of the observation concerning the <s>Hotṛ</s>. / Jaim_3,7.45 /
The <s>camasa</s>-<s>Adhvaryus</s> [tend] the cups, because of their designation. / Jaim_3,7.46 /
Or the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, because that is the proper rule for him. / Jaim_3,7.47 /
And because something different is observed in the case of the <s>camasa</s>. / Jaim_3,7.48 /
In case of inability, they should substitute for one another. / Jaim_3,7.49 /
Because of the instruction regarding the <s>Veda</s>, as before, when there is a difference of <s>Veda</s>, they should act according to the instruction. / Jaim_3,7.50 /

children.text: tadguṇād vā svadharmaḥ syād adhikārasāmathyāt sahāṅgair avyaktaḥ śeṣe / Jaim_3,7.51 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the quality of that, one's own duty would apply by the force of qualification, together with the subsidiaries, being undetermined in the remainder. / Jaim_3,7.51 /
The hiring of the sacrificer belongs to the rite, because the rite serves that purpose. / Jaim_3,8.1 /
Because of an explicit statement, it would apply to the others. / Jaim_3,8.2 /

children.text: saṃskārās tu puruṣasāmarthye yathāvedaṃ karmavadvyavatiṣṭheran / Jaim_3,8.3 /
children.translated_text: But the <s>saṃskāras</s> (consecrations), being within the capacity of the person, would be settled according to the <s>Veda</s>, like the rite. / Jaim_3,8.3 /
But those belonging to the sacrificer (<s>yājamāna</s>) are like the rite, because they have that [rite] as their principal. / Jaim_3,8.4 /
And because of the designation. / Jaim_3,8.5 /
When it has a subsidiary character, the specification of that [is required]. / Jaim_3,8.6 /
And because the injunction corresponds to the entity [enjoined]. / Jaim_3,8.7 /
Because of dissimilarity, they would have different procedures. / Jaim_3,8.8 /
And <s>tapas</s> (austerity) [yields its result] like [it does] in the world, because the result is established [independently]. / Jaim_3,8.9 /
And the remainder of the sentence is likewise. / Jaim_3,8.10 /
Because of an explicit statement, it would apply to the others. / Jaim_3,8.11 /

children.text: guṇatvāc ca vedena na vyavasthā syāt / Jaim_3,8.12 /
children.translated_text: And because of its subsidiary character, there would be no [separate] arrangement by means of the <s>Veda</s>. / Jaim_3,8.12 /
Likewise, desire (<s>kāma</s>), because of the connection with the purpose. / Jaim_3,8.13 /
Because of the designation, it would apply to the others. / Jaim_3,8.14 /
And the <s>mantras</s> that do not accompany a ritual act are likewise. / Jaim_3,8.15 /
And because [this] is observed in case of disjunction. / Jaim_3,8.16 /
In the case of those mentioned twice, both [applications hold], because the double mention is meaningful. / Jaim_3,8.17 /

children.text: jñāte ca vācanaṃ na hy avidvān vihito 'sti / Jaim_3,8.18 /
children.translated_text: And the recitation [is done] when [the content is] known, for no ignorant person is enjoined [to recite]. / Jaim_3,8.18 /

children.text: yājamāne samākhyānāt karmāṇi yājamānaṃ syuḥ / Jaim_3,8.19 /
children.translated_text: Because of the designation as belonging to the sacrificer, the rites would be the sacrificer's. / Jaim_3,8.19 /

children.text: adhvaryur vā tadartho hi nyāyapūrve samākhyānam / Jaim_3,8.20 /
children.translated_text: Or [they belong to] the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, for the designation in the earlier rule serves that purpose. / Jaim_3,8.20 /

children.text: vipratiṣedhe karaṇaḥ samāvāyaviśeṣād itaram anyas teṣāṃ yato viśeṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_3,8.21 /
children.translated_text: In case of conflict, the performer [is determined] by a particular association; the other [option applies to] the others, from which a distinction may arise. / Jaim_3,8.21 /
And in the case of the <s>praiṣas</s> (directives), because another has the qualification. / Jaim_3,8.22 /
But the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, because of observation. / Jaim_3,8.23 /
Or it is secondary (<s>gauṇa</s>), because of the commonality of the rite. / Jaim_3,8.24 /
The priest (<s>ṛtvij</s>) receives the result in the case of the instruments, because they are purposeful. / Jaim_3,8.25 /
Or [it belongs to] the owner (<s>svāmin</s>), because it serves his purpose. / Jaim_3,8.26 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_3,8.27 /

children.text: karmārtha phalaṃ teṣāṃ svāminaṃ pratyarthavattvāt / Jaim_3,8.28 /
children.translated_text: The result pertaining to the rite accrues to their owner, because it is meaningful for him. / Jaim_3,8.28 /
And because of the designation. / Jaim_3,8.29 /
The <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration) of the substance belongs to all rites, because there is no distinction of context. / Jaim_3,8.30 /
But because of the explicit specification, in a modification (<s>vikṛti</s>), what is unprecedented (<s>apūrva</s>) has no qualification. / Jaim_3,8.31 /

children.text: virodhe ca śrutiviśeṣād avyaktaḥ śeṣe / Jaim_3,8.32 /
children.translated_text: And in case of conflict, because of the particularity of <s>śruti</s>, it is undetermined in the remainder. / Jaim_3,8.32 /
But the removal pertains to a part, because there is a connection with what exists. / Jaim_3,8.33 /
In a modification, the remainder serves all purposes, like the archetype. / Jaim_3,8.34 /
Or the primary meaning [applies] to the subsidiary, because it is not [separately] enjoined. / Jaim_3,8.35 /
Because there is no distinction of proximity, [the subsidiary] would not be possible for those that are not its elements. / Jaim_3,8.36 /
If [one argues that it is] likewise in the <s>Ādhāna</s> (fire-establishment) — / Jaim_3,8.37 /
No, because [the subsidiary] has no [independent] context, and the subsidiary is not caused by that. / Jaim_3,8.38 /
Or [it applies] at that time, because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_3,8.39 /
Or [it applies] to all, because there is no distinction. / Jaim_3,8.40 /
The observation of an indicatory sign is in accordance with the rule (<s>nyāya</s>). / Jaim_3,8.41 /
But meat belongs to the <s>Savanīya</s> offerings, because there is no distinction in the injunction. / Jaim_3,8.42 /
If [one argues that] the distribution (<s>bhakti</s>) is improper in the absence of proximity — / Jaim_3,8.43 /
It would be [established] from the indicatory sign of the archetype, like the <s>Vairāja</s> offering. / Jaim_3,8.44 /
Now, therefore, an inquiry into [whether the rite serves] the purpose of the rite (<s>kratvarthā</s>) or the purpose of the person (<s>puruṣārtha</s>). / Jaim_4,1.1 /

children.text: yasmin prītiḥ puruṣasya tasya lipsārthalakṣaṇāvibhaktatvāt / Jaim_4,1.2 /
children.translated_text: That in which a person takes pleasure — his desire for it [has the] characteristic of [seeking] an object; [the two are] undifferentiated. / Jaim_4,1.2 /

children.text: tadutsarge karmāṇi puruṣārthāya śāstrasyānatiśaṅkyatvān na ca dravyaṃ cikīrṣyate tenārthenābhisambandhāt kriyāyāṃ puruṣaśrutiḥ / Jaim_4,1.3 /
children.translated_text: In the general case, the rites serve the purpose of the person, because the injunction is not to be doubted; and it is not the substance that is intended — because of the connection with that purpose, the mention of the person is in relation to the action. / Jaim_4,1.3 /

children.text: aviśeṣāt tu śāstrasya yathāśruti phalāni syuḥ / Jaim_4,1.4 /
children.translated_text: But because there is no distinction in the injunction, the results would be as stated in the <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim_4,1.4 /

children.text: api vā kāraṇāgrahaṇe tadartham arthasyānabhisambandhāt / Jaim_4,1.5 /
children.translated_text: Or, because the cause is not apprehended, [the rite] serves that [person's] purpose, since the object has no [independent] connection. / Jaim_4,1.5 /
And so it is in worldly affairs. / Jaim_4,1.6 /
However, <s>dravyas</s> (substances) should be offered without distinction, since otherwise they would be purposeless.

children.text: svena tvarthe na sambandho dravyāṇāṃ pṛthagarthatvāt tasmād yathāśruti syuḥ / Jaim_4,1.8 /
children.translated_text: But substances have no connection with a purpose of their own, since each substance has a separate purpose; therefore they should follow the Vedic text as heard.
And they are enjoined in rites that serve a purpose.
And because of the observation of indicatory marks (<s>liṅga</s>).
In that case, the unity [of the offering] is not a constituent of the sacrifice (<s>yajña</s>), since the substance is subordinate [to the action].
And because of the uniformity of the Vedic statement.
If it be said that [the purpose] is understood [independently],
[We say] no, what is not expressed by words [cannot be accepted], since the verbal testimony (<s>śabda</s>) is the authority, as established before.

children.text: śabdavat tūpalabhyate tadāgame hi taddṛśyate tasya jñānaṃ hi yathānyeṣām / Jaim_4,1.15 /
children.translated_text: But [the purpose] is apprehended just like a word — for when that [word] is present, that [meaning] is perceived; the knowledge of it is like that of other [meanings].
And the observation of indicatory marks (<s>liṅga</s>) is likewise [dependent on verbal expression].
And the indicatory mark (<s>liṅga</s>) also [supports] this.
In the case of substrata, the existence of purpose should be understood without distinction.

children.text: codanāyāṃ tv anārambho 'vibhaktatvān na hy anyena vidhīyate / Jaim_4,1.19 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>codanā</s> (injunction), there is no independent initiation [of the substance], since it is undifferentiated — for it is not enjoined by another [injunction].

children.text: syād vā dravyacikīrṣāyāṃ bhāvo 'rthe ca guṇabhūtatāśrayād dhi guṇībhāvaḥ / Jaim_4,1.20 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, when there is an intention regarding the substance (<s>dravya</s>), its existence in the purpose [is established], and the subordination arises from dependence on what is itself subordinate.
Because of the equal and unequal relation of substances and actions with respect to the purpose.
Since there is a single production, all [substances] should be equal.
Or <s>āmikṣā</s> (a curd preparation) would be the principal, since it results from the combination of flavors.
And because of its connection with the primary term.
The subsidiary action does not motivate [independently], since the bringing [of the substance] serves another purpose.

children.text: arthābhidhānakarma ca bhaviṣyatā saṃyogasya tannimittatvāt tadartho hi vidhīyate / Jaim_4,1.26 /
children.translated_text: And the action that designates the purpose is [connected] with what is yet to come, since the combination has that as its cause — for it is enjoined for that purpose.
In the case of the animal (<s>paśu</s>), since there is no slaughtering [as a separate act], the blood and dung have no [independent] ritual function.
And [blood and dung] being substances of a part [of the animal], because of their connection with what is mentioned at the time of production.

children.text: nirdeśāt tasyānyad arthād iti cet / Jaim_4,1.29 /
children.translated_text: If it be said that [they have] a different purpose, because of the [separate] mention,
[We say] no, because of the proximity of the remainder (<s>śeṣa</s>).
Because [they are] effected by the [main] ritual action.
And because of the observation of indicatory marks (<s>liṅga</s>).

children.text: abhighāraṇe viprakarṣād anūyājavat pātrabhedaḥ syāt / Jaim_4,1.33 /
children.translated_text: In the case of <s>abhighāraṇa</s> (basting with ghee), because of the separation [from the main act], there should be a difference of vessel, as in the case of the <s>anūyāja</s> (after-offerings).

children.text: na vā pātratvād apātratvaṃ tv ekadeśatvāt / Jaim_4,1.34 /
children.translated_text: Or rather not, because it serves as a vessel; and the non-vessel status is because it is a part [of the same offering].
And because the joint employment is the cause.
And because of the observation of absence [of a separate vessel].
When [ghee] is present, the mention of 'with' [is appropriate].
If it be said that [the word 'with'] does not [refer] to that,
It should [refer to that], because of its primary meaning.

children.text: samānayanaṃ tu mukhyaṃ syāl liṅgadarśanāt / Jaim_4,1.40 /
children.translated_text: But the bringing together should be the primary [meaning], because of the observation of indicatory marks (<s>liṅga</s>).
For in the [Vedic] statement, the reason lacks the capacity [to prove otherwise].
In that case, the production should be undifferentiated.
There, [the mention of] the <s>juhū</s> (offering ladle) is for the purpose of prohibiting the <s>anūyāja</s> (after-offerings).
If it be said that [the mention of] the <s>upabhṛt</s> (secondary ladle) is likewise,
[We say] it should be a perpetual restatement (<s>anuvāda</s>), due to the prohibition of the <s>juhū</s>.
The number of those is eight, because of the Vedic statement.
And because of the support of [the number belonging to] the <s>juhū</s> [offerings].

children.text: dvayos tu hetusāmarthayaṃ śravaṇaṃ ca samānayane / Jaim_4,1.48 /
children.translated_text: But for both, the capacity of the reason and the Vedic statement [apply] in the case of bringing together.
The <s>svaru</s> (sacrificial post fragment), however, has multiple productions, because it is denoted by a term referring to its own action.
And [the doubt arises] because of its belonging to a different class.
Or it is a part of [the <s>yūpa</s>], since the nature of being a <s>svaru</s> has that [yūpa] as its cause.
And because of the Vedic statement regarding the chip (<s>śakala</s>).
And [it is] for each sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>), as is observed.
In the taking [of the svaru], the word 'karoti' (makes) [is used].
In the [Vedic] branch, because that [action] is the principal [meaning].

children.text: śākhāyāṃ tatpradhānatvād upaveṣeṇa vibhāgaḥ syād vaiṣamyaṃ tat / Jaim_4,2.8 /
children.translated_text: In the [Vedic] branch, because that is the principal, the division should be by means of <s>upaveṣa</s> (trimming); that [produces] the inequality.
And because of the departure from the Vedic text.

children.text: haraṇe tu juhotir yogasāmānyād dravyāṇāṃ cārthaśeṣatvāt / Jaim_4,2.10 /
children.translated_text: But in the carrying [of the substance], the word 'juhoti' (offers) [applies] because of the general connection, and because the substances are subordinate to the purpose.
Or the understanding of the word [should be according to] that which is principal in it.
Even if [it be said that it refers] to the purpose,

children.text: na tasyānadhikārād arthasya ca kṛtatvāt / Jaim_4,2.13 /
children.translated_text: [We say] no, because [the substance] has no authority over that, and because the purpose has already been accomplished.

children.text: utpattyasaṃyogāt praṇītānām ājyavad vibhāgaḥ syāt / Jaim_4,2.14 /
children.translated_text: Since there is no connection with production, [the waters] that have been brought forward should be divided like <s>ājya</s> (ghee).

children.text: saṃyavanārthānāṃ vā pratipattir itarāsāṃ tatpradhānatvāt / Jaim_4,2.15 /
children.translated_text: Or the understanding [should be] of those [waters] that serve the purpose of mixing, because that is their principal [function] among the others.
The giving of the staff to the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> [priest] is like the <s>prāsana</s> (preliminary offering), since its purpose has been accomplished.
Or it is a purposeful action, because of the connection with the agent, like the garland (<s>sraj</s>).
And because it is observed in connection with ritual action.

children.text: utpattau yena saṃyuktaṃ tadarthaṃ tacchrutihetutvāt tasyārthāntaragamane śeṣatvāt pratipattiḥ syāt / Jaim_4,2.19 /
children.translated_text: That which is connected [with a substance] at the time of production serves the purpose of that [substance], since that is the reason for the Vedic statement; when it passes to another purpose, because of its subordinate status, it should be [merely] received.
And in the <s>Saumika</s> [rite], because the purpose has been accomplished.
Or it is a purposeful action, because of the connection with the designation.
Or it should be [merely] received, since that is the rule; the Vedic statement about the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath) relates to the place.
The agent, place, and time are not [separately] enjoined in the performance, because of their invariable co-existence [with the action].
Or the Vedic statement serves the purpose of restriction (<s>niyama</s>).
Similarly, the mention of qualities regarding substances is because of the connection with production.
And in the case of <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration), because that [quality] is principal in it.
The word 'yajati' (sacrifices) [encompasses] substance, deity, and action in the <s>codanā</s> (injunction); [they are mentioned together] because the purpose is accomplished in the aggregate.

children.text: tadukte śravaṇāj juhotir āsecanādhikaḥ syāt / Jaim_4,2.28 /
children.translated_text: When that is stated, because of the Vedic text, the word 'juhoti' (offers) should additionally [imply] the act of pouring.

children.text: vidheḥ karmāpavargitvād arthāntare vidhipradeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_4,2.29 /
children.translated_text: Since the injunction (<s>vidhi</s>) concludes the action, the injunctive expression should apply to another purpose.

children.text: api votpattisaṃyogād arthasambandho 'viśiṣṭānāṃ prayogaikatvahetuḥ syāt / Jaim_4,2.30 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the connection with production, the relation to purpose of undifferentiated [elements] should be the reason for unity of performance.

children.text: dravyasaṃskārakarmasu parārthatvāt phalaśrutir arthavādaḥ syāt / Jaim_4,3.1 /
children.translated_text: In the case of substances, consecrations (<s>saṃskāra</s>), and actions, because they serve another purpose, the mention of fruit (<s>phala</s>) should be <s>arthavāda</s> (laudatory passage).
And because in the injunction of production, that [fruit] is not the principal [element].
But the fruit [is operative] when it [the fruit] is the principal [element] of the injunction.

children.text: naimittike vikāratvāt kratupradhānam anyat syāt / Jaim_4,3.4 /
children.translated_text: In an occasional rite (<s>naimittika</s>), because it is a modification, the principal should be something other than the sacrifice (<s>kratu</s>).
But when one [element] belongs to both, there is a separation of connections.
If it be said that [it is merely] a subsidiary (<s>śeṣa</s>),
[We say] no, because of the separateness of the purpose.
But the consecration (<s>saṃskāra</s>) of substances that serve the action should be a property of the sacrifice (<s>kratu</s>).
Because of [its] separateness, it would remain distinct.

children.text: codanāyāṃ phalāśruteḥ karmamātraṃ vidhīyeta na hy aśabdaṃ pratīyate / Jaim_4,3.10 /
children.translated_text: When there is no mention of fruit in the injunction (<s>codanā</s>), only the bare action should be understood as enjoined — for what is not expressed by words cannot be understood.

children.text: api vāmnānasāmatharthyāc codanārthena gamyetārthānāṃ hy arthatvena vacanāni pratīyante 'rthatopy asamarthānām ānantarye 'py asambandhas tasmāc chrutyekadeśaḥ saḥ / Jaim_4,3.11 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the incapacity of mere recitation, [the fruit] should be understood through the meaning of the injunction — for the statements of purposes are understood as having purposefulness; and even for those [statements] that are incapable of [conveying] purpose independently, though proximate, there is no connection [without the injunction]; therefore that [fruit] is a part of the Vedic statement.
And the meaning of the sentence is like a subordinate purpose.
That [injunction] serves all purposes, since there is no [specific] designation.
Or [it serves] one [purpose only], because of the unity of the injunction.

children.text: sa svargaḥ syāt sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_4,3.15 /
children.translated_text: That [one purpose] should be <s>svarga</s> (heaven), since it is common to all without distinction.
And because of the [universal] expectation [of heaven as a result].
In a sacrifice (<s>kratu</s>), the mention of fruit is <s>arthavāda</s> (laudatory passage), not a subsidiary — like the black antelope skin (<s>kārṣṇājini</s>).

children.text: phalamātreyo nirdeśād aśrutau hy anumānaṃ syāt / Jaim_4,3.18 /
children.translated_text: The fruit [determines the connection with] <s>Mātreya</s> rites, because of the [specific] mention; for when there is no Vedic statement, inference should [be employed].
In the case of subsidiaries (<s>aṅgas</s>), [the mention of fruit] is praise (<s>stuti</s>), because they serve another purpose.

children.text: kāmye karmaṇi nityaḥ svarge yathā yajñāṅge kratvarthaḥ / Jaim_4,3.20 /
children.translated_text: In a <s>kāmya</s> (desire-motivated) rite, the constant [subsidiary] serves the purpose of the sacrifice (<s>kratu</s>), just as a subsidiary of a sacrifice (<s>yajña</s>) [serves] <s>svarga</s> (heaven).
And when the cause has ceased, because of the restriction.
Or the desire (<s>kāma</s>) is prompted by connection with that [fruit].
In the case of subsidiaries (<s>aṅgas</s>), [the mention of fruit] is praise (<s>stuti</s>), because they serve another purpose.
And when [the cause] has ceased, the restriction serves that purpose.
All desire-motivated [elements] are [connected] with the desires for subsidiaries, because of the context (<s>prakaraṇa</s>).
Or it is an indication of fruit, because of the connection with the term [denoting] the principal.
In that case, all [are included] without distinction.
Or the accomplishment of the connection [is established], because the purpose is not connected with production.
In co-existence, because the connection with the injunction (<s>codanā</s>) is meaningful.
If it be said that when time is mentioned, [the injunction relates to] time,
[We say] no, because of the non-co-existence with the purpose.
If it be said that [the injunction] serves both purposes,
[We say] no, because of the unity of the verbal expression.
If it be said [that it is determined] by the context (<s>prakaraṇa</s>),
[We say] no, because of the connection with production.

children.text: anutpattau tu kālaḥ syāt prayojanena sambandhāt / Jaim_4,3.36 /
children.translated_text: But when there is no [connection with] production, [the injunction should relate to] time, because of the connection with the purpose.

children.text: utapattikālaviśaye kālaḥ syād vākyasya tatpradhānatvāt / Jaim_4,3.37 /
children.translated_text: When the subject concerns the time of production, [the injunction should relate to] time, because the sentence has that as its principal [element].

children.text: phalasaṃyogas tv acodite na syād aśeṣabhūtatvāt / Jaim_4,3.38 /
children.translated_text: But the connection with fruit should not exist for what is not [separately] enjoined, because it is not a subsidiary.
However, the connection of subsidiaries (<s>aṅgas</s>) with obstruction serves a causal purpose.
Because of the connection of subsidiaries (<s>aṅgas</s>) with the principal (<s>pradhāna</s>), the primary time [of the subsidiaries is that of the principal].

children.text: apavṛtte tu codanā tatsāmānyāt svakāle syāt / Jaim_4,3.41 /
children.translated_text: But when [the principal] has concluded, the injunction should [assign the subsidiary] to its own time, because of the similarity with that [principal].

children.text: prakaraṇāvibhāge ca vipratiṣiddhaṃ hy ubhayam / Jaim_4,4.1 /
children.translated_text: And when there is no division of the context (<s>prakaraṇa</s>), both [interpretations] are contradictory.

children.text: api vāṅgamanijyāḥ syus tato viśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_4,4.2 /
children.translated_text: Or the offerings (<s>iṣṭi</s>) should be subsidiaries (<s>aṅgas</s>), because they are thereby distinguished.
What is in the middle [belongs to] that in the middle of which [it occurs].

children.text: sarvāsāṃ vā samatvāc codanātaḥ syān na hi tasya prakaraṇaṃ deśārtham ucyate madhye / Jaim_4,4.4 /
children.translated_text: Or all [offerings should be subsidiaries] equally, because of the injunction — for the context (<s>prakaraṇa</s>) of that [rite] is not stated for the purpose of place [alone]; [it is stated] in the middle.

children.text: prakaraṇāvibhāge ca vipratiṣiddhaṃ hy ubhayam / Jaim_4,4.5 /
children.translated_text: And when there is no division of the context (<s>prakaraṇa</s>), both [interpretations] are contradictory.

children.text: api vā kālamātraṃ syād adarśanād viśeśasya / Jaim_4,4.6 /
children.translated_text: Or it should relate to time only, because no specific distinction is observed.

children.text: phalavad voktahetutvād itarasya pradhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_4,4.7 /
children.translated_text: Or, because [one rite] is stated as the reason, [while] the other should be the principal, like [the relation between] fruit [and rite].
The <s>dadhighara</s> (curd-libation) is occasional (<s>naimittika</s>), because of the connection with the Vedic statement.
And it is constant (<s>nitya</s>), because of the word 'jyeṣṭha' (eldest/chief).
And because of its universal applicability.

children.text: nityo vā syād arthavādastayoḥ karmaṇy asambandhād bhaṅgitvāc cāntarāyasya / Jaim_4,4.11 /
children.translated_text: Or it should be constant (<s>nitya</s>), [while the mention of occasion is] <s>arthavāda</s> (laudatory passage), because there is no connection of those two with the [occasional] rite, and because the obstacle is incidental.

children.text: vaiśvānaraś ca nityaḥ syān nityaiḥ samānasaṅkhyatvāt / Jaim_4,4.12 /
children.translated_text: And the <s>Vaiśvānara</s> [offering] should be constant (<s>nitya</s>), because it has the same number as the constant [offerings].
Or [it is connected] with the half-month (<s>pakṣa</s>), because of the connection with what has arisen.
The six layers of bricks (<s>ṣaṭciti</s>) [should be constructed], because of the similarity with the preceding.
And because of the equal number with those [preceding layers].
And because of the cogency of the <s>arthavāda</s> (laudatory passage).

children.text: ekacitir vā syād apavṛkte hi codyate nimittena / Jaim_4,4.17 /
children.translated_text: Or there should be one layer only, for [the additional layer] is enjoined when [the regular construction] has concluded, by reason of the occasion.
Because of the contradiction, the number equal to those [is established].
The <s>Pitṛyajña</s> (offering to the ancestors) should be an independent [rite] and not a subsidiary (<s>aṅga</s>), because of its having its own time.
And because it is enumerated as equal [to other independent rites].
And because it is observed [to be performed] even when [the main rite is] prohibited.

children.text: paśvaṅga raśamā syāt tadāgame vidhānāt / Jaim_4,4.22 /
children.translated_text: The <s>raśanā</s> (tethering rope) should be a subsidiary of the animal (<s>paśu</s>), because it is enjoined when that [animal] is present.
Or it is a subsidiary of the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>), because of its being a consecration (<s>saṃskāra</s>) of that.
And the <s>arthavāda</s> (laudatory passage) [supports this], as it relates to that purpose.
And the <s>svaru</s> (post-chip) also, because of being a part [of the yūpa].
And the ransom (<s>niṣkraya</s>) is like a subsidiary of that.
Or [the rope] is a subsidiary of the animal (<s>paśu</s>), because it serves a purposeful action.
The statement about ransom (<s>niṣkraya</s>) should be [understood] figuratively (<s>bhakti</s>).
In the <s>Darśapūrṇamāsa</s> (new and full moon sacrifices), the offerings (<s>iṣṭi</s>) are principal, without distinction.

children.text: api vāṅgāni kāni cidyeśvaṅgatvena saṃstutiḥ sāmānyo hy abhisaṃstavaḥ / Jaim_4,4.30 /
children.translated_text: Or some are subsidiaries (<s>aṅgas</s>), [for] certain ones are praised as being subsidiaries; for the praise is general.
And likewise, [there is] observation of [them] serving another purpose.

children.text: avaśiṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ pradhāneṣu guṇasya vidyamānatvāt / Jaim_4,4.32 /
children.translated_text: But the remaining reason [for their being principal is valid] regarding the principal [rites], since the subordinate [element] is present [in them].
When [a rite] is not [separately] enjoined, it is not observed to serve another purpose, because it serves [the purpose of] another.

children.text: pṛthavatve tv abhidhānayor niveśaḥ śrutito vyapadeśāc ca tatpunarmukhyalakṣaṇaṃ yatphalavatvaṃ tatsannidhāv asaṃyuktaṃ tadaṅgaṃsyādbhāgitvāt kāraṇasyāśrutaś cānyasambandhaḥ / Jaim_4,4.34 /
children.translated_text: But when the two statements are separate, [a rite] should be established based on the Vedic text and on the designation; and its primary characteristic is that which possesses fruit — when that [fruit] is proximate, what is unconnected [with it] should be a subsidiary, because of partaking [in the principal]; and the connection of the cause with another [not mentioned in the text] is unheard of.

children.text: guṇāś ca nāmasaṃyuktā vidhīyante nāṅgeṣūṣapadyante / Jaim_4,4.35 /
children.translated_text: And the qualities connected with the name are enjoined [in the principal rite] and do not apply to the subsidiaries (<s>aṅgas</s>).

children.text: tulyā ca kāraṇaśrutir anyair aṅgāṅgisambandhaḥ / Jaim_4,4.36 /
children.translated_text: And the Vedic statement of the cause is equal [in both cases]; the subsidiary-principal relationship [is determined] by other [means].

children.text: utpattāv abhisambandhas tasmād aṅgopadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_4,4.37 /
children.translated_text: The connection [is established] at the time of production; therefore there should be an indication of subsidiary status.
And likewise, [there is] observation of [them] serving another purpose.

children.text: jyotiṣṭome tulyāny aviśiṣṭaṃ hi kāraṇam / Jaim_4,4.39 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> (a Soma sacrifice), [the subsidiary rites] are equal, for the cause is undifferentiated. / Jaim_4,4.39 /

children.text: guṇānāṃ tūtpattivākyena sambandhāt kāraṇaśrutis tasmāt somaḥ pradhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_4,4.40 /
children.translated_text: But for the subsidiaries (<s>guṇa</s>), there is a statement of cause through the originating sentence due to their connection; therefore <s>Soma</s> would be the principal (<s>pradhāna</s>). / Jaim_4,4.40 /
And thus there is observation of [this principle] in other contexts. / Jaim_4,4.41 /
The sequence (<s>ānupūrvya</s>) is determined by scripture (<s>śruti</s>), because that is the authority. / Jaim_5,1.1 /
And from the purpose. / Jaim_5,1.2 /
There is no fixed rule elsewhere. / Jaim_5,1.3 /

children.text: krameṇa vā niyamyeta kratvekatve tadguṇatvāt / Jaim_5,1.4 /
children.translated_text: Or the order may be fixed by sequence when the sacrifice is one, because [the elements] are subsidiary to it. / Jaim_5,1.4 /

children.text: aśābda iti cet syād vākyaśabdatvāt / Jaim_5,1.5 /
children.translated_text: If it be said that [the sequence] is not expressed in words, [we reply that] it would be so, because it is expressed through the sentence. / Jaim_5,1.5 /

children.text: arthakṛte vānumānaṃ syāt kratvekatve parārthatvāt svena tv arthena sambandhas tasmāt svaśabdam ucyeta / Jaim_5,1.6 /
children.translated_text: Or there may be inference based on purpose when the sacrifice is one, because [the elements] serve another; but the connection is through its own purpose, therefore it should be stated by its own word. / Jaim_5,1.6 /
And thus there is observation of [this principle] in other contexts. / Jaim_5,1.7 /
For subsidiaries that are simultaneous in their operation, [the sequence is determined] from their commencement. / Jaim_5,1.8 /
If it be said [that this applies to] all — / Jaim_5,1.9 /
No, because [the rite] has not yet been performed. / Jaim_5,1.10 /
If it be said [it should be] like another sacrifice — / Jaim_5,1.11 /
No, because there is no inherent connection. / Jaim_5,1.12 /
And from the position, due to its connection with origination. / Jaim_5,1.13 /
Or the sequence of the subsidiaries (<s>aṅga</s>) follows the principal, because they serve its purpose. / Jaim_5,1.14 /
But in the archetype (<s>prakṛti</s>), the sequence up to [the end] should be understood from its own explicit statement. / Jaim_5,1.15 /

children.text: mantratas tu virodhe syāt prayogarūpasāmarthyāt tasmād utpattideśaḥ saḥ / Jaim_5,1.16 /
children.translated_text: But in case of conflict, [the order should be determined] from the <s>mantras</s>, due to the capacity of the form of application; therefore that is the place of origination. / Jaim_5,1.16 /

children.text: tadvacanād vikṛtau yathā pradhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_5,1.17 /
children.translated_text: In the modified rite (<s>vikṛti</s>), by reason of that statement, it should be as in the principal. / Jaim_5,1.17 /
Or in case of discrepancy, [the order should be] according to the archetype, by conformity with the archetype. / Jaim_5,1.18 /

children.text: vikṛtiḥ prakṛtidharmatvāt tatkālā syād yathā śiṣṭam / Jaim_5,1.19 /
children.translated_text: The modified rite should follow the time of the archetype, because it partakes of the archetype's properties, as taught. / Jaim_5,1.19 /

children.text: api vā kramakālasaṃyuktā sadyaḥ kriyeta tatra vidher anumānāt prakṛtidharmalopaḥ syāt / Jaim_5,1.20 /
children.translated_text: Or alternatively, being connected with sequence and time, it should be performed immediately; there, from inference of the injunction, there would be loss of the archetype's properties. / Jaim_5,1.20 /
If it be said [there is] temporal advancement (<s>utkarṣa</s>) — / Jaim_5,1.21 /
No, because of its connection with that [archetype]. / Jaim_5,1.22 /

children.text: aṅgānāṃ mukhyakālatvād yathoktam utkarṣe syāt / Jaim_5,1.23 /
children.translated_text: Since the subsidiaries have the time of the principal, in case of advancement it should be as stated. / Jaim_5,1.23 /

children.text: tadādi vābhisambandhāt tadantam apakarṣe syāt / Jaim_5,1.24 /
children.translated_text: Or beginning with that, due to the connection, it should end with that in case of postponement (<s>apakarṣa</s>). / Jaim_5,1.24 /
For those whose time has been established by [their] operation. / Jaim_5,1.25 /
And because of conflict with the verbal statement. / Jaim_5,1.26 /

children.text: asaṃyogāt tu vaikṛtaṃ tad eva pratikṛṣyeta. Jaim_5,1.27 /
children.translated_text: But due to lack of connection, that which is of the modified rite should itself be postponed. / Jaim_5,1.27 /
And that which is incidental (<s>prāsaṅgika</s>) should not be advanced, due to lack of connection. / Jaim_5,1.28 /
Likewise that which is unprecedented (<s>apūrva</s>). / Jaim_5,1.29 /

children.text: sāntapanīyā tūtkarṣed agnihotraṃ savanavad vaiguṇyāt / Jaim_5,1.30 /
children.translated_text: But the <s>Sāntapanīya</s> (expiatory rite) should be advanced, [placed before] the <s>Agnihotra</s> like a <s>savana</s> (pressing), because of a deficiency. / Jaim_5,1.30 /
And because of intervention. / Jaim_5,1.31 /
But [it] should not be advanced due to lack of connection. / Jaim_5,1.32 /
And because the occasion has been reached. / Jaim_5,1.33 /
Due to the connection, [there is] advancement to the <s>savana</s> (pressing). / Jaim_5,1.34 /
And the <s>Ṣoḍaśī</s> (sixteen-versed hymn) due to its connection with the <s>Ukthya</s>. / Jaim_5,1.35 /

children.text: sannipāte prādhānānām ekaikasya guṇānāṃ sarvakarma syāt / Jaim_5,2.1 /
children.translated_text: When principal [rites] come together, each one's subsidiaries should serve all [the principals]. / Jaim_5,2.1 /
For all [principals], [each subsidiary applies] uniformly, because the sequence has been established. / Jaim_5,2.2 /
Repetition [occurs] due to the cause. / Jaim_5,2.3 /

In the case of scooping (<s>muṣṭi</s>), cutting of the sacrificial cake (<s>kapālāvadāna</s>), anointing (<s>añjana</s>), smearing (<s>abhyañjana</s>), shaving (<s>vapana</s>), and purifying (<s>pāvana</s>), [it is done] with one [act]. / Jaim_5,2.4 /
But all [these acts apply to] each, because they serve a single purpose, and because they are subsidiary to that. / Jaim_5,2.5 /

children.text: saṃyukte tu prakramāt tadaṅgaṃ syād itarasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_5,2.6 /
children.translated_text: But when [two rites are] conjoined, from the commencement [of one], [the subsidiary] would belong to that [rite], because it serves the purpose of the other. / Jaim_5,2.6 /

children.text: vacanāt tu parivyāṇāntam añjanādiḥ syāt / Jaim_5,2.7 /
children.translated_text: But by reason of the verbal statement, [the procedure] from anointing onwards should extend up to the covering (<s>parivyāṇa</s>). / Jaim_5,2.7 /

children.text: kāraṇādvā(na) vasargaḥ syād yathā pātravṛddhiḥ / Jaim_5,2.8 /
children.translated_text: Or from the cause, [there should be no] release, as in the case of the increase of vessels (<s>pātravṛddhi</s>). / Jaim_5,2.8 /

children.text: na vā śabdakṛtatvān nyāyamātramitaradarthāt pātravivṛddhiḥ / Jaim_5,2.9 /
children.translated_text: Or not, because [the rule] is established by the word, the other is merely a principle (<s>nyāya</s>) [derived] from purpose; the increase of vessels [is determined differently]. / Jaim_5,2.9 /
In a group of animals (<s>paśugaṇa</s>), one should set apart each [animal separately], because each sacrificial animal is a unit. / Jaim_5,2.10 /
Because of the unity of action with respect to the deities. / Jaim_5,2.11 /
And because the <s>mantra</s> has a [specific] meaning. / Jaim_5,2.12 /
For different kinds of grain, there is one mortar (<s>ulūkhala</s>), due to capacity. / Jaim_5,2.13 /
Or there should be an increase [of mortars], because the sequence is restrictive, since they serve that purpose. / Jaim_5,2.14 /

children.text: ekaṃ vā taṇḍulabhāvād dhantes tadarthatvāt / Jaim_5,2.15 /
children.translated_text: Or one [mortar], because [the grains] attain the state of rice grains (<s>taṇḍula</s>) through husking, and [the mortar] serves that purpose. / Jaim_5,2.15 /

children.text: vikāre tv anūyājānāṃ pātrabhedo 'rthabhedāt syāt / Jaim_5,2.16 /
children.translated_text: But in a modification, there should be a distinction of vessels for the <s>anūyājas</s> (after-offerings), due to the distinction of purpose. / Jaim_5,2.16 /

children.text: prakṛteḥ pūrvoktatvād apūrvam ante syān na hy acoditasya śeṣāmnānam / Jaim_5,2.17 /
children.translated_text: Since the archetype has been stated earlier, the new [element] should come at the end, for there is no supplementary mention of what has not been enjoined. / Jaim_5,2.17 /

children.text: mukhyānantaryamātreyas tena tulyaśrutitvād aśabdatvāt prākṛtānāṃ vyavāyaḥ syāt / Jaim_5,2.18 /
children.translated_text: <s>Ātreya</s> [holds that] there should be only immediate succession to the principal; therefore, because of equal textual authority and the absence of explicit statement, the archetypal [elements] should be interspersed. / Jaim_5,2.18 /

children.text: ante tu bādarāyaṇas teṣāṃ pradhānaśabdatvāt / Jaim_5,2.19 /
children.translated_text: But <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s> [holds they should come] at the end, because those [archetypal elements] have the character of the principal. / Jaim_5,2.19 /
And thus there is observation of [this principle] in other contexts. / Jaim_5,2.20 /

children.text: kṛtadeśāt tu pūrveṣāṃ sa deśaḥ syāt tena pratyakṣasaṃyogān nayāyamātramitarat / Jaim_5,2.21 /
children.translated_text: But for the earlier [elements] whose place has been established, that place should [remain], because of direct connection with that; the other is merely a principle. / Jaim_5,2.21 /
And that which is before the archetype. / Jaim_5,2.22 /
If there is a convergence, [the new element] should come at the end as stated. / Jaim_5,2.23 /
There should be an increase due to the distinction of rites, as in the case of <s>pṛṣadājya</s> (curd mixed with ghee); it should be assigned to each [rite separately]. / Jaim_5,3.1 /

children.text: api vā sarvasaṅkhyatvād vikāraḥ pratīyeta / Jaim_5,3.2 /
children.translated_text: Or alternatively, since [the word denotes] the entire number, a modification should be understood. / Jaim_5,3.2 /
But they should be increased from their own place, because the sequence has been established. / Jaim_5,3.3 /

children.text: samidhyamānavatīṃ samiddhavatīṃ cāntareṇa dhāyyāḥ syur dyāvāpṛthiñyorantarālaṃ samarhaṇāt / Jaim_5,3.4 /
children.translated_text: The <s>dhāyyās</s> (oblation verses) should be [placed] between the <s>Samidhyamānavatī</s> and the <s>Samiddhavatī</s> [verses], as [they occupy] the intermediate space between heaven and earth, by reason of fitness. / Jaim_5,3.4 /
Or [this is indicated by] the word 'that.' / Jaim_5,3.5 /
At the end of the <s>Uṣṇih</s> and <s>Kakubh</s> [metres], from observation. / Jaim_5,3.6 /

children.text: stomavivṛddhau vahiṣpavamāne purastāt paryāsād āgantavaḥ syus tathā hi dṛṣṭaṃ dvādaśāhe / Jaim_5,3.7 /
children.translated_text: In the increase of the <s>stoma</s> (hymn-form), in the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> (external purification chant), before the reversal (<s>paryāsa</s>), the additional [verses] should be [placed], for thus it is seen in the <s>Dvādaśāha</s> (twelve-day rite). / Jaim_5,3.7 /
And the reversal (<s>paryāsa</s>) is called the end. / Jaim_5,3.8 /
Or [they should be placed] at the end, as that has been stated. / Jaim_5,3.9 /
But in the <s>Dvādaśāha</s>, by reason of the verbal statement. / Jaim_5,3.10 /
And [this is] not a modification of that. / Jaim_5,3.11 /
Even in a modification of that, because of its being unprecedented. / Jaim_5,3.12 /
But [additional verses] should be given at the end of the latter two. / Jaim_5,3.13 /
Or alternatively, in the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, <s>Bṛhatī</s>, and <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> [metres], by reason of the verbal statement. / Jaim_5,3.14 /

The brick [laid] at the <s>graha</s> (cup-drawing) is an accessory to the <s>aupānuvākya</s> (invitatory verse), being a remainder of the <s>savana</s> (pressing) and the <s>citi</s> (fire-altar layer). / Jaim_5,3.15 /
Or it is a remainder of the sacrifice and the fire, because it has been enjoined, while the sequence of that which is not enjoined [is not determinative]. / Jaim_5,3.16 /
They should be at the end, because there is no interruption. / Jaim_5,3.17 /
And from the observation of an indicatory mark (<s>liṅga</s>). / Jaim_5,3.18 /
But in the middle [pressing], [the verses] containing <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> [references should be recited], by reason of the verbal statement. / Jaim_5,3.19 /
Before the <s>Lokampṛṇā</s> [libation], because that [libation] serves the purpose of completion. / Jaim_5,3.20 /
After the consecration (<s>saṃskāra</s>) of [the ritual substance], the rite [should follow], because the consecrations serve that purpose. / Jaim_5,3.21 /
The vow (<s>vrata</s>) [follows] immediately after, because it partakes of that [consecrated state]. / Jaim_5,3.22 /
And [it comes] before, from the observation of an indicatory mark. / Jaim_5,3.23 /
Or it is an <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage), because the meaning is already established. / Jaim_5,3.24 /
And because of the conflict with the [general] principle. / Jaim_5,3.25 /

children.text: sañcite tv agnicid yuktaṃ prāpaṇān nimittasya / Jaim_5,3.26 /
children.translated_text: But when [the fire-altar] has been piled up, [the rite of] the <s>Agnicit</s> (fire-altar builder) is appropriate, because the occasion has been reached. / Jaim_5,3.26 /
Or [it should be performed] at the end of the sacrifice, because there is no statement of application. / Jaim_5,3.27 /
Because of the designation of the fire as having the nature of a rite. / Jaim_5,3.28 /

children.text: pareṇāvedanād dīkṣitaḥ syāt sarvair dīkṣābhisambandhāt / Jaim_5,3.29 /
children.translated_text: Through [the connection] with the next [rite], until the concluding bath, [the sacrificer] should be consecrated (<s>dīkṣita</s>) with all [consecrations], because of the connection with the <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation). / Jaim_5,3.29 /

children.text: iṣṭyante vā tadarthā hy aviśeṣārthasanvandhāt / Jaim_5,3.30 /
children.translated_text: Or [the consecrations should extend] until the end of the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering), for they serve that purpose, because of the connection with a non-specific purpose. / Jaim_5,3.30 /
And the designation (<s>samākhyāna</s>) is likewise. / Jaim_5,3.31 /
The sequence of sacrifices is like that of subsidiaries. / Jaim_5,3.32 /
Or not, because of the absence of connection. / Jaim_5,3.33 /
And because they are optional (<s>kāmya</s>). / Jaim_5,3.34 /
If it be said that [the sequence is] not [required] because of purposelessness — / Jaim_5,3.35 /

children.text: syād vidyārthatvād yathā pareṣu sarvasvārāt / Jaim_5,3.36 /
children.translated_text: It would [still be required] because it serves the purpose of knowledge, as in the case of the others, from the <s>Sarvasvāra</s> [hymn]. / Jaim_5,3.36 /
'Whoever [sacrifices] by this [rite]' — [this refers to] the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, from the context. / Jaim_5,3.37 /
And from the indicatory mark (<s>liṅga</s>). / Jaim_5,3.38 /
'And by another' — [this refers to] the <s>saṃsthās</s> (concluding forms of sacrifice), because of proximity. / Jaim_5,3.39 /
Or, [since they are] modifications of that archetype, substitution and transposition do not apply when [the rites] are equal. / Jaim_5,3.40 /
And [this is confirmed by] the praise, because there is no transposition. / Jaim_5,3.41 /

children.text: vidhipratyayād vā na hy akasmāt praśaṃsā syāt / Jaim_5,3.42 /
children.translated_text: Or, from the apprehension of an injunction, for praise would not occur without a reason. / Jaim_5,3.42 /
Or [it applies] in the single <s>stoma</s> (hymn-form), because of the connection with the sacrifice. / Jaim_5,3.43 /

children.text: sarveṣāṃ vā codanāviśeṣāt praśaṃsā stomānām / Jaim_5,3.44 /
children.translated_text: Or the praise of the <s>stomas</s> [applies] to all, because there is no distinction in the injunction. / Jaim_5,3.44 /
The exchange of sequence (<s>kramakoya</s>) [is determined] from purpose and word, because of a specific scriptural statement and because it is directed toward a purpose. / Jaim_5,4.1 /
In the cutting of portions (<s>avadāna</s>), basting (<s>abhighāraṇa</s>), and placing [on the altar] (<s>āsādana</s>), the sequence should be [determined] by the [order of] operation. / Jaim_5,4.2 /
Or [it should be] according to the order of offering, because [the sequence] serves that purpose. / Jaim_5,4.3 /
And from the observation of an indicatory mark. / Jaim_5,4.4 /
The <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) has precedence, by reason of the verbal statement. / Jaim_5,4.5 /

children.text: somaś caikeṣām agnayādheyasyartunakṣatrātikramavacanāt tadantenānarthakaṃ hi syāt / Jaim_5,4.6 /
children.translated_text: And according to some, <s>Soma</s> [has precedence] over the <s>Agnayādhāna</s> (establishment of the sacred fires), because of the statement regarding the passing of seasons and asterisms; [otherwise] with that [Agnayādhāna] at the end, it would be purposeless. / Jaim_5,4.6 /
And from the statement serving that purpose, [it does] not [follow that there is] identity of purpose due to non-distinction. / Jaim_5,4.7 /

children.text: ayakṣyamāṇasya ca pavamānahaviṣāṃ kālanirdeśād ānantaryād viśaṅkā syāt / Jaim_5,4.8 /
children.translated_text: And for one who is not about to sacrifice, from the specification of time for the <s>Pavamāna</s> (purificatory) and <s>havis</s> (oblation) [rites], there would be doubt due to immediate succession. / Jaim_5,4.8 /

children.text: iṣṭir ayakṣyamāṇasya tadarthye na somapūrvatvam / Jaim_5,4.9 /
children.translated_text: The <s>iṣṭi</s> of one who is not about to sacrifice — if it serves that purpose, there is no precedence of <s>Soma</s>. / Jaim_5,4.9 /
Due to advancement, <s>Soma</s> would be [performed first] for a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>. / Jaim_5,4.10 /
Or [it should be performed] on the full-moon day (<s>paurṇamāsī</s>), because of the connection with scripture. / Jaim_5,4.11 /
For all, because of the unity of action. / Jaim_5,4.12 /
Or there may be an injunction with that purpose. / Jaim_5,4.13 /
But the time should be [determined] from the context. / Jaim_5,4.14 /
[It should be performed] at its own time, because there is no contradiction. / Jaim_5,4.15 /
Or the removal of the [fire-]establishment [should occur], because of the applicability to all times. / Jaim_5,4.16 /

children.text: paurṇamāsy ūrdhvaṃ somād brāhmaṇasya vacanāt / Jaim_5,4.17 /
children.translated_text: The full-moon day after the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifice] for the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, by reason of the verbal statement. / Jaim_5,4.17 /

children.text: ekaṃ vā śabdasāmarthyāt prāk kṛtsnavidhānam / Jaim_5,4.18 /
children.translated_text: Or [there should be] one [performance], by the force of the word, [with] the complete procedure before [the Soma]. / Jaim_5,4.18 /

children.text: puroḍāśas tv anirdeśe tadyukte devatābhāvāt / Jaim_5,4.19 /
children.translated_text: But the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice-cake offering), when there is no specification, [should be assigned] to that which is appropriate, because of the absence of a deity [otherwise]. / Jaim_5,4.19 /
If it be said that the <s>ājya</s> (ghee oblation) also — / Jaim_5,4.20 /
No, because it has mixed deities, like the <s>Aindrāgna</s> (offering to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>). / Jaim_5,4.21 /

children.text: vikṛteḥ prakṛtikālatvāt sadyaskālottarā vikṛtis tayoḥ pratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_5,4.22 /
children.translated_text: The modified rite has the time of its archetype; the modified rite follows immediately after, because both are directly taught. / Jaim_5,4.22 /
But when [the rite] extends over two days, [it should be] according to the standard rule. / Jaim_5,4.23 /
There would be unity of time, by reason of the verbal statement. / Jaim_5,4.24 /

The modifications of the <s>Sānnāyya</s> (mixed milk oblation) and the <s>Agnīṣomīya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>) [should be performed] after the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifice], like the archetype. / Jaim_5,4.25 /
Likewise the modifications of the <s>Soma</s> [should follow] the <s>Darśapūrṇamāsa</s> (new- and full-moon sacrifices). / Jaim_5,4.26 /
When substances (<s>dravya</s>) are connected with a rite, the connection is as a subsidiary (<s>guṇa</s>). / Jaim_6,1.1 /
But [a substance] that does not accomplish [the rite directly] is [connected] because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_6,1.2 /

children.text: pratyarthaṃ cābhisaṃyogātkarmato hy abhisambandhas tasmāt karmopadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,1.3 /
children.translated_text: And for each purpose the connection is through the rite, for the connection is with the rite; therefore there should be instruction regarding the rite. / Jaim_6,1.3 /

children.text: phalārthatvāt karmaṇaḥ śāstraṃ sarvādhikāraṃ syāt / Jaim_6,1.4 /
children.translated_text: Since the rite is for the sake of the result (<s>phala</s>), the scriptural injunction should have universal applicability. / Jaim_6,1.4 /

children.text: kartur vā śrutisaṃyogād vidhiḥ kārtsnyena gamyate / Jaim_6,1.5 /
children.translated_text: Or, from the connection with scripture, the injunction is understood in its entirety as pertaining to the performer (<s>kartṛ</s>). / Jaim_6,1.5 /
<s>Aitiśāyana</s> [holds that it is] connected with males, because of the specification of the masculine indicatory mark (<s>liṅga</s>). / Jaim_6,1.6 /
And because the statement of fault [pertains to cases] where [the gender] is not known, since that is what is stated. / Jaim_6,1.7 /

children.text: jātiṃ tu bādarāyaṇo 'viśeṣāt tasmāt stry api pratīyeta jātyarthasyāviśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_6,1.8 /
children.translated_text: But <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s> [holds it refers to] the class (<s>jāti</s>), because there is no distinction; therefore a woman also should be understood [as eligible], because the class-meaning is undifferentiated. / Jaim_6,1.8 /
Because it is enjoined, [it should be taken] according to the literal text. / Jaim_6,1.9 /

children.text: dravyavattvāt tu puṃsāṃ syād dravyasaṃyuktaṃ krayavikrayābhyām adravyatvaṃ strīṇāṃ dravyaiḥ samānayogitvāt / Jaim_6,1.10 /
children.translated_text: But [the right to perform rites] would belong to men because of [their] possessing property (<s>dravya</s>); property is connected through buying and selling; women lack property because they are always dependent on property [of others]. / Jaim_6,1.10 /
And thus there is observation of [this principle] in other contexts. / Jaim_6,1.11 /
The purpose of the rite is [determined] by the purpose [it serves]. / Jaim_6,1.12 /
But because there is no distinction in the enthusiasm for the result. / Jaim_6,1.13 /
And because [the result] is inherent in the purpose. / Jaim_6,1.14 /
Purchase (<s>kraya</s>) is merely a legal formality (<s>dharma</s>). / Jaim_6,1.15 /
[Scripture] also shows the state of ownership. / Jaim_6,1.16 /

children.text: svavatos tu vacanād aikakarmyaṃ syāt / Jaim_6,1.17 /
children.translated_text: But for one who owns [property], from the verbal statement, there would be unity of action. / Jaim_6,1.17 /
And from the observation of an indicatory mark. / Jaim_6,1.18 /

children.text: krītatvāt tu bhaktyā svāmitvam ucyate / Jaim_6,1.19 /
children.translated_text: But because of having been purchased, ownership is said to be through devotion (<s>bhakti</s>). / Jaim_6,1.19 /
But the connection is through ownership, because [one is] desirous of the result. / Jaim_6,1.20 /
[Scripture] shows the state of bearing fruit. / Jaim_6,1.21 /
And a dual establishment [of fires] is like a dual sacrifice. / Jaim_6,1.22 /

children.text: guṇasya tu vidhānatvāt patnyā dvitīyaśabdaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,1.23 /
children.translated_text: But since [the wife's role] is a subsidiary element, the word 'second' would apply to the wife. / Jaim_6,1.23 /

children.text: tasyā yāvaduktam āśīr brahmacaryam atulyatvāt / Jaim_6,1.24 /
children.translated_text: For her, the vow of celibacy lasts as long as stated, because of the dissimilarity. / Jaim_6,1.24 /
All four <s>varṇas</s> (social classes) [are eligible], because there is no distinction. / Jaim_6,1.25 /

children.text: nirdeśād vā trayāṇāṃ syād agnyādheye 'sambandhaḥ kratuṣu brāhmaṇaśruter ity ātreyaḥ / Jaim_6,1.26 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the express mention, [the eligibility] of the three [upper <s>varṇas</s>] would apply; in the <s>Agnyādheya</s> (fire-establishment rite), there is no connection [for the fourth]; in the sacrificial rites, because of the Vedic statement regarding the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> — thus <s>Ātreya</s>. / Jaim_6,1.26 /

children.text: nimittārthe na bādaris tasmāt sarvādhikāraṃ syāt / Jaim_6,1.27 /
children.translated_text: Not so, says <s>Bādari</s>, because [the mention] serves as an occasion; therefore there would be universal eligibility. / Jaim_6,1.27 /
Or, because of the observation of another purpose, it should be understood according to the literal text. / Jaim_6,1.28 /
But because of the express mention, [the restriction] would apply in the alternative view. / Jaim_6,1.29 /
If [it be objected] that it is not so because of a deficiency in the subsidiary element — / Jaim_6,1.30 /
Not so, because [those rites] are optional. / Jaim_6,1.31 /
And in the case of the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecratory rite), because that [Vedic study] is the principal element therein. / Jaim_6,1.32 /

children.text: api vā vedanirdeśād apaśūdrāṇāṃ pratīyeta / Jaim_6,1.33 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the Vedic statement, it should be understood as applying to all except <s>Śūdras</s>. / Jaim_6,1.33 /
If [it be objected] that it is not so because [the <s>saṃskāra</s>] is for the purpose of a subsidiary element — / Jaim_6,1.34 /
Because the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration) has its purpose in that [Vedic study], the Vedic statement regarding the person [applies] to the <s>vidyā</s> (knowledge). / Jaim_6,1.35 /
If [it be objected] that it is not so because of the express mention of <s>vidyā</s> (knowledge) — / Jaim_6,1.36 /
Because he is not a [qualified] student, the absence [of eligibility] would apply in the case of the ritual act. / Jaim_6,1.37 /
And thus another purpose is observed. / Jaim_6,1.38 /
One of the three [upper <s>varṇas</s>] who is endowed with the [requisite] substances [is eligible] for the ritual act, because [the act is] accomplished through substances. / Jaim_6,1.39 /

children.text: anityatvāt tu naivaṃ syād arthād dhi dravyasaṃyogaḥ / Jaim_6,1.40 /
children.translated_text: But it would not be so because of the impermanence [of wealth]; for the connection with substance is based on the purpose. / Jaim_6,1.40 /
And one who is deficient in a subsidiary element has the same character as that [element]. / Jaim_6,1.41 /
Because of the permanent connection at the time of origination. / Jaim_6,1.42 /
The loss of the <s>Ātreya</s> lineage designation would result. / Jaim_6,1.43 /
Because of the scriptural statement, the <s>Rathakāra</s> (chariot-maker) [is eligible] for the <s>Ādhāna</s> (fire-establishment), because he is subordinate to all [rites]. / Jaim_6,1.44 /

children.text: nyāyyo vā karmasaṃyogāc chūdrasya pratiṣiddhatatvāt / Jaim_6,1.45 /
children.translated_text: Or it is proper because of the connection with ritual action, since the <s>Śūdra</s>'s [participation] has been prohibited. / Jaim_6,1.45 /
But it would not be so because of the absence of ritual competence. / Jaim_6,1.46 /
And it would be purposeless because of the connection. / Jaim_6,1.47 /
If [it be said that it is] for the purpose of a subsidiary element — / Jaim_6,1.48 /
It has been stated that [the mention] does not serve as an occasion. / Jaim_6,1.49 /

children.text: saudhanvanās tu hīnatvān mantravarṇāt pratīyeran / Jaim_6,1.50 /
children.translated_text: But the <s>Saudhanvanas</s> (descendants of Sudhanvan), because of their lower status, should be understood from the words of the <s>mantras</s>. / Jaim_6,1.50 /
The <s>Rathapati</s> (chariot-lord) would be a <s>Niṣāda</s> (a mixed-caste person), because of the force of the word. / Jaim_6,1.51 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_6,1.52 /
Because a person's purpose is accomplished by a single [performance], the eligibility would belong to that particular person. / Jaim_6,2.1 /

children.text: api cotpattisaṃyogo yathā syāt satvadaryaśanaṃ tathābhāvo vibhāge syāt / Jaim_6,2.2 /
children.translated_text: And also, the originary connection would be as if the observation of the existence were so; in the case of separation, the absence would apply. / Jaim_6,2.2 /

children.text: prayoge puruṣaśruter yathākāmī prayoge syāt / Jaim_6,2.3 /
children.translated_text: Because of the Vedic statement regarding the person in [the context of] performance, one who desires [the result] would perform [the rite] at will. / Jaim_6,2.3 /
If [it be objected that] there is a Vedic text for each purpose — / Jaim_6,2.4 /

children.text: tādarthye na guṇārthatānukte 'rthāntaratvāt kartuḥ pradhānabhūtatvāt / Jaim_6,2.5 /
children.translated_text: When the purpose is subsidiary, there is no subsidiary nature of what is not mentioned, because it is a different matter, and because the performer is the principal element. / Jaim_6,2.5 /

children.text: api vā kāmasaṃyoge sambandhāt prayogāyopadiśyeta pratyarthaṃ hi vidhiśrutir viṣāṇāvat / Jaim_6,2.6 /
children.translated_text: Or, when there is a connection with desire, it would be prescribed for performance because of the connection; for the injunctive scripture applies to each purpose, like a horn [has a specific location]. / Jaim_6,2.6 /
If [it be said] that it would belong to another — / Jaim_6,2.7 /
The connection is through another's purpose. / Jaim_6,2.8 /
If [it be said] that one who desires the fruit is the occasion — / Jaim_6,2.9 /
Not so, because [the obligation] is permanent. / Jaim_6,2.10 /
If [it be said] that the ritual act is likewise — / Jaim_6,2.11 /
Not so, because of the inherent connection. / Jaim_6,2.12 /
But one would be restricted by inclination, because the undertaking has its occasion in the action. / Jaim_6,2.13 /
Or there is no restriction because of the desire for the result, as in the case of one who has not yet begun. / Jaim_6,2.14 /

children.text: niyamo vā tannimittatvāt kartus tatkāraṇaṃ syāt / Jaim_6,2.15 /
children.translated_text: Or there is a restriction because that [desire] is the occasion; the performer's cause would be that. / Jaim_6,2.15 /
In the world, ritual actions are like those in the <s>Veda</s>; from that, knowledge regarding the person [is derived]. / Jaim_6,2.16 /
And even in the case of transgression, the <s>śāstra</s> (authoritative teaching) [applies] through them. / Jaim_6,2.17 /

children.text: aśāstrāt tūpasamprāptiḥ śāstraṃ syān na prakalpakaṃ tasmād arthena gamyetāprāpte śāstram arthavat / Jaim_6,2.18 /
children.translated_text: But the attainment [of knowledge] is from that which is not [explicitly in] the <s>śāstra</s>; the <s>śāstra</s> would not be a mere constructor; therefore, one should infer from the purpose — the <s>śāstra</s> is purposeful when [something is] not [otherwise] attained. / Jaim_6,2.18 /

children.text: pratiṣedheṣv akarmatvāt kriyā syāt pratiṣiddhānāṃ vibhaktatvād akarmaṇām / Jaim_6,2.19 /
children.translated_text: In the case of prohibitions, because of the absence of ritual competence, there would be [mere] action on the part of those who are prohibited, because of the distinction between those without ritual competence. / Jaim_6,2.19 /

children.text: śāstrāṇāṃ tv arthavatvena puruṣārtho vidhīyate tayor

children.translated_text: because of the non-inherence, in the case of purposefulness, there would be a transgression of the injunction. / Jaim_6,2.20 /
But because the <s>śāstras</s> (authoritative teachings) are purposeful, the person's purpose is enjoined; of these two,

children.text: tasmiṃs tu śiṣyamāṇāni jananena pravarteran / Jaim_6,2.21 /
children.translated_text: But in that case, [the rites] being taught would be set in motion by [mere] birth. / Jaim_6,2.21 /

children.text: api vā vedatulyatvād upāyena pravarteran / Jaim_6,2.22 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of equality with the <s>Veda</s>, they would be set in motion by means [of instruction]. / Jaim_6,2.22 /
Repetition, because of being a remainder without ritual action, is enjoined for the person's purpose. / Jaim_6,2.23 /
In that case, when [it is] not possible, [it follows] from the purpose. / Jaim_6,2.24 /
They are not taught with reference to specific times. / Jaim_6,2.25 /
Because of the observation of time-indicators, there is an injunction regarding time. / Jaim_6,2.26 /
Because those [time-indicators] are original, one would proceed by tradition. / Jaim_6,2.27 /
And thus is the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_6,2.28 /
Likewise [for rites] employed within the sacrifice. / Jaim_6,2.29 /

children.text: ācārād gṛhyamāṇeṣu tathā syāt puruṣārthatvāt / Jaim_6,2.30 /
children.translated_text: In cases where [the procedure] is learned from custom, it would be so because of being for the person's purpose. / Jaim_6,2.30 /

children.text: brāhmaṇasya tu somavidyāprajam ṛṇavākyena saṃyogāt / Jaim_6,2.31 /
children.translated_text: But for the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, [the obligation regarding] <s>Soma</s>-knowledge, offspring, and debt, because of the connection with the Vedic statement. / Jaim_6,2.31 /
When all capacities are present, activity would ensue, because of the instruction regarding such a [qualified] person. / Jaim_6,3.1 /

children.text: api vāpy ekadeśe syāt pradhāne hy arthanirvṛttir guṇamātram itarat tadarthatvāt / Jaim_6,3.2 /
children.translated_text: Or it may be in a single part [of the rite]; for the accomplishment of the purpose is in the principal element, and the rest is merely subsidiary, because it has its purpose in that. / Jaim_6,3.2 /

children.text: tadakarmaṇi ca doṣas tasmāt tato viśeṣaḥ syāt pradhānenābhisambandhāt / Jaim_6,3.3 /
children.translated_text: And there is fault in the non-performance of that; therefore the distinction would arise because of the connection with the principal element. / Jaim_6,3.3 /

children.text: karmābhedaṃ tu jaiminiḥ prayogavacanaikatvāt sarveṣām upadeśaḥ syād iti / Jaim_6,3.4 /
children.translated_text: But <s>Jaimini</s> [holds that] there is no division of the ritual act, because the instruction would apply to all, due to the unity of the statement regarding performance. / Jaim_6,3.4 /

children.text: arthasya vyapavargitvād ekasyāpi prayoge syād yathā kratvantareṣu / Jaim_6,3.5 /
children.translated_text: Because the purpose is discharged [by a single performance], even a single performance would suffice, as in other sacrifices. / Jaim_6,3.5 /
And because of the observation of transgression against the injunction, [it continues] until completion. / Jaim_6,3.6 /
And because of the injunction regarding <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiatory rite). / Jaim_6,3.7 /
And thus in optional rites, because of the [performer's] desire. / Jaim_6,3.8 /

children.text: asaṃyogāt tu naivaṃ syād vidheḥ śabdapramāṇatvāt / Jaim_6,3.9 /
children.translated_text: But it would not be so because of the absence of connection, since the injunction has verbal testimony as its authority. / Jaim_6,3.9 /
And in the case of non-performance, because there is no adverse consequence. / Jaim_6,3.10 /

children.text: kriyāṇām āśritatvād dravyāntare vibhāgaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,3.11 /
children.translated_text: Because ritual actions depend [on substances], there would be a division when the substance differs. / Jaim_6,3.11 /

children.text: api vāvyatirekād rūpaśabdāvibhāgāc ca gotvavad aikakarmyaṃ syān nāmadheyaṃ ca sattvavat / Jaim_6,3.12 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the non-difference [of the substance], and because of the non-distinction of form and name, there would be unity of action, like the genus 'cow'; and the designation, like the individual existence. / Jaim_6,3.12 /
Because Vedic text is the authority, in the absence of what is taught, there is no tradition [as authority] for another, because it is not [directly] taught. / Jaim_6,3.13 /
And because in some cases there is an injunction. / Jaim_6,3.14 /
Or there is tradition [as authority], because there is no distinction in the purpose of the injunctive text. / Jaim_6,3.15 /
In some cases, the injunction is for the purpose of restriction. / Jaim_6,3.16 /
That [obligation] is permanent, for the intention to perform is [always present]. / Jaim_6,3.17 /
Not [the restriction applies to] the deity, fire, verbal formula, and action, because of their connection with another purpose. / Jaim_6,3.18 /
And in the case of the deity, because it has its purpose in that. / Jaim_6,3.19 /
And what is prohibited [applies] without distinction; for such is the scriptural statement. / Jaim_6,3.20 /

children.text: tathā svāminaḥ phalasamavāyāt phalasya karmayogitvāt / Jaim_6,3.21 /
children.translated_text: Likewise, because the result inheres in the patron (<s>svāmin</s>), and because the result is connected with the ritual act. / Jaim_6,3.21 /
But when many [patrons] are engaged, another may be brought in, because there is no deficiency. / Jaim_6,3.22 /
He would be the patron (<s>svāmin</s>), because of the connection. / Jaim_6,3.23 /
Or he is a hired worker, because he is paid. / Jaim_6,3.24 /
And because the result is observed in his case. / Jaim_6,3.25 /
He would have the same character as that [patron], because of the connection with the ritual act. / Jaim_6,3.26 /
The commonality [of eligibility] is because the intention to perform is [universal]. / Jaim_6,3.27 /

children.text: nirdeśāt tu vikalpe yat pravṛttam / Jaim_6,3.28 /
children.translated_text: But because of the express mention, in the case of an alternative, what has been set in motion [applies]. / Jaim_6,3.28 /
If [it be objected] that it is without verbal authority — / Jaim_6,3.29 /
Not so, because it is not a subsidiary element. / Jaim_6,3.30 /

children.text: vacanāc cānyāyyam abhāve tatsāmānyena pratinidhir abhāvād itarasya / Jaim_6,3.31 /
children.translated_text: And because of the statement, [what is] improper [would occur] in the absence; in [such] absence, a substitute (<s>pratinidhi</s>) [is employed] based on similarity, because of the absence of the other. / Jaim_6,3.31 /
There is no substitute, because of equality. / Jaim_6,3.32 /
It would apply in the case defined by scripture, because of the fixed nature. / Jaim_6,3.33 /
Not so, for that is not the intended [substance]. / Jaim_6,3.34 /

children.text: mukhyādhigame mukhyam āgamo hi tadabhāvāt / Jaim_6,3.35 /
children.translated_text: When the primary [substance] is obtainable, the primary should be used, for tradition [supports this] because of the absence of that [substitute's authority]. / Jaim_6,3.35 /
If [it be said that a substitute may apply] even when [the rite] has commenced — / Jaim_6,3.36 /
Not so, because it would be purposeless. / Jaim_6,3.37 /
When there is a conflict between the substance and the preparation, the substance [prevails], because [the preparation] has its purpose in that. / Jaim_6,3.38 /

children.text: arthadravyavirodhe 'rtho dravyābhāve tadutpatter dravyāṇām arthaśeṣatvāt / Jaim_6,3.39 /
children.translated_text: When there is a conflict between the purpose and the substance, the purpose [prevails], because in the absence of the substance, [the rite] originates from that [purpose]; for substances are subordinate to the purpose. / Jaim_6,3.39 /
The injunction too may apply to a single part. / Jaim_6,3.40 /

children.text: api vārthasya śakyatvād ekadeśena nirvartetārthānām avibhaktatvād guṇamātram itarat tadarthatvāt / Jaim_6,3.41 /
children.translated_text: Or, because the purpose can be accomplished by a single part, [the rite] would be completed with that part; because purposes are undivided, the rest is merely subsidiary, since it has its purpose in that. / Jaim_6,3.41 /
From the remainder, when two portions are destroyed, [the rite] would [still be valid], because [the remainder] has its purpose in that. / Jaim_6,4.1 /
Or, because of express mention, another [substance] should be brought in. / Jaim_6,4.2 /

children.text: api vā śeṣabhājāṃ syād viśiṣṭakāraṇatvāt / Jaim_6,4.3 /
children.translated_text: Or it would belong to those who partake of the remainder, because of the distinctive causation. / Jaim_6,4.3 /
Because of the express mention, the eating of the remainder [is done] by others, like the principal [offering]. / Jaim_6,4.4 /
Or by all, because of the inherent connection. / Jaim_6,4.5 /
The express mention is for the purpose of a subsidiary element. / Jaim_6,4.6 /
In the principal [rite], the definition is based on scripture. / Jaim_6,4.7 /
If [it be said] that it is purposeful — / Jaim_6,4.8 /
Not so, because of the conflict with the injunctive text. / Jaim_6,4.9 /
Because of the connection with the purpose, the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiatory rite) [applies] even in a single part. / Jaim_6,4.10 /

children.text: na tv aśeṣe vaiguṇyāt tadarthaṃ hi / Jaim_6,4.11 /
children.translated_text: But not when the whole [is destroyed], because of the deficiency; for it has its purpose in that [whole]. / Jaim_6,4.11 /

children.text: syād vā prāptanimittatvād ataddharmo nityasaṃyogān na hitasya guṇārthenānityatvāt / Jaim_6,4.12 /
children.translated_text: Or it may apply, because [the part] has attained the character of an occasion; [the part] not having the character of that [whole], because of the permanent connection — not in the case of what is prescribed, because of the subsidiary nature, because of the impermanence. / Jaim_6,4.12 /

children.text: guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvād vacanād vyapāśraya syāt / Jaim_6,4.13 /
children.translated_text: And because subsidiary elements serve another's purpose, because of the statement, there would be a dependent relation. / Jaim_6,4.13 /
[The statement] is for the purpose of distinction. / Jaim_6,4.14 /
Not so, because [it] is subsidiary in nature. / Jaim_6,4.15 /
And it would be purposeless in the case of total destruction. / Jaim_6,4.16 /

children.text: kṣāme tu sarvadāhe syād ekadeśasyāvarjanīyatvāt / Jaim_6,4.17 /
children.translated_text: But in the case of diminishment, when there is total burning, [the rite continues] in a single part, because that part cannot be avoided. / Jaim_6,4.17 /
Because of observation, [the rite would continue] in a single part. / Jaim_6,4.18 /

children.text: anyena vaitac chāstrād dhi kāraṇaprāptiḥ / Jaim_6,4.19 /
children.translated_text: This is by another [authority]; for the attainment of the cause is through the <s>śāstra</s> (authoritative teaching). / Jaim_6,4.19 /
If [it be objected] that it is not so because of the word <s>havis</s> (oblation material) — / Jaim_6,4.20 /

children.text: syād anyāyatvādijyāgāmī haviḥ śabdas talliṅgasaṃyogāt / Jaim_6,4.21 /
children.translated_text: It would be so, because of the irregularity; the word <s>havis</s> (oblation material) approaches the sacrifice, because of the connection with the indicative sign of that. / Jaim_6,4.21 /
If [it be said] 'according to the scripture' — / Jaim_6,4.22 /

children.text: na tallakṣaṇatvād upapāto hi kāraṇam / Jaim_6,4.23 /
children.translated_text: Not so, because [the definition] is based on that characteristic; for the falling [of the substance into the fire] is the cause. / Jaim_6,4.23 /
And the <s>homa</s> (oblation), the <s>abhiṣava</s> (Soma-pressing), and the <s>bhakṣaṇa</s> (ritual eating) are likewise. / Jaim_6,4.24 /

children.text: ubhābhyāṃ vā na hi tayor dharmaśāstram / Jaim_6,4.25 /
children.translated_text: Or neither, for neither of those two is a <s>dharmaśāstra</s> (treatise on duty). / Jaim_6,4.25 /
[The fire] should be re-established, like the <s>odana</s> (rice-offering). / Jaim_6,4.26 /
Or, because of the production of [new] substance, [the rule] would apply to both. / Jaim_6,4.27 /

children.text: pañcaśarāvas tu dravyaśruteḥ pratinidhiḥ syāt / Jaim_6,4.28 /
children.translated_text: But the five <s>śarāvas</s> (dishes) would be a substitute, because of the scriptural statement regarding the substance. / Jaim_6,4.28 /

children.text: codanā vā dravyadevatāvidhir avācye hi / Jaim_6,4.29 /
children.translated_text: Or the injunctive text is an injunction regarding substance and deity, for in the case of the unspecified — / Jaim_6,4.29 /
He should return from the place. / Jaim_6,4.30 /
Or it is an injunction regarding a subsidiary element, because of the connection with the occasion. / Jaim_6,4.31 /
When the <s>Viśvajit</s> (a particular sacrifice) has been commenced, the existence [of the rule] would be in the ritual act. / Jaim_6,4.32 /
And because of the statement regarding redemption-price. / Jaim_6,4.33 /
In the case of the connection with the calf, the injunction regarding the vow would apply. / Jaim_6,4.34 /
Or it is a time [specification], because of the connection with the produced [calf], regarding what has been stated. / Jaim_6,4.35 /
And because the purpose is unlimited. / Jaim_6,4.36 /

children.text: vatsas tu śrutisaṃyogāt tadaṅgaṃ syāt / Jaim_6,4.37 /
children.translated_text: But the calf, because of the connection with the scriptural statement, would be a subsidiary element of that [rite]. / Jaim_6,4.37 /
But it would be a time [specification], because there is no injunction. / Jaim_6,4.38 /
And it would be purposeless in the case of connection with the ritual act. / Jaim_6,4.39 /
And because the word denoting itself is not stated. / Jaim_6,4.40 /
If it is a time [specification], in the alternative view [where the calf is present], because of the connection with the indicative sign of that. / Jaim_6,4.41 /
Or, because it serves the purpose of time, it should be understood in both [cases]. / Jaim_6,4.42 /
In the case of the <s>prastara</s> (grass-bundle), like the resort to a [Vedic] branch. / Jaim_6,4.43 /
Or it is a time-injunction for both, because [the substances] are available. / Jaim_6,4.44 /
And because [the specification] is not for the purpose of the preparation of that. / Jaim_6,4.45 /
And therefore, in the case of separation, [the rule] would apply. / Jaim_6,4.46 /
And the <s>upaveṣa</s> (fasting/sitting near) would apply in the alternative view. / Jaim_6,4.47 /

children.text: abhyudaye kālāparādhād ijyācodanā syād yathā pañcaśarāve / Jaim_6,5.1 /
children.translated_text: In the case of a prosperous [sacrifice], because of the transgression of time, the injunction regarding the sacrifice would apply, as in the case of the five <s>śarāvas</s> (dishes). / Jaim_6,5.1 /
Or it is a removal, because of the absence of the knowledge. / Jaim_6,5.2 /
And because of the nature of the words being of that form. / Jaim_6,5.3 /
Because of the observation of the <s>ātañcana</s> (straining) repetition. / Jaim_6,5.4 /
Because of being unprecedented, there would be an injunction. / Jaim_6,5.5 /
Because of the defect in the milk, in the five <s>śarāvas</s> (dishes), [the alternative is used because] the other is not defective. / Jaim_6,5.6 /
If [it be said] that the <s>sānnāyya</s> (mixed milk-offering) is likewise — / Jaim_6,5.7 /

children.text: na tasyāduṣṭatvād aviśiṣṭaṃ hi kāraṇam / Jaim_6,5.8 /
children.translated_text: Not [so], because it is not defective; for the cause is undistinguished. / Jaim_6,5.8 /
The scriptural statement is for the purpose of characterization. / Jaim_6,5.9 /
In the <s>upāṃśuyāja</s> (low-voiced offering), because of the absence of [explicit] statement, [it should be] according to the archetype. / Jaim_6,5.10 /
Or the removal [of the offering material should be] through [ritual] action, as in the case of the others. / Jaim_6,5.11 /
When [the grain] is husked, [the connection] would be because of the connection with that. / Jaim_6,5.12 /
Or when [the ritual] has commenced, because of the attainment of the occasion. / Jaim_6,5.13 /
The other is merely a characterizing mark. / Jaim_6,5.14 /
And thus it is observed [to serve] a different purpose. / Jaim_6,5.15 /

children.text: anirupte 'bhyudite prākṛtībhyo nirvaped ity āśmarathyas taṇḍulabhūteṣv apanayāt / Jaim_6,5.16 /
children.translated_text: When [the grain is] not husked, in an <s>abhyudita</s> (special) [rite], one should select from the archetypal [materials] — so says <s>Āśmarathya</s> — because of the removal from among the grains in their natural state. / Jaim_6,5.16 /

children.text: vyūrdhvabhāgbhyas tv ālekhanas tatkāritvād devatāpanayasya / Jaim_6,5.17 /
children.translated_text: But from the upper portions by scraping, because the deity-removal is effected thereby. / Jaim_6,5.17 /

children.text: vinirupte na muṣṭīnām apanayas tadguṇatvāt / Jaim_6,5.18 /
children.translated_text: When [the grain is] separately husked, the handfuls are not removed, because they are subsidiary to that [process]. / Jaim_6,5.18 /
For the connection is with what is not archetypal, because it stands in its place. / Jaim_6,5.19 /
And because of the absence of the other, [the archetypal procedure] would apply. / Jaim_6,5.20 /
Because of the connection with the <s>sānnāyya</s> (cooked-milk offering), [it] would not be [derived] from a non-<s>sānnāyya</s>. / Jaim_6,5.21 /
Or because of the connection with the herbal [ingredient], [it applies] to both. / Jaim_6,5.22 /
