If [one objects] that it would not [apply] because of the deficiency [in quality] — / Jaim_6,5.23 /
No, because it is not a preparation of that [specific substance]. / Jaim_6,5.24 /
In the <s>Sāmutthāna</s> (chanting-based rite), when purchased for the <s>Viśvajit</s> [sacrifice], because of the connection with the division. / Jaim_6,5.25 /
Or when [the ritual] has commenced, because of the attainment of the occasion. / Jaim_6,5.26 /
The other scriptural statement is for the purpose of substitution. / Jaim_6,5.27 /
Regarding the measure of the <s>dīkṣā</s> (consecration), because there is no distinction in [the rule] 'as one desires.' / Jaim_6,5.28 /
But twelve days would apply, because of the indicatory mark. / Jaim_6,5.29 /
On the full-moon day, there is no restriction, because of non-distinction. / Jaim_6,5.30 /
But because of immediate succession, [it would be] the <s>Caitrī</s> (the full moon of <s>Caitra</s>). / Jaim_6,5.31 /
Or the <s>Māghī</s> (full moon of <s>Māgha</s>), because of the scriptural mention of the <s>Aṣṭakā</s> rite. / Jaim_6,5.32 /
If [one argues that] others too [are possible] — / Jaim_6,5.33 /

children.text: na bhaktitvād eṣā hi loke / Jaim_6,5.34 /
children.translated_text: No, because this is a matter of devotion; for [this is how it is observed] in the world. / Jaim_6,5.34 /
And because of favor in the event of a lapse in the <s>dīkṣā</s> (consecration). / Jaim_6,5.35 /
And because of sprouting at the time of rising [of the new season]. / Jaim_6,5.36 /
And all the indicatory marks [point] to this [full moon]. / Jaim_6,5.37 /

children.text: dīkṣākālasya śiṣṭatvād atikrame niyatānām anutkarṣaḥ prāptakālatvāt / Jaim_6,5.38 /
children.translated_text: Because the <s>dīkṣā</s>-period is prescribed, when it is exceeded, there is no postponement of the fixed [rites], because they have already become due. / Jaim_6,5.38 /

children.text: utkarṣo vā dīkṣitatvād aviśiṣṭaṃ hi kāraṇam / Jaim_6,5.39 /
children.translated_text: Or there would be a postponement, because of the consecrated status [of the performer]; for the cause is undistinguished. / Jaim_6,5.39 /

children.text: tatra pratihomo na vidyate yathā pūrveṣām / Jaim_6,5.40 /
children.translated_text: In that case, the counter-oblation (<s>pratihoma</s>) is not [performed], as in the case of the earlier [rites]. / Jaim_6,5.40 /
And because of the primacy of time. / Jaim_6,5.41 /
And because of the prohibition, after the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath), [the procedure is] as enjoined. / Jaim_6,5.42 /

children.text: pratihomaś cet sāyam agnihotraprabhṛtīni hūyeran / Jaim_6,5.43 /
children.translated_text: If there is a counter-oblation, the evening <s>agnihotra</s> and the subsequent [offerings] should be offered. / Jaim_6,5.43 /
But in the morning, [it should be] in the <s>ṣoḍaśin</s> (sixteen-verse chant). / Jaim_6,5.44 /
The expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>) [applies] in the domain of qualification, everywhere, because of the commonality of the fault. / Jaim_6,5.45 /
Or [it applies only] in the [specific] context, because the word is the ground. / Jaim_6,5.46 /
And the excess is in both modifications. / Jaim_6,5.47 /

children.text: vyāpannasyāpsu gatau yad abhojyam āryāṇāṃ tat pratīyeta / Jaim_6,5.48 /
children.translated_text: When [milk] that has gone to water [i.e., spoiled] belongs to one who has lapsed, whatever is unfit to eat for the noble should be understood [as applying]. / Jaim_6,5.48 /

children.text: vibhāgaśruteḥ prāyaścittaṃ yaugapadye na vidyate / Jaim_6,5.49 /
children.translated_text: Because of the scriptural mention of division, the expiation is not [performed] when [the faults occur] simultaneously. / Jaim_6,5.49 /

children.text: syād vā prāptanimittatvāt kālamātram ekam / Jaim_6,5.50 /
children.translated_text: Or [it] would apply, because the occasion has arisen; [the difference is merely] one of time. / Jaim_6,5.50 /
In that case, because of conflict, there would be an option. / Jaim_6,5.51 /
Or in a different performance, there would be accommodation of both. / Jaim_6,5.52 /
And because of the connection with one [fault, there is not both]. / Jaim_6,5.53 /
In [the case of] precedence and subsequence, the earlier is weaker, as in the archetype. / Jaim_6,5.54 /

children.text: yady udgātā jaghanyaḥ syāt punar yajñe sarvavedasaṃ dadyād yathetarasmin / Jaim_6,5.55 /
children.translated_text: If the <s>Udgātṛ</s> (chanting priest) should be last, he should give the <s>sarvavedasa</s> (complete gift) at the sacrifice again, as in the other [case]. / Jaim_6,5.55 /

children.text: ahargaṇe yasminn apacchedas tad āvarteta karma pṛthaktvāt / Jaim_6,5.56 /
children.translated_text: In a series of days, the rite in which there was an interruption should be repeated, because of the separateness [of each day's performance]. / Jaim_6,5.56 /

children.text: sannipāte vaiguṇyāt prakṛtivat tulyakalpā yajeran / Jaim_6,6.1 /
children.translated_text: In a confluence [of rites], because of a deficiency of quality, those of equal capacity should sacrifice as in the archetype. / Jaim_6,6.1 /
Or, because of the verbal statement, [the offering] would be [placed] on the head. / Jaim_6,6.2 /
Or not, because [the statement] is not an initiating directive. / Jaim_6,6.3 /
Or [it] would apply, because it serves the sacrifice, like the <s>audumbarī</s> (fig-wood post). / Jaim_6,6.4 /
No, because that [sacrifice] is the principal. / Jaim_6,6.5 /
The <s>audumbarī</s> [serves] another's purpose, like the [sacrificial] vessel (<s>kapāla</s>). / Jaim_6,6.6 /
If [one argues that it can be done] by another too — / Jaim_6,6.7 /
No, because of the oneness of that [purpose]; and because of the non-qualification of that [person]; and because of the undivided nature of the word. / Jaim_6,6.8 /

children.text: sannipātāt tu nimittavighātaḥ syād bṛhadrathantaravad vibhaktaśiṣṭatvād vasiṣṭhanirvartye / Jaim_6,6.9 /
children.translated_text: But because of the confluence, there would be an obstruction of the occasion, like the <s>Bṛhat</s>-<s>Rathantara</s> [chants]; because what is prescribed is separate, in the rite to be performed by <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>. / Jaim_6,6.9 /

children.text: api vā kṛtsnasaṃyogād avighātaḥ pratīyeta svāmitvenābhisaṃbandhāt / Jaim_6,6.10 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the connection with the whole, the non-obstruction would be understood, because of the relationship as owner. / Jaim_6,6.10 /

children.text: sāmnoḥ karmavṛddhyaikadeśena saṃyoge guṇatvenābhisaṃbandhas tasmāt tatra vighātaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,6.11 /
children.translated_text: Regarding the two <s>sāmans</s> (chants), when the connection is through a portion of the multiplication of rites, the relationship is as subsidiary; therefore in that case there would be an obstruction. / Jaim_6,6.11 /

children.text: vacanāt tu dvisaṃyogas tasmād ekasya pāṇivat / Jaim_6,6.12 /
children.translated_text: But because of the verbal statement, there is a dual connection; therefore [it belongs] to one, like [one's own] hand. / Jaim_6,6.12 /
But because of the absence of purpose, it should not be so. / Jaim_6,6.13 /

children.text: arthānāṃ ca vibhaktatvān na tacchrutena saṃbandhaḥ / Jaim_6,6.14 /
children.translated_text: And because the purposes are separate, there is no connection through that scriptural [statement]. / Jaim_6,6.14 /
Regarding <s>Prāṇa</s> (the vital breath rite), because of being a subsidiary to each limb [individually], the non-connection would be understood. / Jaim_6,6.15 /
<s>Satras</s> (sacrificial sessions) are for all <s>varṇas</s> (social classes), because of non-distinction. / Jaim_6,6.16 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory mark. / Jaim_6,6.17 /
Or [only] for <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, since the other two [classes] do not have the status of being <s>ṛtvij</s> (officiating priests). / Jaim_6,6.18 /
If [one argues] because of the verbal statement — / Jaim_6,6.19 /
No, for what is enjoined is the ownership [of the sacrifice]. / Jaim_6,6.20 /
Or [the two other classes] would [participate] at the <s>gārhapatya</s> (householder's) fire, because there is no prohibition. / Jaim_6,6.21 /
Or not, because of conflict with the [prescribed] procedure. / Jaim_6,6.22 /
Because of the ownership [of the others], in the <s>Ahīna</s> (multi-day sacrifice), the observation of an indicatory mark [applies]. / Jaim_6,6.23 /
Or because of the restriction of <s>Brahman</s>-priesthood to the descendants of <s>Vasiṣṭha</s>. / Jaim_6,6.24 /
Or [the restriction extends] to all, because of a counter-exception. / Jaim_6,6.25 /
Because of the restriction of the <s>Hautra</s> (Hotṛ's function) to <s>Viśvāmitra</s>, the descendants of <s>Bhṛgu</s>, <s>Śunaka</s>, and <s>Vasiṣṭha</s> have no qualification. / Jaim_6,6.26 /

children.text: vihārasya prabhutvād anagnīnām api syāt / Jaim_6,6.27 /
children.translated_text: Because of the power of the <s>vihāra</s> (sacrificial walk), [the rite] would [be permitted] even for those without [sacred] fires. / Jaim_6,6.27 /
And because it is observed in the <s>Sārasvata</s> [rite]. / Jaim_6,6.28 /
And because of the prescription of expiation. / Jaim_6,6.29 /
Or [only] for those who possess [sacred] fires, because the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) is prior [requirement]. / Jaim_6,6.30 /
And because [the rite] is undertaken for one's own purpose. / Jaim_6,6.31 /
And [the text] shows the <s>sannivāpa</s> (communal deposit). / Jaim_6,6.32 /

children.text: juhvādīnām aprayuktatvāt saṃdehe yathākāmī pratīyeta / Jaim_6,6.33 /
children.translated_text: Because the <s>juhū</s> (offering ladle) and other [implements] are not [specifically] used, in case of doubt, [one may perform] as one desires. / Jaim_6,6.33 /

children.text: api vānyāni pātrāṇi sādhāraṇāni kurvīran vipratiṣedhāc chāstrakṛtvāt / Jaim_6,6.34 /
children.translated_text: Or they should make other vessels that are common, because of conflict, since scripture is the authority. / Jaim_6,6.34 /
Expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>) would apply in the event of calamity. / Jaim_6,6.35 /

children.text: puruṣakalpena vikṛtau kartṛniyamaḥ syād yajñasya tadguṇatvād abhāvād itarān pratyekasminn adhikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_6,6.36 /
children.translated_text: Through the rule regarding the person, in a modified [rite], there would be a restriction of the performer; because the sacrifice has that as its subsidiary, and because of the absence [of the restriction] with respect to the others, each would have qualification. / Jaim_6,6.36 /
And because of the indicatory mark, as in the case of the specification of sacrifice. / Jaim_6,6.37 /

children.text: na vā saṃyogapṛthaktvād guṇasyejyāpradhānatvād asaṃyuktā hi codanā / Jaim_6,6.38 /
children.translated_text: Or not, because of the separateness of the connection — since the subsidiary [quality] has the sacrifice as principal, the injunction is not [specifically] connected. / Jaim_6,6.38 /
In the sacrifice, because it is subsidiary to that, [it] would be restricted by the specific [qualification]. / Jaim_6,6.39 /
In [the case of] giving one's own [possessions], [one may give] everything, because of non-distinction. / Jaim_6,7.1 /

children.text: yasya vā prabhuḥ syād itarasyāśakyatvāt / Jaim_6,7.2 /
children.translated_text: Or [one may give only] that of which one is the master, because of the impossibility [of giving] another's [property]. / Jaim_6,7.2 /

children.text: na bhūmiḥ syāt sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_6,7.3 /
children.translated_text: Land should not [be given as <s>dakṣiṇā</s>], because [it is] undistinguished with respect to all. / Jaim_6,7.3 /

children.text: akāryatvāc ca tataḥ punar viśeṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,7.4 /
children.translated_text: And because [it is] not [a product of] action; therefore from that, a further distinction would apply. / Jaim_6,7.4 /
And because of [its] permanence, there is no connection with impermanent [things]. / Jaim_6,7.5 /
And [the rule applies] for a <s>Śūdra</s>, because of the rules of <s>dharma</s>. / Jaim_6,7.6 /

children.text: dakṣiṇākāle yat svaṃ tat pratīyeta taddānasaṃyogāt / Jaim_6,7.7 /
children.translated_text: At the time of the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (priestly fee), whatever is one's own would be understood, because of the connection with giving that. / Jaim_6,7.7 /

children.text: aśeṣatvāt tadantaḥ syāt karmaṇo dravyasiddhitvāt / Jaim_6,7.8 /
children.translated_text: Because it is not a subsidiary [in its own right], it would be within that [rite], because the substance accomplishes [the purpose of] the rite. / Jaim_6,7.8 /

children.text: api vā śeṣakarma syāt kratoḥ pratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_6,7.9 /
children.translated_text: Or [the <s>dakṣiṇā</s>] would be a subsidiary rite, because of the direct instruction regarding the sacrifice. / Jaim_6,7.9 /
And thus it is observed [to serve] a different purpose. / Jaim_6,7.10 /

children.text: aśeṣaṃ tu samañjasādānena śeṣakarma syāt / Jaim_6,7.11 /
children.translated_text: But what is not a subsidiary would be the subsidiary rite [performed] properly by giving. / Jaim_6,7.11 /
Not through non-giving, because of its non-permanence. / Jaim_6,7.12 /

children.text: dīkṣāsu vinirdeśād akratvarthena saṃyogas tasmād avirodhaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,7.13 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>dīkṣā</s> (consecrations), because of the specific designation, the connection is not with the purpose of the sacrifice; therefore there would be no conflict. / Jaim_6,7.13 /

children.text: ahargaṇe ca taddharmaḥ syāt sarveṣām aviśeṣāt / Jaim_6,7.14 /
children.translated_text: And in a series of days, that would be the rule for all, because of non-distinction. / Jaim_6,7.14 /
Or [the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> would be] twelve hundred, as in the archetype. / Jaim_6,7.15 /
Because [it is] not subsidiary to that, it should not be so. / Jaim_6,7.16 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory mark. / Jaim_6,7.17 /
Being a modification, [it would apply] to both, because of non-distinction. / Jaim_6,7.18 /
Or [there would be] an increase, because of a counter-exception. / Jaim_6,7.19 /
And because of favor, like the foot [of the verse]. / Jaim_6,7.20 /
When not delimited, the prohibition of number for what is prescribed [is based on] it being heard as such. / Jaim_6,7.21 /
Or [there is] an alternative procedure, because it is to be enumerated as being of equal [status]. / Jaim_6,7.22 /
There is no restriction, because of non-distinction. / Jaim_6,7.23 /

children.text: adhikaṃ vā syād bahūrthatvād itareṣāṃ sannidhānāt / Jaim_6,7.24 /
children.translated_text: Or [there would be] more, because it serves multiple purposes, because the others are in proximity. / Jaim_6,7.24 /
And the <s>arthavāda</s> (laudatory passage) is like that which serves that purpose. / Jaim_6,7.25 /

children.text: parakṛtipurākalpaṃ ca manuṣyadharmaḥ syād arthāya hy anukīrtanam / Jaim_6,7.26 /
children.translated_text: And accounts of other [beings'] conduct and ancient tradition are [governed by] the rules for humans, for the recitation is for [practical] purpose. / Jaim_6,7.26 /
And because of the prohibition in what is connected with that. / Jaim_6,7.27 /

children.text: nirdeśād vā taddharmaḥ syāt pañcāvattavat / Jaim_6,7.28 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the specific designation, that would be the rule, like the <s>pañcāvatta</s> [offering]. / Jaim_6,7.28 /

children.text: vidhau tu vedasaṃyogād upadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,7.29 /
children.translated_text: But when there is an injunction, because of the connection with the <s>Veda</s>, [it] would be an instruction. / Jaim_6,7.29 /

children.text: arthavādo vā vidhiśeṣatvāt tasmān nityānuvādaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,7.30 /
children.translated_text: Or [it is an] <s>arthavāda</s> (laudatory passage), because it is subsidiary to the injunction; therefore it would be a constant reference (<s>anuvāda</s>). / Jaim_6,7.30 /
A thousand years — because of the impossibility of such a lifespan among humans. / Jaim_6,7.31 /

children.text: api vā tadadhikārān manuṣyadharmaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,7.32 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the [human] qualification, [it] would be a rule for humans. / Jaim_6,7.32 /
No, because of incapacity. / Jaim_6,7.33 /
Because of the non-observation of a connection. / Jaim_6,7.34 /

children.text: sa kulakalpaḥ syād iti kārṣṇājinir ekasminn asaṃbhavāt / Jaim_6,7.35 /
children.translated_text: It would be a family tradition — so says <s>Kārṣṇājini</s> — because of the impossibility for one [person alone]. / Jaim_6,7.35 /

children.text: api vā kṛtsnasaṃyogād ekasyaiva prayogaḥ syāt / Jaim_6,7.36 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the connection with the whole, the performance would be by one [person] alone. / Jaim_6,7.36 /

children.text: vipratiṣedhāt tu guṇyanyataraḥ syād iti lāvukāyanaḥ / Jaim_6,7.37 /
children.translated_text: Because of conflict, one or the other would be subsidiary — so says <s>Lāvukāyana</s>. / Jaim_6,7.37 /
A year, because of the [possibility of] deviation. / Jaim_6,7.38 /
That would be the archetype, because of the qualification. / Jaim_6,7.39 /
Or [it is counted in] days, because of being enumerable. / Jaim_6,7.40 /

children.text: iṣṭipūrvatvād akratuśeṣo homaḥ saṃskṛteṣv agniṣu syād pūrvo 'py ādhānasya sarvaśeṣatvāt / Jaim_6,8.1 /
children.translated_text: Because the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) is prior, the <s>homa</s> (oblation), being not subsidiary to the sacrifice, would be [performed] on the established [sacred] fires — [this is] prior even to the <s>ādhāna</s> (fire-establishment), because [the <s>ādhāna</s>] serves all [subsequent rites]. / Jaim_6,8.1 /

children.text: iṣṭitve na tu saṃstavaś caturhotṝn asaṃskṛteṣu darśayati / Jaim_6,8.2 /
children.translated_text: But in having the status of an <s>iṣṭi</s>, [the <s>Caturhotra</s>] chant does not [apply]; [rather, the text] shows the <s>Caturhotṛ</s> [recitations] on the non-established fires. / Jaim_6,8.2 /
But the instruction [applies], because of novelty. / Jaim_6,8.3 /
That [applies] to all, because of non-distinction. / Jaim_6,8.4 /

children.text: api vā kratvabhāvād anāhitāgner aśeṣabhūtanirdeśaḥ / Jaim_6,8.5 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the absence of a sacrifice for one who has not established the [sacred] fires, [it is] a designation of what is not a subsidiary. / Jaim_6,8.5 /
Or [it would be] a <s>japa</s> (murmured recitation), because of the non-connection with fire. / Jaim_6,8.6 /

children.text: iṣṭitvena saṃstute homaḥ syād anārabhyāgnisaṃyogād itareṣām avācyatvāt / Jaim_6,8.7 /
children.translated_text: When it is praised as having the status of an <s>iṣṭi</s>, [it] would be a <s>homa</s> (oblation), because of the connection with the fire that is not initiated [separately]; and because the others cannot be stated [otherwise]. / Jaim_6,8.7 /
Both [apply], as in the <s>pitṛyajña</s> (ancestor sacrifice). / Jaim_6,8.8 /
Or the designation [applies] to one without established fires, because of the connection with fire that is not initiated. / Jaim_6,8.9 /
In the <s>pitṛyajña</s> (ancestor sacrifice), the re-statement of what is [already] connected. / Jaim_6,8.10 /
One should establish the fires when performing the <s>upanayana</s> (initiation), because of the connection with the <s>homa</s> (oblation). / Jaim_6,8.11 /
Or [it may be performed] on a domestic fire, like the <s>Sthapati-iṣṭi</s> (chief's offering), because of the proper sequence of knowledge and ritual. / Jaim_6,8.12 /
And the <s>ādhāna</s> (fire-establishment) is connected with [having] a wife. / Jaim_6,8.13 /

children.text: akarma cordhvam ādhānāt tatsamavāyo hi karmabhiḥ / Jaim_6,8.14 /
children.translated_text: And no rite [is performed] before the <s>ādhāna</s> (fire-establishment); for its co-inherence is with the rites [that follow]. / Jaim_6,8.14 /
If [one argues] that it is like the <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestor offering) — / Jaim_6,8.15 /
No, because of conflict with the scriptural statement. / Jaim_6,8.16 /

children.text: sarvārthatvāc ca putrārtho na prayojayet / Jaim_6,8.17 /
children.translated_text: And because [the fire-establishment] serves all purposes, the purpose of [obtaining] a son should not be a [separate] reason [for it]. / Jaim_6,8.17 /

children.text: somapānāt tu prāpaṇaṃ dvitīyasya tasmād upayacchet / Jaim_6,8.18 /
children.translated_text: But because of the <s>Soma</s>-drinking, the second [fire] is obtained; therefore one should take [a wife]. / Jaim_6,8.18 /

children.text: pitṛyajñe tu darśanāt prāg ādhānāt pratīyeta / Jaim_6,8.19 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>pitṛyajña</s> (ancestor sacrifice), because of observation, [it] would be understood as [performed] before the <s>ādhāna</s>. / Jaim_6,8.19 /

children.text: sthapatīṣṭiḥ prayājavad agnayādheyaṃ prayojayet tādarthyāc cāpavṛjyeta / Jaim_6,8.20 /
children.translated_text: The <s>Sthapati-iṣṭi</s>, like the <s>prayāja</s> (preliminary offering), would require the <s>agnayādheyam</s> (fire-establishment); and because of serving that purpose, [it] would be included. / Jaim_6,8.20 /

children.text: api vā laukike 'gnau syād ādhānasyāsarvaśeṣatvāt / Jaim_6,8.21 /
children.translated_text: Or [it] would be [performed] on a domestic fire, because the <s>ādhāna</s> is not subsidiary to all [rites]. / Jaim_6,8.21 /
And the <s>avakīrṇi-paśu</s> (expiatory animal sacrifice) is likewise, because the time for the <s>ādhāna</s> has not yet arrived. / Jaim_6,8.22 /

children.text: udagayanapūrvapakṣāhaḥ puṇyāheṣu daivāni smṛtirūpāny ārthadarśanāt / Jaim_6,8.23 /
children.translated_text: On days of the northern solstice, the bright fortnight, and auspicious days, the rites for the gods — which have the form of tradition — because of the observation of [their] purpose. / Jaim_6,8.23 /
And the completeness of the rite [should be performed] within the day. / Jaim_6,8.24 /
But on the other [occasions], the rites for the ancestors [are performed]. / Jaim_6,8.25 /
Solicitation-purchase [is done] when [the substance] is not available, as in worldly practice. / Jaim_6,8.26 /
Or it would be restricted, because it is meaningful. / Jaim_6,8.27 /
Likewise with the partaking-directive, covering, designation, immolation, and oblation — [the same rule applies] to the pair. / Jaim_6,8.28 /
But what is purposeless would be non-obligatory. / Jaim_6,8.29 /
In the injunction regarding the animal [sacrifice], there is no restriction [on the species], because of the absence of distinction. / Jaim_6,8.30 /
Or a goat, because of the wording of the <s>mantra</s>. / Jaim_6,8.31 /
No, because [that would] conflict with the injunction. / Jaim_6,8.32 /
If [one argues it is] like the <s>ārṣeya</s> (lineage-designation) — / Jaim_6,8.33 /
No, because in that case there is no injunction [for it]. / Jaim_6,8.34 /

children.text: niyamo vaikārthyaṃ hy arthabhedād bhedaḥ pṛthavatvenābhidhānāt / Jaim_6,8.35 /
children.translated_text: The restriction or the optional character — for difference [arises] from difference of purpose, because [each] is stated separately. / Jaim_6,8.35 /
Or there is no restriction, because it is a different matter; the otherness [is established] from the distinction in exclusion and in word. / Jaim_6,8.36 /
Because of form and indicatory sign (<s>liṅga</s>). / Jaim_6,8.37 /
In the case of the goat, there is no designation by the name of the rite, because of form and indicatory sign. / Jaim_6,8.38 /
Because of the difference in form, the generic word (<s>jātiśabda</s>) would not apply. / Jaim_6,8.39 /
It is not a modification (<s>vikāra</s>), because it is original. / Jaim_6,8.40 /
It is incidental to the animal, because the subsidiary is not [independently] enjoined. / Jaim_6,8.41 /
Or [it pertains to] the genus (<s>jāti</s>), because of both the preponderant usage and the meaningfulness [of that interpretation]. / Jaim_6,8.42 /

children.text: śrutipramāṇatvāc cheṣāṇāṃ mukhyabhede yathādhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt / Jaim_7,1.1 /
children.translated_text: Because <s>śruti</s> is authoritative, when there is a division in the primary [rite], the subsidiaries would apply according to their respective qualifications. / Jaim_7,1.1 /

children.text: utpattyarthāvibhāgād vā sattvavad aikadharmyaṃ syāt / Jaim_7,1.2 /
children.translated_text: Or, because there is no distinction in the purpose of origination, there would be uniformity of properties, as with an entity. / Jaim_7,1.2 /

children.text: codanāśeṣabhāvād vā tadbhedād vyavatiṣṭherann utpatter guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_7,1.3 /
children.translated_text: Or, because [the subsidiaries] are subordinate to the injunction, they would be settled by the divisions of that [injunction], since origination is subsidiary. / Jaim_7,1.3 /
In the case of an entity, because of the connection with the defining characteristic, it would be universally applicable. / Jaim_7,1.4 /
But because of non-division, it would not be so. / Jaim_7,1.5 /
And a dual purpose is contradictory. / Jaim_7,1.6 /

children.text: utpattau vidhyabhāvād vā codanāyāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt tataś ca karmabhedaḥ syāt / Jaim_7,1.7 /
children.translated_text: Or, because there is no injunction at origination, the application would be to the [existing] injunction; and from that there would be a division of rites. / Jaim_7,1.7 /

children.text: yadi vāpy abhidhānavat sāmānyāt sarvadharmaḥ syāt / Jaim_7,1.8 /
children.translated_text: Or if, like the statement, because of commonality, it would possess all properties — / Jaim_7,1.8 /

children.text: arthasya tv avibhaktatvāt tathā syād abhidhāneṣu pūrvavattvāt prayogasya karmaṇaḥ śabdabhāvyatvād vibhāgāc cheṣāṇām apravṛttiḥ syāt / Jaim_7,1.9 /
children.translated_text: But because the purpose is undivided, it would be so in the statements; because of the prior-like character of the performance, because the rite is to be known through words, because of the division, there would be non-application of the subsidiaries. / Jaim_7,1.9 /
If [one argues] because of recollection (<s>smṛti</s>) — / Jaim_7,1.10 /
No, because of its prior-like character. / Jaim_7,1.11 /

children.text: arthasya śabdabhāvyatvāt prakaraṇanibandhanāc chabdād evānyatra bhāvaḥ syāt / Jaim_7,1.12 /
children.translated_text: Because the purpose is to be known through words, and because it is grounded in context, the application to another [rite] would be through the word alone. / Jaim_7,1.12 /
In the <s>Sāman</s> (chant), because of its prior-like character, the qualification would arise at origination. / Jaim_7,1.13 /
If [one argues about] the <s>Śyena</s> (Hawk) sacrifice — / Jaim_7,1.14 /
No, because of the absence of proximity. / Jaim_7,1.15 /

children.text: api vā yady apūrvatvād itaradadhikārthe jyautiṣṭomikād vidhes tadvācakaṃ samānaṃ syāt / Jaim_7,1.16 /
children.translated_text: Or if, because of its unprecedented character, the other [reading] would serve the purpose of qualification — the injunction derived from the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> would be its equivalent expression. / Jaim_7,1.16 /
In the five <s>Sañcaras</s>, the extension (<s>atideśa</s>) of the <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage) [applies], because of proximity. / Jaim_7,1.17 /
Or [it applies] to all, because of the identity of the word. / Jaim_7,1.18 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_7,1.19 /
If [one argues] 'not so,' because of the mention of what is [already] enjoined — / Jaim_7,1.20 /
No, because it serves the other's purpose. / Jaim_7,1.21 /
And likewise in the <s>Ekakapāla</s> offering to <s>Indrāgnī</s>. / Jaim_7,1.22 /

children.text: ekakapālānāṃ vaiśvadevikaḥ prakṛtir āgrayaṇe sarvahomāparivṛttidarśanād avabhṛthe ca sakṛd dvyavadānasya vacanāt / Jaim_7,1.23 /
children.translated_text: For the <s>Ekakapāla</s> offerings, the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> is the archetype; in the <s>Āgrayaṇa</s>, because the non-performance of all oblations is observed; and in the <s>Avabhṛtha</s>, because of the statement that the two-<s>avadāna</s> [offering is performed] once. / Jaim_7,1.23 /
The application of the <s>Sāman</s> would be through the word of designation, as it is taught. / Jaim_7,2.1 /

children.text: śabdais tv arthavidhitvād arthāntare 'pravṛttiḥ syāt pṛthagbhāvāt kriyāyā hy abhisambandhaḥ / Jaim_7,2.2 /
children.translated_text: But through words, because they prescribe a purpose, there would be no application to a different purpose; because the action is distinct, the connection is [only] with the action. / Jaim_7,2.2 /

children.text: svārthe vā syāt prayojanaṃ kriyāyās tadaṅgabhāvenopadiśyeran / Jaim_7,2.3 /
children.translated_text: Or the purpose would be its own; they would be taught as subsidiaries of the action. / Jaim_7,2.3 /
If [one argues it is] merely a word — / Jaim_7,2.4 /
No, because it is original. / Jaim_7,2.5 /
And thus the injunction would be purposeless. / Jaim_7,2.6 /
If [one argues] because of the accent (<s>svara</s>) — / Jaim_7,2.7 /
No, because in the absence of purpose, the <s>śruti</s> has no connection. / Jaim_7,2.8 /
But the accent would apply at the originations, because the measure (<s>mātrā</s>) and the syllable (<s>varṇa</s>) are undifferentiated. / Jaim_7,2.9 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_7,2.10 /
But because there is no [specific] <s>śruti</s> for the modification, in the later [rites it applies] as stated. / Jaim_7,2.11 /
And there would be inconsistency of the words. / Jaim_7,2.12 /

children.text: api tu karmaśabdaḥ syād bhāvo 'rthaḥ prasiddhagrahaṇatvād vikāro hy aviśiṣṭo 'nyaiḥ / Jaim_7,2.13 /
children.translated_text: But the word designating the rite would [denote] an entity as its meaning, because it is understood in its well-known sense; for the modification is not distinguished from the others. / Jaim_7,2.13 /
And what is not a substance is also observed. / Jaim_7,2.14 /

children.text: tasya ca kriyā grahaṇārthā nānārtheṣu virūpitvād artho hy āsāmalaukiko vidhānāt / Jaim_7,2.15 /
children.translated_text: And the action in it serves the purpose of apprehension; because in diverse meanings there is diversity of form — for the meaning here is non-worldly, because of the injunction. / Jaim_7,2.15 /
In that, there would be specific designations, because of the distinctness of the modification. / Jaim_7,2.16 /

children.text: yoniśasyāś ca tulyavad itarābhir vidhīyante / Jaim_7,2.17 /
children.translated_text: And the original ones are enjoined likewise by the others. / Jaim_7,2.17 /
And even in what is not original, one that is not of that origin is observed. / Jaim_7,2.18 /

children.text: aikārthye nāsti vairūpyam iti cet / Jaim_7,2.19 /
children.translated_text: If [one argues that] when the purpose is one, there is no diversity of form — / Jaim_7,2.19 /

children.text: syād arthāntareṣv aniṣpatter yathā pāke / Jaim_7,2.20 /
children.translated_text: It would be so in other purposes, because of non-completion — as in cooking. / Jaim_7,2.20 /
And there would be consistency of the words. / Jaim_7,2.21 /

children.text: uktaṃ kriyābhidhānaṃ tacchrutāv anyatra vidhipradeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_7,3.1 /
children.translated_text: The designation of the action has been stated; when that <s>śruti</s> [is found] elsewhere, the injunction would extend there. / Jaim_7,3.1 /
Or even in something unprecedented, because of being a part [of the rite]. / Jaim_7,3.2 /
But because the name is original [to a specific rite]. / Jaim_7,3.3 /

children.text: pratyakṣād guṇasaṃyogāt kriyābhidhānaṃ syāt tadabhāve 'prasiddhaṃ syāt / Jaim_7,3.4 /
children.translated_text: Because of direct perception, the connection with the subsidiary — the designation of the action would apply; in its absence, it would not be established. / Jaim_7,3.4 /

children.text: api vā satrakarmaṇi guṇārthaiṣā śrutiḥ syāt / Jaim_7,3.5 /
children.translated_text: Or this <s>śruti</s> would serve a subsidiary purpose in the <s>Satra</s> (session) rite. / Jaim_7,3.5 /

children.text: viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe tatpūrvakatvāj jyautiṣṭomikāni pṛṣṭhāny asti ca pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ / Jaim_7,3.6 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Viśvajit</s> (All-Conquering sacrifice), all the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s> chants [apply], because they presuppose the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> <s>Pṛṣṭha</s> chants; and the word '<s>Pṛṣṭha</s>' does exist. / Jaim_7,3.6 /

children.text: ṣaḍahād vā tatra hi codanā / Jaim_7,3.7 /
children.translated_text: Or [they are derived] from the <s>Ṣaḍaha</s> (six-day rite), because the injunction is there. / Jaim_7,3.7 /
And because of the indicatory sign. / Jaim_7,3.8 /
The <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> has the qualification arising [from it]. / Jaim_7,3.9 /
If [one argues that] the injunction pertains to both — / Jaim_7,3.10 /
No, because the word 'all' would be purposeless. / Jaim_7,3.11 /
Likewise, the <s>Avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath) [derives] from the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifice]. / Jaim_7,3.12 /
If [one argues it derives] from the archetype — / Jaim_7,3.13 /
No, because it is a distribution (<s>bhakti</s>). / Jaim_7,3.14 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_7,3.15 /

children.text: dravyādeśe taddravyaḥ śrutisaṃyogāt puroḍāśas tv anādeśe tatprakṛtitvāt / Jaim_7,3.16 /
children.translated_text: When there is a substitution of substance, [the offering] has that substance, because of the connection with <s>śruti</s>; but the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice-cake) [applies] when there is no substitution, because it is the archetype thereof. / Jaim_7,3.16 /

children.text: guṇavidhis tu na gṛhṇīyāt samatvāt / Jaim_7,3.17 /
children.translated_text: But a subsidiary injunction would not take [the substitute], because of equality. / Jaim_7,3.17 /
And likewise in the <s>Nirmanthya</s> and similar [rites]. / Jaim_7,3.18 /

children.text: praṇayanaṃ tu saumikam avācyaṃ hītarat / Jaim_7,3.19 /
children.translated_text: But the bringing forward (<s>praṇayana</s>) pertains to the <s>Soma</s> sacrifice, because the other is not stated. / Jaim_7,3.19 /
And the prohibition of the <s>Uttaravedi</s> (northern altar) is likewise. / Jaim_7,3.20 /
Or it belongs to the archetype, because it has no [specific] name. / Jaim_7,3.21 /
The mention serves the purpose of enumeration (<s>parisaṅkhyā</s>), or it is an <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage) regarding a subsidiary. / Jaim_7,3.22 /
For the first and last [rites], the bringing forward [applies], because of the prohibition of the <s>Uttaravedi</s>. / Jaim_7,3.23 /
Or [it applies to] the middle ones, because of the <s>arthavāda</s> regarding the movement. / Jaim_7,3.24 /
The prohibition relating to the <s>Uttaravedi</s> is an <s>anārabhyavāda</s> (statement not initiating a new topic). / Jaim_7,3.25 /
And the <s>Svara</s>-<s>Sāman</s>, <s>Ekakapāla</s>, and <s>Āmikṣā</s> (curdled milk offering) — because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_7,3.26 /
Or because of the commonality of the injunction. / Jaim_7,3.27 /
In what is produced by the rite, the [subsidiary] rite [applies], like the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>). / Jaim_7,3.28 /
Or the form, because it is a subsidiary part. / Jaim_7,3.29 /
In the domain [of what is available], the worldly [procedure] would apply, because it serves all purposes. / Jaim_7,3.30 /
The Vedic [procedure] is not [applicable], because of the specification of purpose. / Jaim_7,3.31 /
Likewise, the origination of the others, because of equality. / Jaim_7,3.32 /
It would be the prepared [form], because of that word. / Jaim_7,3.33 /
Or by distribution, because it is a subsidiary of the sacrifice, and because it states the subsidiaries. / Jaim_7,3.34 /
The word '<s>Pṛṣṭha</s>' would [designate] the rite, because such is the instruction. / Jaim_7,3.35 /

children.text: abhidhānopadeśād vā vipratiṣedhād dravyeṣu pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ syāt / Jaim_7,3.36 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the instruction regarding the designation, owing to the conflict, the word '<s>Pṛṣṭha</s>' would [designate] the substances. / Jaim_7,3.36 /
The procedure (<s>itikartavyatā</s>) of the injunction 'he sacrifices' (<s>yajati</s>) follows the pattern of the prior [archetype]. / Jaim_7,4.1 /
It would be worldly, because its application is observed [in the world]. / Jaim_7,4.2 /
But because of an explicit statement, it would be different from that. / Jaim_7,4.3 /

children.text: liṅgena vā niyamyeta liṅgasya tadguṇatvāt / Jaim_7,4.4 /
children.translated_text: Or it would be restricted by the indicatory sign, because the indicatory sign has the character of being subordinate to that. / Jaim_7,4.4 /

children.text: api vānyāyapūrvatvād yatra nityānuvādavacanāni syuḥ / Jaim_7,4.5 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of its unprecedented character, where the obligatory restatements would apply. / Jaim_7,4.5 /

children.text: mitho vipratiṣedhāc ca guṇānāṃ yathārthatalpanā syāt / Jaim_7,4.6 /
children.translated_text: And because of mutual conflict among the subsidiaries, the arrangement would be according to purpose. / Jaim_7,4.6 /

children.text: bhāgitvāt tu niyamyeta guṇānām abhidhānatvāt sambandhād abhidhānavad yathā dhenuḥ kiśoreṇa / Jaim_7,4.7 /
children.translated_text: But it would be restricted by being a part, because it states the subsidiaries; because of the connection, like the statement — as a cow [is connected] with a calf. / Jaim_7,4.7 /

children.text: utpattīnāṃ samatvād vā yathādhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt / Jaim_7,4.8 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the equality of the originations, the application would be according to qualification. / Jaim_7,4.8 /
And the statement of 'origination-remainder' is contradictory when [applied to] one [rite]. / Jaim_7,4.9 /

children.text: vidhyanto vā prakṛtivac codanāyāṃ pravarteta tathā hi liṅgadarśanam / Jaim_7,4.10 /
children.translated_text: Or the end-point of the injunction would operate like the archetype in the injunction; for so is the observation of the indicatory sign. / Jaim_7,4.10 /
Because the indicatory sign is the cause, in the absence of an indicatory sign, the worldly [procedure] would apply. / Jaim_7,4.11 /

children.text: liṅgasya pūrvavattavāc codanāśabdasāmānyād ekenāpi nirūpyeta yathā sthālīpulākena / Jaim_7,4.12 /
children.translated_text: Because of the prior-like character of the indicatory sign, because of the commonality of the injunctive word, it could be determined even by one [instance] — as by a grain of rice in the pot. / Jaim_7,4.12 /

children.text: dvādaśāhikam ahargaṇe tatprakṛtitvād aikāhikam adhikāgamāt tadākhyaṃ syād ekāhavat / Jaim_7,4.13 /
children.translated_text: The twelve-day [rite] — in the series of days, because it has that as its archetype — the one-day [rite applies] because of the additional [elements]; it would have that designation, like the one-day rite. / Jaim_7,4.13 /
And because of the indicatory sign. / Jaim_7,4.14 /

children.text: na vā kratvabhidhānād adhikānām aśabdatvam / Jaim_7,4.15 /
children.translated_text: Or not, because of the designation of the rite — the additional ones would be without [Vedic] word. / Jaim_7,4.15 /

children.text: liṅgaṃ saṃghātadharmaḥ syāt tadarthāpatter dravyavat / Jaim_7,4.16 /
children.translated_text: The indicatory sign is a property of the aggregate, because of the implication of that — like a substance. / Jaim_7,4.16 /
Or not, because it is a property of the purpose, and the aggregate is subsidiary. / Jaim_7,4.17 /
Because of implication, in substances, the property would be obtained. / Jaim_7,4.18 /
The observation of an indicatory sign for what is determined by its operation. / Jaim_7,4.19 /
The observation of a divergent arrangement for a distinguished [rite applies], because the <s>anārabhyavādas</s> serve the purpose of the archetype. / Jaim_7,4.20 /
Now, the definition of the particular [modifications]. / Jaim_8,1.1 /
That which has an indicatory sign, because of the connection with purpose — like a statement. / Jaim_8,1.2 /

children.text: pravṛttitvād iṣṭeḥ some pravṛttiḥ syāt / Jaim_8,1.3 /
children.translated_text: Because of the operative character of the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering), there would be application in the <s>Soma</s> sacrifice. / Jaim_8,1.3 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_8,1.4 /
Or, because of the complete injunction [already being present], it is unprecedented. / Jaim_8,1.5 /
And the absence of <s>sruk</s>-ghee-pouring [is merely] a restatement of what is obligatory. / Jaim_8,1.6 /
If [one argues that it is] an injunction — / Jaim_8,1.7 /
No, because it is a sentence-remainder. / Jaim_8,1.8 /
And because it confirms (<s>anupoṣaṇa</s>) the doubt. / Jaim_8,1.9 /
The observation would pertain to the <s>iṣṭi</s>-related [elements]. / Jaim_8,1.10 /
In the <s>iṣṭis</s>, the application would be from the <s>Darśapūrṇamāsa</s> (New- and Full-Moon sacrifices). / Jaim_8,1.11 /
And in the animal [sacrifice], because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_8,1.12 /
And that which pertains to the <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation), in the others. / Jaim_8,1.13 /
In the <s>Ekādaśinī</s> rites, the <s>Sautya</s> (Soma-pressing related) and <s>Dvairaśanya</s> [elements], because of observation. / Jaim_8,1.14 /

children.text: tatpravṛttir gaṇeṣu syāt pratipaśu yūpadarśanāt / Jaim_8,1.15 /
children.translated_text: The application of that to the groups would be per each animal, because of the observation of the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>). / Jaim_8,1.15 /
But in the undetermined [cases], from the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifice]. / Jaim_8,1.16 /
In the groups [of rites], from the twelve-day sacrifice. / Jaim_8,1.17 /
And that relating to cattle, in those beginning with that. / Jaim_8,1.18 /

children.text: nikāyināṃ ca pūrvasyottareṣu pravṛttiḥ syāt / Jaim_8,1.19 /
children.translated_text: And for those of the same group, the prior [rite's elements] would apply to the later ones. / Jaim_8,1.19 /

children.text: karmaṇas tv apravṛttitvāt phalaniyamakartṛ samudāyasyānanvayas tadbandhanatvāt / Jaim_8,1.20 /
children.translated_text: But because the rite does not operate [independently], the restrictor of the result — the aggregate — has no continuation, because it is bound to that. / Jaim_8,1.20 /
And even in the operative [case], because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_8,1.21 /
And because it is not stated in <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim_8,1.22 /
In the optional rites motivated by desire (<s>kāmya</s>), because of dependence, there would be application. / Jaim_8,1.23 /
Or non-application, because of the difference of the rite. / Jaim_8,1.24 /

children.text: api vātadvikāratvāt kratvarthatvāt pravṛttiḥ syāt / Jaim_8,1.25 /
children.translated_text: Or, because it is not a modification of that, because it serves the purpose of the rite, there would be application. / Jaim_8,1.25 /
In a single rite, the option is non-division, because the injunction is one. / Jaim_8,1.26 /
Or there would be an option, because of the commonality of the indicatory sign. / Jaim_8,1.27 /

children.text: aikārthyād vā niyamyeta pūrvavattvād vikāro hi / Jaim_8,1.28 /
children.translated_text: Or it would be restricted because of the unity of purpose, for the modification is like the prior. / Jaim_8,1.28 /
If [one argues] 'not so,' because it is not stated in <s>śruti</s> — / Jaim_8,1.29 /
It would be so, because of the presence of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_8,1.30 /
And thus the observation of another purpose [is explained]. / Jaim_8,1.31 /

children.text: vipratipattau haviṣā niyamyeta karmaṇas tadupākhyatvāt / Jaim_8,1.32 /
children.translated_text: In case of disagreement, it would be restricted by the oblation material (<s>havis</s>), because the rite is designated by that. / Jaim_8,1.32 /
And because of the connection with the rite through that. / Jaim_8,1.33 /
The mention of the deity is in a subsidiary capacity. / Jaim_8,1.34 /
Gold has the nature of clarified butter (<s>ājya</s>), because of its luster. / Jaim 8.1.35 /
And because of the conformity to the [established] rule. / Jaim 8.1.36 /
Or, [gold is] a medicinal substance, because of its clarity. / Jaim 8.1.37 /
And because of the word '<s>caru</s>' (oblation-porridge). / Jaim 8.1.38 /
And because of the scriptural statement of cooking in that [context]. / Jaim 8.1.39 /
In the honey-and-water [mixture], because of the commonality of substance, it would be a modification of milk. / Jaim 8.1.40 /
Or, [it would be] clarified butter, because of the commonality of color. / Jaim 8.1.41 /
And because of the conformity to the [established] rule. / Jaim 8.1.42 /
And because the former is not distinctive. / Jaim 8.1.43 /

children.text: vājine somapūrvatvaṃ sautrāmaṇyāñ ca graheṣu tācchabdyāt / Jaim_8,2.1 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Vājapeya</s>, the priority of <s>Soma</s> [applies], and in the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s> [the same applies] to the ladle-offerings (<s>grahas</s>), because of the word designating that. / Jaim 8.2.1 /
And because of the after-call (<s>anuvaṣaṭkāra</s>). / Jaim 8.2.2 /
And because of the eating after the invocation (<s>upahūya bhakṣaṇa</s>). / Jaim 8.2.3 /

And the purchasing, cooking, <s>puroruc</s> (preliminary hymn), <s>upayāma</s> (receiving), grasping, consecration (<s>āsādana</s>), covering (<s>vāsa</s>), and binding (<s>upanayana</s>) are likewise. / Jaim 8.2.4 /
Or, [the rite] would be determined by the oblatory material, because of its being a modification of that. / Jaim 8.2.5 /
The word '<s>Soma</s>' is [merely] a praise. / Jaim 8.2.6 /
The other [elements are established] by the scriptural statement. / Jaim 8.2.7 /
And the designation is likewise. / Jaim 8.2.8 /
And the observation of the indicatory mark of the animal-and-rice-cake [offering]. / Jaim 8.2.9 /
The animal would be a modification of the rice-cake (<s>puroḍāśa</s>), because of the commonality of deity. / Jaim 8.2.10 /
And because of the sprinkling (<s>prokṣaṇa</s>). / Jaim 8.2.11 /
And because of the circumambulation with fire (<s>paryagnikaraṇa</s>). / Jaim 8.2.12 /
Or, [it would be a modification of] the <s>sānnāyya</s> (cooked-milk offering), because of its being derived from that. / Jaim 8.2.13 /
And because of the observation of its vessel. / Jaim 8.2.14 /
It would be [a modification] of curds (<s>dadhi</s>), because of the commonality of solid form. / Jaim 8.2.15 /
Or, [it would be a modification] of milk, because of the commonality of time. / Jaim 8.2.16 /
Because of the immediate succession to the animal [sacrifice]. / Jaim 8.2.17 /
And the liquid nature is not distinctive. / Jaim 8.2.18 /
Because <s>āmikṣā</s> (fresh cheese) partakes of both natures, it would be a modification of both. / Jaim 8.2.19 /
Or, it would be one [substance], because of the oneness of the injunction. / Jaim 8.2.20 /
Because of the commonality with the aggregate of curds. / Jaim 8.2.21 /

children.text: payo vā tatpradhānatvāl lokavad dadhnas tadarthatvāt / Jaim_8,2.22 /
children.translated_text: Or, [it would be a modification of] milk, because of the primacy of that — like [practice in] the world — since curds serve the purpose of that [milk]. / Jaim 8.2.22 /
And because of the conformity to the rule. / Jaim 8.2.23 /

children.text: satramahīnaś ca dvādaśāhas tasyobhayathā pravṛttir aikakarmyāt / Jaim_8,2.24 /
children.translated_text: The <s>sattra</s> (sacrificial session) and the <s>ahīna</s> (multi-day rite) — and the twelve-day rite — function as both [of those types], because of the oneness of the rite. / Jaim 8.2.24 /

children.text: api vā yajatiśruter ahīnabhūtapravṛttiḥ syāt prakṛtyā tulya śabdatvāt / Jaim_8,2.25 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the scriptural word 'he sacrifices,' it would function as an <s>ahīna</s>, because the word is equal [in authority] to the primary [rite]. / Jaim 8.2.25 /
For the two-night and other [rites] up to the eleven-night, [they have] the status of <s>ahīna</s>, because of the injunction 'he sacrifices.' / Jaim 8.2.26 /
In the thirteen-night and following [rites], [they function] as <s>sattras</s>, because in those there is the injunction of sitting together (<s>āsanopāyi</s>). / Jaim 8.2.27 /
And because of the indicatory mark. / Jaim 8.2.28 /

children.text: anyatarato 'tirātratvāt pañcadaśarātrasyāhīnatvaṃ kuṇḍapāyināmayanasya ca tadbhūteṣv ahīnatvasya darśanāt / Jaim_8,2.29 /
children.translated_text: Because of the <s>atirātra</s> (overnight rite) being on one side, the fifteen-night [rite] would be an <s>ahīna</s>, as also the <s>Kuṇḍapāyin</s> and the <s>ayana</s> (annual session), because of the observation of <s>ahīna</s> status in those that function [as such]. / Jaim 8.2.29 /
And because of the statement [of it being] an <s>ahīna</s>. / Jaim 8.2.30 /
Or, [it would be] a <s>sattra</s>, because of the injunction of sitting together. / Jaim 8.2.31 /
And [the text] shows the indicatory mark of a <s>sattra</s>. / Jaim 8.2.32 /
In a group of oblations, [the procedure applies] to the immediately subsequent [offering], because of the commonality of place. / Jaim 8.3.1 /

children.text: devatayā vā niyamyeta śabdattvād itarasyāśrutitvāt / Jaim_8,3.2 /
children.translated_text: Or, [it] would be determined by the deity, because of [its] being a word, [whereas] the other is not heard [in scripture]. / Jaim 8.3.2 /

children.text: gaṇacodanāyāṃ yasya liṅgaṃ tadāvṛttiḥ pratīyetāgneyavat / Jaim_8,3.3 /
children.translated_text: In an injunction regarding a group, that which has the indicatory mark — its repetition would be understood, like the <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>). / Jaim 8.3.3 /

children.text: nānāhāni vā saṃghātatvāt pravṛttiliṅgena codanāt / Jaim_8,3.4 /
children.translated_text: Or, [they are to be performed on] different days, because of the aggregate nature, by injunction through the indicatory mark of performance. / Jaim 8.3.4 /
And thus the observation [of this] serves another purpose. / Jaim 8.3.5 /
Even in the repetition of time, <s>Bādari</s> [holds that there is no repetition], because of the difference of rite. / Jaim 8.3.6 /

children.text: tadāvṛttiṃ tu jaiminir ahnām apratyakṣasaṃkhyatvāt / Jaim_8,3.7 /
children.translated_text: <s>Jaimini</s>, however, [holds] that the repetition [follows] that [of the rite], because the number of days is not directly perceived. / Jaim 8.3.7 /
In groups of concluding rites (<s>saṃsthā</s>), the repetition of that [rite] would be understood, because of the adoption of the criterion of what has been accomplished. / Jaim 8.3.8 /

children.text: adhikārād vā prakṛtis tadviśiṣṭā syād abhidhānasya tannimittatvāt / Jaim_8,3.9 /
children.translated_text: Or, from the governing qualification, the primary [rite], distinguished by that [qualification], would [determine the procedure], because the designation has that as its basis. / Jaim 8.3.9 /
From the group, [there is] an increase, because of its being the basis of that [primary rite]. / Jaim 8.3.10 /
Or, from a single-day [rite], their equality would [be established]. / Jaim 8.3.11 /

children.text: gāyatrīṣu prākṛtīnām avacchedaḥ prakṛtyādhikārāt saṃkhyātvād agniṣṭomavad avyatirekāt tadākhyatvam / Jaim_8,3.12 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Gāyatrī</s> [stomas], the determination of the primary [elements] would be from the primary [rite's] governing qualification, because of the [defined] number — like the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s> — because of the non-deviation, it has that name. / Jaim 8.3.12 /

children.text: tan nityavac ca prathaksatīṣu tadvacanam / Jaim_8,3.13 /
children.translated_text: And that, being permanent, like in the independent <s>satīs</s> — such is the statement. / Jaim 8.3.13 /
If [one objects that] in twenty [there is] not ten — / Jaim 8.3.14 /
There would be oneness of number alone. / Jaim 8.3.15 /

children.text: guṇād vā dravyaśabdaḥ syād asarvaviṣayatvāt / Jaim_8,3.16 /
children.translated_text: Or, the substance-word would be from a subsidiary, because of its not being universally applicable. / Jaim 8.3.16 /
And the correlation is like [that of] cowness (<s>gotva</s>). / Jaim 8.3.17 /
And because the number has the nature of a word. / Jaim 8.3.18 /
And because the other is not heard [in scripture]. / Jaim 8.3.19 /
Because of the non-establishment in another substance, [the stoma] would be distinguished by the omissions of the <s>Ukthya</s>. / Jaim 8.3.20 /
And because of the non-scriptural nature of the criterion. / Jaim 8.3.21 /
Because the name belongs to origination, it would apply in independent <s>satīs</s> through the portion-distribution. / Jaim 8.3.22 /
If [one argues] because of the statement — / Jaim 8.3.23 /
[Only] as much as is stated. / Jaim 8.3.24 /

children.text: apūrve ca vikalpaḥ syād yadi saṃkhyāvidhānam / Jaim_8,3.25 /
children.translated_text: And in the case of something new, there would be an option, if it is an injunction of number. / Jaim 8.3.25 /
If [one objects] that this is not so because the <s>ṛc</s> (verse) is subsidiary — / Jaim 8.3.26 /
It would be so [established], as in the preceding [case]. / Jaim 8.3.27 /
And the entry of the subsidiary [applies] everywhere. / Jaim 8.3.28 /
If [one objects] that this is not so because of the adoption of the completed [form] — / Jaim 8.3.29 /
Here too it would be so. / Jaim 8.3.30 /

children.text: yadi vāviśaye niyamaḥ prakṛtyupabandhāc chareṣv api prasiddhaḥ syāt / Jaim_8,3.31 /
children.translated_text: If, however, the restriction [applies] in the non-specific [case], it would be established in the arrows too, because of the connection with the primary [rite]. / Jaim 8.3.31 /
If [one argues] that the application has been observed — / Jaim 8.3.32 /
So too in the arrows. / Jaim 8.3.33 /
If [one argues] because of the portion-distribution — / Jaim 8.3.34 /
So too in the other [case]. / Jaim 8.3.35 /

children.text: arthasya cāsamāptatvān na tāsām ekadeśe syāt / Jaim_8,3.36 /
children.translated_text: And because the purpose is not accomplished, they [the verses] would not [apply] in a part [alone]. / Jaim 8.3.36 /
The ladle-oblation (<s>darvihoma</s>) is designated a 'sacrifice' (<s>yajña</s>), because of its conjunction with the oblation. / Jaim 8.4.1 /

children.text: sa laukikānāṃ syāt kartus tadākhyatvāt / Jaim_8,4.2 /
children.translated_text: It would pertain to worldly [householders], of the performer, because it has that designation. / Jaim 8.4.2 /
Or, [it pertains] to all, because of the observation in the house-offering (<s>vāstuhoma</s>). / Jaim 8.4.3 /
Or, [it pertains] to those having the injunction 'he offers' (<s>juhoti</s>), because of the conjunction with that. / Jaim 8.4.4 /
Or, because of the instruction regarding the substance, it would be a designation of a subsidiary. / Jaim 8.4.5 /

children.text: na laukikānām ācāragrahaṇatvāc chabdavatāṃ cānyārthavidhānāt / Jaim_8,4.6 /
children.translated_text: [It does] not [pertain] to worldly [householders], because of the adoption of customary practice, and because for those having [Vedic] words, the injunction serves another purpose. / Jaim 8.4.6 /
And because of the observation of a different vessel. / Jaim 8.4.7 /
Similarly for the fire and the oblatory material. / Jaim 8.4.8 /
And the connection with the purpose has been stated. / Jaim 8.4.9 /
In that [context], <s>Soma</s> would be the [appropriate offering], because of its unmanifest nature. / Jaim 8.4.10 /

children.text: na vā svāhākāreṇa saṃyogād vāṣaṭkārasya ca nirdeśāt tantretena vipratiṣedhāt / Jaim_8,4.11 /
children.translated_text: Or not, because of the conjunction with the <s>svāhā</s>-call, and because of the indication of the <s>vaṣaṭ</s>-call, and because of the conflict with the unified performance (<s>tantra</s>). / Jaim 8.4.11 /
Because it is a different word. / Jaim 8.4.12 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim 8.4.13 /

children.text: uttarārthas tu svāhākāro yathā sāptadaśyaṃ tatrāvipratiṣiddhā punaḥ pravṛttir liṅgadarśanāt paśuvat / Jaim_8,4.14 /
children.translated_text: But the <s>svāhā</s>-call serves a subsequent purpose, as in the <s>Sāptadaśya</s> (seventeen-fold rite); there the re-application is not contradicted, because of the observation of the indicatory mark — like the animal [sacrifice]. / Jaim 8.4.14 /

children.text: anuttarārtho vārthavattvād ānarthakyād dhi prākṛtasyoparodhaḥ syāt / Jaim_8,4.15 /
children.translated_text: Or, [the <s>svāhā</s>-call] does not serve a subsequent purpose, because it has a purpose [of its own]; for from purposelessness, there would be obstruction of the primary [element]. / Jaim 8.4.15 /
If [one argues] that [it does] not [apply] even in the primary [rite] — / Jaim 8.4.16 /
The weakness of the secondary [has been] stated in [the discussion of] co-inherence. / Jaim 8.4.17 /

children.text: taccodanā veṣṭeḥ pravṛttitvād vidhiḥ syāt / Jaim_8,4.18 /
children.translated_text: That injunction would be a rule, because [the <s>svāhā</s>-call] is an element of performance. / Jaim 8.4.18 /
And because of the force of the word. / Jaim 8.4.19 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim 8.4.20 /

children.text: tatrābhāvasya hetutvād guṇārthe syād adarśanam / Jaim_8,4.21 /
children.translated_text: There, the absence [of something] being the cause, the non-observation would be for the purpose of the subsidiary. / Jaim 8.4.21 /
If [one argues that] it is an injunction — / Jaim 8.4.22 /

children.text: na vākyaśeṣatvād guṇārthe ca samādhānaṃ nānātvenopapadyate / Jaim_8,4.23 /
children.translated_text: No, because it is a sentence-complement; and in the case of a subsidiary purpose, the reconciliation is established as being multiple. / Jaim 8.4.23 /

children.text: yeṣāṃ vāparayor hemas teṣāṃ syād avirodhāt / Jaim_8,4.24 /
children.translated_text: For those [rites] in which gold is [used as] the other two [substances], it would [apply], because of the absence of conflict. / Jaim 8.4.24 /

children.text: tatrauṣadhāni codyante tāni sthānena gamyeran / Jaim_8,4.25 /
children.translated_text: There, the medicinal substances are enjoined; those should be understood from their place [of occurrence]. / Jaim 8.4.25 /
Or, from the indicatory mark, [it would apply] to the remainder and the oblation. / Jaim 8.4.26 /

children.text: pratipatti tu te bhavatas tasmād atādvikāratvam / Jaim_8,4.27 /
children.translated_text: But the understanding is that they belong to you; therefore, they are not modifications of that. / Jaim 8.4.27 /

children.text: sannipāte virodhinām apravṛttiḥ pratīyeta vidhyutpattivyavasthānād arthasyāpariṇeyatvād vacanād atideśaḥ syāt / Jaim_8,4.18 /
children.translated_text: When conflicting [rules] come together, non-application would be understood — from the establishment by the origination, arrangement, and purpose of the injunction — because of the non-transformability of the purpose — by the statement, the extension (<s>atideśa</s>) would [apply]. / Jaim 8.4.18 [sic] /

children.text: yajñakarma pradhānaṃ tad dhi codanābhūtaṃ tasya dravyeṣu saṃskāras tatprayuktas tadarthatvāt / Jaim_9,1.1 /
children.translated_text: The sacrificial action (<s>yajñakarma</s>) is the principal, for it is the subject of the injunction; the preparation (<s>saṃskāra</s>) of the substances is impelled by that, and serves that purpose. / Jaim 9.1.1 /

children.text: saṃskāre yujyamānānāṃ tādarthyāt tatprayuktaṃ syāt / Jaim_9,1.2 /
children.translated_text: For those [substances] being prepared, because of their serving that purpose, they would be impelled by that [sacrificial action]. / Jaim 9.1.2 /

children.text: tena tvarthena yajñasya saṃyogād dharmasambandhas tasmād yajñaprayuktaṃ syāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_9,1.3 /
children.translated_text: Through that purpose, by conjunction with the sacrifice, there is a connection with <s>dharma</s> (duty); therefore, [the preparation] would be impelled by the sacrifice, since the preparation serves that purpose. / Jaim 9.1.3 /
And [similarly] for the result (<s>phala</s>) and the deity. / Jaim 9.1.4 /
The subsidiary relationship [of the deity] is not [derived] from the injunction, for that quality [belongs to it independently]. / Jaim 9.1.5 /

children.text: devatā vā prayojayed atithivad bhojanasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_9,1.6 /
children.translated_text: Or, the deity may be the impeller, like a guest for a meal, since [the meal] serves that purpose. / Jaim 9.1.6 /
And by implication. / Jaim 9.1.7 /
And therefore, the connection [is] through that. / Jaim 9.1.8 /

children.text: api vā śabdapūrvatvād yajñakarma pradhānaṃ syād guṇatve devatāśrutiḥ / Jaim_9,1.9 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because a word precedes [it], the sacrificial action would be the principal; if the deity were subsidiary, the scriptural statement regarding the deity [would follow]. / Jaim 9.1.9 /

children.text: atithau tatpradhānatvam abhāvaḥ karmaṇi syāt tasya prītipradhānatvāt / Jaim_9,1.10 /
children.translated_text: In [the case of] a guest, the primacy of that [guest] — [such] absence [of primacy] would [obtain] in the [sacrificial] action, because pleasure in [feeding] the guest is primary. / Jaim 9.1.10 /
Or, the aggregate of substance, number, and cause — because of the conjunction with scripture. / Jaim 9.1.11 /

children.text: arthakārite ca dravyeṇa na vyavasthā syāt / Jaim_9,1.12 /
children.translated_text: And when the purpose is effected by the substance, there would be no fixed arrangement. / Jaim 9.1.12 /

children.text: artho vā syāt prayojanam itareṣām acodanāt tasya ca guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_9,1.13 /
children.translated_text: Or, the purpose (<s>artha</s>) would be the motive; for the others, because of the absence of an injunction, and because of their subsidiary nature. / Jaim 9.1.13 /
Because of novelty, there would be a fixed arrangement. / Jaim 9.1.14 /
And when impelled by that [sacrificial action], <s>dharma</s> has universal applicability. / Jaim 9.1.15 /
If [one argues] 'of that which is connected with it' — / Jaim 9.1.16 /
No, because it is not heard [in scripture]. / Jaim 9.1.17 /
If [one argues] because of the governing qualification — / Jaim 9.1.18 /

children.text: tulyeṣu nādhikāraḥ syād acoditaś ca sambandhaḥ pṛthaksatāṃ yajñārthenābhisambandhas tasmādyajñaprayojanam / Jaim_9,1.19 /
children.translated_text: Among equals, there would be no governing qualification, and the connection [would be] un-enjoined; the independent <s>satīs</s> [have] connection with the sacrifice through the sacrificial purpose; therefore, the sacrifice is the motive. / Jaim 9.1.19 /

children.text: deśabaddham upāṃśutvaṃ teṣāṃ syāc chrutinirdeśāt tasya ca tatrabhāvāt / Jaim_9,1.20 /
children.translated_text: The low-voiced nature (<s>upāṃśutva</s>) would be place-bound for those [rites], because of the scriptural indication, and because of its occurrence there. / Jaim 9.1.20 /
Or, [it would pertain] to the sacrifice, because of the conjunction with that. / Jaim 9.1.21 /
And the restatement is purposive like that. / Jaim 9.1.22 /
If [one argues] that the <s>praṇītā</s> (led-forward water) and so forth are likewise — / Jaim 9.1.23 /
No, because the sacrifice is not heard [in that connection]. / Jaim 9.1.24 /
Or, [it pertains] to the things in that place, because the aggregate is enjoined. / Jaim 9.1.25 /
The fire-nature of the offering-platform is [determined] from the aggregate, like the full-moon [rite]. / Jaim 9.1.26 /

children.text: agner vā syād dravyaikatvād itarāsāṃ tadarthatvāt / Jaim_9,1.27 /
children.translated_text: Or, it would be [a property] of the fire, because of the oneness of substance; the other [elements] serve the purpose of that. / Jaim 9.1.27 /

children.text: codanāsamudāyāt tu paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā syāt / Jaim_9,1.28 /
children.translated_text: But because of the aggregate of injunctions, it would be so at the full-moon [rite]. / Jaim 9.1.28 /
The ending with the wife's offerings (<s>patnīsaṃyāja</s>) [applies] to all [rites], because of non-specification. / Jaim 9.1.29 /
Or, from the indicatory mark, [it would be] before the last [rite]. / Jaim 9.1.30 /

children.text: anuvādo vā dīkṣā yathā naktaṃ saṃsthāpanasya / Jaim_9,1.31 /
children.translated_text: Or, the <s>dīkṣā</s> (consecration) would be a restatement, like the night establishment. / Jaim 9.1.31 /

children.text: syād vānārabhya vidhānād ante liṅga virodhāt / Jaim_9,1.32 /
children.translated_text: Or, it would be because of a rule not beginning [a new topic] — at the end, because of the conflict of the indicatory mark. / Jaim 9.1.32 /

children.text: abhyāsaḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ prāthamyāt sthānadharmaḥ syāt / Jaim_9,1.33 /
children.translated_text: The repetition of the <s>sāmidhenī</s> (kindling) verses would be a property of position, because of [their] priority. / Jaim 9.1.33 /
When the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) is repeated, the <s>ārambhaṇīyā</s> (inaugural rite) would be repeated like the preliminary offerings (<s>prayājas</s>). / Jaim 9.1.34 /

children.text: sakṛd vārambhasaṃyogād ekaḥ punarārambho yāvajjīvaprayogāt / Jaim_9,1.35 /
children.translated_text: Or, [it would be performed] once, because of the conjunction with the commencement; the re-commencement is single, because of the application throughout life. / Jaim 9.1.35 /

children.text: arthābhidhānasaṃyogān mantreṣu śeṣabhāvaḥ syāt tatrācoditam aprāptaṃ coditābhidhānāt / Jaim_9,1.36 /
children.translated_text: Because of the conjunction of purpose-expression, in the <s>mantras</s>, there would be the status of remainder; there, what is un-enjoined and un-obtained [is to be established] from the expressed [content] of the enjoined. / Jaim 9.1.36 /

children.text: tataś cāvacanaṃ teṣām itarārthaṃ prayujyate / Jaim_9,1.37 /
children.translated_text: And therefore, the non-expression of those [mantras] is employed for the purpose of the other [element]. / Jaim 9.1.37 /
If [one argues] that the subsidiary-word is thus — / Jaim 9.1.38 /
No, because of co-inherence. / Jaim 9.1.39 /

children.text: codite tu parārthatvād vidhivadavikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_9,1.40 /
children.translated_text: But when [something is] enjoined, because of its serving another's purpose, there would be no modification, as with an injunction. / Jaim 9.1.40 /
The modification would apply when that [other element] is the principal. / Jaim 9.1.41 /
Because of the non-conjunction, in those [elements] serving its purpose, what is distinguished by that would be understood. / Jaim 9.1.42 /
If [one argues] that this is so because of the absence of rite — / Jaim 9.1.43 /
No, because of its serving another's purpose. / Jaim 9.1.44 /

children.text: liṅgaviśeṣanirdeśāt samānavidhāneṣv aprāptā sārasvatī strītvāt / Jaim_9,1.45 /
children.translated_text: Because of the indication of a specific indicatory mark, in [rites of] the same procedure, the <s>Sārasvatī</s> [cow] would [apply though] not [originally] obtained, because of [its] femaleness. / Jaim 9.1.45 /

children.text: paśvabhidhānād vā tad dhi codanābhūtaṃ puṃviṣayaṃ punaḥ paśutvam / Jaim_9,1.46 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the expression 'animal' — for that is the subject of the injunction — the animality applies to the male. / Jaim 9.1.46 /
Or, the specification [applies], because of the indication of that purpose. / Jaim 9.1.47 /
And the animality [applies], because of the oneness of the word. / Jaim 9.1.48 /
Or it should be as stated, due to proximity. (Jaim_9,1.49)

children.text: āmnātād anyad adhikāre vacanād vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_9,1.50 /
children.translated_text: Something different from what is taught, when in the context of a [new] injunction, would be a <s>vikāra</s> (modification). (Jaim_9,1.50)

children.text: dvaidhaṃ vā tulyahetutvāt sāmānyād vikalpaḥ syāt / Jaim_9,1.51 /
children.translated_text: Or there would be a twofold option, since the reasons are equal, and due to generality there would be an alternative. (Jaim_9,1.51)
And because of the instruction regarding the <s>Sāman</s> (chant). (Jaim_9,1.52)

children.text: niyamo vā śrutiviśeṣād itarat sāptadaśyavat / Jaim_9,1.53 /
children.translated_text: Or there is a restriction due to a specific <s>śruti</s> (Vedic text); the other would be like the <s>Sāptadaśī</s> (seventeen-versed). (Jaim_9,1.53)
When the word-form is different due to non-precedence, the instruction would be of that nature. (Jaim_9,1.54)

children.text: yatsthāne vā tadgītiḥ syāt padānyatvapradhānatvāt / Jaim_9,1.55 /
children.translated_text: Or the singing would be in the place of that [original], since the difference of words is not the principal element. (Jaim_9,1.55)
And because of the connection with the melody. (Jaim_9,1.56)
If one says it is [merely] a verbal statement— (Jaim_9,1.57)
No, because that [melody] is the principal element. (Jaim_9,1.58)
Some [hold that] the <s>Sāmans</s> (chants) are <s>mantras</s> (sacred formulae), based on tradition and instruction. (Jaim_9,2.1)
That has the defect already stated. (Jaim_9,2.2)
Or [the <s>Sāman</s>] is an action, characterized by an injunction. (Jaim_9,2.3)
The substance would be of that kind, due to a verbal statement, like in the <s>pākayajña</s> (cooked-food sacrifice). (Jaim_9,2.4)

children.text: tatrāvipratiṣiddho dravyāntare vyatirekaḥ pradeśaś ca / Jaim_9,2.5 /
children.translated_text: In that case, there is no prohibition against exclusion in [the case of] another substance, and [this is] a precedent. (Jaim_9,2.5)
But because [the <s>Sāman</s>] has verbal sound as its meaning, it should not be so. (Jaim_9,2.6)
And because words serve another purpose. (Jaim_9,2.7)

children.text: asambandhaś ca karmaṇā śabdayoḥ pṛthagarthatvāt / Jaim_9,2.8 /
children.translated_text: And there is no connection of the two words with the action, since they have separate meanings. (Jaim_9,2.8)
And the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration), when not in the [proper] context, would be like fire, since it is employed [elsewhere]. (Jaim_9,2.9)

children.text: akāryatvāc ca śabdānām aprayogaḥ pratīyeta / Jaim_9,2.10 /
children.translated_text: And since words cannot be produced [as effects], their non-application would be understood. (Jaim_9,2.10)
And because [they are] dependent. (Jaim_9,2.11)
If one says that [they] are employed— (Jaim_9,2.12)
[They] would be employed for the purpose of apprehension. (Jaim_9,2.13)
It would apply to the <s>tṛca</s> (group of three verses), since the <s>śruti</s> (Vedic text) indicates so. (Jaim_9,2.14)
Because the modification has verbal sound as its meaning. (Jaim_9,2.15)
And [the scripture] demonstrates [this]. (Jaim_9,2.16)

children.text: vākyānāṃ tu vibhaktatvāt pratiśabdaṃ samāptiḥ syāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_9,2.17 /
children.translated_text: But since sentences are divided, the completion would be for each word, because the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration) serves that purpose. (Jaim_9,2.17)
And likewise, the demonstration is for a different purpose. (Jaim_9,2.18)
And the instruction without a <s>vā</s>-syllable is likewise. (Jaim_9,2.19)
The other <s>śruti</s> (Vedic text) [is known] through repetition. (Jaim_9,2.20)
That repetition would apply in the <s>samā</s>-verses. (Jaim_9,2.21)
And because of the indication of a sign. (Jaim_9,2.22)
But the posteriority is incidental and would be understood from succession. (Jaim_9,2.23)
And that repetition [is] due to unity of purpose. (Jaim_9,2.24)
But [the rule] relating to the <s>Pragātha</s> (a type of verse-pair)— (Jaim_9,2.25)
And in its own [context]. (Jaim_9,2.26)
And in the <s>Pragātha</s>. (Jaim_9,2.27)
And because of the non-deviation from what the sign indicates. (Jaim_9,2.28)
There would be an option due to identity of purpose. (Jaim_9,2.29)

children.text: arthaikatvād vikalpaḥ syād ṛksāmayos tadarthatvāt / Jaim_9,2.30 /
children.translated_text: There would be an option due to identity of purpose between the <s>Ṛk</s> (verse) and the <s>Sāman</s> (chant), since they serve that [same] purpose. (Jaim_9,2.30)
The specific application would be due to a verbal statement. (Jaim_9,2.31)

children.text: sāmapradeśe vikāras tadapekṣaḥ syāc chāstrakṛtvāt / Jaim_9,2.32 /
children.translated_text: In the case of a <s>Sāman</s> prescription, the <s>vikāra</s> (modification) would depend on that, since the <s>śāstra</s> (injunctive text) is the basis. (Jaim_9,2.32)

children.text: varṇe tu vādarir yathādravyaṃ dravyavyatirekāt / Jaim_9,2.33 /
children.translated_text: But regarding the syllabic form, <s>Vādari</s> [holds that it follows] according to the substance, due to the exclusion of [other] substances. (Jaim_9,2.33)
Some [hold that] the <s>stobha</s> (exclamatory syllable) ceases in [the case of] another substance, like the <s>Ṛk</s> (verse). (Jaim_9,2.34)

children.text: sarvātideśas tu sāmānyāl lokavad vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_9,2.35 /
children.translated_text: But a complete transfer, due to generality, would be a modification, as in worldly [practice]. (Jaim_9,2.35)
And [the scripture] also shows the continuation. (Jaim_9,2.36)
Or there is cessation due to loss of purpose. (Jaim_9,2.37)
Or the continuation would be [merely] an <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage). (Jaim_9,2.38)

children.text: adhikañ ca vivarṇañ ca jaiminiḥ stobhaśabdatvāt / Jaim_9,2.39 /
children.translated_text: <s>Jaimini</s> [holds that] what is additional and what is discolored [are both <s>stobha</s>], because they have the nature of <s>stobha</s>-sounds. (Jaim_9,2.39)

Since <s>dharma</s> (duty) is purpose-determined, when there is prohibition of transgression regarding modification of substance and quality, there is connection with the injunction, due to inherent relation. (Jaim_9,2.40)

children.text: tadutpattes tu nivṛttis tatkṛtatvāt syāt / Jaim_9,2.41 /
children.translated_text: But cessation [would follow] from the origination of that, since it is produced by that. (Jaim_9,2.41)
Or they would be entered [into the modified rite] because they are purposeful, since the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration) serves that purpose. (Jaim_9,2.42)

children.text: ākhyā caivaṃ tadāveśād vikṛtau syād apūrvatvāt / Jaim_9,2.43 /
children.translated_text: And thus the designation, through such entry, would apply in the <s>vikṛti</s> (modified rite) due to its novelty. (Jaim_9,2.43)

children.text: parārthena tv arthasāmānyaṃ saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_9,2.44 /
children.translated_text: But through what serves another purpose, there is generality of purpose for the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration), since the consecration serves that purpose. (Jaim_9,2.44)
Or they would be performed, since the purpose is accomplished. (Jaim_9,2.45)
Due to unity of purpose, there would be no separation. (Jaim_9,2.46)
Or, due to an explicit statement, they would stand separately. (Jaim_9,2.47)
In what is not archetypal, due to modification of that and due to contradiction, they would stand apart. (Jaim_9,2.48)
And likewise in [a rite with] both <s>Sāmans</s> (chants), since a single purpose would result. (Jaim_9,2.49)

children.text: svārthatvād vā vyavasthā syāt prakṛtivat / Jaim_9,2.50 /
children.translated_text: Or the arrangement would be due to self-purposefulness, as in the <s>prakṛti</s> (archetype). (Jaim_9,2.50)

children.text: pārvaṇahomayos tv apravṛttiḥ samudāyārthasaṃyogāt tadabhījyā hi / Jaim_9,2.51 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>Pārvaṇa</s> (new/full moon) and <s>Homa</s> (oblation) rites, there is no application, due to connection with the collective purpose; for that [rite] is not to be offered separately. (Jaim_9,2.51)
If one says [it refers] to time— (Jaim_9,2.52)
No, because it is not the [relevant] context. (Jaim_9,2.53)
And because of the wording of the <s>mantra</s> (sacred formula). (Jaim_9,2.54)
If one says that in the absence of that, it would be like the fire [offering]— (Jaim_9,2.55)
No, because it is not the governing [rule]. (Jaim_9,2.56)
Because there is no distinction between the two. (Jaim_9,2.57)
Or, that for which the offering is not [separately] made—those two would relate to that. (Jaim_9,2.58)
If one says [this applies] also to the <s>prayāja</s> (fore-offering)— (Jaim_9,2.59)
No, because it has not been enjoined. (Jaim_9,2.60)

children.text: prakṛtau yathotpattivacanam arthānāṃ tathottarasyāṃ tatau tatprakṛtitvātvād arthe cākāryatvāt / Jaim_9,3.1 /
children.translated_text: The statement of origin of elements as it occurs in the <s>prakṛti</s> (archetype) applies likewise in the subsequent [rite], because of its being based on that archetype, and because the purpose cannot be [independently] produced. (Jaim_9,3.1)
And because of the indication of a sign. (Jaim_9,3.2)
What is incidental to the type [applies] in its proper place. (Jaim_9,3.3)
Some [hold] there is no modification, because it is not of the <s>ṛṣi</s>-s (sages). (Jaim_9,3.4)
And because of the indication of a sign. (Jaim_9,3.5)
Or the modification [has] a reason not already stated. (Jaim_9,3.6)
The sign [serves] the purpose of indicating the intention of the <s>mantra</s> (sacred formula). (Jaim_9,3.7)
Or there is a restriction, because it partakes of both. (Jaim_9,3.8)

children.text: laukike doṣasaṃyogād apavṛkte hi codyate nimittena prakṛtau syād abhāgitvāt / Jaim_9,3.9 /
children.translated_text: In the worldly [case], since there is connection with a defect, it is enjoined in the excluded [case]; due to the cause, it would apply in the <s>prakṛti</s> (archetype), because [the other] has no share. (Jaim_9,3.9)

children.text: anyāyas tv avikāreṇā draṣṭapratighātitvād aviśeṣāc ca tenāsya / Jaim_9,3.10 /
children.translated_text: But the procedure without modification [applies to] the other, since it does not obstruct what is seen, and because there is no distinction with that. (Jaim_9,3.10)
Or there would be modification, since it serves that purpose. (Jaim_9,3.11)

children.text: api tv anyāyasambandhāt prakṛtivat pareṣv api yathārthaṃ syāt / Jaim_9,3.12 /
children.translated_text: But rather, due to connection with the [proper] procedure, it would apply according to purpose in the subsequent [rites] also, as in the <s>prakṛti</s> (archetype). (Jaim_9,3.12)
But [it would apply] according to purpose, because the procedure has not been [separately] enjoined. (Jaim_9,3.13)
But in the Vedic [context], [it should be] as observed. (Jaim_9,3.14)

children.text: vipratipattau vikalpaḥ syāt tatsatvād guṇe tv anyāyakalpanaikadeśatvāt / Jaim_9,3.15 /
children.translated_text: In case of conflicting views, there would be an option, since that [basis] exists; but regarding the subsidiary, because it is only a part of the procedural arrangement. (Jaim_9,3.15)
And because of the specific context. (Jaim_9,3.16)

children.text: arthābhāvāt tu naivaṃ syād guṇamātram itarat / Jaim_9,3.17 /
children.translated_text: But it should not be so, due to absence of purpose; the other is merely a subsidiary. (Jaim_9,3.17)
If one says that in the two <s>Dyāvā</s> [-pṛthivī rites] it is likewise— (Jaim_9,3.18)
No, because it is a word of origination. (Jaim_9,3.19)
But in what is unprecedented, the absence of modification would be understood from the absence of a precedent. (Jaim_9,3.20)
And also in the <s>vikṛti</s> (modified rite), because of the statement regarding that. (Jaim_9,3.21)

children.text: adhriguḥ savanīyeṣu tadvat samānavidhānāś cet / Jaim_9,3.22 /
children.translated_text: <s>Adhrigu</s> [holds that] in the <s>Savanīya</s> (Soma-pressing) rites, it would be likewise, if the procedures are the same. (Jaim_9,3.22)
And in substitution, because there is no modification. (Jaim_9,3.23)

children.text: anāmnānād aśabdatvam abhāvāc cetarasya syāt / Jaim_9,3.24 /
children.translated_text: Due to non-teaching, there would be absence of the [proper] word-form, and because of the absence of the other. (Jaim_9,3.24)

children.text: tādarthyād vā tadākhyaṃ syāt saṃskārair aviśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_9,3.25 /
children.translated_text: Or, due to serving that purpose, it would have that designation, since it is not distinguished by its <s>saṃskāras</s> (consecrations). (Jaim_9,3.25)
And the true nature of this has been stated. (Jaim_9,3.26)
And in cases involving combination, because the purpose does not have a fixed measure. (Jaim_9,3.27)
And because of the indication of a sign. (Jaim_9,3.28)
Since there is a single connection [expressed by] 'in one way,' the designation would be through repetition. (Jaim_9,3.29)
Or there is no modification of the many, as in a single action. (Jaim_9,3.30)
