children.text: sakṛttvaṃ caikadhyaṃ syād ekatvāt tvaco 'nabhipretaṃ tatprakṛtitvāt pareṣv abhyāsena vivṛddhāv abhidhānāṃ syāt / Jaim_9,3.31 /
children.translated_text: The oneness would be the unity, due to the oneness [of the rite]; but regarding the skin, [the modification is] not intended, because of its being based on that archetype; in the subsequent [rites], the designation would be through repetition in augmentation. (Jaim_9,3.31)

children.text: medhapatitvaṃ svāmidevatasya samavāyāt sarvatra ca prayuktatvāt tasyācānyāyanigadatvāt sarvatraivāvikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_9,3.32 /
children.translated_text: The <s>medhapati</s>-status (lordship of the sacrificial animal) [belongs] to the one having [the relationship of] owner and deity, due to inherent relation; and since it is employed everywhere, and because its procedure is stated in the standard formulas, there would be no modification anywhere. (Jaim_9,3.32)

children.text: api vā dvisamavāyo 'rthānyatve yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prayogaḥ syāt / Jaim_9,3.33 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, there is a dual inherent relation; when the purpose differs, the application would be according to number. (Jaim_9,3.33)

children.text: svāmino vaikaśabdyād utkarṣo devatāyāṃ syāt patnyāṃ dvitīyaśabdaḥ syāt / Jaim_9,3.34 /
children.translated_text: Due to the unity of designation, the superiority of the owner would apply to the deity; regarding the wife, there would be a secondary designation. (Jaim_9,3.34)

children.text: devatā tu tadāśīṣṭvāt samprāptatvāt svāminy anarthikā syāt / Jaim_9,3.35 /
children.translated_text: But the deity, since it is [the object of] his benediction, having been obtained, would be without purpose regarding the owner. (Jaim_9,3.35)

children.text: utsargāc ca bhaktyā tasmin patitvaṃ syāt / Jaim_9,3.36 /
children.translated_text: And due to offering, through devotion, the lordship would apply to that [deity]. (Jaim_9,3.36)
The one connected with a single [deity] would be elevated in a <s>dvidevatā</s> (two-deity rite), since it is possible. (Jaim_9,3.37)

children.text: ekas tu samavāyāt tasya tallakṣaṇatvāt / Jaim_9,3.38 /
children.translated_text: But [there is] one, due to inherent relation, since that has that as its characteristic. (Jaim_9,3.38)

children.text: saṃsargitvāc ca tasmāt tena vikalpaḥ syāt / Jaim_9,3.39 /
children.translated_text: And since there is combination, therefore there would be an option with that. (Jaim_9,3.39)
Even in oneness, because there is no loss of the subsidiary qualities. (Jaim_9,3.40)
In a <s>bahudevatā</s> (multi-deity rite), there would be a restriction [or] modification. (Jaim_9,3.41)
Or there would be an option, as in the <s>prakṛti</s> (archetype). (Jaim_9,3.42)

children.text: arthāntare vikāraḥ syād devatāpṛthaktvād ekābhisamavāyāt syāt / Jaim_9,3.43 /
children.translated_text: In a different purpose, there would be modification; since the deity is not separate, it would be due to inherent relation with a single [entity]. (Jaim_9,3.43)

children.text: ṣaḍviṃśatir abhyāsena paśugaṇe tatprakṛtitvād gaṇasya pravibhaktatvād avikāre hi tāsām akārtsnyenābhisambandho vikārān na samāsaḥ syād asaṃyogāc ca sarvābhiḥ / Jaim_9,4.1 /
children.translated_text: Twenty-six [are designated] through repetition in the <s>paśugaṇa</s> (group of animals), because it is based on that archetype; since the group is divided, and because in non-modification their connection is not with the totality, there would be no aggregation of modifications, due to non-connection with all. (Jaim_9,4.1)
If one says that in repetition also it is likewise— (Jaim_9,4.2)
No, because of the subsidiary [nature], and because it is purpose-determined. (Jaim_9,4.3)
If one says that in aggregation also it is likewise— (Jaim_9,4.4)
No, because it is impossible. (Jaim_9,4.5)

children.text: svābhiś ca vacanaṃ prakṛtau tatheha syāt / Jaim_9,4.6 /
children.translated_text: And with their own [deities], the statement in the <s>prakṛti</s> (archetype) would likewise [apply] here. (Jaim_9,4.6)

children.text: vaṅkrīṇāṃ tu pradhānatvāt samāsenābhidhānaṃ syāt prādhānyam adhrigos tadarthatvāt / Jaim_9,4.7 /
children.translated_text: But regarding the <s>vaṅkrī</s>-ribs, due to their principality, the designation would be through aggregation; the principality of <s>adhrigu</s> [holds] since it serves that purpose. (Jaim_9,4.7)
And because of the statement of their totality. (Jaim_9,4.8)

children.text: api tv asannipātitvāt patnīvad āmnātenābhidhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_9,4.9 /
children.translated_text: But rather, since they do not come together, the designation would be through what is taught, like the wife. (Jaim_9,4.9)
But the <s>vikāra</s> (modification) [applies] because it is a precedent, like the <s>yajamāna</s> (sacrificer). (Jaim_9,4.10)
Likewise regarding the wife, because of its unprecedented nature. (Jaim_9,4.11)

children.text: anāmnātas tv avikārāt saṅkhyāsu sarvagāmitvāt / Jaim_9,4.12 /
children.translated_text: But those not taught [would follow] from the absence of modification; in the numbers, because of universal applicability. (Jaim_9,4.12)

children.text: saṅkhāyā tv evaṃ pradhānaṃ syād vaṅkrayaḥ punaḥ pradhānam / Jaim_9,4.13 /
children.translated_text: But regarding number, thus the principal would be [the animal]; but the <s>vaṅkrī</s>-ribs again would be the principal. (Jaim_9,4.13)

children.text: anāmnātavacanam avacanena hi vaṅkrīṇāṃ syān nirdeśaḥ / Jaim_9,4.14 /
children.translated_text: The statement of what is not taught [would serve as] the indication of the <s>vaṅkrī</s>-ribs through non-statement. (Jaim_9,4.14)
Or there would be repetition, due to absence of modification. (Jaim_9,4.15)

children.text: paśus tv evaṃ prādhānaṃ syād abhyāsasya tannimittatvāt tasmāt samāsaśabdaḥ syāt / Jaim_9,4.16 /
children.translated_text: But the animal would thus be the principal, since the repetition has that as its cause; therefore the aggregate designation would apply. (Jaim_9,4.16)

children.text: aśvasya catustriṃśat tasya vacanād vaiśeṣikam / Jaim_9,4.17 /
children.translated_text: For the horse, thirty-four, due to a specific statement regarding that. (Jaim_9,4.17)

children.text: tat pratiṣidhya prakṛtir niyujyate sā catustriṃśadvācyatvāt / Jaim_9,4.18 /
children.translated_text: Having prohibited that, the <s>prakṛti</s> (archetype) is enjoined; and that [archetype applies] because it expresses thirty-four. (Jaim_9,4.18)

children.text: ṛg vā syād āmnātatvād avikalpaś ca nyāyyaḥ / Jaim_9,4.19 /
children.translated_text: Or the <s>Ṛk</s> (verse) would apply, since it is taught; and the absence of an option is proper. (Jaim_9,4.19)

children.text: tasyāṃ tu vacanād airavatpadavikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_9,4.20 /
children.translated_text: But in that [case], due to a verbal statement, there would be modification of the <s>Airavatī</s> verse-foot. (Jaim_9,4.20)
Or there would be a complete prohibition, due to non-connection with the verse-foot. (Jaim_9,4.21)
Due to the proximity of <s>Vaniṣṭhu</s>, the designation of the <s>vapā</s> (omentum) would be through the <s>Urūkā</s> [verse]. (Jaim_9,4.22)
The designation of the <s>praśasta</s> (praised portion). (Jaim_9,4.23)
Or [it is] a praise of many. (Jaim_9,4.24)
In [the rites of] <s>Śyena</s>, <s>Śalā</s>, <s>Kaśyapa</s>, <s>Kavaṣa</s>, and <s>Trekaparṇā</s>, the statement refers to the type, due to proximity with what is well-known. (Jaim_9,4.25)
Or there would be totality, due to the absence of that [specific reference]. (Jaim_9,4.26)
And regarding the <s>adhrigu</s> [rite], since it serves that purpose. (Jaim_9,4.27)

children.text: prāsaṅgike prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate parārthatvāt tadarthe hi vidhīyate / Jaim_9,4.28 /
children.translated_text: In what is incidental, there is no <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation), since it serves another purpose; for it is enjoined for that [other] purpose. (Jaim_9,4.28)
And in the holding [rite], because it serves another purpose. (Jaim_9,4.29)
In the other [cases], because they serve the purpose of action, there would be a [ritual] act. (Jaim_9,4.30)
But not when [the result] has already arisen, because the time for the injunction has passed for that. (Jaim_9,4.31)

children.text: pradānadarśanaṃ śrapaṇe taddharmabhojanārthatvāt saṃsargāc ca madhūdakavat / Jaim_9,4.32 /
children.translated_text: The indication of offering in the cooking [is] because it serves the purpose of eating according to that <s>dharma</s> (rule); and due to combination, like honey-water. (Jaim_9,4.32)
And likewise the prohibition of <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration). (Jaim_9,4.33)
And when that is prohibited, because of the avoidance of what is of that nature. (Jaim_9,4.34)

children.text: adharmatvam apradānāt praṇītārthe vidhānād atulyatvād asaṃsargaḥ / Jaim_9,4.35 /
children.translated_text: There would be <s>adharma</s> (wrong) from non-offering; since it is enjoined for the purpose of the <s>praṇīta</s> (consecrated water), there is no combination due to dissimilarity. (Jaim_9,4.35)
The other would be a constant restatement. (Jaim_9,4.36)
Or [it is] a prohibition of what has been enjoined. (Jaim_9,4.37)

children.text: varjane guṇabhāvitvāt taduktapratiṣedhāt syāt kāraṇāt kevalāśanam / Jaim_9,4.38 /
children.translated_text: In avoidance, since it has the nature of a subsidiary, due to the prohibition stated therein, the eating alone would result from that cause. (Jaim_9,4.38)
And because of the <s>vrata-dharma</s> (rule of the observance), like the smearing. (Jaim_9,4.39)
Or the prohibition of the juice (of <s>Soma</s>) would apply, because it pertains to the person. / Jaim_9,4.40 /

children.text: abhyudaye dohāpanayaḥ svadharmā syāt pravṛttatvāt / Jaim_9,4.41 /
children.translated_text: In a rite of prosperity, the removal of the milking would be its own property, because it is already in operation. / Jaim_9,4.41 /
And because of the scriptural instruction regarding the boiled (offering). / Jaim_9,4.42 /
Or the removal would apply to another matter, because of the injunction — like the <s>carupaya</s> (porridge-vessel). / Jaim_9,4.43 /
The scriptural text regarding boiling is for the purpose of characterization. / Jaim_9,4.44 /

children.text: śrayaṇānāṃ tv apūrvatvāt pradānārthe vidhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_9,4.45 /
children.translated_text: But because of the novelty of the receptacles, the injunction would be for the purpose of giving. / Jaim_9,4.45 /
Or it would be a subsidiary, because it serves the purpose of the receptacles. / Jaim_9,4.46 /
And because there is no specification. / Jaim_9,4.47 /
And because of the scriptural text, since that is the principal. / Jaim_9,4.48 /
And the <s>arthavāda</s> (commendatory passage), because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_9,4.49 /

children.text: saṃskāraṃ prati bhāvāc ca tasmād apy apradhānam / Jaim_9,4.50 /
children.translated_text: And because of its existence in relation to the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration), therefore it too is non-principal. / Jaim_9,4.50 /
In the case of the release of those that have been carried around the fire, the purpose is like that of the placing. / Jaim_9,4.51 /
Or the prohibition of the remainder would apply, because of the absence of purpose — like [the case of what is] ending with the <s>iḍā</s> (sacrificial food portion). / Jaim_9,4.52 /

children.text: pūrvatvāc ca śabdasya saṃsthāpayatīti cāprabṛttenopapadyate / Jaim_9,4.53 /
children.translated_text: And because of the priority of the word, it is consistent with 'he establishes' and [the passage] beginning with 'from the commencement.' / Jaim_9,4.53 /

children.text: prabṛtter yajñahetutvāt pratiṣedhe saṃskārāṇām akarma syāt tatkāritatvād yathā prayājapratiṣedhe grahaṇam ājyasya / Jaim_9,4.54 /
children.translated_text: Because the commencement is the cause of the sacrifice, in the prohibition of the <s>saṃskāras</s> (consecrations), there would be non-action, because it is caused by that — just as in the prohibition of the <s>prayāja</s> (fore-offerings), the taking of the ghee [is still performed]. / Jaim_9,4.54 /

children.text: kriyā vā syād avacchedād akarma sarvahānaṃ syāt / Jaim_9,4.55 /
children.translated_text: Or there would be an action, because of limitation; otherwise, non-action would mean total abandonment. / Jaim_9,4.55 /
The substitute for the ghee-offering would be a <s>saṃsthā</s> (concluding rite), because of the release of the substance. / Jaim_9,4.56 /
Because of the word denoting completion. / Jaim_9,4.57 /

children.text: codanā vā karmotsargād anyaiḥ syād aviśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_9,4.58 /
children.translated_text: Or the injunction, because of the release of the rite, would be [fulfilled] by other [rites], since they are undifferentiated. / Jaim_9,4.58 /

children.text: anijyāṃ ca vanaspateḥ prasiddhāntena darśayati / Jaim_9,4.59 /
children.translated_text: And he shows the non-offering-nature of the <s>Vanaspati</s> (forest-lord oblation) by means of the established conclusion. / Jaim_9,4.59 /
The <s>saṃsthā</s> (concluding rite) would be [determined] by the deity, because it pertains to that deity. / Jaim_9,4.60 /
Because of the extension of the injunction to another context, all rites should [be performed]. / Jaim_10,1.1 /

children.text: api vābhidhānasaṃskāradravyam arthe kriyeta tādarthyāt / Jaim_10,1.2 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, the designation, consecration, and substance would be performed for the purpose of the meaning, because they serve that purpose. / Jaim_10,1.2 /
Because they are distinguished by what is not directly perceptible. / Jaim_10,1.3 /

children.text: iṣṭhir ārambhasaṃyogād aṅgabhūtān nivartetāramabhasya pradhānasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,1.4 /
children.translated_text: The <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering), because of its connection with the commencement, should set aside the subsidiaries — because of the connection of the commencement with the principal. / Jaim_10,1.4 /
And from a principal connected with another, all the commencements should be set aside, because they are non-subsidiaries. / Jaim_10,1.5 /
But in that [case], it would be like the <s>prayāja</s> (fore-offering). / Jaim_10,1.6 /
Or not, because of its subsidiary nature. / Jaim_10,1.7 /
And because of the unity of the sentence. / Jaim_10,1.8 /

children.text: karma ca dravyasaṃyogārtham arthābhāvān nivarteta tādarthyaṃ śrutisaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,1.9 /
children.translated_text: And the rite, being for the purpose of connection with the substance, would be set aside in the absence of purpose; the purpose is due to connection with the scriptural text. / Jaim_10,1.9 /

children.text: sthāṇau tu deśamātratvād anibṛttiḥ pratīyeta / Jaim_10,1.10 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>sthāṇu</s> (post/pillar), because it is merely a place, non-cessation would be understood. / Jaim_10,1.10 /

children.text: api vā śeṣabhūtatvāt saṃskāraḥ pratīyeta / Jaim_10,1.11 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of its subsidiary nature, the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration) would be understood. / Jaim_10,1.11 /
And the designation is likewise. / Jaim_10,1.12 /
And the <s>mantra</s>-words are likewise. / Jaim_10,1.13 /
And in the <s>prayāja</s> (fore-offering), because it follows the same principle. / Jaim_10,1.14 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim_10,1.15 /
Likewise the <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portion) and fire — if [one objects]. / Jaim_10,1.16 /
Because of the designation, the deity is different. / Jaim_10,1.17 /
And because of equality. / Jaim_10,1.18 /
If [one argues] also in the animal [sacrifice] — / Jaim_10,1.19 /
No, because of the statement of its non-existence. / Jaim_10,1.20 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim_10,1.21 /

children.text: guṇo vā syāt kapālavad guṇabhūtavikārāc ca / Jaim_10,1.22 /
children.translated_text: Or it would be a subsidiary, like the <s>kapāla</s> (potsherds) — and because of the modification of what is subsidiary. / Jaim_10,1.22 /

children.text: api vā śeṣabhūtatvāt tatsaṃskāraḥ pratīyeta svāhākāravad aṅgānām arthasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,1.23 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of its subsidiary nature, the consecration of that would be understood — like the <s>svāhākāra</s> (exclamation 'svāhā') — because of the connection of the subsidiaries with the purpose. / Jaim_10,1.23 /
And the statement of increase, in case of disagreement, because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_10,1.24 /
If [one argues] also in the case of subsidiaries — / Jaim_10,1.25 /
No, because of the non-abandonment — like the <s>karāla</s> (a type of vessel). / Jaim_10,1.26 /

children.text: grahāṇāñ ca sampratipattau tadvacanaṃ tadartvāt / Jaim_10,1.27 /
children.translated_text: And in the case of agreement regarding the <s>grahas</s> (libation-cups), the statement is for that purpose. / Jaim_10,1.27 /
And in the absence of the <s>grahas</s>, the same statement [applies]. / Jaim_10,1.28 /

children.text: devatāyāś ca hetutvaṃ prasiddhaṃ tena darśayati / Jaim_10,1.29 /
children.translated_text: And the causality of the deity is established; thereby he shows [it]. / Jaim_10,1.29 /

children.text: aviruddhopapattir arthāpatteḥ śṛtavad bhūtavikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,1.30 /
children.translated_text: A non-contradictory establishment through presumption — like the boiled [offering], the modification of the substance would apply. / Jaim_10,1.30 /

children.text: sa dvyarthaḥ syād ubhayoḥ śrutibhūtatvād vipratipattau tādarthyād vikāratvam uktaṃ tasyārthavādatvam / Jaim_10,1.31 /
children.translated_text: It would have a dual purpose, because both are based on scripture; in case of disagreement, because it serves that purpose, the modification has been stated — and the <s>arthavāda</s> (commendatory) nature of that. / Jaim_10,1.31 /
In case of disagreement, the modification of name for those would apply. / Jaim_10,1.32 /
Or repetition, like the <s>prayāja</s> (fore-offering) — one part being dedicated to another deity. / Jaim_10,1.33 /
The <s>caru</s> (porridge) would be a modification of the <s>havis</s> (oblation), because of its connection with offering. / Jaim_10,1.34 /
And because of its being taken as established [usage]. / Jaim_10,1.35 /
Or the <s>odana</s> (boiled rice), because of its connection with food. / Jaim_10,1.36 /
No, because of the dual purpose. / Jaim_10,1.37 /
Or it would be a modification of the <s>kapāla</s> (potsherd-offering), because of the scope and purpose. / Jaim_10,1.38 /
And because of the distinction between subsidiary and principal. / Jaim_10,1.39 /
And in the scriptural text regarding that, because of its being different from the other <s>havis</s> (oblation). / Jaim_10,1.40 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim_10,1.41 /
Or the <s>odana</s> (boiled rice), because it is employed. / Jaim_10,1.42 /
And because of the designation as unprecedented. / Jaim_10,1.43 /
And thus the indicatory mark is observed. / Jaim_10,1.44 /

children.text: sa kapāle prakṛtyā syād anyasya cāśrutitvāt / Jaim_10,1.45 /
children.translated_text: It would be on the <s>kapāla</s> (potsherds) by original procedure, because there is no scriptural text for the other. / Jaim_10,1.45 /
Or on one [only], because of mutual contradiction. / Jaim_10,1.46 /

children.text: na vārthāntarasaṃyogād apūpe pākasaṃyuktaṃ dhāraṇārthaṃ carau bhavati tatrārthāt pātralābhaḥ syād aniyamo 'viśeṣāt / Jaim_10,1.47 /
children.translated_text: No, because of connection with another matter: in the <s>apūpa</s> (cake), what is connected with baking is for the purpose of holding — in the <s>caru</s> (porridge), there would be the vessel [as needed] from that purpose; the rule would be unrestricted because of non-distinction. / Jaim_10,1.47 /
Or in the <s>caru</s> (porridge), because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim_10,1.48 /
In that, the grinding would apply, because of the non-abandonment of purpose. / Jaim_10,1.49 /
Or there would be non-action, because it serves the purpose of the <s>apūpa</s> (cake). / Jaim_10,1.50 /
And the kneading, because it serves the purpose of making a ball. / Jaim_10,1.51 /
And the sowing, because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_10,1.52 /
The heating, because of the downward cooking. / Jaim_10,1.53 /
And the placing, because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_10,1.54 /
The broad and smooth [shapes], because it is not a cake. / Jaim_10,1.55 /
And the heaping up, because it serves the purpose of baking on top. / Jaim_10,1.56 /
Likewise the kindling. / Jaim_10,1.57 /
And the lifting up and placing, because there is no scriptural text for it in the original procedure. / Jaim_10,1.58 /
In the case of black grains, there would be loss of purpose. / Jaim_10,2.1 /
Or it would apply, because of being directly taught — like the giving. / Jaim_10,2.2 /
For the strewing and the anointing, because they serve the purpose of the <s>amṛta</s> (nectar), there would be non-action. / Jaim_10,2.3 /
Or they would be performed, because of the <s>arthavāda</s> (commendatory) nature [of the prohibition] — because those two serve the purpose of mixture. / Jaim_10,2.4 /

children.text: akarma vā caturbhir āptivacanāt saha pūrṇaṃ punaś caturavattam / Jaim_10,2.5 /
children.translated_text: Or there would be non-action with respect to four, because of the statement of completion — the full [offering] again with four portions. / Jaim_10,2.5 /

children.text: kriyā vā mukhyāvadānaparimāṇāt sāmanyāt tadguṇatvam / Jaim_10,2.6 /
children.translated_text: Or there would be action, because of the measure of the principal offering — from generality, the subsidiary nature of that. / Jaim_10,2.6 /
And because of their having a single portion. / Jaim_10,2.7 /
The completion is determined by the number, because of equality. / Jaim_10,2.8 /
But the statement of completion would be purposeless when it already exists. / Jaim_10,2.9 /
The alternative, however, is because of the single-portion nature. / Jaim_10,2.10 /

children.text: sarvavikāre tv abhyasānarthakyaṃ haviṣo hītarasya syād api vā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ syād itarasyānyāyyatvāt / Jaim_10,2.11 /
children.translated_text: But in the case of a total modification, the repetition of the <s>havis</s> (oblation) would be purposeless — or it would pertain to the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> (rite for the rectification of errors), because the other is not proper. / Jaim_10,2.11 /

children.text: akarma vā saṃsargārthanivṛttatvāt tasmād āptisamarthatvaṃ / Jaim_10,2.12 /
children.translated_text: Or there would be non-action, because the purpose of mixture has ceased — therefore the capacity for completion [suffices]. / Jaim_10,2.12 /

children.text: bhakṣāṇāṃ tu pratyarthatvād akarma syāt / Jaim_10,2.13 /
children.translated_text: But for the eating-portions, because they serve each particular purpose, there would be non-action. / Jaim_10,2.13 /
Or they would apply, because of the observation of disposal. / Jaim_10,2.14 /

children.text: vacanaṃ vājyabhakṣasya prakṛtau syād abhāgitvāt / Jaim_10,2.15 /
children.translated_text: Or the statement regarding the ghee-eating-portion would apply in the original procedure, because it has no share [otherwise]. / Jaim_10,2.15 /

children.text: vacanaṃ vā hiraṇyasya pradānavadājyasya guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_10,2.16 /
children.translated_text: Or the statement regarding the gold, like the giving — the ghee being of subsidiary nature. / Jaim_10,2.16 /

children.text: ekadhopahāre sahatvaṃ brahmabhakṣāṇāṃ prakṛtau vihitatvāt / Jaim_10,2.17 /
children.translated_text: In a single offering, the simultaneous presentation of the <s>Brahma</s>-eating-portions [applies] in the original procedure, because they are enjoined [there]. / Jaim_10,2.17 /

children.text: sarvatvaṃ ca teṣām adhikārāt syāt / Jaim_10,2.18 /
children.translated_text: And the totality of those would follow from their entitlement. / Jaim_10,2.18 /
Or the removal of the person [from] those, because they are not specified. / Jaim_10,2.19 /
From the removal of the person, the proper time [is established]. / Jaim_10,2.20 /
Because of the oneness of purpose, there would be non-separation. / Jaim_10,2.21 /
The gift to the <s>ṛtvij</s> (officiating priest) would be for <s>dharma</s> (merit) alone, because of the capacity of 'he gives.' / Jaim_10,2.22 /
Or it would be for the purpose of purchase, because of connection with the rite — like [transactions] in the world. / Jaim_10,2.23 /
And because of the statement connecting [it] with the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee). / Jaim_10,2.24 /
And one should not be made to bow by another; one would purchase from the rite, because it serves another's purpose. / Jaim_10,2.25 /
And because of the statement 'purchased.' / Jaim_10,2.26 /
It is indeed a wage, because of the statement. / Jaim_10,2.27 /
Because of the association with one who is not a performer. / Jaim_10,2.28 /
And the eating of the remainder is likewise. / Jaim_10,2.29 /
Or it is a consecration of the substance, because it serves another's purpose. / Jaim_10,2.30 /
And in the remainder, because of equality. / Jaim_10,2.31 /

children.text: svāmini ta darśanāt tatsāmānyād itareṣāntathātvam / Jaim_10,2.32 /
children.translated_text: But for the owner, from observation — from the similarity with that, the otherness of the rest. / Jaim_10,2.32 /
And thus the observation of serving another purpose. / Jaim_10,2.33 /

children.text: varaṇamṛtvijāmānamanārthatvāt satre na syāt svakarmatvāt / Jaim_10,2.34 /
children.translated_text: The selection of priests by the patron would not apply in a <s>Satra</s> (sacrificial session), because of [its being] one's own rite. / Jaim_10,2.34 /
And the purchase [of priestly services], because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_10,2.35 /
And the prohibition, like [that in] a rite. / Jaim_10,2.36 /
Or it would apply to the <s>prāsarpika</s> (preparatory rite), because of its being for <s>dharma</s> (merit) alone. / Jaim_10,2.37 /

children.text: na dakṣiṇāśabdāt tasmān nityānuvādaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,2.38 /
children.translated_text: No, because of the word <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee); therefore, it would be a restatement of what is permanent. / Jaim_10,2.38 /

children.text: udavasānīyaḥ satradharmā syāt tadaṅgatvāt tatra dāne dharmamātraṃ syāt / Jaim_10,2.39 /
children.translated_text: The <s>udavasānīya</s> (concluding rite) would follow the rules of the <s>Satra</s> (sacrificial session), because it is a subsidiary thereof; and in the giving there, it would be for <s>dharma</s> alone. / Jaim_10,2.39 /

children.text: na tv etat prakṛtitvād vibhaktacoditatvāc ca / Jaim_10,2.40 /
children.translated_text: But this is not so, because it is the original procedure, and because it is enjoined as separate. / Jaim_10,2.40 /

children.text: teṣāṃ tu vacanād dviyajñavatsahaprayogaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,2.41 /
children.translated_text: But from the statement regarding those, there would be combined performance, like a two-sacrifice [situation]. / Jaim_10,2.41 /
In that case, they would select other priests. / Jaim_10,2.42 /

children.text: ekaikaśas tv avipratiṣedhāt prakṛteś caikasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,2.43 /
children.translated_text: But one by one, because of non-contradiction, and because of the connection of the original procedure with one [person]. / Jaim_10,2.43 /
And in the <s>kāmeṣṭi</s> (desire-offering), because of the word 'gift.' / Jaim_10,2.44 /
Or the statement, because it is a <s>Satra</s> (sacrificial session). / Jaim_10,2.45 /
And in the case of one who is hostile, because of the injunction — from the removal of the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (fee). / Jaim_10,2.46 /

children.text: asthiyajño 'vipratiṣedhād itareṣāṃ syād vipratiṣedhād asthnām / Jaim_10,2.47 /
children.translated_text: The bone-sacrifice would apply to the rest without contradiction — but for the bones, because of contradiction. / Jaim_10,2.47 /
As much as is stated, that would be the application. / Jaim_10,2.48 /

children.text: yadi tu vacanāt teṣāṃ japasaṃskāram arthaluptaṃ seṣṭi tadarthatvāt / Jaim_10,2.49 /
children.translated_text: If, however, because of the statement, the <s>japa</s>-consecration of those [has its] purpose lost, [it should be performed] with the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering), because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_10,2.49 /
But for the purpose of the rite, it should be performed, because of its subsidiary nature. / Jaim_10,2.49* /

children.text: kāmyāni tu na vidyante kāmā jñānād yathetarasyānucyamānāni / Jaim_10,2.50 /
children.translated_text: But desire-rites are not found [to be] desires through knowledge, just as the other [rites] that are not mentioned. / Jaim_10,2.50 /
And the exertion-rites, because of the absence [of separate purpose] — like the <s>sūktavāka</s> (hymn-recitation). / Jaim_10,2.51 /
Or they would exist, because of their <s>arthavāda</s> (commendatory) nature. / Jaim_10,2.52 /
Not from the designation of wish, because of its absence in the other. / Jaim_10,2.53 /
Or they would be desires of the <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoking priest). / Jaim_10,2.54 /
No, because that has the nature of a blessing. / Jaim_10,2.55 /

children.text: sarvasvārasya diṣṭagatau samāpanaṃ na vidyate karmaṇo jīvasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,2.56 /
children.translated_text: In the case of one who has given all his possessions, when fate [has decreed] departure, there is no completion of the rite, because of the connection with life. / Jaim_10,2.56 /
Or both would [be completed], because of being directly taught. / Jaim_10,2.57 /
When [the person] has departed, the rite [continues] like the bone-sacrifice. / Jaim_10,2.58 /

children.text: jīvaty avacanam āyur āśiṣas tadarthatvāt / Jaim_10,2.59 /
children.translated_text: While [the person] lives, the statement [about] lifespan is a blessing, because it serves that purpose. / Jaim_10,2.59 /
Or the statement [applies], because of having a share, as stated formerly. / Jaim_10,2.60 /
There would be action for those that are only for <s>dharma</s> (merit). / Jaim_10,2.61 /
And in the loss of the subsidiary, [the loss] of the principal. / Jaim_10,2.62 /

children.text: muṣṭilopāt tu saṃkhyālopas tadguṇatvāt syāt / Jaim_10,2.63 /
children.translated_text: But from the loss of the handful, the loss of number [would follow], because of its subsidiary nature. / Jaim_10,2.63 /
No, because it is the remainder of the pouring. / Jaim_10,2.64 /

children.text: saṃkhyā tu codanāṃ prati sāmānyāt tadvikāraḥ saṃyogāc ca paraṃ muṣṭheḥ / Jaim_10,2.65 /
children.translated_text: But the number, with respect to the injunction, from generality — the modification of that — and from connection, beyond the handful. / Jaim_10,2.65 /
No, because of the connection with the injunction, in the original procedure, because of the connection with consecration. / Jaim_10,2.66 /

children.text: autpattike tu dravyato vikāraḥ syād akāryātvāt / Jaim_10,2.67 /
children.translated_text: But in the original procedure, the modification would be from the substance, because it is not produced [anew]. / Jaim_10,2.67 /

children.text: naimittike tu kāryatvāt prakṛteḥ syāt tadāpatteḥ / Jaim_10,2.68 /
children.translated_text: But in the occasional [rite], because it is produced, it would follow from the original procedure, because of the contingency. / Jaim_10,2.68 /

children.text: vipratiṣedhe tadvacanāt prākṛtaguṇalopaḥ syāt tena ca karmasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,2.69 /
children.translated_text: In case of contradiction, because of the statement, there would be loss of the original subsidiary — and because of the connection with the rite. / Jaim_10,2.69 /
There would be prohibition of the others. / Jaim_10,2.70 /
And because of the prohibition. / Jaim_10,2.71 /
In the absence of [its own] purpose, it would have the status of a <s>saṃskāra</s> (preparatory rite). / Jaim_10,2.72 /

children.text: arthena ca viparyāse tādaryāttattvameva syāt / Jaim_10,2.73 /
children.translated_text: And when there is a reversal in purpose, because of that very character, the same nature would remain. / Jaim_10,2.73 /

children.text: vikṛtau śabdavattvāt pradhānasya guṇānām adhikotpattiḥ sannidhānāt / Jaim_10,3.1 /
children.translated_text: In a modification (<s>vikṛti</s>), because the principal has a [Vedic] word, the additional origination of subsidiaries [derives from] proximity. / Jaim_10,3.1 /
And there is no obstruction of that, as in the archetype (<s>prakṛti</s>). / Jaim_10,3.2 /
And because the injunction has authority. / Jaim_10,3.3 /

children.text: pradhānaṃ tv aṅgasaṃyuktaṃ tathābhūtam apūrvaṃ syāt tasya vidhyupalakṣaṇāt sarvo hi pūrvavān vidhir aviśeṣāt pravartitaḥ / Jaim_10,3.4 /
children.translated_text: But the principal, when connected with subsidiaries, being of that nature, would be unprecedented (<s>apūrva</s>); because of the defining character of the injunction — for every injunction possessing a prior [model] is applied without distinction. / Jaim_10,3.4 /
And a subsidiary injunction would not apply to what is not a subsidiary. / Jaim_10,3.5 /

children.text: karmaṇaś caikaśabdyāt sannidhāne vidher ākhyāsaṃyogo guṇena tadvikāraḥ syāc chabdasya vidhigāmitvād guṇasya copadeśyatvāt / Jaim_10,3.6 /
children.translated_text: And because the rite has a single designation, in proximity to the injunction, the connection of the designation with the subsidiary — that would be a modification, because the word tends toward the injunction, and because the subsidiary is to be taught. / Jaim_10,3.6 /
And because the name has no operative force. / Jaim_10,3.7 /
And the authority is equal in the subsidiary. / Jaim_10,3.8 /

children.text: sarvam evaṃ pradhānam iti cet / Jaim_10,3.9 /
children.translated_text: If [one argues that] everything is thus the principal — / Jaim_10,3.9 /
Because of the connection with what is of that nature, the injunctions would be according to their purpose. / Jaim_10,3.10 /

children.text: vidhitvaṃ cāviśiṣṭham evaṃ prākṛtānāṃ vaikṛtaiḥ karmaṇāyogāt tasmāt sarvaṃ pradhānārtham / Jaim_10,3.11 /
children.translated_text: And the injunctive character is undistinguished; thus, because the archetypal elements have no connection with the modified rite — therefore everything serves the purpose of the principal. / Jaim_10,3.11 /

children.text: samatvāc ca tadutpatteḥ saṃskārair adhikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,3.12 /
children.translated_text: And because the origination of that is equal, the qualification would be [established] through the <s>saṃskāras</s>. / Jaim_10,3.12 /
The <s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> [offering belongs] to the first [rite], because of the indicatory sign of the <s>mantra</s>. / Jaim_10,3.13 /
And because there is no obstruction of the archetype. / Jaim_10,3.14 /
Or [it belongs] to the latter, because of the need for the <s>mantra</s>. / Jaim_10,3.15 /

children.text: vidhyatideśāt tacchrutau vikāraḥ syād guṇānām upadeśyatvāt / Jaim_10,3.16 /
children.translated_text: Because of the extension (<s>atideśa</s>) of the injunction, when that <s>śruti</s> [is found], there would be a modification of the subsidiaries, because the subsidiaries are to be taught. / Jaim_10,3.16 /
And because in the former, the absence of the <s>mantra</s> is observed. / Jaim_10,3.17 /

children.text: saṃskāre tu kriyāntara tasya vidhāyakatvāt / Jaim_10,3.18 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>saṃskāra</s>, it is a different action, because it prescribes that. / Jaim_10,3.18 /
And because there is no obstruction of the archetype. / Jaim_10,3.19 /

children.text: vidhes tu tatra bhāvāt sandehe yasya śabdas tadarthaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,3.20 /
children.translated_text: But because the injunction exists there, in case of doubt, that for which there is a word would serve that purpose. / Jaim_10,3.20 /
Because of the capacity of the <s>saṃskāra</s>, and because of the connection with the subsidiary. / Jaim_10,3.21 /
Because of the conflict, it would apply in the context of the action. / Jaim_10,3.22 /

children.text: ṣaḍbhir dīkṣayatīti tāsāṃ mantravikāraḥ śrutisaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,3.23 /
children.translated_text: 'He initiates with six' — the modification of the <s>mantras</s> pertaining to those [initiations], because of the connection with <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim_10,3.23 /
But because of the repetition, [it belongs to] the principal. / Jaim_10,3.24 /
By means of repetition, the <s>mantra</s>-action would be [established]. / Jaim_10,3.25 /

children.text: api vā pratimantratvāt prākṛtānām ahāniḥ syād anyāyaś ca kṛte 'bhyāsaḥ / Jaim_10,3.26 /
children.translated_text: Or, because each has its own <s>mantra</s>, there would be no loss of the archetypal elements; and repetition when [the action] is [already] done would be improper. / Jaim_10,3.26 /
And the sequence in the repetition is not possible, because it is incidental. / Jaim_10,3.27 /
And [the text] shows the distinctness of that. / Jaim_10,3.28 /
And because there is no distinction, the designation would not apply. / Jaim_10,3.29 /

children.text: agnyādheyasya naimittike guṇavikāre dakṣiṇādānam adhikaṃ syād vākyasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,3.30 /
children.translated_text: In the incidental subsidiary-modification of the <s>Agnyādheya</s> (fire-establishment), the giving of the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (fee) would be additional, because of the connection with the sentence. / Jaim_10,3.30 /
And because the others are established, [they apply] in their respective positions. / Jaim_10,3.31 /

children.text: vikāras tv aprakaraṇe hi kāmyāni / Jaim_10,3.32 /
children.translated_text: But the modification [applies] when there is no [specific] context — for they are optional (<s>kāmya</s>). / Jaim_10,3.32 /

children.text: śaṅkate ca nivṛtter ubhayatvaṃ hi śrūyate / Jaim_10,3.33 /
children.translated_text: And one doubts because of the cessation — for both characters are heard. / Jaim_10,3.33 /
The garment and the calf, because of commonality. / Jaim_10,3.34 /
Because of implication (<s>arthāpatti</s>), it would have those properties, because of the connection with the designation of the occasion. / Jaim_10,3.35 /
In giving, the cooking is characterized by purpose. / Jaim_10,3.36 /
And [it is] in the cooking, because of being a food-preparation. / Jaim_10,3.37 /
Likewise with the ghee-pouring (<s>abhighāraṇa</s>). / Jaim_10,3.38 /

children.text: dravyavidhisannidhau saṅkhyā teṣāṃ guṇatvāt syāt / Jaim_10,3.39 /
children.translated_text: In proximity to a substance-injunction, the number would be [determined] by the subsidiary character of those. / Jaim_10,3.39 /

children.text: samatvāt tu guṇānām ekasya śrutisaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,3.40 /
children.translated_text: But because of the equality of the subsidiaries, [it would pertain] to one, because of the connection with <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim_10,3.40 /

children.text: yasya vā sannidhāne syād vākyato hy abhisambandhaḥ / Jaim_10,3.41 /
children.translated_text: Or it would apply in the proximity of whichever [rite], for the connection is from the sentence. / Jaim_10,3.41 /

children.text: asaṃyuktās tu tulyavad itarābhir vidhīyante tasmāt sarvādhikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,3.42 /
children.translated_text: But those that are unconnected are enjoined likewise by the others; therefore the qualification would extend to all. / Jaim_10,3.42 /

children.text: asaṃyogād vidhiśrutāv ekajātādhikāraḥ syāc chrutyākopāt kratoḥ / Jaim_10,3.43 /
children.translated_text: Because of non-connection, when the injunction is heard, the qualification would extend to those of the same genus, since it does not disturb the <s>śruti</s> of the rite. / Jaim_10,3.43 /
And the meaning of the word [would be determined] as in worldly usage. / Jaim_10,3.44 /
Of those having animals [as dakṣiṇā], because of the division at origination. / Jaim_10,3.45 /
There is no restriction, because of the absence of distinction. / Jaim_10,3.46 /
Or it would pertain to cows, because of being a part. / Jaim_10,3.47 /
Because of the suffix. / Jaim_10,3.48 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_10,3.49 /

children.text: tatra dānaṃ vibhāgena pradānānāṃ pṛthaktvāt / Jaim_10,3.50 /
children.translated_text: There, the giving would be by division, because the bestowals are separate. / Jaim_10,3.50 /
And because of the hiring, as in worldly practice. / Jaim_10,3.51 /
And [the text] also shows the division. / Jaim_10,3.52 /
It would be equal, because it is not stated in <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim_10,3.53 /
Or, because of the inequality of the rites. / Jaim_10,3.54 /

children.text: atulyāḥ syuḥ parikraye viṣamākhyā vidhiśrutau parikrayān na karmaṇy upapadyate darśanād viśeṣasya tathābhyudaye / Jaim_10,3.55 /
children.translated_text: They would be unequal in the hiring — because of the designation of inequality in the injunctive <s>śruti</s>; the hiring is not possible in the rite [itself], because of the observation of distinction; likewise in prosperity. / Jaim_10,3.55 /

children.text: tasya dhenur iti gavāṃ prakṛtau vibhaktacoditatvāt sāmānyāt tadvikāraḥ syād yatheṣṭir guṇaśabdena / Jaim_10,3.56 /
children.translated_text: 'His cow' — in the archetype of cows, because it is enjoined with divisions, because of commonality, it would be a modification thereof — just as the <s>iṣṭi</s> [is modified] by the subsidiary word. / Jaim_10,3.56 /

children.text: sarvasya vā kratusaṃyogād ekatvaṃ dakṣiṇārthasya guṇānāṃ kāryaikatvād arthe vikṛtau śrutibhūtaṃ syāt tasmāt samavāyād dhi karmabhiḥ / Jaim_10,3.57 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the connection with the entire rite, there would be oneness of what serves as <s>dakṣiṇā</s>; because the subsidiaries have a single effect, in the purpose, in a modification, it would be based on <s>śruti</s>; therefore [it follows] from the combination with the rites. / Jaim_10,3.57 /

children.text: codanānām anāśrayāl liṅgena niyamaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,3.58 /
children.translated_text: Because the injunctions have no [other] basis, the restriction would be by the indicatory sign. / Jaim_10,3.58 /
'One or five' — like the cow. / Jaim_10,3.59 /
And [the animal should be] three years old. / Jaim_10,3.60 /
And thus is the observation of the indicatory sign. / Jaim_10,3.61 /

children.text: eke tu śrutibhūtatvāt saṅkhyayā gavāṃ liṅgaviśeṣeṇa / Jaim_10,3.62 /
children.translated_text: But some [say that], because it is based on <s>śruti</s>, by the number of cows, with the particular indicatory sign. / Jaim_10,3.62 /
If [one argues] that the two visible [instances] are so — / Jaim_10,3.63 /

children.text: api tv avayavārthatvād vibhaktaprakṛtitvād guṇedantāvikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,3.64 /
children.translated_text: But because it serves the purpose of the parts, because the archetype is divided, the modification would be in the subsidiary at the extremities. / Jaim_10,3.64 /

children.text: dhenuvac cāśvadakṣiṇā sa brahmaṇa iti puruṣāpanayo yathā hiraṇyasya / Jaim_10,3.65 /
children.translated_text: Like the cow, so the horse as <s>dakṣiṇā</s>; 'it [goes] to the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>' — the removal of the person, like that of gold. / Jaim_10,3.65 /

children.text: eke tu kartṛsaṃyogāt sragvat tasya liṅgaviśeṣeṇa / Jaim_10,3.66 /
children.translated_text: But some [say that], because of the connection with the performer, like the garland, [it is determined] by its particular indicatory sign. / Jaim_10,3.66 /

children.text: api vā tadadhikārād dhiraṇyavad vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,3.67 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of that qualification, it would be a modification, like gold. / Jaim_10,3.67 /
And likewise the <s>Soma</s> cup (<s>camasa</s>). / Jaim_10,3.68 /

children.text: sarvavikāro vā kratvarthe pratiṣedhāt paśūnāṃ / Jaim_10,3.69 /
children.translated_text: Or there would be a total modification serving the purpose of the rite, because of the prohibition regarding animals. / Jaim_10,3.69 /
If [one argues that] in the gift to the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, there is no distinction — / Jaim_10,3.70 /

children.text: utsargasya kratvarthatvāt pratiṣiddhasya karma syānn a ca gauṇaḥ prayojanam arthaḥ sa dakṣiṇānāṃ syāt / Jaim_10,3.71 /
children.translated_text: Because the general rule serves the purpose of the rite, the prohibited [element] would belong to the rite; and the secondary [meaning] is not the purpose — that would belong to the <s>dakṣiṇās</s>. / Jaim_10,3.71 /

children.text: yadi tu brahmaṇas tadūnaṃ tadvikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,3.72 /
children.translated_text: But if it is less than that of the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, it would be a modification thereof. / Jaim_10,3.72 /

children.text: sarvaṃ vā puruṣāpanayāt tāsāṃ kratupradhānatvāt / Jaim_10,3.73 /
children.translated_text: Or everything, because of the removal of the person — because those [fees] have the rite as their principal. / Jaim_10,3.73 /
In what is connected with the <s>Yajus</s>, the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> of the <s>Adhvaryu</s> would be a modification. / Jaim_10,3.74 /

children.text: api vā śrutibhūtatvāt sarvāsāṃ tasya bhāgo niyamyate / Jaim_10,3.75 /
children.translated_text: Or, because it is based on <s>śruti</s>, the share of all of those would be restricted to him. / Jaim_10,3.75 /
Because of the non-conjunction of the indicatory sign of the archetype with the sacrificial connection, the <s>saṃskāra</s> of the rite in the modification would be additional. / Jaim_10,4.1 /
When there is a conjunction of the injunction and the indicatory sign, that modification would be understood, because of the proximity of the archetype. / Jaim_10,4.2 /

children.text: sarvatra tu grahāmnānam adhikaṃ syāt prakṛtivat / Jaim_10,4.3 /
children.translated_text: But everywhere, the mention of the <s>graha</s> (cup) would be additional, like the archetype. / Jaim_10,4.3 /
And because of forming a single sentence with the additional elements. / Jaim_10,4.4 /
And because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_10,4.5 /
And in the <s>Prājāpatya</s> offerings, because of the mention. / Jaim_10,4.6 /
In the <s>Āma</s> (raw-offering), because of the observation of an indicatory sign. / Jaim_10,4.7 /
In the <s>Upagu</s> [priests], it would be like the reed, because of the conjunction with the indicatory sign of the archetype. / Jaim_10,4.8 /
But it would be additional, because of purposelessness [otherwise]. / Jaim_10,4.9 /
And in the <s>saṃskāra</s>, because of the connection with another. / Jaim_10,4.10 /
If [one argues it is] like the <s>prayāja</s> (preliminary offering) — / Jaim_10,4.11 /
No, because the purpose is different. / Jaim_10,4.12 /

children.text: ācchādane tv aikārthyāt prākṛtasya vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,4.13 /
children.translated_text: But in the covering (<s>ācchādana</s>), because of the unity of purpose, it would be a modification of the archetypal element. / Jaim_10,4.13 /
Or it would be additional, because it serves a different purpose. / Jaim_10,4.14 /
And [the text] shows cumulative performance. / Jaim_10,4.15 /
Because of the <s>śruti</s> of a different purpose in the <s>Sāman</s>, non-modification would be understood. / Jaim_10,4.16 /

children.text: arthe tv aśrūyamāṇe śeṣatvāt prākṛtasya vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,4.17 /
children.translated_text: But when the purpose is not stated, because of its subsidiary character, it would be a modification of the archetypal element. / Jaim_10,4.17 /
Of all, because of the absence of distinction. / Jaim_10,4.18 /

children.text: ekasyā vā śrutisāmarthyāt prakṛteś cāvikārāt / Jaim_10,4.19 /
children.translated_text: Or of one only, because of the capacity of <s>śruti</s>, and because the archetype is not modified. / Jaim_10,4.19 /

children.text: stomavibṛddhau tv adhikaṃ syād avibṛddhau dravyavikāraḥ syād itarasyāśrutitvāc ca / Jaim_10,4.20 /
children.translated_text: In the increase of the <s>stoma</s> (praise-structure), it would be additional; when there is no increase, there would be a substance-modification, and because the other is not stated in <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim_10,4.20 /
In the <s>Pavamāna</s> (purifying chant), they would apply to that, because of the observation of insertion and removal. / Jaim_10,4.21 /
But the statements are unprecedented. / Jaim_10,4.22 /

children.text: vidhiśabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ syāt tena codanā / Jaim_10,4.23 /
children.translated_text: When the injunctive word has the character of a <s>mantra</s>, it would exist [as such]; thereby [comes] the injunction. / Jaim_10,4.23 /

children.text: śeṣāṇāṃ vā codanaikatvāt tasmāt sarvatra śrūyate / Jaim_10,4.24 /
children.translated_text: Or because of the unity of injunction for the subsidiaries, therefore it is heard everywhere. / Jaim_10,4.24 /
Likewise in the later [rite] — because it has that as its archetype. / Jaim_10,4.25 /
When the subsidiary is mentioned in <s>śruti</s> of the archetypal element, the statement would be with the subsidiary included. / Jaim_10,4.26 /
Or there would be no modification, because the word of purpose does not depart — it would be like a substance. / Jaim_10,4.27 /

children.text: tathārambhāsamavāyād vā coditenābhidhānaṃ syād arthasya śrutisamavāyitvād avacane ca guṇaśāstram anarthakaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,4.28 /
children.translated_text: Because of the non-conjunction with the initiation, the statement would be by the enjoined [word], because the purpose is conjoined with <s>śruti</s>; and without the statement, the subsidiary injunction would be purposeless. / Jaim_10,4.28 /

children.text: dravyeṣv ārambhagāmitvād arthe vikāraḥ sāmarthyāt / Jaim_10,4.29 /
children.translated_text: In substances, because [modification] tends toward the initiation, the modification in purpose [would follow] from capacity. / Jaim_10,4.29 /
<s>Budhanvat</s>, like the <s>Pavamāna</s>, because of the specific statement. / Jaim_10,4.30 /
Because of the specific statement of the <s>mantra</s>, there would be no modification of the deity. / Jaim_10,4.31 /

children.text: vidhinigamabhedāt prakṛtau tatprakṛtitvād vikṛtāv api bhedaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,4.32 /
children.translated_text: Because of the distinction between injunction and explicit mention (<s>nigama</s>), in the archetype — because it has that as its archetype — in the modification too, there would be a distinction. / Jaim_10,4.32 /

children.text: yathoktaṃ vā vipratipatter na codanā / Jaim_10,4.33 /
children.translated_text: Or as stated, because of disagreement — there is no injunction. / Jaim_10,4.33 /
When the deity of the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s> who makes the sacrifice complete) is different, it would cease, because of the [same] word. / Jaim_10,4.34 /
Or there would be a conjunction, because of implication, since the designation arises from the rite. / Jaim_10,4.35 /

children.text: saguṇasya guṇalope nigameṣu yāvaduktaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,4.36 /
children.translated_text: When a subsidiary of that which has subsidiaries is dropped, in the explicit mentions it would apply as far as stated. / Jaim_10,4.36 /
Or of all, because they belong to one rite. / Jaim_10,4.37 /

children.text: sviṣṭakṛd āvāpiko 'nuyāje syāt prayojanavad aṅgānām arthasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,4.38 /
children.translated_text: The <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> would be an insertion in the <s>Anuyāja</s> (after-offering), because the subsidiaries have a purposeful connection. / Jaim_10,4.38 /

children.text: anvāheti ca śastravatkarma syāc codanāntarāt / Jaim_10,4.39 /
children.translated_text: 'He recites after' — and the <s>śastra</s>-like rite would be [established] from another injunction. / Jaim_10,4.39 /

children.text: saṃskāro vā coditasya śabdasya vacanārthatvāt / Jaim_10,4.40 /
children.translated_text: Or it is a <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration) of the enjoined word, because the statement serves that purpose. / Jaim_10,4.40 /
It would be so, because it serves a subsidiary purpose. / Jaim_10,4.41 /

children.text: manotāyāṃ tu vacanād avikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,4.42 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>Manotā</s>, because of an explicit statement, there would be no modification. / Jaim_10,4.42 /

children.text: pṛṣṭhārthe 'nyad rathantarāt tadyonipūrvatvād ṛcāṃ pravibhaktatvāt / Jaim_10,4.43 /
children.translated_text: In what serves the purpose of the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s>, [it is] other than the <s>Rathantara</s>, because that has priority of origin, and because the <s>ṛcs</s> (verses) are distributed. / Jaim_10,4.43 /
Or [it applies] in its own origin, because it designates all. / Jaim_10,4.44 /
If [one argues it is] like the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>) — / Jaim_10,4.45 /
No, because of the connection with the rite. / Jaim_10,4.46 /
Because the latter two are to be performed, [they follow] the archetype. / Jaim_10,4.47 /
Or, in the case of the same deity, because the <s>tṛca</s> (group of three verses) is undivided. / Jaim_10,4.48 /

children.text: grahāṇāṃ devatānyatve stutaśastrayoḥ karmatvād avikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,4.49 /
children.translated_text: When the deity of the <s>grahas</s> (cups) is different, in the <s>stuta</s> (praise) and <s>śastra</s> (recitation), because they are rites, there would be no modification. / Jaim_10,4.49 /

children.text: ubhayapānāt pṛṣadājye dadhnaḥ syād upalakṣaṇaṃ nigameṣu pātavyasyopalakṣaṇāt / Jaim_10,4.50 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>pṛṣadājya</s> (curd-and-ghee mixture), because both are drunk, yogurt would serve as the defining mark, in the explicit mentions, because the drinkable substance serves as the defining mark. / Jaim_10,4.50 /
Or not, because it serves another's purpose — like the lord of the sacrifice. / Jaim_10,4.51 /
Or it would be [so], because the invocation serves that purpose. / Jaim_10,4.52 /
Or not, because the word designates a <s>saṃskāra</s>. / Jaim_10,4.53 /
Or it would be [so], because [the word] designates a substance. / Jaim_10,4.54 /

children.text: dadhnas tu guṇabhūtatvād ājyapānigamāḥ syur guṇatvaṃ śruter ājyapradhānatvāt / Jaim_10,4.55 /
children.translated_text: But because yogurt is subsidiary, the explicit mentions would pertain to the ghee — the subsidiary character is from <s>śruti</s>, because ghee is the principal. / Jaim_10,4.55 /

children.text: dadhi vā syāt pradhānam ājye prathamāntyasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,4.56 /
children.translated_text: Or yogurt would be the principal in the ghee, because of the connection with the first and last [elements]. / Jaim_10,4.56 /

children.text: api vājyapradhānatvād guṇārthe vyapadeśe bhaktyā saṃskāraśabdaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,4.57 /
children.translated_text: Or, because ghee is the principal, in the subsidiary-purpose designation, by distribution, the word would designate a <s>saṃskāra</s>. / Jaim_10,4.57 /

children.text: api vākhyāvikāratvāt tena syād upalakṣaṇam / Jaim_10,4.58 /
children.translated_text: Or, because the designation is not modified, thereby it would serve as the defining mark. / Jaim_10,4.58 /
Or it would not be so, because it is a subsidiary injunction. / Jaim_10,4.59 /

children.text: ānupūrvyavatām ekadeśagrahaṇeṣv āgamavad antyalopaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,5.1 /
children.translated_text: For those that have a fixed sequence, when a part is taken, the omission would be from the end, as in the <s>āgama</s> (traditional teaching). / Jaim_10,5.1 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_10,5.2 /
Or there would be an option, because of the equality. / Jaim_10,5.3 /
The supplementary [element], from [the principle of] sequence, would be at the end. / Jaim_10,5.4 /

children.text: liṅgam aviśiṣṭaṃ saṅkhyāyā hi tadvacanam / Jaim_10,5.5 /
children.translated_text: The indicative sign is undistinguished; for the statement is of the number. / Jaim_10,5.5 /

children.text: ādito vā pravṛttiḥ syād ārambhasya tadāditvād vacanād antyavidhiḥ syāt / Jaim_10,5.6 /
children.translated_text: Or the activity would be from the beginning, because the commencement starts from that; because of the statement, the injunction regarding the last [element] would apply. / Jaim_10,5.6 /

In the <s>Ekatrika</s> (single-triplet rites), in the <s>Tṛca</s> (three-verse hymns) and the like, of the <s>Mādhyandina</s> (midday) <s>Chandas</s> (metres), because of their being scriptural in character. / Jaim_10,5.7 /
Or from the beginning, because that is the proper procedure, and the other is merely inferential. / Jaim_10,5.8 /
And according to the [original] arrangement, like the archetype, because the modification is merely in the number. / Jaim_10,5.9 /
The triad would apply to the <s>Tṛca</s> (three-verse hymn) in the leading [chant]. / Jaim_10,5.10 /
Or in a single one, because the <s>stoma</s> (praise-form) has the character of repetition. / Jaim_10,5.11 /

children.text: codanāsu tv apūrvatvāl liṅgena dharmaniyamaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,5.12 /
children.translated_text: But in the injunctive texts, because of being unprecedented, the restriction of the rule would be by the indicative sign. / Jaim_10,5.12 /
But the applicability [is understood] because of the connection with the word 'night.' / Jaim_10,5.13 /

children.text: apūrvāsu tu saṅkhyāsu vikalpaḥ syāt sarvāsām arthavattvāt / Jaim_10,5.14 /
children.translated_text: But in the case of unprecedented numbers, there would be an option among all, because all are purposeful. / Jaim_10,5.14 /

children.text: stomavivṛddhau prākṛtānām abhyāsena saṅkhyāpūraṇam avikārāt saṅkhyāyāṃ guṇaśabdatvād anyasya cāśrutitvāt / Jaim_10,5.15 /
children.translated_text: In the augmentation of the <s>stoma</s> (praise-form), the filling of the number is by repetition of the archetypal [verses], because there is no modification — because the number is merely a subsidiary designation, and because the other [method] is not stated in scripture. / Jaim_10,5.15 /
Or by tradition, because the repetition is not stated in scripture. / Jaim_10,5.16 /
And because the number is assigned separately. / Jaim_10,5.17 /
Because of the word <s>parāk</s> (far, beyond). / Jaim_10,5.18 /
And because of the non-modification of what has been stated. / Jaim_10,5.19 /
If [it be objected] 'not so,' because it is not stated in scripture — / Jaim_10,5.20 /
There would be a rule of measure for those that are prompted by purpose. / Jaim_10,5.21 /
And the statement of insertion is not applicable in the case of repetition. / Jaim_10,5.22 /
And because of the productive capacity of the <s>Sāmans</s> (chants). / Jaim_10,5.23 /
If [it be said that it applies] also in the leading [chants] — / Jaim_10,5.24 /
Not so, because the [stoma] has the character of repetition. / Jaim_10,5.25 /
In the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> (the external Pavamāna chant), there is no introduction of [new] <s>Ṛc</s> (verses), because of the unity of the <s>Sāman</s> (chant). / Jaim_10,5.26 /

children.text: abhyāsena tu saṃkhyāpūraṇaṃ sāmidhenīṣv abhyāsaprakṛtitvāt / Jaim_10,5.27 /
children.translated_text: But the filling of the number is by repetition in the <s>Sāmidhenīs</s> (kindling verses), because repetition is the archetypal [method] there. / Jaim_10,5.27 /
If [it be objected] 'not so,' because of the absence of distinction — / Jaim_10,5.28 /
It would be so, because it has that character; like the archetype, one should repeat until the number is filled. / Jaim_10,5.29 /
Or as much as has been stated, because the measure has been determined. / Jaim_10,5.30 /
And because of the observation of additional [elements]. / Jaim_10,5.31 /
If [it be said that it applies] also in the ritual acts — / Jaim_10,5.32 /
Not so, because they are enjoined. / Jaim_10,5.33 /
The <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s> (sixteen-fold praise) is a modification; there, because of the complete injunction. / Jaim_10,5.34 /
And because of the observation of absence in the archetype. / Jaim_10,5.35 /
And because of the statement 'it is not a sacrifice.' / Jaim_10,5.36 /
Or [it belongs] to the archetype, because it is a remainder [of the archetype]. / Jaim_10,5.37 /
And because of the observation [that it is part] of the archetype. / Jaim_10,5.38 /
What has been transmitted is for the purpose of enumeration. / Jaim_10,5.39 /
The observation of absence has been stated. / Jaim_10,5.40 /
The character of 'not being a sacrifice' is due to its being a subsidiary element. / Jaim_10,5.41 /
Its inclusion is because of the <s>Agrayaṇa</s> (preliminary Soma-drawing). / Jaim_10,5.42 /
And because of the statement regarding the <s>Ukthya</s> (a Soma sacrifice). / Jaim_10,5.43 /
Because of the statement, [it] would be in the third pressing. / Jaim_10,5.44 /
When there is no repetition, [the word] <s>parāk</s> has its purpose in that. / Jaim_10,5.45 /
And because it is a statement of the cessation of the <s>Ukthya</s>. / Jaim_10,5.46 /

children.text: āgrayaṇād vā parākśabdasya deśavācitvāt punarādheyavat / Jaim_10,5.47 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the <s>Agrayaṇa</s> (preliminary drawing), the word <s>parāk</s> denotes place, like the <s>Punarādheya</s> (re-establishment of fire). / Jaim_10,5.47 /
The cessation is because of the commonality of the <s>stoma</s> (praise-form). / Jaim_10,5.48 /

children.text: ukthyāgniṣṭomasaṃyogād astutaśastraḥ syāt sati hi saṃsthānyatvam / Jaim_10,5.49 /
children.translated_text: Because of the connection with the <s>Ukthya</s> and the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, [the rite] would be without the praise-recitation (<s>stuta-śastra</s>); for the difference in the concluding form (<s>saṃsthā</s>) exists only when that [praise] is present. / Jaim_10,5.49 /
Or it would include the praise-recitation, because it is a subsidiary element of that. / Jaim_10,5.50 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_10,5.51 /
Because of the statement, there is a difference in the concluding form (<s>saṃsthā</s>). / Jaim_10,5.52 /
Because of [its] absence, it is included in the <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight Soma sacrifice) rites. / Jaim_10,5.53 /
Or the connection [would apply], because the injunction is without a [new] commencement. / Jaim_10,5.54 /

children.text: caturthecaturthe 'hany ahīnasya gṛhyata ity abhyāsena pratīyeta bhojanavat / Jaim_10,5.55 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Ahīna</s> (multi-day sacrifice), it is included on every fourth day; it should be understood by repetition, like the [rule for] eating. / Jaim_10,5.55 /

children.text: api vā saṅkhyāvattvān nānāhīneṣu gṛhyate pakṣavad ekasmin saṃkhyārthabhāvāt / Jaim_10,5.56 /
children.translated_text: Or, because it has a [specified] number, it is included in various <s>Ahīna</s> rites; like a fortnight, in a single one, because the purpose of the number is fulfilled. / Jaim_10,5.56 /
In the case of the eating, it would be according to that number. / Jaim_10,5.57 /

children.text: jagatsāmni sāmābhāvād ṛktaḥ sāmatadākhyaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,5.58 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Jagat-sāman</s> (world-chant), because of the absence of a [distinct] <s>Sāman</s>, from the <s>Ṛc</s> (verse), the designation of the <s>Sāman</s> would be derived. / Jaim_10,5.58 /

children.text: ubhayasāmni naimittikaṃ vikalpena samatvāt syāt / Jaim_10,5.59 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Ubhaya-sāman</s> (double-chant), the occasional [element], because of the equality, would apply by option. / Jaim_10,5.59 /
Or it would be restricted by the primary [element]. / Jaim_10,5.60 /

children.text: nimittavighātād vā kratuyuktasya karma syāt / Jaim_10,5.61 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the cancellation of the occasion, the action connected with the sacrifice would apply. / Jaim_10,5.61 /
Because of the statement that the <s>Aindravāyava</s> (offering to Indra and Vāyu) is foremost, the displacement would be from the beginning. / Jaim_10,5.62 /

children.text: api vā dharmāviśeṣāt taddharmāṇāṃ svasthāne prakaraṇād agratvam ucyate / Jaim_10,5.63 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the non-distinction of the rule, the precedence of those having that character is stated by the context in their own place. / Jaim_10,5.63 /
And because of the connection with the stream [of Soma pouring]. / Jaim_10,5.64 /

children.text: kāmasaṃyoge tu vacanād āditaḥ pratikarṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,5.65 /
children.translated_text: But when there is a connection with desire, because of the statement, the displacement would be from the beginning. / Jaim_10,5.65 /

children.text: taddeśānāṃ vāgrasaṃyogāt tadyuktaṃ kāmaśāstraṃ syān nityasaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,5.66 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the connection with precedence for those [rites] belonging to that place, the teaching regarding desire would be applicable, because of the permanent connection. / Jaim_10,5.66 /

children.text: pareṣu cāgraśabdaḥ pūrvavat syāt tadādiṣu / Jaim_10,5.67 /
children.translated_text: And in the subsequent [rites], the word 'foremost' would apply as before, in those beginning with that. / Jaim_10,5.67 /
Or the displacement [occurs] with a permanent purpose, because the 'foremost' [position] is not connected with that. / Jaim_10,5.68 /
And [scripture] shows the displacement. / Jaim_10,5.69 /
The <s>Aindravāyava</s> is before the foremost, because its place has been determined. / Jaim_10,5.70 /
And because of the equality of character. / Jaim_10,5.71 /
And thus is the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_10,5.72 /
And also the accomplishment, because of its subsidiary nature. / Jaim_10,5.73 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_10,5.74 /
And also the giving is like the accomplishment. / Jaim_10,5.75 /

children.text: na vā pradhānatvāc cheṣatvāt sādanaṃ tathā / Jaim_10,5.76 /
children.translated_text: Or not, because of the principal nature; the accomplishment is likewise because of its subsidiary nature. / Jaim_10,5.76 /

children.text: tryanīkāyāṃ nyāyokteṣv āmnānaṃ guṇārthaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,5.77 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Tryanīkā</s> (three-army rite), the transmission of what has been stated by the proper procedure would be for the purpose of a subsidiary element. / Jaim_10,5.77 /

children.text: api vāhargaṇeṣv agnivat samānavidhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,5.78 /
children.translated_text: Or, in the groups of days, like the fire, the injunction would be the same. / Jaim_10,5.78 /

children.text: dvādaśāhasya vyūḍhasamūḍhatvaṃ pṛṣṭhavat samānavidhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,5.79 /
children.translated_text: The <s>Dvādaśāha</s> (twelve-day sacrifice) being spread out (<s>vyūḍha</s>) or compressed (<s>samūḍha</s>) — like the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s> (a type of chant), the injunction would be the same. / Jaim_10,5.79 /

children.text: vyūḍho vā liṅgadarśanāt samūḍhavikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,5.80 /
children.translated_text: Or it is spread out, because of the observation of the indicative sign; the compressed would be a modification. / Jaim_10,5.80 /
Because of the connection with desire. / Jaim_10,5.81 /
Its activity in both ways [arises] from the unity of the rite. / Jaim_10,5.82 /
Like the <s>Ekādaśinī</s> (eleven-fold rite), in the <s>Tryanīkā</s>, there would be rotation. / Jaim_10,5.83 /
Or the augmentation would be in their own places for the days, because the number is not explicitly [specified]. / Jaim_10,5.84 /

children.text: pṛṣṭhyāvṛttau cāgrayaṇasya darśanāt trayastriṃśe parivṛttau punaraindravāyavaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,5.85 /
children.translated_text: And in the rotation of the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s> [chants], because of the observation regarding the <s>Agrayaṇa</s>; in the thirty-third [stoma], in the rotation, the <s>Aindravāyava</s> would recur. / Jaim_10,5.85 /
Because of the statement, there is rotation in the <s>Ekādaśinī</s> (eleven-fold) rites. / Jaim_10,5.86 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_10,5.87 /

children.text: chandovyatikramād vyūḍhe bhakṣapavamānaparidhikapālasyama ntrāṇāṃ yathotpattivacanam ūhavat syāt / Jaim_10,5.88 /
children.translated_text: In the spread-out (<s>vyūḍha</s>) [arrangement], because of the transgression of the metre, the statement regarding the <s>mantras</s> for the <s>bhakṣa</s> (ritual eating), <s>pavamāna</s> (purifying chant), <s>paridhi</s> (enclosing sticks), and <s>kapāla</s> (potsherds) would be according to their original production, like the <s>ūha</s> (adaptation). / Jaim_10,5.88 /

children.text: ekarca sthāni yajñe syuḥ svādhyāyavat / Jaim_10,6.1 /
children.translated_text: The single-verse [hymns] would be substitutes in the sacrifice, like in <s>svādhyāya</s> (private recitation). / Jaim_10,6.1 /
Or in the <s>Tṛca</s> (three-verse hymn), because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_10,6.2 /
The <s>Svardṛśa</s> (heaven-seeing) glance is merely a time [marker], because it serves another's purpose. / Jaim_10,6.3 /
For the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> (a six-day Soma rite), because of the simultaneous injunction, the two-<s>Sāman</s> character would be like a one-day [rite]. / Jaim_10,6.4 /

children.text: vibhakte vā samastavidhānāt tadvibhāge vipratiṣiddham / Jaim_10,6.5 /
children.translated_text: Or, when [the rites are] divided, because of the injunction of the aggregate, dividing them would be contradictory. / Jaim_10,6.5 /
But the aggregate [applies] in the <s>Ekādaśinī</s> (eleven-fold) rites, because that is their archetype. / Jaim_10,6.6 /
And because of the prohibition of the <s>vihāra</s> (alternation). / Jaim_10,6.7 /

children.text: śrutito vā lokavad vibhāgaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,6.8 /
children.translated_text: Or, from scripture, the division would be as in common [practice]. / Jaim_10,6.8 /
And because the <s>vihāra</s> (alternation) is the archetype. / Jaim_10,6.9 /
And in the domain, because of the proximity to that. / Jaim_10,6.10 /
If [it be said that] the three are likewise — / Jaim_10,6.11 /
Not so, because of the equality, like the <s>Prayāja</s> (preliminary offering). / Jaim_10,6.12 /

children.text: sarvapṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhaśabdāt teṣāṃ syād ekadeśatvaṃ pṛṣṭhasya kṛtadeśatvāt / Jaim_10,6.13 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Sarvapṛṣṭha</s> (all-Pṛṣṭha rite), because of the word <s>pṛṣṭha</s>, their character would be as a portion, because the position of the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s> has been determined. / Jaim_10,6.13 /
But because of the injunction, there would be a displacement. / Jaim_10,6.14 /

children.text: vairūpasāmā kratusaṃyogāt trivṛdvad ekasāmā syāt / Jaim_10,6.15 /
children.translated_text: The <s>Vairūpa-sāman</s> (a particular chant), because of its connection with the sacrifice, would have a single <s>Sāman</s>, like the <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold stoma). / Jaim_10,6.15 /
Or, for the purpose of the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s>, because of the connection with the indicative sign of the archetype. / Jaim_10,6.16 /
If [it be said] 'like the <s>Trivṛt</s>' — / Jaim_10,6.17 /
Not so, because in the archetype, the connection is not complete. / Jaim_10,6.18 /
If [it be objected] 'not so, because it is an injunction' — / Jaim_10,6.19 /
It would be so in the domain, because that is the proper procedure, because the rite is undivided. / Jaim_10,6.20 /
And because of the non-modification of the archetype. / Jaim_10,6.21 /
In the <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold stoma), because it has the character of a number, there would be a modification of all numbers. / Jaim_10,6.22 /
Or of the <s>stoma</s> (praise-form), because that is its indicative sign. / Jaim_10,6.23 /
In the <s>Ubhaya-sāman</s> (double-chant), the division would be like in the <s>Viśvajit</s> (a particular sacrifice). / Jaim_10,6.24 /
Or, for the purpose of the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s>, because it does not serve that purpose. / Jaim_10,6.25 /
And because of the observation of the indicative sign. / Jaim_10,6.26 /

children.text: pṛṣṭhe rasabhojanam āvṛtte saṃsthite trayastriṃśe 'hani syāt tadānantaryāt prakṛtivat / Jaim_10,6.27 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s>, the <s>rasabhojana</s> (tasting of the juice) would occur on the thirty-third day after the rotation has concluded, because of its immediate succession, like the archetype. / Jaim_10,6.27 /
Or at the end, because the time has been determined. / Jaim_10,6.28 /

children.text: abhyāse ca tadabhyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ punaḥ prayogāt / Jaim_10,6.29 /
children.translated_text: And in the case of repetition, the repetition of that [tasting] would apply, because the rite is performed again. / Jaim_10,6.29 /
Or at the end, because the time has been determined. / Jaim_10,6.30 /

children.text: āvṛttis tu vyavāye kālabhedāt syāt / Jaim_10,6.31 /
children.translated_text: But the repetition would apply in the case of interruption, because of the difference of time. / Jaim_10,6.31 /
The consecrated one (<s>dīkṣita</s>) should not [consume] honey, because of being a <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student). / Jaim_10,6.32 /
It may be consumed, because it serves the purpose of the sacrifice. / Jaim_10,6.33 /

children.text: mānasam ahar antaraṃ syād bhedavyapadeśāt / Jaim_10,6.34 /
children.translated_text: The <s>Mānasa</s> (mental day) would be an intermediate day, because of the designation of the distinction. / Jaim_10,6.34 /
And because of the recitation (<s>saṃstava</s>) associated with it. / Jaim_10,6.35 /

children.text: ahar antāc ca pareṇa codanā / Jaim_10,6.36 /
children.translated_text: And because of the end of the day, the injunction is by the subsequent [rite]. / Jaim_10,6.36 /
In the fortnight, the number [applies] like a thousand. / Jaim_10,6.37 /
Or it is a subsidiary element of the day, like the <s>Aṃśu</s> (Soma-stalk), because there is no injunction. / Jaim_10,6.38 /
And because of the statement regarding the release on the tenth [day]. / Jaim_10,6.39 /
And 'on the tenth day' — because of the teaching regarding its subsidiary character. / Jaim_10,6.40 /
Because of the consistency of the numbers. / Jaim_10,6.41 /
And in the case of an excess of animals, because of the existence of a single one. / Jaim_10,6.42 /
The designation of the praise (<s>stuti</s>) is contradicted by the subsidiary element, like a vow. / Jaim_10,6.43 /
Because of the statement, it does not end with that. / Jaim_10,6.44 /
The <s>Sattra</s> (communal sacrifice) [is performed by] one person, like the archetype. / Jaim_10,6.45 /
But because of the statement, it would be [performed by] many. / Jaim_10,6.46 /
If [it be said that there would be only] a designation — / Jaim_10,6.47 /
Not so, because of the designation of unity. / Jaim_10,6.48 /
And [scripture] shows the assembling together. / Jaim_10,6.49 /

children.text: bahūnām iti caikasmin viśeṣavacanaṃ vyartham / Jaim_10,6.50 /
children.translated_text: If [it be said] 'of many' — then a special statement regarding a single one would be purposeless. / Jaim_10,6.50 /
Others would be the <s>ṛtvijs</s> (priests), like the archetype. / Jaim_10,6.51 /

children.text: api vā yajamānāḥ syur ṛtvijām abhidhānasaṃyogāt teṣāṃ syād yajamānatvam / Jaim_10,6.52 /
children.translated_text: Or they would be the <s>yajamānas</s> (sacrificers), because of the connection with the designation of the <s>ṛtvijs</s>; they would have the status of sacrificers. / Jaim_10,6.52 /

children.text: kartṛsaṃskāro vacanād ādhātṛvad iti cet / Jaim_10,6.53 /
children.translated_text: If [it be said that] the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration) of the performer [applies] because of the statement, like the one who establishes the fire — / Jaim_10,6.53 /
It would be so in the domain, because that is the proper procedure, like the archetype. / Jaim_10,6.54 /

children.text: svāmyākhyāḥ syur gṛhapativad iti cet / Jaim_10,6.55 /
children.translated_text: If [it be said] they would be called owners (<s>svāmins</s>), like the householder — / Jaim_10,6.55 /
Not so, because [the term] is used in its well-known sense; one who is not connected [as a sacrificer] does not [acquire] that character. / Jaim_10,6.56 /
And the designation of 'consecrated' and 'non-consecrated' is not applicable, because the two states always exist. / Jaim_10,6.57 /
And because there is no <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee). / Jaim_10,6.58 /

children.text: dvādaśāhasya satratvam āsanopāyicodanena yajamānabahutvena ca satraśabdābhisaṃyogāt / Jaim_10,6.59 /
children.translated_text: The <s>Dvādaśāha</s> (twelve-day sacrifice) has the character of a <s>Sattra</s> (communal sacrifice), because of the injunction regarding sitting in proximity, because of the plurality of sacrificers, and because of the connection with the word <s>sattra</s>. / Jaim_10,6.59 /
Because of the injunction 'he sacrifices,' it has the character of an <s>Ahīna</s> (multi-day sacrifice), and because the number of patrons is not fixed. / Jaim_10,6.60 /

children.text: ahīne dakṣiṇāśāstraṃ guṇatvāt pratyaha karmabhedaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,6.61 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Ahīna</s>, the rule regarding <s>dakṣiṇās</s> (sacrificial fees) — because they are subsidiary — would be a division per day according to the rite. / Jaim_10,6.61 /
Or for the whole, because of the unity of the rite. / Jaim_10,6.62 /
Or, like the <s>pṛṣadājya</s> (curdled ghee), the rule regarding the days would be subsidiary. / Jaim_10,6.63 /

children.text: jyautiṣṭomyas tu dakṣiṇāḥ sarvāsām ekakarmatvāt prakṛtivat tasmān nāsāṃ vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,6.64 /
children.translated_text: But the <s>dakṣiṇās</s> (sacrificial fees) follow the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> pattern, because all [days] constitute a single rite, like the archetype; therefore there would be no modification of them. / Jaim_10,6.64 /

children.text: dvādaśāhe tu vacanāt pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇābhedas tatprakṛtitvāt pareṣu tāsāṃ saṃkhyāvikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,6.65 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>Dvādaśāha</s> (twelve-day sacrifice), because of the statement, the <s>dakṣiṇās</s> (sacrificial fees) are divided per day; because that is the archetype, in the subsequent [rites] there would be a modification of their number. / Jaim_10,6.65 /

children.text: parikrayāvibhāgād vā samastasya vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,6.66 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the non-division of the purchase-price, the modification would be of the aggregate. / Jaim_10,6.66 /
But the differentiation is due to the conjunction with subsidiaries. / Jaim 10.6.67 /

children.text: pratyahaṃ sarvasaṃskāraḥ prakṛtivat sarvāsāṃ sarvaśeṣatvāt / Jaim_10,6.68 /
children.translated_text: Every day, all the preparatory rites (<s>saṃskāras</s>) [should be performed] as in the primary [rite], because all [rites] are subsidiary to all [others]. / Jaim 10.6.68 /
If [one objects] that this is not so because of the oneness of purpose — / Jaim 10.6.69 /
[The daily performance] would be [justified] at the time of origination, because of the difference of time. / Jaim 10.6.70 /
But by dividing [them], because of the instruction regarding preparatory rites, [it would be] like the twelve-day [rite]. / Jaim 10.6.71 /

children.text: liṅgena dravyanirdeśe sarvatra pratyayaḥ syāl liṅgasya sarvagāmitvād āgneyavat / Jaim_10,6.72 /
children.translated_text: When a substance is indicated by an indicatory mark (<s>liṅga</s>), the expectation [of that substance] would apply everywhere, because the indicatory mark extends to all [instances] — like the <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>). / Jaim 10.6.72 /

children.text: yāvad arthaṃ vārthaśeṣatvād alpena parimāṇaṃ syāt tasmiṃś ca liṅgasāmarthyam / Jaim_10,6.73 /
children.translated_text: Or, [the substance should be used] to the extent required, and because it is a remainder of the purpose, the measure would be determined by the lesser [quantity]; and in that case, the force of the indicatory mark [applies]. / Jaim 10.6.73 /
In the <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>), the complete injunction [applies]. / Jaim 10.6.74 /

children.text: ṛjīṣasya pradhānatvād ahargaṇe sarvasya pratipattiḥ syāt / Jaim_10,6.75 /
children.translated_text: Because of the primacy of the <s>ṛjīṣa</s> (residue), in the series of days the application of everything would follow. / Jaim 10.6.75 /

children.text: vāsasi mānopāvaharaṇe prakṛtau somasya vacanāt / Jaim_10,6.76 /
children.translated_text: Regarding the garment, the measurement and the removal — in the primary [rite], because of the scriptural statement concerning <s>Soma</s>. / Jaim 10.6.76 /
There, in the series of days, the garment would be the primary [element], by reason of the purpose. / Jaim 10.6.77 /

children.text: mānaṃ pratyutpādayet prakṛtau tena darśanād upāvaharaṇasya / Jaim_10,6.78 /
children.translated_text: One should produce the measurement in the primary [rite], because of the observation of the removal through that [measurement]. / Jaim 10.6.78 /

children.text: haraṇe vā śrutyasaṃyogād arthād vikṛtau tena / Jaim_10,6.79 /
children.translated_text: Or, in the [act of] removal, because there is no scriptural connection, [it would apply] by reason of purpose in the modified [rite], through that [means]. / Jaim 10.6.79 /
