The animal [sacrifice] constitutes a single oblation, because it is enjoined as a whole. / Jaim 10.7.1 /

children.text: pratyaṅgaṃ vā grahavad aṅgānāṃ pṛthakkalpanatvāt / Jaim_10,7.2 /
children.translated_text: Or, [the portions are] per limb, like the ladle-offerings (<s>graha</s>), because the limbs are conceived separately. / Jaim 10.7.2 /

children.text: havir bhedāt karmaṇe 'bhyāsas tasmāt tebhyo 'vadānaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,7.3 /
children.translated_text: Because of the difference of oblatory material, there is repetition for the rite; therefore the portions (<s>avadāna</s>) would be from those [limbs]. / Jaim 10.7.3 /

children.text: ājyabhāgavad vā nirdeśāt parisaṃkhyā syāt / Jaim_10,7.4 /
children.translated_text: Or, like the <s>ājyabhāgas</s> (shares of clarified butter), because of the [scriptural] indication, there would be a restriction on the number. / Jaim 10.7.4 /

children.text: teṣāṃ vā dvyavadānatvaṃ vivakṣann abhinirdiśet paśoḥ pañcāvadānatvāt / Jaim_10,7.5 /
children.translated_text: Or, intending to express the two-portion nature of those, one would explicitly state [it], because the animal has five portions (<s>avadānas</s>). / Jaim 10.7.5 /

children.text: aṃsaśiro'nūkasakthipratiṣedhaś ca tadanyaparisaṅkhyāne 'narthakaḥ syāt pradānatvāt teṣāṃ niravadānapratiṣedhaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.6 /
children.translated_text: And the prohibition of the shoulder, head, <s>anūka</s> (backbone), and thigh — in the enumeration of the others — would be purposeless, because those are the primary portions; the prohibition would be of [taking them as] portion-less. / Jaim 10.7.6 /

children.text: api vā parisaṅkhyā syād anavadānīyaśabdatvāt / Jaim_10,7.7 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, there would be a restrictive enumeration, because the word [used] means 'not to be portioned.' / Jaim 10.7.7 /
And because of observation [of this practice] among non-<s>Brāhmaṇas</s>. / Jaim 10.7.8 /

children.text: śṛtāśṛtopadeśāc ca teṣām utsargavad ayajñaśeṣatvaṃ / Jaim_10,7.9 /
children.translated_text: And because of the instruction regarding cooked and uncooked [portions], their status as non-sacrificial remainder would be like a general rule. / Jaim 10.7.9 /
Because it is a remainder of the offering, <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> (the 'well-offered' oblation) should be offered as in the primary [rite]. / Jaim 10.7.10 /

children.text: tryaṅgair vā śaravad vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.11 /
children.translated_text: Or, the modification would be with three limbs, like the arrow [sacrifice]. / Jaim 10.7.11 /

children.text: adhyūdhnī hotus tryaṅgavad iḍābhakṣavikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.12 /
children.translated_text: The <s>adhyūdhnī</s> (over-udder portion) for the <s>Hotṛ</s> — there would be a modification of the <s>iḍā</s>-eating, like [the rule of] three limbs. / Jaim 10.7.12 /

children.text: śeṣe vā samavaiti tasmād rathavan niyamaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.13 /
children.translated_text: Or, it joins with the remainder; therefore, there would be a restriction like [that of] the chariot. / Jaim 10.7.13 /
But because it is not [based on] scripture, it would not be thus. / Jaim 10.7.14 /

children.text: api vā dānamātraṃ syād bhakṣaśabdānabhisambandhāt / Jaim_10,7.15 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, it would be merely a gift, because of the non-connection with the word 'eating.' / Jaim 10.7.15 /

children.text: dātus tv avidyamānatvād iḍābhakṣavikāraḥ syāc cheṣaṃ pratyaviśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_10,7.16 /
children.translated_text: But because of the non-existence of a giver, there would be a modification of the <s>iḍā</s>-eating; the remainder [would apply], because of the non-distinction [from the primary]. / Jaim 10.7.16 /
And the <s>Agnīdh</s> (fire-kindler) and the <s>vaniṣṭhu</s> [are treated] like the <s>adhyūdhnī</s>. / Jaim 10.7.17 /
The <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> (priest of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>) has no [right to] eating, because it is not in the primary [rite]. / Jaim 10.7.18 /

children.text: syād vā hotradhvaryuvikāratvāt tayo karmābhisambandhāt / Jaim_10,7.19 /
children.translated_text: Or, [he would have a right], because of it being a modification of the <s>Hotṛ</s> and <s>Adhvaryu</s>, due to the connection of those two with the rite. / Jaim 10.7.19 /
There would be a two-fold share, because of the two-fold nature of the rite. / Jaim 10.7.20 /
Or, because of the oneness [of the priest], there would be a single share, because the [additional] share is not grounded in scripture. / Jaim 10.7.21 /
And for the <s>Pratiprasthātṛ</s> (deputy), because of the roasting of the <s>vapā</s> (omentum). / Jaim 10.7.22 /

children.text: abhakṣo vā karmabhedāt tasyāḥ sarvapradānatvāt / Jaim_10,7.23 /
children.translated_text: Or, [he has] no eating, because of the difference of rite, since the entire [vapā] is offered. / Jaim 10.7.23 /

children.text: vikṛtau prākṛtasya vidher grahaṇāt punaḥ śrutir anarthikā syāt / Jaim_10,7.24 /
children.translated_text: In the modified [rite], because of the adoption of the primary injunction, a repeated scriptural statement would be purposeless. / Jaim 10.7.24 /
Or rather, there would be a double mention, like the <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>). / Jaim 10.7.25 /
Or not, because of the distinctness of the words. / Jaim 10.7.26 /

children.text: adhikaṃ vārthavattvāt syād arthavādaguṇābhāve vacanād avikāre teṣu hi tādarthyaṃ syād apūrvatvāt / Jaim_10,7.27 /
children.translated_text: Or, it would be an additional [element], because it has a purpose; in the absence of a subsidiary [element from] an <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage), because of the scriptural statement, there is no modification; for in those [cases] there would be a purposive connection, because of its being something new. / Jaim 10.7.27 /
If [one argues] that there would be a prohibition — / Jaim 10.7.28 /
No, because it is not heard [in scripture]. / Jaim 10.7.29 /
If [one argues] because of non-adoption — / Jaim 10.7.30 /
No, because of equivalence. / Jaim 10.7.31 /
Thus, in the adoption of that, it would be so. / Jaim 10.7.32 /
But it should show novelty, because of the purposefulness of the adoption. / Jaim 10.7.33 /
And from that too, [only] as much as is stated would apply. / Jaim 10.7.34 /
The prohibition of eating the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> would apply, because of the equality of cause. / Jaim 10.7.35 /

children.text: atiṣedho vā darśanād iḍāyāṃ syāt / Jaim_10,7.36 /
children.translated_text: Or, the transgression would apply in the <s>iḍā</s>, because of observation. / Jaim 10.7.36 /
Or, the prohibition [applies], because of the observation that it is preceded by an injunction. / Jaim 10.7.37 /

children.text: śaṃyviḍāntatve vikalpaḥ syāt pareṣu patnyanuyājapratiṣedho 'narthakaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.38 /
children.translated_text: When there is the option between ending with the <s>śaṃyuvāka</s> or the <s>iḍā</s>, the prohibition of the wife's after-offerings (<s>patnyanuyāja</s>) would be purposeless among the subsequent [elements]. / Jaim 10.7.38 /

children.text: nityānuvādo vā karmaṇaḥ syād aśabdatvāt / Jaim_10,7.39 /
children.translated_text: Or, [the prohibition] would be a perpetual restatement of the rite, because of the absence of a [new] word. / Jaim 10.7.39 /

children.text: pratiṣedhārthavattvāc cottarasya parastāt pratiṣedhaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.40 /
children.translated_text: And because the prohibition has a purpose, the prohibition of the subsequent [element] would be after [the preceding one]. / Jaim 10.7.40 /

children.text: prāpter vā pūrvasya vacanād atikramaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.41 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the attainment [of the earlier element], the transgression would be because of the statement of the earlier [element]. / Jaim 10.7.41 /

children.text: pratiṣedhasya tvarāyuktatvāt tasya ca nānyadeśatvam / Jaim_10,7.42 /
children.translated_text: But because the prohibition is appropriate in haste, and because it [the rite] is not in another place. / Jaim 10.7.42 /
In the <s>upasads</s> (preliminary rites), as much as is stated would be non-ritual. / Jaim 10.7.43 /
Or, because of the channel (<s>stroveṇa</s>), and because it is not a subsidiary, there would be prohibition of the remainder. / Jaim 10.7.44 /
Or, non-prohibition, because of the counter-exception of what is [already] prohibited. / Jaim 10.7.45 /

children.text: anijyā vā śeṣasya mukhyadevatān abhījyatvāt / Jaim_10,7.46 /
children.translated_text: Or, non-offering of the remainder, because the principal deity is not to be offered to [again]. / Jaim 10.7.46 /

children.text: avabhṛthe barhiṣaḥ pratiṣedhāc cheṣakarma syāt / Jaim_10,7.47 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath), because of the prohibition of the sacred grass (<s>barhis</s>), [the offering] would be a remainder-rite. / Jaim 10.7.47 /

children.text: ājyabhāgayor vā guṇatvāc cheṣapratiṣedhaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.48 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the subsidiary nature of the <s>ājyabhāgas</s> (clarified-butter shares), there would be prohibition of the remainder. / Jaim 10.7.48 /

children.text: prayājānāṃ tv ekadeśapratiṣedhād vākyaśeṣatvaṃ tasmān nityānuvādaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.49 /
children.translated_text: But because of the partial prohibition of the preliminary offerings (<s>prayājas</s>), [the statement] would be a sentence-complement; therefore, there would be a perpetual restatement. / Jaim 10.7.49 /

children.text: ājyabhāgayor grahaṇaṃ vityānuvādo vā gṛhamedhīyavat syāt / Jaim_10,7.50 /
children.translated_text: The adoption of the <s>ājyabhāgas</s> would be a perpetual restatement, or [it would be] like the <s>Gṛhamedhīya</s> (domestic rite). / Jaim 10.7.50 /

children.text: virodhinām ekaśrutau niyamaḥ syād grahaṇasyārthavattvāc charavac ca śrutito viśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_10,7.51 /
children.translated_text: Among mutually contradictory [rules], when heard in a single [text], there would be a restriction, because of the purposefulness of adoption, and [the rule would be] like the arrow, because of its being more specific by scripture. / Jaim 10.7.51 /
If [one objects] that this is not so, because of the occurrence in both contexts — / Jaim 10.7.52 /
If [one argues] that this is so in the arrows as well — / Jaim 10.7.53 /

children.text: virodhyagrahaṇāt tathā śareṣv iti cet / Jaim_10,7.54 /
children.translated_text: If [one argues] that it is the same in the arrows, because of the non-adoption of the contradictory — / Jaim 10.7.54 /
So also in the other [case]. / Jaim 10.7.55 /
If [one argues] that the scripture would be purposeless — / Jaim 10.7.56 /
Because of the purposefulness of adoption, the adoption would apply where [the rule] has not taken effect. / Jaim 10.7.57 /

children.text: sarvāsāṃ ca guṇānām arthavattvād grahaṇam apravṛtte syāt / Jaim_10,7.58 /
children.translated_text: And because of the purposefulness of all subsidiary [elements], the adoption would apply where [the rule] has not taken effect. / Jaim 10.7.58 /
If [one argues] that there would be an additional [element] — / Jaim 10.7.59 /
No, because of the absence of purpose. / Jaim 10.7.60 /

children.text: tathaikārthavikāre prākṛtasyāpravṛttiḥ pravṛttau hi vikalpaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.61 /
children.translated_text: Similarly, in a modification serving the same purpose, the primary [rule] would not take effect; for if it did take effect, there would be an option. / Jaim 10.7.61 /
If [one argues] 'to the extent of the scriptural text' — / Jaim 10.7.62 /
No, in the primary [rite], because of the absence of a [specific] word. / Jaim 10.7.63 /

children.text: vikṛtau tv aniyamaḥ syāt praṣadājyavad grahaṇasya guṇārthatvād ubhayoś ca pradiṣṭatvād guṇaśāstraṃ yadeti syāt / Jaim_10,7.64 /
children.translated_text: But in the modified [rite], there would be no restriction, like the <s>pṛṣadājya</s> (curd-mixed ghee), because the adoption serves a subsidiary purpose, and because both are indicated; the rule regarding subsidiaries would apply where it says 'which.' / Jaim 10.7.64 /

children.text: aikārthyād vā niyamyeta śrutito viśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_10,7.65 /
children.translated_text: Or, [the element] would be restricted because of the unity of purpose, because of being more specific by scripture. / Jaim 10.7.65 /
And because of contradiction, like [practice in] the world. / Jaim 10.7.66 /
And because it is subsidiary to the rite. / Jaim 10.7.67 /

children.text: virodhināñ ca tacchrutāv aśabdatvād vikalpaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,7.68 /
children.translated_text: And among contradictory [rules], when that [subsidiary] is heard in scripture, there would be an option because of the absence of [a determining] word. / Jaim 10.7.68 /
In [the case of] <s>pṛṣadājya</s> (curd-mixed ghee), the adoption serves a subsidiary purpose because of the accumulation. / Jaim 10.7.69 /

children.text: yady api caturavattīti tu niyame nopapadyate / Jaim_10,7.70 /
children.translated_text: Even though 'with four <s>avattis</s> (pourings)' — in the case of a restriction, this does not hold. / Jaim 10.7.70 /
Or, in another rite, because it follows the same principle, due to the difference of rite. / Jaim 10.7.71 /
If [one argues] 'according to the scriptural text' — / Jaim 10.7.72 /
No, because of the oneness of the injunction. / Jaim 10.7.73 /

children.text: pratiṣedhaḥ pradeśe 'nārabhyavidhāne ca prāptapratiṣiddhatvād vikalpaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,8.1 /
children.translated_text: A prohibition in a particular context, and in a rule not beginning [a new topic] — because of what is attained being [then] prohibited, there would be an option. / Jaim 10.8.1 /
If [one argues] that it is like what is obtained by implication — / Jaim 10.8.2 /
No, because both are characterized by words, since the cause is the same. / Jaim 10.8.3 /

children.text: api tu vākyaśeṣaḥ syād anyāyyatvād vikalpasya vidhīnām ekadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,8.4 /
children.translated_text: But rather, it would be a sentence-complement, because an option is unreasonable; it would be a part of the injunctions. / Jaim 10.8.4 /
And in the case of something new, it would be an <s>arthavāda</s> (explanatory passage). / Jaim 10.8.5 /
But having taught [the positive rule], the prohibition would [apply]. / Jaim 10.8.6 /

children.text: na ced anyaṃ prakalpayet prakḷptāv arthavādaḥ syād ānarthakyāt parasāmarthyāc ca / Jaim_10,8.7 /
children.translated_text: If one does not establish another [meaning], when [the rule] is already established, it would be an <s>arthavāda</s>, because of purposelessness and because of the force of the other [interpretation]. / Jaim 10.8.7 /
And because of the simultaneity with the earlier [rules]. / Jaim 10.8.8 /
And a censure is likewise. / Jaim 10.8.9 /
If [one argues] that because of the prohibition, it is non-ritual — / Jaim 10.8.10 /
No, because a [positive] word precedes it. / Jaim 10.8.11 /

The prohibition of giving, oblation, and cooking for the consecrated (<s>dīkṣita</s>) — because of non-specification — would be a prohibition of all giving, all oblation, and all cooking. / Jaim 10.8.12 /

children.text: akratuyuktānāṃ vā dharmaḥ syāt kratoḥ pratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_10,8.13 /
children.translated_text: Or, [the prohibition] pertains to those not connected with the sacrifice, because the sacrifice is taught by direct perception. / Jaim 10.8.13 /
Or, even of that [sacrificial giving etc.], it would be inferential, because of non-specification. / Jaim 10.8.14 /

children.text: api tu vākyaśeṣatvād itaraparyudāsaḥ syāt pratiṣedhe vikalpaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,8.15 /
children.translated_text: But rather, because it is a sentence-complement, there would be exclusion of the other; in [the case of] a prohibition, there would be an option. / Jaim 10.8.15 /

children.text: aviśeṣeṇa yac chāstram anyāyyatvād vikalpasya tat sandigdham ārād viśeṣaśiṣṭaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,8.16 /
children.translated_text: A rule that is unspecified — because an option is unreasonable — that is doubtful; when specified from a distance, it would apply. / Jaim 10.8.16 /

children.text: aprakaraṇe tu yac chāstraṃ viśeṣe śruyamāṇam avikṛtam ājyabhāgavat prākṛtapratiṣedhārtham / Jaim_10,8.17 /
children.translated_text: But a rule that is heard as specifying, outside its [immediate] context, unmodified — like the <s>ājyabhāgas</s> — is for the purpose of prohibiting [something] in the primary [rite]. / Jaim 10.8.17 /
But in the modified [rite], it would serve that purpose. / Jaim 10.8.18 /

children.text: vākyaśeṣo vā kratunā grahaṇāt syād anārabhyavidhānasya / Jaim_10,8.19 /
children.translated_text: Or, it would be a sentence-complement, because of the adoption by the rite — this would be [the case] of a rule not beginning [a new topic]. / Jaim 10.8.19 /
In the <s>mantras</s> (sacred formulas), there would be no sentence-complement status, because of the instruction regarding subsidiaries. / Jaim 10.8.20 /
And because of observation [of this] in cases not [specifically] taught. / Jaim 10.8.21 /
And because of the prohibition. / Jaim 10.8.22 /

children.text: agnyatigrāhyasya vikṛtāv upadeśād apravṛttiḥ syāt / Jaim_10,8.23 /
children.translated_text: That which is not to be grasped by fire — in the modified [rite], because of the instruction, there would be non-application. / Jaim 10.8.23 /
And the monthly grasping is likewise. / Jaim 10.8.24 /
Or, [there would be] grasping, because of equivalence. / Jaim 10.8.25 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim 10.8.26 /
The grasping would follow the same procedure. / Jaim 10.8.27 /
The monthly grasping is for the purpose of prohibiting repetition. / Jaim 10.8.28 /

children.text: utpattitādarthyāc caturavattama pradhānasya homasaṃyogād adhikam ājyam atulyatvāl lokavad utpatter guṇabhūtatvāt / Jaim_10,8.29 /
children.translated_text: Because of the purposive connection at origination, the four <s>avattis</s> — because of the conjunction of the principal with the oblation — the clarified butter is additional, because of non-equivalence; like [practice in] the world, at origination, because it is subsidiary. / Jaim 10.8.29 /
And because of the scriptural statement regarding its preparation. / Jaim 10.8.30 /

children.text: tābhyāṃ vā saha sviṣṭakṛtaḥ sakṛttve dvipabhighāraṇena tadāptivacanāt / Jaim_10,8.31 /
children.translated_text: Or, together with those two, of the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> — when performed once — by the double sprinkling [of ghee], because of the statement of its attainment. / Jaim 10.8.31 /
And having stated [it] as equivalent, in all [cases], because of the sequence of portions. / Jaim 10.8.32 /
[It] would be restricted, like the <s>Sāptadaśya</s> (seventeen-fold rite). / Jaim 10.8.33 /

children.text: haviṣo vā guṇabhūtatvāt tathābhūtavivakṣā syāt / Jaim_10,8.34 /
children.translated_text: Or, because the oblatory material is subsidiary, the expression would be understood as being of that nature. / Jaim 10.8.34 /

children.text: puroḍāśābhyām itya dhikṛtānāṃ puroḍāśayor upadeśas tacchrutitvād vaiśyastomavat / Jaim_10,8.35 /
children.translated_text: For those governed by the [instruction] 'with the two rice-cakes' — the instruction pertains to the two rice-cakes, because it has that [specific] scriptural wording — like the <s>Vaiśyastoma</s> (sacrifice for <s>Vaiśyas</s>). / Jaim 10.8.35 /

children.text: na tv anityādhikāro 'sti vidhau nityena sambandhas tasmād avākyaśeṣatvam / Jaim_10,8.36 /
children.translated_text: But there is no non-permanent governing qualification; in an injunction, the connection is with the permanent; therefore, there would be no sentence-complement status. / Jaim 10.8.36 /

children.text: sati ca naikadeśena kartuḥ pradhānabhūtatvāt / Jaim_10,8.37 /
children.translated_text: And when [the governing qualification] obtains, not by a single part [of the rite], because of the primacy of the performer. / Jaim 10.8.37 /
But because of entirety, so too in the <s>Stoma</s> (chanting-form). / Jaim 10.8.38 /
If [one argues] it pertains to the performer — / Jaim 10.8.39 /

children.text: na guṇārthatvāt prāpte na copadeśārthaḥ / Jaim_10,8.40 /
children.translated_text: No, because it serves a subsidiary purpose; when [the rule] is already obtained, the instruction has no purpose. / Jaim 10.8.40 /

children.text: karmaṇos tu prakaraṇe tannyāyatvād guṇānāṃ liṅgena kālaśāstraṃ syāt / Jaim_10,8.41 /
children.translated_text: But regarding the two rites in their context, because they follow the same principle, for the subsidiaries, the time-rule would be [determined] by indicatory mark. / Jaim 10.8.41 /

children.text: yadi tu sānnāyyaṃ somayājino na tābhyāṃ samavāyo 'sti vibhaktakālatvāt / Jaim_10,8.42 /
children.translated_text: If, however, the <s>Sānnāyya</s> (cooked-milk offering) belongs to the <s>Soma</s>-sacrificer, there is no conjunction of those two [rites], because of the distinctness of their times. / Jaim 10.8.42 /

children.text: api vā vihitatvād guṇārthāyāṃ punaḥ śrutau sandehe śrutir dvidevatārthā syād yathānabhipretas tathāgneyo darśanād ekadevate / Jaim_10,8.43 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because it is enjoined, when there is doubt in a repeated scriptural statement serving a subsidiary purpose, the scripture would serve the purpose of a two-deity [offering]; like the <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>), as it is unintended, because of the observation of a single-deity [offering]. / Jaim 10.8.43 /
<s>Bādarāyaṇa</s> [considers it] an injunction. / Jaim 10.8.44 /
Or, because of the cognition of what is prohibited. / Jaim 10.8.45 /
And thus, the observation serves another purpose. / Jaim 10.8.46 /

children.text: upāṃśuyājam antarā yajatīti havirliṅgāśrutitvād yathākāmī pratīyeta / Jaim_10,8.47 /
children.translated_text: The <s>upāṃśuyāja</s> (low-voiced sacrifice) in between — 'he sacrifices' — because the oblatory-material indicatory mark is not heard, one may proceed as one wishes. / Jaim 10.8.47 /
Or it may be due to the permanent (offering), because of its connection with all (rites). / Jaim_10,8.48 /
And similarly it should be with regard to the deity. / Jaim_10,8.49 /
Of the <s>tāndrī</s> (drowsiness-related offerings), because of the context. / Jaim_10,8.50 /
Or <s>Prajāpati</s> would be (the deity) on account of the <s>dharma</s> (nature of the rite). / Jaim_10,8.51 /

children.text: devatāyās tv anirvacanaṃ tatra śabdasyeha mṛdutvaṃ tasmād ihādhikāreṇa / Jaim_10,8.52 /
children.translated_text: But as for the deity, there is no explicit statement; since the word is soft (ambiguous) here, therefore (it is determined) by the governing rule here. / Jaim_10,8.52 /

children.text: viṣṇur vā syād dhautrāmnānād amāvāsyāhaviś ca syād dhautrasya tatra darśanāt / Jaim_10,8.53 /
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s> may be (the deity), because of the mention of the <s>hautra</s> (Hotṛ's recitation); and it would be an <s>amāvāsyā</s> (new-moon) oblation, since the <s>hautra</s> is seen there. / Jaim_10,8.53 /

children.text: api vā paurṇamāsyāṃ syāt pradhānaśabdasaṃyogād guṇatvān mantro yathā pradhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_10,8.54 /
children.translated_text: Or rather it should belong to the full-moon day, because of its connection with the word denoting the principal; since it is a subordinate, the <s>mantra</s> should follow the principal, as it were. / Jaim_10,8.54 /

children.text: ānantaryañ ca sānnāyyasya puroḍāśena darśayaty amāvāsyāvikāre / Jaim_10,8.55 /
children.translated_text: And the immediate succession of the <s>sānnāyya</s> (mixed milk oblation) with the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice-cake) shows (this) in the modified new-moon rite. / Jaim_10,8.55 /

children.text: agnīṣomavidhānāt tu paurṇamāsyām ubhayatra vidhīyate / Jaim_10,8.56 /
children.translated_text: But because of the prescription relating to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, it is ordained at the full-moon in both (rites). / Jaim_10,8.56 /

children.text: pratiṣiddhyavidhānād vā viṣṇuḥ samānadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_10,8.57 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the absence of a prohibitory prescription, <s>Viṣṇu</s> would be (the deity) in the same place. / Jaim_10,8.57 /
And thus it is seen from other (authoritative) instances. / Jaim_10,8.58 /

children.text: na cānaṅga sakṛc chrutāv ubhayatra vidhīyotāsambandhāt / Jaim_10,8.59 /
children.translated_text: And what is not a subsidiary, when heard once, is not ordained for both (rites), because of the absence of connection. / Jaim_10,8.59 /

children.text: guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt pravṛttau vidhiliṅgāni darśayati / Jaim_10,8.60 /
children.translated_text: And since subsidiaries exist for the sake of another, the injunctive marks indicate (their) operation. / Jaim_10,8.60 /
And in the modified rite, because there is no (separate) scriptural statement. / Jaim_10,8.61 /
In the two-<s>puroḍāśa</s> (offering) it should be (so), because it serves an intermediate purpose. / Jaim_10,8.62 /
And because it serves the purpose of avoiding confusion. / Jaim_10,8.63 /

children.text: tadartham iti cen na tatpradhānatvāt / Jaim_10,8.64 /
children.translated_text: If (one says) it is for that purpose — no, because (the offering) is principally for that (deity). / Jaim_10,8.64 /
And because of the connection with what is not taught (elsewhere). / Jaim_10,8.65 /

children.text: utpattes tu niveśaḥ syād guṇasyānuparodhenārthasya vidyamānatvād vidhānād antarārthasya naimittikatvāt tadabhāve 'śrutau syāt / Jaim_10,8.66 /
children.translated_text: But the placement should be from origination, without obstructing the subsidiary, because the purpose exists, because of the prescription, because the intermediate purpose is occasioned (by it); in its absence, when there is no scriptural statement, it would be (so). / Jaim_10,8.66 /
But because both are prescribed. / Jaim_10,8.67 /

children.text: guṇānāñ ca parārthatvād upaveṣavad yadeti syāt / Jaim_10,8.68 /
children.translated_text: And since subsidiaries exist for the sake of another, it should be like placement — that which (is prescribed) should follow. / Jaim_10,8.68 /

children.text: anapāyaś ca kālasya lakṣaṇaṃ hi puroḍāśau / Jaim_10,8.69 /
children.translated_text: And there is no deviation from the time, for the two <s>puroḍāśas</s> (rice-cakes) are the defining mark. / Jaim_10,8.69 /
The non-confusion is for the purpose of praise. / Jaim_10,8.70 /

children.text: prayojanābhisambandhāt pṛthak satāṃ tataḥ syād aikakarmyam ekaśabdābhisaṃyogāt / Jaim_11,1.1 /
children.translated_text: Because of the connection with purpose, since they exist separately, there should be unified performance (<s>aikakarmya</s>), because of the connection with a single word. / Jaim_11,1.1 /

children.text: śeṣavad vā prayojanaṃ pratijanaṃ pratikarma vibhajyeta / Jaim_11,1.2 /
children.translated_text: Or, like a subordinate, the purpose should be distributed individually for each rite. / Jaim_11,1.2 /
But this should not be so, because there is no (separate) prescription. / Jaim_11,1.3 /

children.text: śeṣasya hi parārthatvād vidhānāt pratipradhānabhāvaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,1.4 /
children.translated_text: For since the subordinate exists for the sake of another, from the prescription there would be a relation to each principal. / Jaim_11,1.4 /

children.text: aṅgānāṃ tu śabdabhedāt kratuvat syāt phalānayatvam / Jaim_11,1.5 /
children.translated_text: But for the subsidiaries, because of the difference of words, like a sacrifice, there would be non-identity of result. / Jaim_11,1.5 /
But the difference of meaning there — here, because of unity of purpose, there is unified performance (<s>aikakarmya</s>). / Jaim_11,1.6 /
If (one objects) that this is not so because of difference of words — / Jaim_11,1.7 /

children.text: karmārthatvāt prayoge tācchabdyaṃ syāt tadarthatvāt / Jaim_11,1.8 /
children.translated_text: Because it is for the purpose of the rite, in performance the designation would follow, since it serves that purpose. / Jaim_11,1.8 /
Because the injunction regarding the performer has different purposes with respect to subsidiaries and principals. / Jaim_11,1.9 /
Because the undertaking is preceded by the (scriptural) word. / Jaim_11,1.10 /

children.text: ekenāpi samāpyeta kṛtārthatvād yathā kratvantareṣu prāpteṣu cottarāvat syāt / Jaim_11,1.11 /
children.translated_text: It could be accomplished by even one (performer), since the purpose is fulfilled; just as when other sacrifices are obtained, it would be like what follows. / Jaim_11,1.11 /
If (one objects) that this is not so because of the absence of result — / Jaim_11,1.12 /
No, because of the connection with the rite, the defect of the purposive word would (not) arise. / Jaim_11,1.13 /
If (one argues) because of the unity of designation — / Jaim_11,1.14 /
No, because of the separateness of meaning; because of equality, there is no subordination. / Jaim_11,1.15 /

children.text: vidhes tv ekaśrutitvād aparyāyavidhānān nityavac chrutabhūtābhisaṃyogād arthena yugapatprāpter yathāprāptaṃ svaśabdo nivītavat sarvaprayoge pravṛttiḥ syāt / Jaim_11,1.16 /
children.translated_text: But because the injunction is heard as one, because of the prescription which is not an alternative, like what is permanent, because of the connection with what is heard as existing, because of the simultaneous attainment through purpose, according to what is obtained, the own word (operates) like the <s>nivīta</s> (sacred thread worn in a particular way) — there would be operation in all performances. / Jaim_11,1.16 /
Similarly, because it is an instruction regarding the rite. / Jaim_11,1.17 /
In other sacrifices there is repetition (of the statement). / Jaim_11,1.18 /

children.text: uttarāsvaśrutitvād viśeṣāṇāṃ kṛtārthatvāt saṃdohe yathākāmī pratīyeta / Jaim_11,1.19 /
children.translated_text: Because in the subsequent (rites) there is no (separate) scriptural statement, since the specific (rules) have fulfilled their purpose, in a collective performance one may choose as one wishes. / Jaim_11,1.19 /

children.text: karmaṇy ārambhabhāvyatvāt kṛṣivat pratyārambhaṃ phalāni syuḥ / Jaim_11,1.20 /
children.translated_text: Since the rite must be undertaken (each time), like agriculture, the results should be for each undertaking. / Jaim_11,1.20 /

children.text: adhikāraś ca sarveṣāṃ kāryatvād upapadyate viśeṣaḥ / Jaim_11,1.21 /
children.translated_text: And the eligibility of all is established because of the obligatory nature; the distinction is appropriate. / Jaim_11,1.21 /

children.text: sakṛt tu syāt kṛtārthatvād aṅgavat / Jaim_11,1.22 /
children.translated_text: But it should be (performed) once, since the purpose is fulfilled, like a subsidiary. / Jaim_11,1.22 /
And such is the meaning of the word in the world. / Jaim_11,1.23 /

children.text: api vā saṃprayoge yathākāmī pratīyetāśrutitvād vidhiṣu vacanāni syuḥ / Jaim_11,1.24 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, in combined performance, one may choose as one wishes; because there is no (separate) scriptural statement, the verbal expressions would be in the injunctions. / Jaim_11,1.24 /
Similarly in the subsidiaries, because of the unity of designation. / Jaim_11,1.25 /
In the world, (the meaning) is characterized by the purpose of action. / Jaim_11,1.26 /

children.text: kriyāṇām arthaśeṣatvāt pratyakṣatas tannirvṛttyāpavargaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,1.27 /
children.translated_text: Since actions are subordinate to purpose, completion would come from the direct accomplishment thereof. / Jaim_11,1.27 /

children.text: dharmamātre tv adarśanāc chabdārthenāpavargaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,1.28 /
children.translated_text: But in the case of <s>dharma</s> alone, because it is not perceived, completion would come through the meaning of the (scriptural) word. / Jaim_11,1.28 /
And like a sacrifice, by inference, in repetition there would be an abundance of results. / Jaim_11,1.29 /
Or (it should be performed) once, because of the oneness of the cause. / Jaim_11,1.30 /
And the quantity would be without restriction. / Jaim_11,1.31 /
Because the result is accomplished at the undertaking, in sacrifices there would be difference of result. / Jaim_11,1.32 /

children.text: arthavāṃs tu naikatvād abhyāsaḥ syād anarthako yathā bhojanam ekasminn arthasyāparimāṇatvāt pradhāne ca kriyārthatvād aniyamaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,1.33 /
children.translated_text: But that which has meaning — since there is no oneness, repetition would be purposeless, like eating for one person; because the purpose is without limit, and since in the principal (rite) the action serves a purpose, there would be no restriction. / Jaim_11,1.33 /
Because of separateness, from the injunction, there would be a fixed quantity. / Jaim_11,1.34 /

children.text: anabhyāso vā prayogavacanaikatvāt sarvasya yugapacchāstrād aphalatvāc ca karmaṇaḥ syāt kriyārthatvāt / Jaim_11,1.35 /
children.translated_text: Or there should be no repetition, because of the oneness of the performance-statement, because the scripture (applies) to all simultaneously, and because the action has no (separate) result; this would be so because of the purposefulness of action. / Jaim_11,1.35 /

children.text: abhyāso vā chedanasaṃmārgāvadāneṣu vacanāt sakṛttvasya / Jaim_11,1.36 /
children.translated_text: Or there should be repetition, because of the statement of once-ness in the cases of cutting, sweeping, and ladling out. / Jaim_11,1.36 /
But non-repetition, because it (the once-ness) must be stated (to override the default). / Jaim_11,1.37 /
Because of the attainment of all through the plural form, there would be an option. / Jaim_11,1.38 /
If (one says) that performance is observed (to require repetition) — / Jaim_11,1.39 /
If (one argues) by portion — / Jaim_11,1.40 /
Similarly in the other (case). / Jaim_11,1.41 /

children.text: prathamaṃ vā niyamyeta kāraṇād atikramaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,1.42 /
children.translated_text: Or the first should be fixed; because of the cause, there would be transgression (of the order). / Jaim_11,1.42 /
Because there is no distinction in the meaning of the scripture. / Jaim_11,1.43 /
And thus it is seen from other (authoritative) instances. / Jaim_11,1.44 /
And with the archetype (<s>prakṛti</s>), as before, because of their proximity. / Jaim_11,1.45 /
In the subsequent (rites), each according to its own (prescription), because of novelty. / Jaim_11,1.46 /
Or each according to its own (rule) would be a restatement, by prescription of another. / Jaim_11,1.47 /
Because of the prescription of completeness. / Jaim_11,1.48 /
And because of serving many purposes. / Jaim_11,1.49 /
And in the <s>Agnihotra</s>, the restriction regarding <s>yavāgū</s> (barley gruel) is not like a subordinate; it is a prohibition for the young (uninitiated). / Jaim_11,1.50 /
Even what is applicable to all is connected with the indicatory mark, because of the connection with the deity. / Jaim_11,1.51 /

children.text: pradhānakarmārthatvād aṅgānāṃ tadbhedāt karmabhedaḥ prayoge syāt / Jaim_11,1.52 /
children.translated_text: Since the subsidiaries serve the purpose of the principal rite, from the difference thereof, there would be difference of rites in performance. / Jaim_11,1.52 /
And there would be disruption of the sequence due to simultaneity. / Jaim_11,1.53 /

children.text: tulyānāṃ tu yaugapadyam ekaśabdopadeśāt syād viśeṣāgrahaṇāt / Jaim_11,1.54 /
children.translated_text: But for those that are equal, there should be simultaneity, because of the instruction with a single designation, because no distinction is apprehended. / Jaim_11,1.54 /
Because of unity of purpose, there should be no interruption. / Jaim_11,1.55 /
And thus it is seen from other instances — (so says) <s>Kāmukāyana</s>. / Jaim_11,1.56 /

children.text: tannyāyatvād aśakter ānupūrvyaṃ syāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt / Jaim_11,1.57 /
children.translated_text: Since it follows the same principle, because of incapacity, the sequence should be (determined) for the <s>saṃskāra</s> (preparatory rite), since it serves that purpose. / Jaim_11,1.57 /
Even what is not combined (with the principal), because of serving that purpose. / Jaim_11,1.58 /
Or because of capacity, like a lamp. / Jaim_11,1.59 /

children.text: arthāt tu loke vidhitaḥ pratipradhānaṃ syāt / Jaim_11,1.60 /
children.translated_text: But from the purpose, in the world, from the injunction, there would be (a relation) to each principal. / Jaim_11,1.60 /
<s>Kāmukāyana</s> (says) there should be a single offering, because of conflict with the fixed quantity. / Jaim_11,1.61 /

children.text: vidhes tv itarārthatvāt sakṛd ijyāśrutivyatikramaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,1.62 /
children.translated_text: But because the injunction serves another purpose, there would be a deviation from the statement of single offering. / Jaim_11,1.62 /
<s>Bādarāyaṇa</s> (holds that) when there is no division of context, (it follows) the injunction in performance. / Jaim_11,1.63 /

children.text: api caikena sannidhānam aviśeṣako hetuḥ / Jaim_11,1.64 /
children.translated_text: Moreover, proximity with one is a non-distinguishing reason. / Jaim_11,1.64 /
If (one objects) that this is not so because of the prescription in some (cases) — / Jaim_11,1.65 /
No, because the injunction is impelled (by scripture). / Jaim_11,1.66 /
It has been explained: simultaneity for those that are equal, when no distinction is apprehended among them. / Jaim_11,1.67 /

children.text: bhedas tu kālabhedāc codanāvyavāyāt syād viśiṣṭānāṃ vidhiḥ pradhānakālatvāt / Jaim_11,1.68 /
children.translated_text: But differentiation, because of difference in time, because of interruption by injunctions, would be (the rule) for those that are distinguished; the injunction (applies) because of the time of the principal. / Jaim_11,1.68 /
And thus it is seen from other (authoritative) instances. / Jaim_11,1.69 /

children.text: vidhir iti cen na vartamānāpadeśāt / Jaim_11,1.70 /
children.translated_text: If (one says) it is an injunction — no, because it indicates what is present. / Jaim_11,1.70 /
The principal (rites having) oneness of place, time, and performer, because of instruction with a single designation. / Jaim_11,2.1 /

children.text: avidhiś cet karmaṇām abhisambandhaḥ pratīyeta tallakṣaṇārthābhisaṃyogād vidhitvāc cetareṣāṃ pratipradhānabhāvaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,2.2 /
children.translated_text: If there is no injunction, the connection of the rites would be understood from the connection with the defining mark of that; and because the others are injunctions, there would be a relation to each principal. / Jaim_11,2.2 /

children.text: aṅgeṣu ca tadabhāvaḥ pradhānaṃ pratinirdeśāt / Jaim_11,2.3 /
children.translated_text: And in the subsidiaries, the absence of that (independent status), because the instruction is relative to the principal. / Jaim_11,2.3 /

children.text: yadi tu karmaṇo vidhisambandhaḥ syād aikaśabdyāt pradhānārthābhidhāsaṃyogāt / Jaim_11,2.4 /
children.translated_text: But if there is an injunctive connection with the rite, it would be because of the unity of designation, because of the connection with the statement of the principal purpose. / Jaim_11,2.4 /
And thus it is seen from other instances. / Jaim_11,2.5 /

children.text: śrutiś caiṣāṃ pradhānavat karmaśruteḥ parārthatvāt / Jaim_11,2.6 /
children.translated_text: And the scriptural statement of these is like that of the principal, because the statement of the rite serves another's purpose. / Jaim_11,2.6 /
And because there is no (separate) scriptural statement of the rite. / Jaim_11,2.7 /

children.text: aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt pradhānenopadiśyeraṃs tasmāt syād ekadeśatvam / Jaim_11,2.8 /
children.translated_text: But the subsidiaries, because they are prescriptions, should be taught along with the principal; therefore there would be oneness of place. / Jaim_11,2.8 /
If (one says) that the material offering and the deity are similarly (determined) — / Jaim_11,2.9 /
No, because it is a remainder of the injunctive prescription, the distinction is for the purpose of restriction. / Jaim_11,2.10 /

children.text: teṣu samavetānāṃ samavāyāt tantram aṅgāni bhedas tu tadbhedāt karmabhedaḥ prayoge syāt teṣāṃ pradhānaśabdatvāt tathā cānyārthadarśanam / Jaim_11,2.11 /
children.translated_text: Among those (rites), because of the co-inherence of what is combined, <s>tantra</s> (unified performance) applies to the subsidiaries; but differentiation, because of their difference, means difference of rites in performance — because of their connection with the principal word; and thus it is seen from other instances. / Jaim_11,2.11 /

children.text: iṣṭirājasūyacāturmāsyeṣv aikakarmyād aṅgānāṃ tantrabhāvaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,2.12 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering), <s>Rājasūya</s>, and <s>Cāturmāsya</s> (seasonal) rites, because of unified performance, the subsidiaries should have the status of <s>tantra</s> (unified performance). / Jaim_11,2.12 /
If (one objects) that this is not so because of difference in time — / Jaim_11,2.13 /
No, because of the oneness of place, like the animal (sacrifice). / Jaim_11,2.14 /

children.text: api vā karmapṛthaktvāt teṣāṃ tantravidhānāt sāṅgānām upadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,2.15 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the separateness of the rites, since <s>tantra</s> (unified performance) is prescribed for them, the instruction would be along with (their) subsidiaries. / Jaim_11,2.15 /
And thus it is seen from other (authoritative) instances. / Jaim_11,2.16 /
Similarly it should be in their sub-parts. / Jaim_11,2.17 /

children.text: paśau tu codanaikatvāt tantrasya viprakarṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,2.18 /
children.translated_text: But in the animal (sacrifice), because of the oneness of the injunction, the <s>tantra</s> (unified performance) would extend further. / Jaim_11,2.18 /
Similarly it should be in the <s>adhvara</s>-type <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering), because of the oneness of time for the specific (rites). / Jaim_11,2.19 /
And the word <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) is heard as (denoting) one (rite). / Jaim_11,2.20 /

children.text: api vā karmapṛthakatvāt teṣāṃ ca tantravidhānāt sāṅgānām upadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,2.21 /
children.translated_text: Or rather, because of the separateness of the rites, and because <s>tantra</s> (unified performance) is prescribed for them, the instruction would be along with (their) subsidiaries. / Jaim_11,2.21 /
Or the time-statement applies to the first (rite). / Jaim_11,2.22 /
Because of the oneness of result, the word <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) is as in other (cases). / Jaim_11,2.23 /

children.text: vasāhomas tantram ekadevateṣu syāt pradānasyaikakālatvāt / Jaim_11,2.24 /
children.translated_text: The <s>vasāhoma</s> (fat oblation) should be a <s>tantra</s> (unified performance) in (rites) having the same deity, because of the oneness of time for the principal offering. / Jaim_11,2.24 /
But because of difference in time, there is repetition when there is a difference of deity. / Jaim_11,2.25 /
The <s>yūpāhuti</s> (sacrificial-post oblation) at the end is similarly (treated). / Jaim_11,2.26 /
Or it is a prohibition of the other. / Jaim_11,2.27 /
And because the places have no scriptural (authority). / Jaim_11,2.28 /

children.text: avabhṛthe pradhāne 'gnivikāraḥ syān na hi taddhetur agnisaṃyogaḥ / Jaim_11,2.29 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath), which is the principal, there would be a modification relating to fire; for the connection with fire is not the cause thereof. / Jaim_11,2.29 /
Or (it should be performed) along with its subsidiaries, because of the oneness of the performance-statement. / Jaim_11,2.30 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim_11,2.31 /
And because of the division of words, there is no removal of the deity. / Jaim_11,2.32 /

children.text: dakṣiṇe 'gnau varuṇapradhāseṣu deśabhedāt sarvaṃ kriyate / Jaim_11,2.33 /
children.translated_text: On the southern fire, in the rites where <s>Varuṇa</s> is the principal (deity), everything is performed because of the difference of place. / Jaim_11,2.33 /
If (one objects that) there is no injunction — / Jaim_11,2.34 /
It would be like the full-moon (rite). / Jaim_11,2.35 /
If (one objects regarding) the injunction of performance — / Jaim_11,2.36 /
Here too the performance of the <s>Mārutī</s> (offerings to the <s>Maruts</s>) is enjoined. / Jaim_11,2.37 /
If (one argues about) the placement — / Jaim_11,2.38 /
No, because of the unity of sentence with what follows. / Jaim_11,2.39 /
Because it cannot be stated (otherwise). / Jaim_11,2.40 /
The statement of the sacred tradition is similarly (authoritative). / Jaim_11,2.41 /
If (one argues) that there is difference of performer similarly — / Jaim_11,2.42 /
No, because of co-inherence. / Jaim_11,2.43 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim_11,2.44 /
If (one argues) because of the connection with the altar — / Jaim_11,2.45 /
No, because it is merely a place. / Jaim_11,2.46 /
Because of the unity of sentence. / Jaim 11.2.47 /
Because of the oneness of fire, in the remaining [rites] there should be <s>tantra</s> (unified performance). / Jaim 11.2.48 /
Or [there should be] separate [performance], because of difference of performers. / Jaim 11.2.49 /

children.text: paryagnikṛtānām utsarge prājāpatyānāṃ karmotsargaḥ śrutisāmānayād āraṇyavat tasmād brahmasāmni codanāpṛthaktavaṃ syāt / Jaim_11,2.50 /
children.translated_text: In the rites of circumambulating with fire, when the [ritual elements] belonging to <s>Prajāpati</s> are released, the action is released — because of the similarity of <s>śruti</s> (scriptural text), as in the forest [rites]; therefore, in the <s>Brahmasāman</s>, there should be no separation of injunction. / Jaim 11.2.50 /
Or [there is] a prohibition of consecration (<s>saṃskāra</s>), because of unity of sentence, because of the commonality of the rite. / Jaim 11.2.51 /
When there is unity of sentence, because of the commonality of the rite. / Jaim 11.2.52 /
And in the case of the <s>vapā</s> (omental) offerings, because of the observation of non-anointing. / Jaim 11.2.53 /
If [one says] that the five-yearly [rites] are likewise — / Jaim 11.2.54 /
No, because of the unity of sentence with the injunction. / Jaim 11.2.55 /
And because of [the oblations being] spent (<s>yātayāma</s>). / Jaim 11.2.56 /
And because of the observation that consecrations (<s>saṃskāra</s>) [are performed thus]. / Jaim 11.2.57 /

children.text: daśapeye krayapratikarṣāt pratikarṣas tataḥ prācāṃ tatsamānaṃ tantraṃ syāt / Jaim_11,2.58 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Daśapeya</s> [rite], because of the withdrawal of the purchase, there is withdrawal; therefore, for the eastern [rites], the same <s>tantra</s> (unified performance) should apply. / Jaim 11.2.58 /
The statement of similarity is likewise. / Jaim 11.2.59 /
Or [there is] a drawing forth, because of being the reason for the purpose. / Jaim 11.2.60 /
And in the first [day], because of the observation of the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath). / Jaim 11.2.61 /
[It is] the same, because of the commonality of time. / Jaim 11.2.62 /

children.text: niṣkāsasyāvabhṛthe tadekadeśatvāt paśuvat pradānaviprakarṣaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,2.63 /
children.translated_text: The <s>niṣkāsa</s> (dismissal offering), being a part of the <s>avabhṛtha</s>, like [the case of] the animal [sacrifice] — the gift should be deferred. / Jaim 11.2.63 /
Or [there is] removal, because of connection with what is well-established. / Jaim 11.2.64 /
If [one says it is] an acquisition — no, because of the connection with the ritual action. / Jaim 11.2.65 /
And in the <s>Udayanīya</s> [rite], likewise. / Jaim 11.2.66 /
Or [there would be] acquisition, because of the non-connection with [a specific] action. / Jaim 11.2.67 /

children.text: arthakarma vā śeṣatvāc chrayaṇavat tadarthena vidhānāt / Jaim_11,2.68 /
children.translated_text: Or it would be an action serving a purpose, because of subsidiarity — like [the case of] the <s>Śravaṇa</s> [rite], because of the injunction serving that purpose. / Jaim 11.2.68 /
Since the time of the subsidiaries (<s>aṅga</s>) is primarily [that of the principal rite], difference of time [for subsidiaries arises] from [explicit] statement. / Jaim 11.3.1 /

children.text: dravyasya karmakālaniṣpatteḥ prayogaḥ sarvārthaḥ syāt svakālatvāt / Jaim_11,3.2 /
children.translated_text: Since the substance is accomplished at the time of the ritual action, the employment [of the substance] would serve all purposes, because [it takes place at] its own time. / Jaim 11.3.2 /
And the sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>), because [its preparation is] not [restricted to] the time of the [main] action. / Jaim 11.3.3 /
And [the text] shows a single sacrificial post. / Jaim 11.3.4 /
But the consecrations (<s>saṃskāra</s>) should be repeated, because [they occur at] the time of purpose. / Jaim 11.3.5 /

children.text: tatkālas tu yūpakarmatvāt tasya dharmavidhānāt sarvārthānāṃ ca vacanād anyakālatvam / Jaim_11,3.6 /
children.translated_text: But [the preparation of the post occurs at] that time, because it is an act pertaining to the post; because of the injunction of its properties; and because of the statement [applying to] all purposes, there is difference of time. / Jaim 11.3.6 /
And [the text] shows a single measurement. / Jaim 11.3.7 /
The <s>svaru</s> (wooden peg) should be released [from obligation] at the conclusion of <s>tantra</s> (unified performance), because [its time is] not its own. / Jaim 11.3.8 /
Or [there is] subsequent accomplishment in [what is] common, because of its commonality. / Jaim 11.3.9 /
And at the end of the <s>Soma</s> [sacrifice], because of the observation of acquisition. / Jaim 11.3.10 /

children.text: na cotpattivākyatvāt pradeśāt prastare tathā / Jaim_11,3.11 /
children.translated_text: And not [as prescribed] at [another] place, because of being a sentence of origination; likewise regarding the <s>prastara</s> (grass bundle). / Jaim 11.3.11 /

children.text: ahargaṇe viṣāṇāprāsanaṃ dharmavipratiṣedhād ante prathame vāhani vikalpaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,3.12 /
children.translated_text: In [a sacrificial session of] multiple days, the placement of the horn [cup] — because of conflict with the [prescribed] property, there would be an option: at the end or on the first day. / Jaim 11.3.12 /

children.text: pāṇes tv aśrutibhūtatvād viṣāṇāniyamaḥ syāt prātaḥ savanamadhyatvāc chiṣṭe cābhipravṛttatvāt / Jaim_11,3.13 /
children.translated_text: But for the hand [cup], because of not being [established by] <s>śruti</s>, there should be no restriction to the horn [cup]; [it should be] in the middle of the morning pressing, and because of being engaged [only] when instructed. / Jaim 11.3.13 /
And because of being engaged [only] when instructed. / Jaim 11.3.14 /

children.text: vāgvisargo haviṣkṛtā vījabhede tathā syāt / Jaim_11,3.15 /
children.translated_text: The utterance of speech in the <s>haviṣkṛt</s> [ceremony], when there is a difference of seed [i.e. the soma plant], should be likewise. / Jaim 11.3.15 /
If [one says] 'according to the invocation' also — / Jaim 11.3.16 /

children.text: paśau ca puroḍāśe samānatantraṃ bhavet / Jaim_11,3.17 /
children.translated_text: And in the animal [sacrifice] and the <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice-cake offering), the <s>tantra</s> (unified performance) would be the same. / Jaim 11.3.17 /

children.text: aṅgapradhānārtho yogaḥ sarvāpavarge vimokaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,3.18 /
children.translated_text: The yoking [of subsidiary to principal] serves the purpose of the subsidiary and principal; upon the conclusion of all, there should be release. / Jaim 11.3.18 /
Or upon the conclusion of the principal, because [the subsidiary] serves that purpose. / Jaim 11.3.19 /

children.text: avabhṛthe ca tadvat pradhānārthasya pratiṣedho 'pavṛktārthatvāt / Jaim_11,3.20 /
children.translated_text: And in the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath), likewise — the prohibition of what serves the principal's purpose, because [its] purpose has been discharged. / Jaim 11.3.20 /

children.text: ahargaṇe ca pratyahaṃ syāt tadarthatvāt / Jaim_11,3.21 /
children.translated_text: And in [a session of] multiple days, it should be [performed] each day, because it serves that purpose. / Jaim 11.3.21 /
But the <s>Subrahmaṇyā</s> [litany] should be a <s>tantra</s> (unified performance), because [it occurs at] a different time, like the <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation). / Jaim 11.3.22 /

children.text: tatkālāt tv ādāvarteta prayāgato viśeṣasambandhāt / Jaim_11,3.23 /
children.translated_text: But from that time onward, it should be repeated, because of the specific connection with the performance. / Jaim 11.3.23 /
If [one says it is] a subsidiary not connected with performance — / Jaim 11.3.24 /
[No,] because of the indication of performance, like [the case of] difference of performer. / Jaim 11.3.25 /

children.text: tadbhūtasthānād agnivad iti cet tadapavargas tadarthatvāt / Jaim_11,3.26 /
children.translated_text: Because of being in the place of that [principal], like fire — if so, its conclusion [occurs] because of serving that purpose. / Jaim 11.3.26 /
If [one says] 'like fire' — / Jaim 11.3.27 /
No, because of [fire's] being common to [all] performances. / Jaim 11.3.28 /
And because of the observation of indicatory marks. / Jaim 11.3.29 /
If [one says] 'that is indeed so' — / Jaim 11.3.30 /
No, because of [its] not being taught [explicitly], and because of the other principle [applying here]. / Jaim 11.3.31 /
If [one argues] from the oneness of injunction — / Jaim 11.3.32 /

children.text: na kṛtsnasya punaḥ prayogāt pradhānavat / Jaim_11,3.33 /
children.translated_text: No, because of the re-performance of the whole, like the principal [rite]. / Jaim 11.3.33 /
But in a worldly [context], [one may act] as one wishes, because of the loss of the purpose of the consecrations. / Jaim 11.3.34 /
The sacrificial implements should be maintained, because of the injunction of acquisition — like the <s>ṛjīṣa</s> (residue of soma). / Jaim 11.3.35 /

children.text: yajamānasaṃskāro vā tadarthaḥ śrūyate tatra yathākāmī tadarthatvāt / Jaim_11,3.36 /
children.translated_text: Or [the maintenance is] a consecration of the sacrificer — [for] that purpose it is heard [in scripture]; therein, [one acts] as one wishes, because it serves that purpose. / Jaim 11.3.36 /
Or the principal [rule of] maintenance [applies], because death is not fixed [in time]. / Jaim 11.3.37 /

children.text: yo vā yajanīye 'hani mriyeta so 'dhikṛtaḥ syād upaveṣavat / Jaim_11,3.38 /
children.translated_text: Or whoever dies on a day suitable for sacrifice — he would be the eligible person, like [the rule regarding] a substitute (<s>upaveṣa</s>). / Jaim 11.3.38 /
No, because [eligibility is] characterized by <s>śāstra</s>. / Jaim 11.3.39 /
Or [there would be] origination [of eligibility], because of being the impelling cause, like a benediction (<s>āśīr</s>). / Jaim 11.3.40 /
If [one objects that there is] no agreement with the word — / Jaim 11.3.41 /
[There is] the same [issue] in the benediction as well. / Jaim 11.3.42 /

children.text: śāstrāt tu viprayogas tatraikadravyacikīrṣā prakṛtāv athehāpūrvārthavad bhūtopadeśaḥ / Jaim_11,3.43 /
children.translated_text: But the disjunction from <s>śāstra</s> — therein, [when there is] the desire to produce a single substance in the archetype (<s>prakṛti</s>), the teaching would be like [that] of an unprecedented purpose here. / Jaim 11.3.43 /
Because of serving the purpose of the archetype, [the rites] should be performed at the full moon. / Jaim 11.3.44 /

children.text: agnyādheye vāvipratiṣedhāt tāni dhārayen maraṇasyānimittavāt / Jaim_11,3.45 /
children.translated_text: Or, in the <s>agnyādheya</s> (fire-establishment rite), because of non-conflict — one should maintain those, because death is not fixed [as to its cause]. / Jaim 11.3.45 /
Or [there would be] acquisition, as in the case of the others. / Jaim 11.3.46 /
After [the conclusion of] the <s>Soma</s> sacrifices, [the rites] should proceed with [those belonging to] <s>Prajāpati</s>. / Jaim 11.3.47 /
If [one says there would be] a transposition of subsidiaries without [explicit] statement — / Jaim 11.3.48 /
The advancement is because of connection; the time alone [changes] in the other [case]. / Jaim 11.3.49 /
If [one objects] 'because of the absence of the archetype's time' — [like the case of] those who possess <s>śastras</s> (hymns) — / Jaim 11.3.50 /
No, because of the prohibition by <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim 11.3.51 /
If [one argues it is] in the place of a modification (<s>vikāra</s>) — / Jaim 11.3.52 /
No, because of the non-separation of injunction. / Jaim 11.3.53 /

children.text: utkarṣe sūktavākasya na somadevatānām utkarṣaḥ paśvanaṅgatvād yathā niṣkarṣenānvayaḥ / Jaim_11,3.54 /
children.translated_text: In the advancement of the <s>Sūktavāka</s> [hymn], there is no advancement of the <s>Soma</s>-deity [offerings], because the animal [sacrifice] is not a subsidiary [of them]; the connection [should be understood] just as in the case of extraction. / Jaim 11.3.54 /

children.text: vākyasaṃyogād votkarṣaḥ samānatantratvād arthalopād ananvayaḥ / Jaim_11,3.55 /
children.translated_text: Or the advancement [is due to] the connection of the sentence; because of being a common <s>tantra</s>, from the loss of purpose, there is no connection. / Jaim 11.3.55 /

children.text: codanaikatvād rājasūye 'nuktadeśakālānāṃ samavāyāt tantram aṅgāni / Jaim_11,4.1 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>Rājasūya</s> [rite], because of the oneness of injunction, since the subsidiaries — whose place and time are not stated — come together, they should have <s>tantra</s> (unified performance). / Jaim 11.4.1 /

children.text: pratidakṣiṇaṃ vā kartṛsambandhād iṣṭivad aṅgabhūtatvāt samudāyo hi tannirvṛttyātadekatvād ekatvād ekaśabdopadeśaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,4.2 /
children.translated_text: Or [there should be performance] for each <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (priestly fee), because of the connection with the performer — like an <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering), because of being subsidiary. For the aggregate indeed, because of its accomplishment through that [aggregate], because of its unity, the teaching by the singular word would [apply]. / Jaim 11.4.2 /
And thus it is seen from another [authoritative] purpose. / Jaim 11.4.3 /
If [one says] there would be no restriction — / Jaim 11.4.4 /
No, because it has been taught. / Jaim 11.4.5 /
Because of the oneness of purpose. / Jaim 11.4.6 /
The repeated <s>śruti</s> (scriptural text) is for the purpose of non-distinction. / Jaim 11.4.7 /

children.text: aveṣṭau caikatantryaṃ syāl liṅgadarśanād vacanāt kāmasaṃyogena / Jaim_11,4.8 /
children.translated_text: And in the investiture, there should be unified <s>tantra</s> — because of the observation of the indicatory mark, because of the [explicit] statement, and because of the connection with desire. / Jaim 11.4.8 /

children.text: kratvarthāyām iti cen na varṇasaṃyogāt / Jaim_11,4.9 /
children.translated_text: If [one says it is] for the purpose of the rite — no, because of the connection with the <s>varṇa</s> (social class). / Jaim 11.4.9 /
In the <s>Pavamāna</s> offerings, there is unified <s>tantra</s>, because of the oneness of the statement of performance. / Jaim 11.4.10 /
And because of the observation of the indicatory mark. / Jaim 11.4.11 /

children.text: vartamānāpadeśād vacanāt tu tantrabhedaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,4.12 /
children.translated_text: Because of the reference to what is current, from the [explicit] statement, there would be a differentiation of <s>tantra</s>. / Jaim 11.4.12 /
When [they are performed] together, [the text] would be a mere restatement of what is permanent. / Jaim 11.4.13 /

children.text: dvādaśāhe tu prakṛtitvād ekaikam ahar apavṛjyeta karmapṛthaktvāt / Jaim_11,4.14 /
children.translated_text: But in the <s>Dvādaśāha</s> (twelve-day rite), because of being an archetype, each day should be concluded [independently], because of the separateness of actions. / Jaim 11.4.14 /

children.text: ahrāṃ vā śrutibhūtatvāt tatra sāṅgaṃ kriyeta yathā mādhyandine / Jaim_11,4.15 /
children.translated_text: Or, because the days are established by <s>śruti</s>, the [rite] should be performed there with its subsidiaries, as in the midday [pressing]. / Jaim 11.4.15 /

children.text: api vā phalakartṛsambandhāt saha prayogaḥ syād āgneyāgnīṣomīyavat / Jaim_11,4.16 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the connection of the result with the performer, there should be joint performance — like the <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>) and the <s>Āgnīṣomīya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>-<s>Soma</s>). / Jaim 11.4.16 /

children.text: sāṅgakālaśrutitvād vā svasthānānāṃ vikāraḥ syāt / Jaim_11,4.17 /
children.translated_text: Or, because the time along with subsidiaries is established by <s>śruti</s>, there should be modification of those in their own places. / Jaim 11.4.17 /

children.text: dīkṣopasadāṃ ca saṃkhyā pṛthakpṛthak pratyakṣasaṃyogāt / Jaim_11,4.18 /
children.translated_text: And the number of <s>dīkṣā</s> (initiation) and <s>upasad</s> (preparatory rites) [should be determined] separately for each, because of the direct connection [with each day]. / Jaim 11.4.18 /

children.text: vasatīvarīparyantāni pūrvāṇi tantram anyakālatvād avabhṛthādīny uttarāṇi dīkṣāvisargārthatvāt / Jaim_11,4.19 /
children.translated_text: The prior [rites] up to the <s>vasatīvarī</s> (overnight waters) should be <s>tantra</s> (unified), because [they occur at] a different time; the later [rites] beginning with the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath) [are also unified], because they serve the purpose of releasing [from] the <s>dīkṣā</s>. / Jaim 11.4.19 /
And thus it is seen from another [authoritative] purpose. / Jaim 11.4.20 /

children.text: codanāpṛthaktve tv aikatantryaṃ samavetānāṃ kālasaṃyogāt / Jaim_11,4.21 /
children.translated_text: But when there is non-separation of injunction, there should be unified <s>tantra</s> for those that are combined, because of the connection of time. / Jaim 11.4.21 /

children.text: bhedas tu tadbhedāt karamabhedaḥ prayoge syāt teṣāṃ pradhānaśabdatvāt / Jaim_11,4.22 /
children.translated_text: But the differentiation — because of the differentiation of those [rites], the difference of action in performance would be [established], because they are denoted by principal words. / Jaim 11.4.22 /
And thus it is seen from another [authoritative] purpose. / Jaim 11.4.23 /
The non-statement of the <s>Soma</s>-pressing day is likewise. / Jaim 11.4.24 /
And the surplus of animals [is likewise]. / Jaim 11.4.25 /

children.text: sutyāvivṛddhau subrahmaṇyāyāṃ sarveṣām upalakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtyanvayād āvāhanavat / Jaim_11,4.26 /
children.translated_text: In the augmentation of the pressing day, in the <s>Subrahmaṇyā</s> [litany], it is an indication of all [pressings] — because of connection with the archetype, like the invocation. / Jaim 11.4.26 /

children.text: api vendrābhidhānatvāt sakṛt syād upalakṣaṇaṃ kālasya lakṣaṇārthatvāt / Jaim_11,4.27 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the mention of <s>Indra</s>, it would be a single indication — because the time [reference] serves the purpose of indication. / Jaim 11.4.27 /
And because of non-differentiation. / Jaim 11.4.28 /

children.text: paśugaṇe kumbhīśūlavapāśrapaṇīnāṃ prabhutvāt tantrabhāvaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,4.29 /
children.translated_text: In a group of animal [sacrifices], the <s>kumbhī</s> (pot), <s>śūla</s> (spit), and <s>vapāśrapaṇī</s> (omentum-roasting pan) should have <s>tantra</s> (unified) status, because of [one set] sufficing. / Jaim 11.4.29 /

children.text: bhedas tu sandehād devatāntare syāt / Jaim_11,4.30 /
children.translated_text: But there should be differentiation in case of doubt, when there is a different deity. / Jaim 11.4.30 /
Or from the purpose, the indicatory mark would [determine] the action. / Jaim 11.4.31 /

children.text: pratipādyatvād vasānāṃ bhedaḥ syāt svayājyāpradānatvāt / Jaim_11,4.32 /
children.translated_text: Because of [each] needing to be offered, there should be differentiation of the <s>vapā</s> (omental fat portions), because of [each deity] having its own <s>yājyā</s> (offering hymn) and offering. / Jaim 11.4.32 /

children.text: api vā pratipattitvāt tantraṃ syāt svatvasyāśrutibhūtatvāt / Jaim_11,4.33 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of being [merely] an acquisition, there should be <s>tantra</s> (unified performance), because ownership is not established by <s>śruti</s>. / Jaim 11.4.33 /
If [one says] 'once' — / Jaim 11.4.34 /
No, because of difference of time. / Jaim 11.4.35 /
Because of difference of cooking, the <s>kumbhī</s> (pot), <s>śūla</s> (spit), and <s>vapāśrapaṇī</s> (omentum-roasting pan) should be differentiated. / Jaim 11.4.36 /
In [the case of animals of] different species, there should be differentiation, because of inequality of cooking. / Jaim 11.4.37 /
And because of the observation of increase. / Jaim 11.4.38 /
And the potsherds should be like the pot, for those of equal number. / Jaim 11.4.39 /
Or [there should be one set] for each principal [offering], like the archetype. / Jaim 11.4.40 /
Or [there should be one set] for all together at the outset. / Jaim 11.4.41 /
For consecrations of a single substance, it has been explained [that there is] oneness of action. / Jaim 11.4.42 /

children.text: dravyāntare kṛtārthatvāt tasya punaḥ prayogān mantrasya ca tadguṇatvāt punaḥ prayogaḥ syāt tadarthena vidhānāt / Jaim_11,4.43 /
children.translated_text: For a different substance, because the purpose has been fulfilled, the re-performance of the <s>mantra</s> — because of [the mantra] being subsidiary to that [substance] — there should be re-performance, because of the injunction serving that purpose. / Jaim 11.4.43 /
And in the offering, salting, strewing, and taking of ghee, [they should be treated] as for a single substance, because of the oneness of purpose. / Jaim 11.4.44 /
Or it would be like a different substance, because of the consecration of that [substance]. / Jaim 11.4.45 /

children.text: vediprokṣaṇe mantrābhyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ punaḥ prayogāt / Jaim_11,4.46 /
children.translated_text: In the sprinkling of the altar, the repetition of the <s>mantra</s> [is required], because of the re-performance of the action. / Jaim 11.4.46 /

children.text: ekasya vā guṇavidhir dravyaikatvāt tasmāt sakṛt prayogaḥ syāt / Jaim_11,4.47 /
children.translated_text: Or [it is] an injunction of a subsidiary for the one [substance], because of the oneness of substance; therefore there should be a single performance. / Jaim 11.4.47 /
In the scratching [rite], [there should be separate performance] for each limb, because of the difference of action. / Jaim 11.4.48 /

children.text: api vā codanaikakālam aikakarmyaṃ syāt / Jaim_11,4.49 /
children.translated_text: Or, when the injunction is for the same time, there should be oneness of action. / Jaim 11.4.49 /
And likewise in the propitiatory rites for dreams, river-crossing, rain-drenching, and contact with impurity. / Jaim 11.4.50 /
But in the journey [rite], because of the accomplishment of the purpose. / Jaim 11.4.51 /

children.text: uparavamantras tantraṃ syāl lokavad bahuvacanāt / Jaim_11,4.52 /
children.translated_text: The <s>uparava</s> (resting-place) <s>mantra</s> should be <s>tantra</s> (unified), as in the world, because of the plural [form of the word]. / Jaim 11.4.52 /

children.text: na sannipātitvād asannipātikarmaṇāṃ viśeṣagrahaṇe kālaikatvāt sakṛd vacanam / Jaim_11,4.53 /
children.translated_text: No, because of [the elements] being concurrent; for non-concurrent actions, when there is the grasping of a specific [element], because of the oneness of time, there is a single utterance. / Jaim 11.4.53 /
The <s>haviṣkṛt</s>, <s>adhrigu</s>, and <s>puro'nuvākyā</s> of the <s>manotā</s> should be repeated, because of difference of time. / Jaim 11.4.54 /
And [there should be] transposition of the <s>adhrigu</s>. / Jaim 11.4.55 /
Because of the statement in the future tense. / Jaim 11.4.56 /

children.text: tantrisamavāye codanātaḥ samānānām ekatantryam atulyeṣu tu bhedaḥ syād vidhiprakramatād arthyāt śrutikālanirdeśāt / Jaim_12,1.1 /
children.translated_text: In the co-occurrence of <s>tantra</s> (unified) and [separate performances], from the injunction, those that are identical should have unified <s>tantra</s>; but when they are unequal, there should be differentiation — because of the nature of the injunctive sequence, because of purpose, and because of the indication of <s>śruti</s> and time. / Jaim 12.1.1 /
And because of the modification of subsidiary, time, and variant, there should be differentiation of <s>tantra</s>. / Jaim 12.1.2 /

children.text: tantramadhye vidhānād vā mukhyatantreṇa siddhiḥ syāt tantrārthasyāviśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_12,1.3 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of the injunction within <s>tantra</s>, accomplishment should be through the principal <s>tantra</s>, because the purpose of <s>tantra</s> is undifferentiated. / Jaim 12.1.3 /

children.text: vikārāc ca na bhedaḥ syād arthasyāvikṛtatvāt / Jaim_12,1.4 /
children.translated_text: And because of a modification, there should be no differentiation, because the purpose is unmodified. / Jaim 12.1.4 /
Or, because of the incapacity of some [elements to be performed together]. (Jaim. 12.1.5)
The <s>āhopurīṣaka</s> (ash-removal rite) should [be performed once for all]. (Jaim. 12.1.6)
And the observation is like that of the <s>ekāgni</s> (single-fire rite). (Jaim. 12.1.7)
According to <s>Jaimini</s>, since dependence on another [rite] would result, there should be a prohibition of independent [performance]. (Jaim. 12.1.8)

children.text: nānārthatvāt some darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtīnāṃ vedikarma syāt / Jaim_12,1.9 /
children.translated_text: Because of the multiplicity of purposes, in the <s>Soma</s> sacrifice the <s>vedi</s>-making should follow the model of <s>Darśapūrṇamāsa</s> (new- and full-moon rites). (Jaim. 12.1.9)
Or it would be a non-rite, being a defect of what has already been accomplished. (Jaim. 12.1.10)

children.text: pātreṣu ca prasaṅgaḥ syād dhomārthatvāt / Jaim_12,1.11 /
children.translated_text: And with respect to the vessels, <s>prasaṅga</s> (incidental application) would arise, since they serve the purpose of oblation. (Jaim. 12.1.11)

children.text: nyāyyāni vā prayuktatvād aprayukte prasaṅgaḥ syāt / Jaim_12,1.12 /
children.translated_text: Or they are appropriate, being [already] employed; <s>prasaṅga</s> (incidental application) would arise [only] for what is not employed. (Jaim. 12.1.12)

children.text: śāmitre ca paśupuroḍāśo na syād itarasya prayuktatvāt / Jaim_12,1.13 /
children.translated_text: And in the <s>śāmitra</s> (rite for the Śamitṛ priest), the <s>paśupuroḍāśa</s> (animal cake-offering) should not apply, since the other [element] is already employed. (Jaim. 12.1.13)

children.text: śrapaṇaṃ vāgnihotrasya śālāmukhīye na syāt prājahitasya vidyamānatvāt / Jaim_12,1.14 /
children.translated_text: Or the cooking of the <s>Agnihotra</s> should not take place at the <s>śālāmukhīya</s> (hall-entrance fire), since the <s>prājahita</s> (fire carried forward) already exists. (Jaim. 12.1.14)
The two [fires] in the <s>havirdhāna</s> (Soma-cart shed) should accomplish the purpose of offering, since they are [already] employed. (Jaim. 12.1.15)

children.text: asiddhir vānyadeśatvāt pradhānavaiguṇyād avaiguṇye prasaṅgaḥ syāt / Jaim_12,1.16 /
children.translated_text: Or there would be non-accomplishment because of being in a different location; due to a defect in the principal [rite], <s>prasaṅga</s> (incidental application) would arise when there is no defect. (Jaim. 12.1.16)
And because carts are observed [in such use]. (Jaim. 12.1.17)
And the appropriateness of that [connection] is due to the difference in time. (Jaim. 12.1.18)
And the <s>mantras</s> [are performed once], since they are concurrent. (Jaim. 12.1.19)
In the <s>Soma</s> sacrifice, the <s>agnyanvādhāna</s> (replenishing of the fire) does not apply, since it serves the purpose of maintaining [the fire]. (Jaim. 12.1.20)
Likewise the <s>vrata</s> (observance) [does not apply], since it has been departed from. (Jaim. 12.1.21)
And because of mutual contradiction. (Jaim. 12.1.22)
If [one argues] that it is like [the rule regarding] <s>Satya</s> — (Jaim. 12.1.23)
No, because of the separateness of the combination. (Jaim. 12.1.24)

children.text: grahārthaṃ ca pūrvam iṣṭes tadarthatvāt / Jaim_12,1.25 /
children.translated_text: And the first [rite] before the <s>iṣṭi</s> (offering) is for the purpose of the <s>graha</s> (Soma-cup), since it serves that purpose. (Jaim. 12.1.25)

children.text: śeṣavad iti cen na vaiśvadevo hi syād vyapadeśāt / Jaim_12,1.26 /
children.translated_text: If [one argues] that it is like a subsidiary — no, for it should be the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> [offering], as indicated by the designation. (Jaim. 12.1.26)
No, because it serves the purpose of a subordinate element. (Jaim. 12.1.27)
And the girding [is not repeated], since it has [already] been accomplished. (Jaim. 12.1.28)

children.text: anyavidhānād āraṇyabhojanaṃ na syād ubhayaṃ hi vṛttyartham / Jaim_12,1.29 /
children.translated_text: Because of a separate injunction, eating in the forest should not apply, for both serve the purpose of sustenance. (Jaim. 12.1.29)
If [one argues] that the eating of remnants is likewise — no, because it serves a different purpose. (Jaim. 12.1.30)
And the purchase [is not repeated], since the person is [already] hired. (Jaim. 12.1.31)
If [one argues] that the eating of remnants is likewise — (Jaim. 12.1.32)
No, because of its connection with the ritual act. (Jaim. 12.1.33)

children.text: pravṛttavaraṇāt prati tantravaraṇāt pratitantravaraṇaṃ hotuḥ kriyeta / Jaim_12,1.34 /
children.translated_text: Because the selection has commenced, the selection for each <s>tantra</s> (unified performance) — the selection per <s>tantra</s> — should be made by the <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoking priest). (Jaim. 12.1.34)
If [one argues] that the <s>Brahman</s> (priest) also [should select] — (Jaim. 12.1.35)
No, because of the prior restriction, for it serves that purpose. (Jaim. 12.1.36)
If [one argues] that [the restriction applies] to what is explicitly mentioned — (Jaim. 12.1.37)
No, because it is [already] stated in scripture. (Jaim. 12.1.38)
If [one argues] that the <s>Hotṛ</s> likewise [is restricted] — (Jaim. 12.1.39)
No, because of the connection with the ritual act. (Jaim. 12.1.40)

When instruction concerns the origination of the sacrifice, because of the difference in the procedure of completed rites, it should be performed per <s>tantra</s> (each unified performance separately). (Jaim. 12.1.41)
The <s>mantra</s> is distinguished because of the difference in location. (Jaim. 12.1.42)
If [one argues] that the girding and removal are likewise — (Jaim. 12.1.43)
No, because they serve a different purpose. (Jaim. 12.1.44)

children.text: vihāro laukikānām arthaṃ sādhayet prabhutvāt / Jaim_12,2.1 /
children.translated_text: <s>Vihāra</s> (modification of ritual procedure) should accomplish the purpose of secular [acts], since one has authority [over them]. (Jaim. 12.2.1)
And the prohibition of cooking meat is likewise. (Jaim. 12.2.2)
Or, because of explicit statement, it should apply to Vedic [acts]. (Jaim. 12.2.3)
And when [the fire] exists, because attendance [to it] is observed. (Jaim. 12.2.4)
And because non-existence [of the fire] is observed [otherwise]. (Jaim. 12.2.5)
The prohibition of cooking meat should apply to what is enjoined, because of connection with the oblation. (Jaim. 12.2.6)
Or it is a completion of the sentence, in the southern [fire], since it is not an independent injunction. (Jaim. 12.2.7)

children.text: savanīye chidrāpidhānārthatvāt paśupuroḍāśo na syād anyeṣām evam arthatvāt / Jaim_12,2.8 /
children.translated_text: In the <s>savanīya</s> (Soma-pressing rites), the <s>paśupuroḍāśa</s> (animal cake-offering) should not apply, since it serves the purpose of covering a gap, because others serve the same purpose. (Jaim. 12.2.8)
Or the rite [should apply], since it serves the purpose of the deity. (Jaim. 12.2.9)
Because of the observation of an indicatory sign. (Jaim. 12.2.10)

children.text: haviṣkṛt savanīyeṣu na syāt prakṛtau yadi sarvārthā paśuṃ pratyāhūtā sā kuryād vidyamānatvāt / Jaim_12,2.11 /
children.translated_text: The <s>haviṣkṛt</s> (fire-preparation rite) should not apply in the <s>savanīya</s> rites; if in the <s>prakṛti</s> (model rite) [the deity] is summoned back for all purposes toward the animal, she should perform [the rite], since [that deity] already exists. (Jaim. 12.2.11)
But when the animal has been consecrated, [it should apply] because of the injunction. (Jaim. 12.2.12)

children.text: yogād vā yajñāya tadvimoke visargaḥ syāt / Jaim_12,2.13 /
children.translated_text: Or, by connection with the sacrifice, upon its release there should be dismissal. (Jaim. 12.2.13)

children.text: niśi yajñe prākṛtasyāpravṛttiḥ syāt pratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt / Jaim_12,2.14 /
children.translated_text: In a sacrifice [performed] at night, the <s>prākṛta</s> (model-rite element) should not apply, since it is taught by direct perception. (Jaim. 12.2.14)
And because of the difference in time-statements, there should be a difference in <s>tantra</s> (unified performance). (Jaim. 12.2.15)

children.text: vedyuddhananavrataṃ vipratiṣedhāt tad eva syāt / Jaim_12,2.16 /
children.translated_text: The <s>vedi</s>-raising observance, because of mutual contradiction, should be that [particular one] alone. (Jaim. 12.2.16)

children.text: tantramadhye vidhānād vā tattantrā savanīyavat / Jaim_12,2.17 /
children.translated_text: Or, because of an injunction within the <s>tantra</s> (unified performance), [the rite] belongs to that <s>tantra</s>, like the <s>savanīya</s> rites. (Jaim. 12.2.17)

children.text: vaiguṇyād idhmabarhir na sādhayed agnyanvādhānaṃ ca yadi devatārtham / Jaim_12,2.18 /
children.translated_text: Due to a defect, the fuel-grass should not accomplish [its purpose], and the <s>agnyanvādhāna</s> (replenishing of fire) [likewise], if it serves the purpose of the deity. (Jaim. 12.2.18)
And the <s>agnyanvādhāna</s> (replenishing of the fire), if it serves the purpose of the deity. (Jaim. 12.2.19)

children.text: ārambhaṇīyā vikṛtau na syāt prakṛtikālamadhyatvāt kṛtā punas tadarthena / Jaim_12,2.20 /
children.translated_text: The <s>ārambhaṇīyā</s> (initiatory offering) should not apply in the <s>vikṛti</s> (modified rite), since it falls within the time of the <s>prakṛti</s> (model rite), having been performed [there] for that purpose. (Jaim. 12.2.20)
Because of the connection with a single commencement. (Jaim. 12.2.21)
Or it should apply, since the time is not exhausted [by the model rite]. (Jaim. 12.2.22)
And because of the division of commencements. (Jaim. 12.2.23)

children.text: vipratiṣiddhadharmāṇāṃ samavāye bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharmakatvam / Jaim_12,2.24 /
children.translated_text: When [rites] having mutually contradictory properties come together, the character of the majority should prevail. (Jaim. 12.2.24)
Or the principal [property should prevail], because of the prior injunction, as in worldly [practice]. (Jaim. 12.2.25)
And thus observation of [its serving] another purpose [is seen]. (Jaim. 12.2.26)
And when there is conflict between a subsidiary and a subordinate element, [priority is determined] by the relation of subservience. (Jaim. 12.2.27)
The <s>paridhi</s> (enclosing stick) should have the properties of both, since it serves a dual purpose. (Jaim. 12.2.28)

children.text: yaupyas tu virodhe syān mukhyānantaryāt / Jaim_12,2.29 /
children.translated_text: But the <s>yūpa</s> (sacrificial post), in case of conflict, should [follow the principal], because of its immediate connection with the principal [rite]. (Jaim. 12.2.29)

children.text: itaro vā tasya tatra vidhānād ubhayoś cāṅgasaṃyogaḥ / Jaim_12,2.30 /
children.translated_text: Or the other [should prevail], since it is enjoined in that [context], and both have subsidiary connection. (Jaim. 12.2.30)

children.text: paśusavanīyeṣu vikalpaḥ syād vaikṛtaś ced ubhayor aśrutibhūtatvāt / Jaim_12,2.31 /
